reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to this massage shop for about 15 years, since they were still in their first unit at the beginning of the building. Now they’ve moved to the second unit, and they are still the best.
Over the years, I’ve tried many other massage places, but I was often disappointed with the results. That’s why even though I now live in Pattaya City center, in Soi Buakhao, I still travel to Jomtien twice a week just for my massage here.
The owner, Khun Phom, has fixed my back pain many times — not just once. Around six or seven years ago, she treated me using GESA therapy, and since then I always request her whenever I have any muscle pain or discomfort. She truly knows how to relieve muscle tension and back pain. She really knows what she’s doing.
Every time I leave, I feel relieved, healed, satisfied, and happy.
I highly recommend this place to everyone. They are simply excellent.

ดูแลโดยครูผู้มีประสบการณ์มากว่า 15 ปี เน้นความปลอดภัย การจัดแนวร่างกายที่ถูกต้อง และการฝึกที่เหมาะกับแต่ละบุคคล

เราโดดเด่นด้าน Pilates Reformer ควบคู่กับ Yoga เพื่อการฟื้นฟู ช่วยเสริมสร้างแกนกลาง ลดอาการปวดหลัง ปวดเข่า ปวดไหล่ และเพิ่มความแข็งแรงอย่างอ่อนโยน

เหมาะสำหรับผู้เริ่มต้น ผู้ใหญ่ ผู้สูงอายุ และผู้ที่มองหา Pilates Reformer ใกล้ฉัน ในปากน้ำ หรือสตูดิโอโยคะในสมุทรปราการ

บรรยากาศสงบ เป็นกันเอง สะอาด ไม่เร่งเร้า
คลาสกลุ่มขนาดเล็ก ดูแลใกล้ชิด เหมาะกับคนทำงานและผู้ที่ต้องการฟื้นฟูอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป
มีทั้งคลาสกลุ่ม คลาสส่วนตัว และรับสอนนอกสถานที่

หายใจที่เคซี
address: 149/19 ซ 8 Sai Luat Rd, อ.เมือง Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand
plusCode: HJH2+F9 Samut Prakan, Pak Nam, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text: เคซีโยคะ & พิลาทิส สตูดิโอ ปรับขยายพื้นที่รองรับคลาส Pilates Reformer ทั้งกลุ่มเล็กและส่วนตัว

reviews.name: Apinan Chattupan
reviews.text:
This yoga studio is located on Sai luat rd. It's not too far from the main road and there's parking available in front.

The studio provides yoga mats, so you don't need to bring your own. They offer both group and private classes.

The classes are easy to follow and not too difficult, making them perfect for beginners. I would also recommend this studio to people with office syndrome.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากนะคะที่แบ่งปันประสบการณ์ค่ะ
ยินดีที่ทำเล การจอดรถ และอุปกรณ์ของสตูดิโอช่วยให้มาเรียนได้สะดวก
ดีใจที่คลาสเหมาะกับผู้เริ่มต้น และช่วยดูแลอาการออฟฟิศซินโดรมได้
ทางเรายินดีดูแลการฝึกอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไปเสมอค่ะ

reviews.name: Varisara S.
reviews.text:
คุณครูสอนสนุกพิลาทิสและโยคะ
ชอบโยคะมากๆ สบายตัวมากค่ะ
สถานที่สะอาดดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The instructor teaches fun Pilates and yoga.
I really like yoga; it's very relaxing.
The place is clean.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณสำหรับรีวิวมากค่ะ 🙏
เคซีโยคะตั้งใจดูแลทั้งบรรยากาศ ความสะอาด และความรู้สึกอบอุ่นเป็นกันเอง เพื่อให้ทุกครั้งที่มาได้ฝึกอย่างสบายใจ เหมือนอยู่ในพื้นที่ที่คุ้นเคยและผ่อนคลายค่ะ
ดีใจมากที่ทำเลใกล้ BTS ช่วยให้การเดินทางสะดวกขึ้นนะคะ
ขอบคุณที่มอบความไว้วางใจให้เราได้ดูแลค่ะ 💛

reviews.name: Nicharat Phatharataweesert
reviews.text: สถานที่เรียนโล่งโปล่งสะอาดดี  มีสิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกครบ เคยเรียนมาแล้วเพื่อนแนะนำมาหลังจากนั้นก็ไม่ได้มาอีก  ที่มาก็เพราะปวดหลัง  คอบ่าไหล่มาก ตอนนี้กลับมาเรียนใหม่  อาการดังกล่าวค่อยๆหาย  สำหรับครูสอนก็เอาใจใส่ดี  คอยแนะนำและดูแลอย่างใกล้ชิด  การเล่นโยค่ะนี้ดีจริงๆ  อาการปวดต่างๆ  หายแล้วยังทำให้หุ่นเฟริมอีกค่ะ!!!
reviews.textTranslated: The learning space is spacious, clean, and well-equipped. I've taken classes here before, recommended by a friend, but didn't come back until now. I returned because of severe back, neck, and shoulder pain. Now that I'm back, those symptoms are gradually disappearing. The instructor is attentive, providing close guidance and supervision. Yoga is truly amazing! My pain is gone, and it's even helped me get a firmer body!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ คุณปลัดนก  ครูดีใจมากค่ะที่คุณปลัดได้กลับมาฝึกโยคะที่นี้อีกครั้งค่ะ

reviews.name: Kitiya Kumplee
reviews.text: เป็นมนุษย์ตัวตึงมากนานมาก มาเรียนที่นี่คุณครูน่ารักและใจดีมากๆ สอนละเอียด เรียนได้ไม่นานรู้สึกร่างกายดีขึ้น ตัวยังตึงพอควรแต่ใช้ชีวิตได้ดีกว่าที่ผ่านมาสุดๆ แฮปปี้มากๆ แนะนำให้มาเรียนมาฝึกที่นี่ได้เลย สถานที่ดี คุณครูน่ารักมากๆ สุขภาพดีขึ้นมากๆเช่นกัน
reviews.textTranslated: I was very stiff for a long time. Coming here to learn, the teachers are so lovely and kind, and they teach in detail. Even though I haven't been learning for long, I already feel much better. My body is still a bit stiff, but I can live my life so much better than before. I'm so happy! I highly recommend coming to learn and train here. The place is great, the teachers are wonderful, and my health has improved so much.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากๆ เลยนะคะ 🥰
ดีใจมากที่การฝึกช่วยให้ร่างกายดีขึ้น และใช้ชีวิตสบายขึ้นนะคะ เรื่อง “ตัวตึง” ค่อยๆ ดีขึ้นได้แน่นอนค่ะ ขอแค่ฝึกอย่างสม่ำเสมอและฟังร่างกายไปทีละนิด 💛

ครูกัญและทีมงานดีใจมากที่ได้เป็นส่วนหนึ่งของการดูแลสุขภาพนะคะ
ขอบคุณสำหรับคำแนะนำและความไว้วางใจที่มีให้ KC Yoga & Pilates Studio ค่ะ 🙏✨

reviews.name: Suleerak Pugwat
reviews.text: ลงเรียนโยคะมาหลายครอสแล้วค่ะ ครูผู้สอนดูแลเอาใจใส่ดีค่ะและช่วยปรับท่าทางให้ถูกต้อง ที่ศูนย์ฝึกมีกิจกรรมหลากหลาย เช่น โยคะร้อน, Inside flow และ Pilate Reformer สถานที่กว้างขวาง ไม่อึดอัด สะอาดดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I've taken several yoga classes here. The instructors are attentive and help correct my posture. The center offers a variety of activities such as hot yoga, Inside Flow, and Pilates Reformer. The place is spacious, comfortable, and clean.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากนะคะ 💛
ดีใจที่ได้เป็นส่วนหนึ่งของการดูแลสุขภาพและการฝึกของคุณมาตลอดค่ะ 😊
KC ตั้งใจให้ทุกคลาสอบอุ่น ฝึกได้หลากหลาย และรู้สึกสบายเหมือนได้มีเวลาคุณภาพให้ตัวเองนะคะ 🙏✨

reviews.name: Pornchai Chaiyapon
reviews.text: มาเล่นที่ KC โยคะ เป็นเวลา 3 ปึแล้ว สนุกสนาน บรรยากาศเป็นกันเอง ปัญหาคอ บ่า ไหล่ที่ยึดมานาน ดีขึ้นมากเลย ขอบคุณครูกัญมากครับ
reviews.textTranslated: I've been practicing at KC Yoga for 3 years now. It's fun and the atmosphere is friendly. My long-standing neck, shoulder, and back stiffness has improved a lot. Thank you so much, Teacher Kanya!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณคุณเปามากนะคะ 🙏😊
ที่แบ่งเวลาดูแลสุขภาพกับ KC Yoga มาตลอด 3 ปี ดีใจมากเลยค่ะที่อาการคอ บ่า ไหล่ดีขึ้น 🩵
ครูกัญและทีมงานยินดีมากๆ ที่ได้ดูแลนะคะ

reviews.name: Sunshine Lenso
reviews.text: ครูกัญ ค่อนข้าง เคี่ยวมาก เน้นขาย course ให้จ่าย ยาวๆ แต่มี hidden เยอะ จะลาหรือเลื่อน ต้องมีหลักฐาน ใบรับรองแพทย์ การสอน เบสิคทั่วไป ไม่แนะนำครับ
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Kan is quite strict, focusing on selling long-term courses, but there are many hidden fees. You need proof, such as a medical certificate, to take leave or postpone classes. The teaching is basic and general; I wouldn't recommend it.

reviews.name: pare yingman
reviews.text: มีคลาสฝึกโยคะหลายแบบให้เลือก คุณครูคอยแนะนำช่วยดูแลตลอด และราคาคอร์สดีงามมากกค่า
reviews.textTranslated: There are many types of yoga classes to choose from, the instructors are always helpful and supportive, and the course prices are excellent!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณมากนะคะ 💖🙏
ดีใจมากเลยค่ะที่ชอบบรรยากาศของ KC และรู้สึกสะดวกกับตารางคลาสที่มีให้เลือกหลากหลาย 😊
ทางทีมครูตั้งใจดูแลให้ทุกคนได้ฝึกอย่างสบายใจ ในบรรยากาศที่ผ่อนคลายและเป็นกันเองค่ะ

ขอบคุณสำหรับกำลังใจดี ๆ และหวังว่าจะได้ดูแลคุณต่อไปเรื่อย ๆ นะคะ 🌿✨
“หายใจที่เคซี” ด้วยกันค่ะ 💕

reviews.name: Paiir oo
reviews.text:
แนะนำ KC โยคะค่ะ คุณครูใจดี
สถานที่โล่งโปร่งสบาย มีหลายคลาสให้เลือกสรร ตามความสนใจ เวลาเรียนมีหลายเวลาตามความสะดวก👍👍
reviews.textTranslated:
I recommend KC Yoga. The teachers are kind.
The place is spacious and comfortable. There are many classes to choose from according to your interests. Class times are flexible to suit your convenience. 👍👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณมากนะคะ 💖🙏
ดีใจมากเลยค่ะที่ชอบบรรยากาศของ KC และประทับใจในการดูแลของคุณครู 😊
ทางศูนย์ตั้งใจให้ทุกคนได้ฝึกในบรรยากาศที่โล่ง โปร่ง สบาย และเลือกคลาสได้เหมาะกับตัวเองทั้งเรื่องรูปแบบและช่วงเวลาเรียนค่ะ 🌿✨

ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวน่ารัก ๆ และกำลังใจดี ๆ นะคะ
หวังว่าจะได้ “หายใจที่เคซี” ด้วยกันไปอีกนานค่ะ 💕

reviews.name: Sompreaw Benchawi
reviews.text:
มาเรียนโยคะที่นี่ดีมาก ครูฝึกสอนแต่ละท่าให้ถูกต้อง
สถานที่ฝึกสะอาดและเงียบสงบ
ฝึกแล้วและ cardio ไปด้วย
reviews.textTranslated:
Learning yoga here is great. The instructor teaches each pose correctly.
The place is clean and quiet.
I do a yoga session and cardio at the same time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากนะคะ 🥰
ดีใจที่ชอบการฝึกและบรรยากาศของ KC ค่ะ ครูตั้งใจดูท่าให้ถูกต้องเพื่อให้ได้ทั้งความแข็งแรงและสุขภาพที่ดีนะคะ 💛🙏

reviews.name: Little เหม่ง
reviews.text: สะถานที่สะอาด ครูที่นี่ใจดีน่ารัก ใส่ใจดูแลผู้ฝึกทุกคนอย่างทั่วถึงค่ะ ♥️♥️
reviews.textTranslated: The place is clean, and the instructors here are kind and lovely, taking good care of all the trainees. ♥️♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณมากนะคะ 💖🙏
ดีใจมากที่ชอบบรรยากาศและการดูแลของครู ๆ ที่ KC ค่ะ
ทางสตูดิโอตั้งใจดูแลผู้ฝึกทุกท่านอย่างเต็มที่เสมอ ทั้งเรื่องความสะอาด ความปลอดภัย และบรรยากาศการฝึกที่อบอุ่นสบายใจ 🧘‍♀️✨

ขอบคุณสำหรับกำลังใจดี ๆ นะคะ แล้วพบกันในคลาสค่ะ ♥️

reviews.name: Phawisakan Kunyosying
reviews.text: อุปกร์ณ พื้นที่สะอาด ครูสอนละเอียด ประทับใจมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The equipment and area were clean, the instructor taught thoroughly, I was very impressed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณมากนะคะ ดีใจมากที่คุณประทับใจทั้งอุปกรณ์ พื้นที่ฝึก และการสอนของครู แล้วพบกันอีกนะคะ

reviews.name: Katy Narisa
reviews.text: เรียน พิลาทิส บนเครื่องรีฟอเมอร์  สถานที่ร่มรื่น ห้องเรียนสะอาด คุณครูสอนดี เข้าใจง่าย ได้ออกกำลังร่างกายทุกส่วนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I learned Pilates on the Reformer machine. The place is shady, the classroom is clean, the instructor is good and explains things easily. I got a full-body workout.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณมากนะคะ ดีใจมากที่คุณชอบบรรยากาศห้องเรียนและสนุกกับการฝึกรีฟอร์เมอร์ ขอบคุณที่ไว้วางใจมาเริ่มต้นฝึกกับครูกัญนะคะ แล้วพบกันอีกในคลาสต่อไปค่ะ

reviews.name: Wanvilai Kl
reviews.text: เป็นคลาสเรียนโยคะที่ช่วยคืนความยืดหยุ่นให้ร่างกายได้ดีมากๆเลยค่ะ สถานที่เรียนสะอาด ได้รับการดูแลอย่างดี มีอุปกรณ์ให้พร้อม ครูกัญใจดีมากๆ เข้าใจร่างกายผู้เรียนแต่ละคนว่าควรฝึกประมาณไหนให้ได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดีกับร่างกายโดยไม่บาดเจ็บ ช่วงนี้พอมีเวลาเราเลือกเรียนแบบ unlimited เห็นการเปลี่ยนแปลงของร่างกายชัดเจนเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This yoga class is amazing for restoring flexibility! The place is clean, well-maintained, and fully equipped. The instructor, Kanya, is incredibly kind and understanding, knowing exactly how much practice is best for each student to achieve optimal results without injury. Since I have more free time lately, I've opted for the unlimited session, and I've seen a clear improvement in my body.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ

reviews.name: Suthin Narak
reviews.text: ใครกำลังมองหาที่เรียนโยคะ แนะนำ เคซี โยคะเลยค่ะ สถานที่สะอาด สิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกในการเรียนโยคะที่ครบครัน พร้อมครูที่เป็นกันเองและใส่ใจนักเรียนมาก ในราคาย่อมเยาว์ 🤗🥰❤️
reviews.textTranslated: If you're looking for a place to learn yoga, I highly recommend KC Yoga. The place is clean, has complete facilities for yoga classes, and the teachers are friendly and attentive to students, all at an affordable price. 🤗🥰❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณมากนะคะที่ไว้วางใจและแนะนำเคซีโยคะค่ะ คำชมเรื่องสถานที่ ความพร้อมของอุปกรณ์ และความใส่ใจของครู เป็นกำลังใจให้เรามากจริงๆ ค่ะ

reviews.name: Em-On Thaenchamrat
reviews.text: สถานที่สะอาด ครูสอนดีมาก จากที่ประจำเดือนหายไปหลายเดือนก็กลับมาเป็นอีก ดีใจมากๆๆ จากการไปเรียนแล้วประทับใจหลายๆอย่าง ขอให้คนที่สนใจในการอออกกำลังกาย โยคะก็เป็นอีกการออกกำลังกายที่ดีมากๆนะคะ ได้ทั้งสุขภาพที่ดีภายในสู้ภายนอกค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The place is clean, and the instructor is excellent. My period, which had been absent for several months, has returned, which made me very happy! I was very impressed with many things after attending the class. I highly recommend yoga to anyone interested in exercising; it's a great way to improve your health both inside and out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆ ค่ะคุณเอม สำหรับการรีวิวเพื่อให้บางท่านที่มีปัญหาด้านสุภาพ มีแนวทางเลือกการรักษาเพิ่มขึ้นอีกค่ะ

reviews.name: usathinee yingmann
reviews.text:
สถานที่สะอาด ปลอดโปร่ง บรรยายสบายๆ

reviews.name: Bree Mogg
reviews.text:
I had an awesome experience at Kong Phuket Strength and Conditioning Gym. I went for an open gym session, and from the moment I walked in, the staff were super friendly and welcoming.
The gym is more geared toward CrossFit/Hyrox-style training, and as a former bodybuilder/weightlifter, I was initially a bit intimidated—but that ended up being completely unnecessary. The environment was welcoming, and I felt comfortable right away.
The facility was clean, well-equipped, and had a great atmosphere. The music was exactly what you want in a gym—high energy and motivating, the kind that actually makes you want to push harder.
It was my first time there, and the staff even gave us complimentary passes to try one of their classes. My friend took the class (and it absolutely kicked her butt 😂), while I stayed back and enjoyed a smoothie from their smoothie bar—which was a perfect touch.
They also had fans running throughout the space, which made a big difference in the Phuket heat and made the workout much more manageable.
If I lived here, this would 100% be my home gym. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great workout environment in Phuket.

reviews.name: Nicola Kong
reviews.text:
Man I can’t say enough about how much I love this place. It was our first time and it was such a great experience that we ended up just coming back here our entire holiday!

Huge open-air space right next to the trees, high ceiling, super clean and well maintained equipment and facility - that was a plus point for us ⭐️

Zen recovery area at the back with proper ice bath machines, sauna and chill out space too.

We really loved the Primal series classes by Coach Darius and Cedric. Very well-structured with detailed warmups & cool downs. I really appreciate how they pushed us when needed, but also modified exercises according to past injuries I had.

100% recommend, we WILL be back for more on our next visit!

reviews.name: Francine Miceli
reviews.text:
Kong is an amazing gym with such a great atmosphere. The space is clean, well equipped and has everything you need for a really good workout.

What I love most is the energy of the place. It feels welcoming, motivating and never intimidating. The equipment is excellent, the gym is very well maintained, and you can tell a lot of care goes into creating a great experience for members.

The staff are friendly, helpful and professional, which makes such a difference. I always enjoy training here and would highly recommend Kong to anyone looking for a quality gym. Definitely 5 stars!

reviews.name: Koen Vrints
reviews.text:
Came to Thailand to prepare for my next Hyrox event. I could not think of a better place to train then here. Very good instructors and everything is clean.
Recovery place with sauna and ice bath is something you have to try when you go.

reviews.name: Ирина Москвина
reviews.text:
Sunday morning.

A construction car pulled up this morning and worked right at the entrance for a long time with the engine running, the smell of gasoline was all over the hall. Yoga takes place once a week on Sundays at 8 a.m., when you want to tune in to comfort and peace. Is it really unfashionable to provide the owner of the gym and negotiate with the neighbors at least once a week so that you can be calm and not stink of fuel when you are in a meditative state of mind and body?

reviews.name: George Hellyer
reviews.text:
We stayed at Kong Gym for a month while my wife and I prepared for HYROX Bangkok, and we’ve absolutely loved it.

The gym is always spotless, the support staff are incredibly kind and helpful, and the whole place has such a welcoming community feel. Everyone makes you feel at home from day one.

Jamal and Corey complement each other brilliantly as coaches. They each bring their own style and personality, which keeps the classes fresh, engaging, and suitable for all abilities. The HYROX sessions are exceptionally well structured, but there’s also plenty of open gym space if you want to follow your own training plan.

One of the biggest bonuses is the recovery area at the back. Having the sauna, ice baths, and a relaxing space to unwind after training has made a huge difference.

My wife has loved it just as much as I have, and we genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better place to train. We’d definitely come back and would recommend Kong Gym to anyone visiting Phuket, whether you’re training for HYROX or just looking for a fantastic gym.

reviews.name: Jeff
reviews.text: Loved this gym, friendly staff and great trainers. We did the HYROX class and it was great. Would recommend. Great gym to get a sweat in while on holiday

reviews.name: Lyndsey Rae Harkonen
reviews.text:
🔥 Hyrox, yoga, sauna, ice baths, S&C, Best Vibe, Community — Kong Phuket has it ALL (and more)

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Kong Phuket is truly one-of-a-kind — more than just a fitness center, it’s a full experience that is a sanctuary in the jungle. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with the warmest smiles from the most positive staff, trainers and owners. The sense of community here is unmatched — you immediately feel like you belong. And the details make you feel so special — from the support of the staff to the little luxuries of water, tea, and electrolytes, it’s pure VIP treatment from start to finish.

The workouts? Absolutely next-level. Their Hyrox classes are the perfect balance of fun and intensity — you’ll laugh, sweat, and still leave knowing you just had one of the best workouts of your life. Yoga here is grounding and restorative, especially surrounded by the peaceful jungle vibe. And recovery is taken seriously — from the outdoor sauna and ice baths to the special electrolyte drinks they give after class, every detail is thoughtfully designed to make you feel cared for.

The energy and vibe of Kong Phuket are something you just have to experience for yourself. It’s filling a huge gap on the soi — offering not just training, but true above-and-beyond service. Every visit feels special. I wake up excited to go, not just for the training, but for the people and the community that make this place shine.

If you’re in Phuket and serious about your health, recovery, and fitness — or you just want to feel amazing — you NEED to experience Kong. It’s magic. ✨

reviews.name: Damo Sweet
reviews.text: We were planning to gym hop but ultimately settled on this one.  The coaches are caring and professional and the community is supportive.  They do high fives stretches and even have a smoothie taster.  The recovery area at the back is the perfect way to finish a session and the gym itself is clean functional and spacious.  There’s no need to look anywhere else, it has everything you need.  Plus it feels like you’re in nature!

reviews.text:
What a VIEW this space has. The best on the street. Full forest green view while you do a class. Insane. It's quite a space with hyrox and other s&c classes. No gym machines. Top class hospitalily. For ex they provide water which no one else does. And a glass of electrolytes when the class is over.

OM is very sweet and helpful with everything really. MUST try on fit street.

They also have a recovery center that I didn't end up trying but looks fantastic.

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Best Gym in Town!

KONG GYM is the ultimate place to train! The equipment is top-notch, the atmosphere is energetic, and the community is super motivating. Whether you’re into strength training, cardio, or functional workouts, this gym has everything you need.

The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to help and keep the vibe positive. If you’re serious about fitness, this is the place to be. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Jojo W
reviews.text: Great strength session today with the wonderful Cory!! His coaching is phenomenal.. he takes the time with everyone… excellent music and brings solid vibes!! Thanks buddy for an epic leg seshhh!!

reviews.name: violette al qadi
reviews.text:
Tried the open gym today and it was SICK! The owner was so welcoming and kind!
The gym is perfect, it has all the equipments you can think of from different cardio machines to weight lifting ones! and it’s somehow an open space with a forest/trees view.

They have showers and changing rooms (get your own towels and shower geer 😸)
They even offer different classes like HYROX, strength and conditioning group classes, and Yoga and Pilates classes.

The coolest part is the outdoor ice bath and sauna area, it’s totally private for you if you book it. They’re running an offer on this now which is buy 1 get 1 free! Definitely try it and grab a bite around the area as there are many healthy restaurants (carry CASH with you, they don’t accept cards in this area)

reviews.name: Andre Grant
reviews.text: This gym is incredible. They have everything a person needs for HYROX. The recovery area is very serene and relaxing.  It really felt like I was  relaxing in the jungle. Staff was friendly and took me on a tour. Kudos to Blake (one of the owners) & Om.

reviews.name: Artem Bogdanov
reviews.text:
A fantastic open-air gym with all the equipment you could possibly need, paired with incredibly friendly and welcoming staff. The classes are well-structured, organized, and designed to help you continuously improve your strength and conditioning. The recovery area is excellent too, with consistently cold ice baths and a properly hot sauna. What truly sets this place apart is the sense of community, everyone is supportive, motivating, and creates an environment where you feel encouraged to push your limits while still enjoying the experience. The jungle setting adds something special, especially in the evenings when the natural sounds and atmosphere make both training and recovery feel unique and immersive.

I can 100% recommend this place and will definitely be coming back.

reviews.name: Oki Doki
reviews.text: Amazing place here! The 3 weeks were so good! Thank you so much, Coach Darius and Coach Cory. You always pushed us to our limits and beyond. 1000 Thanks also to the whole kong team. You are the best! Hope to see y soon :)

reviews.text: Best matcha latte in town😍 Chocolate cookie is also very nice and salted pastry (ขนมเปี๊ยะ) so yummy! Will definitely go again when I’m in Khao Lak. Recommend cafe for everyone 😋
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re happy that you enjoyed our drink and pastry. Can’t wait to welcome you again on your next visit to Khao Lak :)

reviews.name: Yin Auejitroj
reviews.text: Best matcha latte in town with warm welcome atmosphere. Variety of books, recommended to check this place out!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Really appreciate your kind words, Nong Yin. ✨💚🥺

reviews.name: Nicole. Aloha
reviews.text:
Coolest café & bookstore in Khaolak🌿🏝️once you stepped in, you’ll feel the relaxing atmosphere; smell of natural aroma, green plants, good music & tasteful Matcha🪲

Sound Baht is another thing you must try here! The most relaxing activity ever, for your mind & body🤎

reviews.name: Joker Teekawat Pattamakome
reviews.text:
Beautiful retail, Amazing selected product, rich and to die for tea & cocoa drinks, Interesting book shop and Calm experienced with meditation by sound.

1000% recommend to check this place out if you around Khaolak !

reviews.name: varun taneja
reviews.text: Must try place, best coffee and staff is super friendly and nice…. If you come to khao lak, do not leave without visiting this cute little paradise
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your sweet words. Happy birthday to your wife again. Hope to see you guys on your next visit to Khao Lak :)

reviews.name: Tina Elfriede Jucker
reviews.text: I come to this place since 2023 for Yoga 3x /week. If I go back to Switzerland I really miss it and I'm always happy to be back home for my Yoga routine. The owner and stuff are so heartwarming friendly, studio and all accommodations clean and the teacher simply the best. I'm happy to live here and really have such a great possibility to do Yoga.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We're happy that we get to see you three times a week when you stay in Khao Lak, Tina. Stay healthy and balanced! 💗

reviews.name: Sophana Tanmanatragul
reviews.text: I highly recommend this place as a soul rest stop to anyone. The selection is carefully curated. Pipe is super passionate and knowledgeable in mindfulness and Fern’s smile will surely brighten anyone’s day. Their cacao is super yummy too!

reviews.name: Alex sander
reviews.text: Suitable for relaxing, the green tea is very good and cheap. I recommend it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Alex. We’re happy that you enjoyed our place. Hope to welcome you back again someday🌞🙏🏼💚

reviews.name: Pavinee R.
reviews.text: Matcha so so good and love all atmosphere. Staffs are friendly and so nice

title: Life Balance Phuket
ownerDescription: Life Balance is a hub for Mind and Body Wellness. We help you balance stress with harmony. We offer Infrared Sauna, Red Light therapy, Ice Bath, Breathing classes, Sound healing and much more

reviews.name: Wei P.
reviews.text:
I really loved today’s Sound Bath session! I’ve been to other Sound Bath sessions before, and this one feels a little different, but I really enjoyed it. I strongly recommend it! I also loved the environment, so peaceful and beautiful. And I absolutely loved the geese😍.

Thank you for this wonderful experience!

reviews.name: Maikaew WH
reviews.text: I really love it. It’s a place that nurtures both the body and the mind at the same time. The atmosphere here is amazing! close to nature, near a pond, and with a view of the mountains. The owner is very friendly and provides excellent service. He truly has a service heart and passion for what he do. I’m really impressed. I will be back for sure.

reviews.name: Adam Boudjemaa
reviews.text: This place is amazing. Jerome is always making sure his guests are happy and comfortable. The sauna with the lake view is incredible and the infrared sessions are something special. You walk in stressed and walk out smiling. Simple as that.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind words, Adam. It means a lot to us.  It was a pleasure to have you, and we hope to see you again soon.
Jerome

reviews.name: Tiffany Taylor
reviews.text:
Came for a semi-private sound bath with Jérôme and had a great experience! The sound bath was very relaxing. The facilities are all brand new and clean. I was impressed with the variety of amenities too: ice baths, saunas, red light therapy, etc. The lake view is breathtaking and the service was 10/10.

I highly recommend visiting this place and will definitely be back soon 🔜
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Tiffany for your kind words. We are thrilled that you had a good experience and we hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Cheryl Barnes
reviews.text: Wow - we so enjoyed this experience - sound bath with Jerome was beautifully calming - I loved that Jerome explained the process so clearly helping us to engage with the therapy on a deeper level.  After a stunning Efoil lesson with Dave (same location) it was time for the Infrared sauna and ice bath which was amazingly rejuvenating for our 70 ish old bones and joints. Don’t leave Phuket without visiting this special place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your Review, Cheryl. It was a pleasure to have you in Life Balance, and we are thrilled you enjoyed your time with us.

reviews.name: Daniel Moyes
reviews.text: Extremely relaxing ☺️ and soul energy balancing will definitely be back again best I’ve tried so far 😇🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words. We are delighted you enjoyed your session. See you soon!

reviews.name: James Griffin
reviews.text: What a location!!! A great place to escape from the noise of life. I've tried both the chakra meditation and sound bath and both are unbelievably relaxing. Highly recommend!! Thank you!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi James, thank you very much for your kind words! It’s always a pleasure to have you in our place 😊

reviews.name: GK
reviews.text: Jerome and his team deliver a wonderful, relaxing wellness experience in Cherngtalay Phuket. The red-light treatment, sauna and ice-bath are just what we needed!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your support. We thrive on your satisfaction.

reviews.name: aunchalee sumakul
reviews.text:
Soundbath session with Jarome is the best experience i ve tried so far, very relax and calm. Place is clean and quiet.
Really recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, we really appreciate your feedback!

reviews.name: Julija Kazakova
reviews.text: Very nice place where mindfulness meets aesthetics 🧘‍♀️. I have visited this place several times for sound bath. It was amazingly deep and powerful. And after you can grab organic meal in a very cozy place! 🙏🧡
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your kind review Julija, we are very happy you like our little place and we hope to see you soon again.

reviews.name: Vanessa Grima
reviews.text: We came here for sound healing and it was fantastic. Highly recommend it and highly recommend it being a weekly class !!

reviews.name: immiumami
reviews.text: One of the best ice bath places in Phuket with a stunning view. Definitely will come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your review. We are so happy you enjoyed our little spot. We will be delighted to see you again.
Jerome

reviews.name: Lucas N. Munhoz
reviews.text: Awesome place specialized in everything wellness and health. Jerome is an knowledgeable host, highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Lucas, thank you so much for your kind review! It was a pleasure to meet you, and we keep in touch!

reviews.name: Charlotte Draper
reviews.text: Friendly staff, beautiful venue, the sound bath healing session was fantastic. Would definitely recommend! 🙏🏽
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Charlotte!

reviews.name: Yuliya Jade
reviews.text:
Truly incredible sound therapy sessions!!
If you are seeking inner balance, harmony and joy, look no further. I’ve been to many sound therapy sessions all over the world, and I am kind of sad leaving Phuket now only because of this place!
Elevated state of mind? Found it here. Inner peace? Felt. Creative energy? Now it flows.
Thank you so much for this wonderful experience! I can’t wait to be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Yulia, we are delighted that you enjoyed your time with us, and your kind words humble us. We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Sina Klinski
reviews.text:
MAGICAL PLACE, highly recommend it.
I tried 4 different services at Life Balance.
1) Aroma Therapy massage, the best massage I ever received. Perfect mix between soft and hard, so relaxing!
2) Gym: The gym with the most beautiful view ever! I got a very intense and fun personal training that left me feeling super strong.
3) Sound bath: This was such a magical experience, I felt like pure bliss afterwards and I would say this was my favourite part of all the things I tried.
4) Ice Bath! I did the ice bath after my 2 days of intense workouts and it cured my soar muscles. Such a (literally) cool experience.

Overall incredibly happy with all the services I booked. I highly recommend this place ♥️♥️♥️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sina,
Many thanks for your words, we are delighted to see you every time. See you soon :)
Jerome

reviews.name: V S
reviews.text: Great place and nice sauna ice plunge experience. It is next to the lake so it has a great natural view that complements and makes the whole experience even better. The girl at the reception is super super nice and happy to help at any time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your review, we are happy you enjoyed our facilities and we are sorry that you lost your swimsuit. We can not be held responsible for our client's items,  however, we check after our client's visit and it's not rare we find a forgotten object or piece of cloth. In your case, unfortunately, the swit suit was nowhere to be found.

reviews.name: Katya Ogai
reviews.text: Did yoga, pulse (circuit training) and sound bath sessions. All were great, Jerome gave solid pointers for the strength training exercises and I worked up a decent sweat. The sound bath is out of this world, such a peaceful/spiritual experience. The studio is beautiful and you can grab a delicious bite at the adjacent woo cafe.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Katya,
Thank you so much for coming to our place, it was a pleasure to have you here. We are delighted that you were satisfied with our services and we hope to see you again.
Jerome

reviews.name: Chloe P
reviews.text: Tried emotional meditation class for the first time during my holiday in Phuket. It’s an amazing experience with Jimmy. The class is comprised of a few sessions: yoga, breathing exercise, guided meditation and finally the sound bath. I released a lot of stress and gained emotional stability through the class. The lake view is stunning and a perfect one for the class. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Chloe, we are very happy you enjoyed your time with us, and we hope to see you soon.

reviews.name: Christopher Yeh
reviews.text: My favorite place to workout in Phuket! High quality workouts and Yoga 💪 Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Chris, it’s always a pleasure to have you at Life Balance!

reviews.name: Arron Lansdowne
reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week at Marina Yoga Retreat in Thailand and honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience. From the moment we arrived, the owner and staff made us feel so welcome and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. A special mention to Margriet, who was absolutely fantastic so warm, helpful and genuinely caring from the moment we arrived.

The yoga sessions were held twice daily with excellent teachers, and there were other activities available in between if you wanted to stay active or explore. One of our favourite touches was the option of enjoying a delicious home-cooked meal each evening — such a lovely way to end the day.

The retreat itself is set in a quaint, tranquil location that feels peaceful and relaxing, yet it’s close enough to town that there’s plenty to see and do nearby. Having mopeds available to hire on site made getting around incredibly easy. We also loved having access to a beautiful pool just a couple of minutes down the road, and the on-site laundry facilities were really convenient.

Our room was comfortable and charming, with a sweet little kitchen area that made it feel like a home away from home. Everything about our stay felt thoughtful and well cared for.

We truly loved our experience at Marina Yoga and would recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing, friendly and well-run retreat. It’s an amazing place with amazing people, and we can’t wait to return.

reviews.name: Lylie West
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my stay at the cozy retreat and from the moment I arrived I was made to feel welcome and at home.

Each day included two yoga and meditation classes with a variety of different yoga styles. The sessions were easy to follow and there were options to increase or reduce the intensity, which made them accessible for everyone.

I also experienced two Reiki sessions and a sound healing session, which were incredibly relaxing and insightful. They added such a special and meaningful layer to the retreat.

The shala is beautifully authentic and the social areas are thoughtfully laid out. One of my favourite moments each day was watching the sunrise from the hammock listening to the birds.

I’m genuinely sad to be leaving and I would recommend it to anyone looking for tranquility, a chance to reconnect with themselves and others, while still having plenty of free time to explore Krabi.

Marina, Margriet, Jeremy and Owen are all such beautiful souls, thank you for such a special experience 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Maren Iba
reviews.text:
I spent 5 wonderful nights at Marina Yoga Retreat and truly enjoyed every moment. The yoga sessions were fantastic, and the teachers were outstanding. Marina and Margriet were incredibly kind, helpful, and created such a relaxed, welcoming vibe. The pool, just a short stroll away, was perfectly refreshing after classes.
The rooms are a bit dated but cozy and fully equipped with everything you need, just don’t expect a 5-star hotel. It’s a little way from the city, but you can easily rent a scooter or take a Grab/Bolt ride. Plus, snacks and drinks are available right on-site. Overall, it’s a peaceful haven for unwinding.

In a world rushing by, places like this remind us to pause, breathe, and reconnect with ourselves.
Thank you!

reviews.name: J T
reviews.text: I stayed here for 6D/5N for a yoga retreat. The booking process was smooth and Margriet replied quickly and she helped me arrange my arrival. I had my own room and it was nice and clean. Breakfast was provided every morning and it had a generous serving of fruits and my egg on rye bread was always delicious. The yoga classes were meaningful with breathing awareness, well-cued poses, and dedicated meditation time. When it was time to go, I felt like I wanted to stay for a few more weeks and continue the inner work. The pool was nice, especially on hot days. All instructors and staff were welcoming and friendly. I felt like I had so much time to be with myself and that was exactly what I wanted.

reviews.name: Gordon Graham
reviews.text:
My first experience of yoga and first experience of a retreat and I’m over 50
What a fantastic experience.
Great place Beatles in the hills surrounded by trees - very peaceful
Great yoga will do again
Also although  located out of town a little and it is a short scooter ride to some excellent beaches
Breakfast and dinner great too
I’d go back - and do more yoga and beach 😀

reviews.name: Kevin Poupard
reviews.text: I spent a beautiful 1 day retreat. Yoga, ear candling, sound bath, reiki...it is the perfect place for such retreat. Award to the last yoga (yin yoga) class by Luis which was amazing. A beautiful diwcovery! The discussion with Marina resonated so much. 🙏 Thanks for the warm welcome. I will be back!

reviews.name: Emily Kloos
reviews.text:
Where to start. One of the most amazing retreats you can imagine. If you’re looking for a welcoming, grounding and relaxing stay, this is the place to go. Marina, Margaret, Cinco, Jeremy and Tatiana are all very warm hearted & kind and really making you feel at home.

All the dogs and cats are also very special, really cute and into cuddling.

I booked the healing package (reiki, ear candeling, sound bath) and I’m so grateful for the treatments/ sessions, they were very powerful and deep. Ive done these type of sessions at other place but this felt like a next level.

What I also liked is that it’s not a ‘look at me being spiritual and awakened’ kind of place. It’s very authentic and down to earth in the way they connect and work.

I love the passion all of them put in their work and the connection with the guests staying. I felt so much at home that I felt sad to leave.

reviews.name: Charlotte Egerton
reviews.text:
Such a special place, we had such a amazing experience here. Everyone was lovely, the yoga was varied making each experience really powerful.

Marina and Margret, well what can I say, two of the most extraordinary women. The reiki session was so powerful. I'm so grateful to be taking so much from the whole experience forward with me.

Breakfast was great, lots of options to choose from. They offer dinner and there are lots of local restaurants.

The accommodation is simple and has everything you need. Lots of friendly animals. Wish we could have stayed longer!

reviews.name: Uli G
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely brilliant time here.  Recovering from an illness, I was able to rebalance myself and regain some mental and physical strength during a 6-day stay.  The variety of yoga classes on the schedule, and the optional healing treatments, introduced me to exciting new experiences. All the Yoga teachers are very professional, and the additional treatments I opted for were great. Delicious optional dinners as well.  But most of all Marina's amazing kind personality made feel like she's invited me and the other participants into a beautiful home that she wants to share with us.
THANK YOU Marina

reviews.name: Lila Kqiku
reviews.text:
I had the chance to experience a shamanic healing session at Marina Yoga in Thailand, and it was absolutely incredible. From the moment I arrived, I felt a warm, authentic, and deeply calming atmosphere. Marina is truly intuitive, kind, and carries a powerful, healing energy.

The session was intense, meaningful, and deeply liberating. I walked away feeling aligned, grounded, and with a sense of inner clarity I hadn’t felt in a long time.

I’m already planning to return and join the Reiki classes, as I know there’s so much more to explore and learn here.

If you’re looking for a deep, spiritual, and respectful healing experience, I recommend Marina Yoga enough. Thank you for this unique and transformative moment 🙏✨.

Lira,

reviews.name: Violeta SPAHIYSKA
reviews.text:
My husband and I took a yoga retreat and couldn't be more happy with it! The Cozy retreat is a peaceful heaven! The yoga teachers are lovely and professional and Margriet and Marina were always nice and available.
We even got our laundry done.
The material is very good and for only 5 days we could both see the progress even though we had very different yoga levels.
Strongly recommend!

reviews.name: Wei Liang Sim
reviews.text:
Marina is a truly kind hearted soul, which you'll feel at her energy healing sessions as well as in her friendly rescued dogs and cats.

Tucked about 15 mins away (by car) from the hustle and bustle of the city, here you'll find a variety of yoga seasons like Ashtanga, Vinyasa, Hatha, Yin and even blindfolded yoga.

Instructors are all top notch with a wealth of different experiences and techniques. I really learned a lot in the short 6 days.

It's in nature, so enjoy reconnecting but be aware there will be  bugs. Marina makes a great plant based dinner, and there are plenty of options within a 15 min walk for meat lovers too.

Don't miss the sunrise view!

reviews.name: Marina Letitia
reviews.text:
What an incredible retreat. This is a beautiful place. But it goes beyond the aesthetics. The yoga instruction was fulsome. The teachers were extremely knowledgeable and generous. The retreat draws people from all over and it was so lovely touching each other’s lives. Marina- Marina is the director and she is a truly beautiful person who is so responsive helpful and compassionate. She will ensure that you get out of this retreat what you need. There are no bells and whistles and you will greatly appreciate the calm, the peace, and the ability to reflect on your practice.
I hope everyone has an opportunity to experience this retreat. The value you receive for what you pay is immeasurable

reviews.name: Jade Grant
reviews.text: A heartfelt thank you to Marina, Margriet, Lexie, Marie, Sinko and all the fur babies for a wonderful stay and experience at Cozy. Going into this retreat I had no expectations or really idea about what to expect. Coming out, I have a more open heart, an abundance of information, and a deeper awareness of myself. Thank you for making me feel welcomed, but more importantly, thank you for feel loved and cared for. I KNOW ill be back!

reviews.name: Marie-Pier Tremblay
reviews.text:
I have been in Marina Yoga for 5 days, enjoying the yoga sessions, the reike and the sound healing. The environnement, the staff and the treatments or perfect to have a relaxing and awaken stay. I am grateful for every new experiences I had there. It’s the perfect place to go in you inner space, with respect and kindness. The teachers adapts to all level of yoga so we all feel welcome.
Marina is also a great cook and it was great to have choices for the breakfast.

reviews.name: Lee McGrath
reviews.text: I recently had a Reiki session at Cozy Retreat & had a wonderful experience. The tranquil atmosphere that has been created here made me feel very calm, comfortable & really able to relax into  enjoying the whole experience. The Reiki session I had was truly excellent & helped me greatly. Marina has something very special & I felt a deep connection with her which really enhanced the experience & results significantly which I am still feeling several weeks after the session. Thank you so much - I'll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Henric Heiner
reviews.text:
A really nice stay.
Good vibes only with beautiful people. Yoga teachers who are competent and helpful and even as a beginner I felt the progress.

The retreat is cozy and it feels like a small home. Especially the stories and the background informations from the owners helped me to understand Yoga and the balance in life.
Thank you and see you again.

reviews.name: Sylvia Drinkall
reviews.text: Loved my stay at Marina Yoga! First time doing any sort of yoga and all the teachers were so kind and welcoming. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a calm and relaxing time in Thailand!

reviews.name: Sarah
reviews.text: What an incredible experience — the peaceful natural surroundings made this the perfect place to unwind. My Reiki sessions were truly transformative, I came in a stressed and lost mess, and came out with unreal feel of serenity and content. The yoga classes were just as wonderful, with skilled teachers and a nurturing atmosphere. There is a pool few min walking distance. I will definitely come back 💚

reviews.name: Andrew Cesario
reviews.text:
I had such a great trip to The Cozy Retreat.  It was much more than promised.  Affordable, clean, inspiring, transformational.     Daily yoga with room for daily rest, exploration, meditation, adventure.  Local Thai massage local clean food, close to the jungle, the cliffs and not too far for a jaunt to the beach!
Amazing people, travelers from all over interacting and sharing their tales.  I look forward to returning!
