reviews.name: Tourist63096565433
reviews.text: Arrived about 10 pm, no reception and a friend of the owners showed us to our room as they were no where to be seen, we weren’t given a key or asked for details. We were very disappointed when we did get into the room as it was filthy. There was money in the bed and hair and stains on the sheets that clearly hadn’t been changed. We asked to move and the man was very apologetic and moved us straight away to a room upstairs. This was a bit better. The next day they said they have another room ready for us which we weren’t meant to stay in but there was an issue with the booking system and our room had been ‘double booked’. So we moved again this time it had obviously been cleaned for us but still very dated. The bathroom was full of ants and bugs. The pictures of the property, the blue pool and tidy outdoor area is also very old and the pool was so dirty we couldn’t go in it. Checking out there was no one to be found we just had to leave our key on the bed side table too.

reviews.name: Nick Smith
reviews.text:
This is a budget priced resort, i realise that. You get what you pay for.
Let me start with the good. My hut was clean, dry during the rain and had plenty of room. The bed was comfortable. A light quilt and fan were provided. Sparsely furnished. It felt a bit like a jungle stay in a wooden hut.
The swimming pool, well to be honest a wading pool, had clean cool water and was pleasant to cool off in on hot afternoons.
The location was good a short ride in and out of Pai by motorcycle and I could walk in and out of walking street in daylight.
I stayed in one of the huts designated as Double room with Private Balcony. I did not investigate other rooms here.
It had no air-conditioning,  I missed the subtle ommission in the wording when I booked. Overall that turned out alright as the weather is cooler at this time of year.
The resort seems poorly maintained.  My private balcony had protruding nails which made walking barefoot a hazard. A few minutes work with a hammer and nail punch could fix that.  The wooden chairs were rickety and uncomfortable. One had peeling blue paint that stuck to skin and clothes. Other areas of the resort look overgrown and abandoned.  What i assume is a fish pond looked like a fetid, fecund swamp.
I didn't eat or drink here, I have no idea about the food.
On the plus side it is quiet and secluded. During my visit there were virtually no mosquitoes,  it was possible to sit on the balcony and not be eaten alive.
Opportunities for improvement.  I stayed 7 nights. Changing the bedding and towels once during that stay would be appreciated . Emptying the bins occasionally would also be appreciated.  I had to flag down a staff member to empty my bin.
An outdoor fan, or an extension cord for the one in the room would have been nice.
Overall I probably should have spent a bit more money and stayed elsewhere.  That is probably the difference being older makes, no doubt a couple of backpackers sharing the room would consider this excellent.

reviews.name: Kelly Klein
reviews.text:
This is a very difficult review because there are some things that were quite nice,  well done, artistic, clean, and other things that were very disappointing. I’m guessing we had the worst room because we had sheets that had burn holes throughout and did not look clean and two toenails found in one sheet. And there is nowhere to plug anything because it was too high off the ground and no tables and nowhere to hang or put clothes. But the staff was very kind and did help us with an extension cord and bringing in a clothes rack. When I first spoke to the owner his immediate response was that we could cancel. We had booked for five days and arriving in the evening could not easily cancel and find another place in our price range and nowhere to go. I suggested we look at solutions to make it livable for us. It was pretty disappointing that an owner is ready to blow me off rather than try to accommodate.

Additionally, outside of the Thai staff who were friendly and helpful, I did not feel particularly welcome. It seemed to be quite a clique. Even the yoga classes were in Hebrew and no announcement for them to other guests. It was a strange experience.

it looks like it’s a large property with many individual huts that looked  lovely from the outside and the setting was lovely in the trees and forest and lots of sitting areas outside, but for us it was uncomfortable and challenging.

And if you are booking through Agoda, warning, the amenities listed are not true and not included. And the distance to town is listed as closer than actual walking distance. The owner has tried to clarify this with Agoda but the misinformation continues.

reviews.name: Jonas
reviews.text:
I booked this hostel because of the many positive reviews and stayed for four nights. The garden is truly lovely and creates a peaceful atmosphere. However, my experience in the dorm room was not as great.

The dorm feels a bit outdated, and since the air conditioning wasn’t turned on, the room felt damp. With nighttime temperatures dropping below 10°C and the need to go outside to use the restroom, it became quite uncomfortable. Additionally, the showers weren’t reliably warm, and one barely provided lukewarm water, which left me with a sore throat for days.

While I didn’t get the chance to try the restaurant, I noticed it wasn’t always staffed, and there were two mornings when I couldn’t even get a coffee before 9 AM, requiring me to head into town instead. The beds were worn-out, the curtain rails were broken, and there were ants here and there, which could have been avoided with better cleanliness.

Overall, the dorm room could use some upgrades to match the charm of the garden. Unfortunately, due to these shortcomings, I wouldn’t choose to stay here again.

reviews.name: Da Macster
reviews.text: Exactly what you would expect from a little resort perfect. The highlight of our trip was meeting the owners of this resort. They were so kind helpful and made us feel really welcome here. The is very clean comfortable and will totally recommend it to anybody wanting to stay. It was a little cold but when telling the owner it was called, he provided us with extra blankets. Couldn’t ask for better. and Coffee is one of the best I’ve ever had so you totally need to have a coffee if you’re here

reviews.name: מתן לחמי
reviews.text:
Wonderful Experience at Shaya Suandoi Resort in Pai!

During my stay at the resort, I received exceptional service from Simon and his wife, Rina, the wonderful owners who took care of every detail and made my vacation truly unforgettable. The value for the price is outstanding – the resort offers a high-quality experience tailored for young travelers, but it’s surprisingly peaceful and quiet, allowing for perfect moments of relaxation.

The location is also very convenient – just a 5-minute scooter ride or a 15-minute walk from Pai’s central area. It’s close enough to everything you need, yet far enough to enjoy some tranquility.

On top of the excellent service, the coffee was fantastic, and the Middle Eastern-style breakfasts were delicious and satisfying. The atmosphere at the resort is fun and pleasant, both during the day and in the evenings.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a cozy, relaxing, and well-located place in Pai with amazing service and a welcoming vibe from Simon and Rina!

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Great value

reviews.name: עמרי טיברגר
reviews.text:
I stayed at Shaya resort more than a month and it was lovely.
Quiet and peaceful,
the workers were really nice and the owners were welcoming.
The food is tasty and every time I needed something I immediately got help from the place.
It is about 15 minutes walk from the walking street so it was quiet and you can also rent motorbike from the owner.

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Great view, Quiet, Kid-friendly, Great value

reviews.name: Laura Obrado
reviews.text:
I had an amazing stay at this place.
The property was great and a perfect location within walking distance to the woods and only 5 min driving (motorcycle or taxi) far from the town.
Rina, her husband and all the staff make you feel like home from the very first moment, at the checkin indeed, and during the whole stay.
This place is perfect for those ones who want to enjoy a quite and wonderful surroundings location.
The bedroom was spacious, super clean and absolutely comfortable.
If I ever visit Pai again, I will repeat this accommodation with no doubt.

reviews.name: Dan Kaizman
reviews.text:
The best vibes in Pai.
Amazing rooms, and the hosts are some of the best people you’ll ever meet.
Such a pleasure to stay here — I’ll definitely come back again

reviews.name: Or Levy
reviews.text:
This resort is the perfect balance of peace and convenience. It’s located in a quiet and relaxing area, yet only a 3-minute walk from Pai’s main street.

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with plenty of cozy spots to chill and unwind. There’s a variety of accommodation options to suit every traveler, making it a great choice for anyone visiting Pai.

The on-site restaurant serves amazing food, and one of the highlights of the stay was the social evenings organized by the wonderful hosts. Shimon, Rina, and the fantastic team at Shaya create a great community vibe with themed nights featuring delicious homemade pizzas, hummus, and more.

I had an amazing time here and highly recommend this place! Thank you so much, Shimon, Rina, and the wonderful team at Shaya, for an unforgettable experience!

reviews.name: Pau
reviews.text: The hostel is full of bedbugs.  We've all been bitten.  Also, the bathroom is super dirty.  And the water from the shower and tap comes out with mud, water that can be very harmful to your health.  To top it all off, they told us the room would have air conditioning and it didn't, it just had a fan.  I do not recommend this dirty place to anyone.  If you can avoid it better.

reviews.name: Fardis Gorji
reviews.text: Dead lizard in the bathroom, bugs on the beds, a broken TV and an extremely rude owner. Only good thing is the local Thai workers who were extremely helpful and kind. I would highly recommend not staying here as it ruined my experience in Pai.

reviews.name: Erik Hrustic
reviews.text:
Our recent visit in this place wasn't what we expected. When we arrived, things seemed okay, but then we saw our room. It was supposed to be for three people, but it didn't look like the pictures we saw when we booked it. The room wasn't very clean, and it seemed like they didn't take good care of the place. Plus, there was a lot of noise from the air conditioners next door. The pool was also not working at all, and the beds in our room were all singles, even though we booked one double and one single.

We talked to the owner about the problems, and they offered us another room, but it was just as bad and very small. It even had a shared bathroom, which wasn't what we signed up for. So, we decided to leave and find somewhere else to stay.

The staff member who helped us was nice, and it wasn't her fault that things weren't right. But the people who run the place need to be more honest about what they offer and show real pictures of the rooms.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We apologize for the inconvenience experienced. At our resort, we offer a range of accommodations, from low budget to high-end suites. We regret that the room you booked did not meet your expectations and that there were discrepancies between the room and the advertised pictures.

We appreciate your feedback and take it seriously. In light of your concerns, we offered two options to rectify the situation with no extra charge or alternatively, if you prefer an upgrade to a different room category for an additional fee but you decided to leave.

We strive to provide our guests with a comfortable and enjoyable experience, and we apologize for falling short on this occasion. Thank you for bringing these issues to our 
.attention

We are dedicated to making continuous improvements to our facilities and services, and we take all of your feedback seriously.

reviews.name: Stanley Dunthorne
reviews.text:
Really enjoyed our stay here. Our double room (500 baht per night) was very spacious, had good AC and a fantastic view of nature outside. The bed was large and comfy. Bathroom did have a lot of ants and was basic, but fine. It's about a 10 minute walk into town, but it's a very dark walk at night.

The best bit about the place was the outside space, with lots of areas for relaxing on cushions or hammocks. They also offer free yoga in the mornings, although this isn't guaranteed to be on every day.

There's a small outdoor bar here with low prices (80 baht for a large Chang), which played nice relaxing music throughout the entire day, giving a lovely atmosphere to the outdoor areas.

Only minor downsides were the included breakfast, which was either three pieces of toast with jam or some rice. Some eggs would be nice :) There's no free drinking water provided here either, which meant we went through a lot of bottles. Overall though I really enjoyed staying here and would happily return.

reviews.name: Josh Brancatisano
reviews.text: Thank you brother for great hospitality! I recommend shaya resort to anyone visiting pai. Nice location on the other side of the river. Quiet, relaxing place. Great service and friendly owner and staff, also provides bike rental service. Rooms are clean and beautiful scenery from your balcony

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Great view, Quiet, Kid-friendly, Great value

reviews.name: Colin Krenitsky
reviews.text: Suandoi has the most beautiful grounds of any hostel I’ve stayed at. Huge space with lots of ponds, hammocks and lounge areas to explore. Free breakfast is included and free shuttle to/from town. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Only a 10 min walk from town, and just far enough to be peaceful. Great value.

reviews.name: Abby Nessa
reviews.text:
The common areas for this hostel are fabulous! It is a fun atmosphere with a bar, great food, lots of seating/places to hang out, and scooter rental. Very friendly staff and bartender.
We booked the deluxe private room, which is a nice size, but lacking in cleanliness. There were many ants and a couple other critters in the room, which is maybe to be expected being out in nature, but had us wishing a mosquito net was provided to make sleeping a bit more comfortable.

reviews.name: Rhys Barter
reviews.text:
Brilliant little holiday home, air conditioning private, bathroom and a hamockkkkkk🫶🏻
Highly recommend as like anything you do in pai a set of wheels is very helpful, but I had a wonderful stay and the host was super!

reviews.name: Manuel Busse
reviews.text:
Our most amazing experience so far!
Spacious rooms for a very reasonable price! All together with a big bathroom, two queen sized beds, an AC, a small refrigerator and little to no mosquitoes despite it being in a jungle-like place with a little river flowing through it. It is an awesome feeling when you return from a night out in Pai.
They have four bigger areas with bamboo huts where you can chill on mattresses, in hammocks or on bamboo lounges and a bar where they play awesome music nearly the whole day.
They have a nice restaurant with good, cheap food and delicious shakes, smoothies and Thai iced coffees/teas.
The staff is super friendly and helpful. In September they even offer free Yoga classes!
Just amazing! We even decided to stay here longer than we planned for.

reviews.name: Mæson Miles
reviews.text: This used to be one of the best hostels in Pai. 8 years ago. The new owners are not Thai and only care about money. The pictures are outdated and the hostel is filthy now. The people who stay here are the most disrespectful backpackers I've ever come across. I came here for one night to see how things had changed and I've never been more disappointed. The new owners have completely ruined the vibe that used to be here and created a place full of angry, aggressive, and disrespectful backpackers the are somehow all from the same county, and a few of the boys there was very clear that because I was not of their nationality, that I was not welcome. Such a shame 😔 I feel terrible for the Thai staff that work and live in the area. Please take your money somewhere else.

title: the Hive Thonglor
subTitle: เดอะไฮฟว์ทองหล่อ
ownerDescription:
The Hive Thonglor spans a massive six floors and chills out in the vibrant sukhumvit district, where both offices and residential spaces find a home. Featuring a large sun terrace with sofas and lounge chairs, the Hive Thonglor is the perfect place to meet with clients or kick back for a cheeky sun tan.

เดอะไฮฟว์ที่พิมาน 49 เป็นที่สาขาแรกของเราในกรุงเทพฯ ภายในอาคารที่สวยงามขนาดใหญ่แบ่งออกเป็นทั้งหมด 6 ชั้น พร้อมทั้งคาเฟ่แสนสวยให้บริการบนชั้นดาดฟ้า
address: Piman 49, 46/9 Sukhumvit 49, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHJG+RJ Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Stephanie Zed
reviews.text: The hive is a beautiful coworking with many floors and a nice rooftop terrace. Unfortunately the coworking space for daily/week’y pass is uncomfortable, with wooden chairs. They chose style over ergonomic chairs. Also half the power outlets were not working which was annoying. Finally, we had to go 3 separate times to get our deposit back since the reception was closed when it should have been opened based according to schedule. Easy fixes could make this coworking a 5*.

reviews.name: Lizette Zambrano (Liz)
reviews.text: Good place for co-working. It's better to take the bike because it is in the busy street of Sukhumvit 49 near Samitivej Hospital. The staff was nice and cheerful. I just find the food expensive because of its actual portion size.

reviews.name: Sayaka K
reviews.text:
Good place for co-working, clean and comfy.
I recommend to come in the morning time because it’s mostly less crowded than in the afternoon.
There’s also an open air cafe which makes you refresh. They have vegan options as well.

reviews.name: Mark Chaimungkalanont
reviews.text: Nice little co-working space with decent internet speeds (70mbps up) all day. Good by Australian standards anyway :) Sweet little rooftop area as well. Location will require some walking but near some great food and wine choices. Around 330 baht for walk ins. Free trial on Tuesdays.

reviews.name: John Cox
reviews.text: Great way to connect with other entrepreneurs while I’m in Bangkok! Also the rooftop is stunning. Went to an ice bath event on the roof last week - surprising but cool!

reviews.name: Yemane Felix Birhan
reviews.text:
The Hot Desk is too short for people taller than 6ft.
Also there is a horizontal bar very uncomfortable for sitting.
The electric outlets also ned better organization.
other than that the staff was great,I would come back.

reviews.name: Philip Bergqvist
reviews.text: A great co-working space. Staff was very friendly, was quick to reply to my email, and gave me a thorough tour when I arrived. There are several floors to choose from. The top floor has a cafe with free and paid drinks and a nice rooftop terrace. Comfortable chairs and good wifi.

reviews.name: Nomad
reviews.text:
A good co-working space in Bangkok that definitely has a relaxed, community feel. The rooftop yoga space and terrace farden are also great spaces to kick back between emails.

If you’re in Thonglor and looking for a spot to get some work done, look this place up.

reviews.name: Mimi Busu
reviews.text: Loved the events every single time! Amazing co working space in sukhumvit with friendly staff! The rooftop upstairs is also pretty nifty!

reviews.name: Anton Tenitsky
reviews.text: I've been a member for few years. Co-working is good but there is no excuse for poor internet connection. There were tens of complains about it already to the management. Nothing ever been done. Might have to eventually cancel my membership. Internet is one most important thing to consider, please do something.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Anton,

Thank you for your review. We are sorry to hear you had a dissatisfactory experience.

Your feedback is valuable to us and we really appreciate you bringing this issue to our attention. We have looked into this situation and have immediately taken action to improve the WiFi performance within the space.

Please reach out to thonglor@thehive.co.th with any further comments or suggestions you wish to share. We strive to deliver an even better experience next time. Again, thank you for taking the time to review our business!

Kind regards,
The Hive Thonglor Team

reviews.name: Sam Ward
reviews.text: Really nice working space. Very relaxed atmosphere. Bought a day pass no issues. A rooftop with a restaurant.

reviews.name: Benjamin Hies
reviews.text: Ok place. Nothing special, seating not so comfortable with bars in the way. Very friendly staff, but no vibe. Also not much space.

reviews.name: Piyamon Maneewat
reviews.text: 2 years here are the period of joy. The staffs' hospitality is impressing.

reviews.name: Lucien Marcs
reviews.text:
A beautiful space! So chill, with many international professionals to interact + learn from.

The staff are incredibly nice and offer several different solutions depending how long your stay and needs.

The neighborhood is also great, with a japanese market and many restaurants nearby. Good central location.

Highly recommended! I searched all of Bangkok for the best co-working space and I’m positive this is it.

Thank you Hive ☺️✨

reviews.name: Ido Lev
reviews.text:
Tastefully styled, best location, well equipped and my personal favorite choice for a relaxing motivational and pleasant environment for work.
For me, on top  of all, it’s the people.
The staff are amazing people, truly caring, providing each costumer comfortable feeling, and enjoying so much working together as a team, which is my golden buzzer for this coworking space.
You can choose to work hard, easy, quietly, meet quality and interesting variety of people, dinners, yoga and the list go on.
Community, family or whatever - it my first choice ❤️

reviews.name: Matthieu Chauveau (Mojomatt)
reviews.text:
One of the best place to work in Bangkok.
Great design, awesome staff, a lot of events and vibe.
Also a great Internet connection

reviews.name: Benjamin Scherrey
reviews.text: The Hive understands what a new startup needs. Management and staff are friendly and competent. They are quite flexible and professional. Most importantly, they provide 24 hr access to the facilities for members which is critical when you have deadlines to make so you don't get kicked out at 8p like what happens at other places. They also have a good mix of community events and a pleasant rooftop space for socializing. It's easy to get exactly the amount of quite / privacy / social /collaboration experience you want just by moving to different floors in the building. Recommended.

reviews.name: Kyle Newton
reviews.text: Nice space. Has spa at the bottom, offices next floor, and a nice bar on the roof top. I recently did the rooftop cinema which was nice and not too crowded, but was promised food would be served (chicken and free popcorn), both of which weren't available so had to try and find food at 11pm once the film was finished. The staff are all great though and we got a free beer upon entry which was the price of the ticket anyway so well worth the  visit.

reviews.name: Bobin Lee
reviews.text:
I tried this coworking space out for half a day in August 2017, and it was a great place to hunker down and get work done. Most floors are very quiet, and there is free water and coffee for guests. You can also smoke out on the top floor balcony.

The staff are very nice and courteous.

reviews.name: Marcus L.
reviews.text: Great coworking place with friendly staffs!

title: Kata Hot Yoga
ownerDescription:
Kata Hot Yoga is the original hot yoga, a combination of 26 Hatha Yoga asanas (physical postures) and 2 breathing exercises performed in a hot room (40 °C / 105 °F) for 90 minutes.

Choose from several daily classes and get strong, fit, and energized during your stay.

We work with different teachers from all over the world, ensuring an amazing Bikram Yoga experience each time you visit us. A lot of effort has been put into making our classes suitable for beginners as well as challenging for experienced practitioners.

Everybody is welcome!
address: 217 Koktanod Rd Kata Beach, Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: R872+W2 Karon, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Kenny James
reviews.text: Kata Hot Yoga is truly a Yoga community.  I spent 6 weeks attending the teacher training program.  I took over 65 yoga classes with like minded people from all over the world, many of whom I will stay connected to throughout the future.  The true spirit of the sacred therapeutic practice of Hot Yoga is practiced at Kata Yoga every single day.  Govert and all of his teachers are consistently present and available for first timers to the world champions of yoga.  Please do yourself a favor and visit Kata Hot Yoga and for a life changing experience attend the teacher training program!

reviews.name: Vanessa Goldsmith
reviews.text:
I attended the intensive Hot Yoga 26 & 2 Teacher Training course at Kata Hot Yoga over the summer, and it was truly a life-changing experience. Having practiced 26 & 2 hot yoga for over ten years, I’ve long appreciated its benefits—but following several health challenges in recent years, including a hip replacement and arthritic shoulders, I’ve become forever indebted to the healing power of this yoga. Both mentally and physically, it has supported my recovery in ways I can’t overstate. This practice is genuinely underrated for its incredible healing benefits.

While I never set out with a burning desire to teach, I wanted to deepen my understanding of the postures and the philosophy behind the practice. The training turned out to be the most demanding challenge I have ever undertaken—certainly not for the faint-hearted! The five and a half weeks were intense and unforgettable, filled with two 90-minute hot yoga classes a day, posture clinics, lectures, and daily assessments.

At times, I questioned the methods and the purpose behind certain aspects of the training and was simply told to “trust the process.” That wasn’t easy at first, and memorizing the dialogue verbatim often felt impossible. But despite the physical and mental exhaustion (and there were plenty of tough days!), the beautiful paradise setting of Kata Beach kept me grounded and motivated to see it through.

Along the way, I met incredible people from around the world—some of whom have become lifelong friends. I’ll always be grateful to Govert and Eric for their tough yet compassionate guidance, encouragement, and unwavering belief in me. Their passion and knowledge for Hot Yoga 26 & 2 are truly inspiring.

Although I started the course unsure if I’d ever teach, I’ve returned to the UK now proudly leading Hot Yoga classes. It would feel like a waste not to share what I’ve learned—the knowledge is too rich and rewarding to keep to myself.

If you’re looking for a challenge that will push you to your limits while deepening your understanding of Hot Yoga 26 & 2 and its philosophy, I cannot recommend the Kata Hot Yoga Teacher Training highly enough. It’s an experience that will stay with you forever.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Great to hear you are teaching , wish you all the best and maybe see you here again one day 
Great story about your teacher training experience , here at kata hot yoga , keep going strong !

reviews.name: Sanders Noah
reviews.text: I don't know why it took me so long to write a review. Kata hot yoga is such an awesome spot. I came back to Phuket just to do yoga here!! I've been to a few different hot yoga studios in different countries, all of which were good. But, Kata Hot Yoga is the best! The room is consistently hot, and the schedule is consistent and convenient as well. I love that the towels and mats are included in the price. Everything is all ready to go when you show up. The teachers are all great too! Absolutely recommended!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: You did great Noah See you soon again

reviews.name: Maciek Lyko
reviews.text:
I’ve been practicing at Kata Hot Yoga every day for the past two weeks, and I can confidently say this place is phenomenal! 🔥🧘‍♂️
Owner was very helpful and guiding
The studio has an incredible energy—from the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed by a community of passionate instructors and dedicated students. The hot yoga classes follow the classic 26+2 Bikram sequence, and the instructors do an amazing job guiding you through the practice with precision, encouragement, and mindfulness. The heat is perfectly balanced, allowing for deeper stretches, improved flexibility, and an amazing detox experience.

Located just a short walk from Kata Beach, the setting couldn’t be better. After an intense class, you can cool off in the ocean or relax with a smoothie nearby. The studio is clean, professional, and well-equipped, making it a perfect place for both beginners and experienced yogis.

💥 EXCITING NEWS! 💥 If you’re serious about deepening your yoga journey, Kata Hot Yoga is offering a Teacher Training Program this summer! This is a golden opportunity to learn from expert instructors, refine your practice, and become a certified hot yoga teacher in one of the most beautiful locations in the world. Whether you’re looking to teach or just elevate your personal practice, this training will be life-changing!

If you’re in Phuket, this is the place to practice hot yoga. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for strength, flexibility, detox, and an inspiring community! 🙌🔥

I’ve been practicing hot yoga daily at Kata Hot Yoga, and it has been an absolute game-changer! 💪✨ The 26+2 Bikram sequence in a perfectly heated room has helped me push my limits, improve flexibility, and feel incredibly energized every single day.

🏝 Bonus? The studio is just minutes from Kata Beach, making it the perfect place to practice, sweat, and then take a refreshing dip in the ocean! 🌊☀️

💥 BIG ANNOUNCEMENT! 💥
This summer, **Kata Hot Yoga is hosting a Teacher Training Program—a life-changing opportunity to master the art of hot yoga and get certified in one of the most beautiful places in the world. Whether you’re looking to teach or take your personal practice to the next level, this training is for you!

✅ Daily practice & expert instruction
✅ Deep dive into the 26+2 sequence
✅ Breathtaking location in Phuket, Thailand

If you’re serious about your health, wellness, and personal growth, don’t miss out! Check out @katahotyoga for more info and sign up before spots fill up!

📍 Where: Kata Hot Yoga, Phuket
💬 Who else loves hot yoga? Drop a 🔥 in the comments if you do!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Maciek ,Best Words in a rating ever,  your words it’s like poetry , magic , and all true, love your energy  , see you soon again

reviews.name: Coco Rose
reviews.text: It was so nice to revisit this studio after 12 years. What I love about Kata Hot Yoga is that it is still the same from what I remembered and hasn’t lost its essence. A tough-loving gem of a studio in Kata Beach providing consistent, quality, traditional Bikram Yoga with a fresh coconut after class.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We will keep true to the sacred yoga practice full power high energy as always , forever

reviews.name: Joakim Lloyd Raboff
reviews.text:
Inspired by my first visit to Kata Hot Yoga in 2018, my wife and I recently completed a 30 Day Hot Yoga Challenge there.

We completed 30 classes within 30 days – and it’s been a transformative journey for us both.

At 61, I’ve tried many different types of exercises and sports. But practicing hot yoga at Kata has proven to be one of the healthiest choices I’ve made in a long time.

The physical benefits are wonderful, I’m stronger, leaner and much more tenuous after the 30 Day Challenge – and it’s also helped me with my mild arthritis.

After my two visits, I am now completely hooked on Kata Hot Yoga's authentic hot yoga experience.

The studio’s focus is on the original Bikram method that combines 26 postures and 2 breathing exercises in a 40C/105F heated room for 90 minutes.

And what makes this studio even more special is Govert, the owner and head teacher. Before opening Kata Hot Yoga over 15 years ago, he actually worked directly with Bikram himself. Whatever you may think of Bikram Choudhury the man, there is no denying that his hot yoga practice is genius.

Govert's deep understanding of all the 26 postures, combined with his light-hearted humor, makes each session both effective and fun.

Likewise, Olivia, Jib, and the other instructors are just as dedicated, offering personalized feedback in real-time that helps everyone tweak their postures so all of us always got the most out of each class.

The studio is located just minutes from Kata Beach and is super-easy to reach. It has a large lounge,  changing/shower rooms and you can buy fresh coconuts, kombucha and water before/after class.

The studio's atmosphere is light and bright, and the outdoor space is perfect for relaxing and cooling down with a few scoops of cold water after an intense morning or evening class.

My wife and I were lucky to do our 30 Day Challenge during the studio’s annual Teacher Training course, which allowed us to meet amazing people from all walks of life and from all over the world.

The positive energy in this studio is palpable, and the sense of community Govert has created is something truly remarkable .

I’ve practiced many different kinds of yoga in many places around the world. But to me, Kata Hot Yoga is the gold standard, the benchmark that offers a truly memorable experience.

We can’t wait to return and continue fine-tuning our postures!

Joakim & Charlotte (from Sweden)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a great review , wow glad to hear your beautiful story , happy it helped you guys in many ways , we are at your service here at kata hot yoga

reviews.name: Eliane Ulrich
reviews.text:
Kata hot Yoga is a very professional hot yoga Studio.
It is located in the heart of Kata beach, easy to reach, clean, showers & you can buy fresh coconuts or kambucha, water etc..

The teachers are very friendly, have a great expertise and whether you are a beginner or advanced yogi, you are well taken care of and supported to get the most out of your practice!

i had the pleasure of doing the 5 week hotyoga teacher training and can recommend this to any experienced yogi!

☮️

reviews.name: Daniel Park
reviews.text:
first time trying hot  yoga and it was an incredible and challenging experience!

teacher who isnt native speaker can be difficult to understand  if you are a beginner.
owner isnt friendly and blatanlty ignored me when I said hi and bye.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I always say hi to everybody , Maybe I was busy doing a transaction or something , but it’s ok bey bey 👌

reviews.name: Jazlene Ong
reviews.text: Am very disappointed as they sold me a 10 class pack last year, telling me that it would last a lifetime (I was intending to use it over two trips). Now that I’m back, they flat out didn’t honour it and still had the gall to ask me to purchase more classes. Very disappointing
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Sorry to disappoint you but a 10 class card is valid 10 weeks not lifetime, you came back more than 1 year later it’s expired

reviews.name: Anna Moir
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Mace G
reviews.text:
Unforgettable Cooking Class in Bangkok with Chef LeeZ — A Must-Do Experience! If you’re visiting Bangkok and want to take home more than just souvenirs, this cooking class is the one to book. It turned out to be one of the absolute highlights of our trip!

From the moment we met Chef Lee, we knew we were in for something special. She's not just an amazing chef — she’s a fantastic teacher, storyteller, and genuinely one of the kindest people we met on our travels. We were calling her Grandma Lee by the end of the class, and it felt totally fitting!

Before we even touched a pan, Chef Lee took us to a local market, where she explained every ingredient in detail — including substitutions we could use back home. She shared stories of her own grandmother who inspired her to cook and reminded us with a smile, “Grandma no waste nothing!” Her approach to food was not just about flavor, but about heart, history, and respect.

Back at her kitchen, which was spotless and professionally set up, we got to work — and the food just didn’t stop coming. From learning how to properly clean shrimp to making rich and flavorful tom yum paste (and three different tom yum soups!), every dish was packed with flavor and fun to make. I never even liked soup before, but Chef Lee changed my mind completely!

We also learned how to use fresh coconut in all its forms — and were even gifted a traditional coconut scraper to take home. It’s touches like these that made this experience feel so personal and memorable.

The menu was packed with crowd-pleasers:
* Pad Thai — surprisingly simple and incredibly delicious.
* Curries — rich, aromatic, and fun to learn how to make from scratch.
* Holy basil stir-fry — spiiiicy.
* Green papaya salad — refreshing with a nice kick.
* And of course, mango sticky rice with puffed rice on top — the perfect sweet finish with a delightful crunch.

Chef Lee’s sister also helped out during the class — their bond and teamwork added a beautiful layer of warmth to the whole experience. It was a joy to witness a family working together and sharing their culture so generously.

To top it all off, Chef Lee went above and beyond even after class ended — helping us hail a cab (not easy during rush hour!) and getting us safely to the water taxi so we could skip traffic.

Chef Lee has such an inspiring story and is open about her humble beginnings. She brings laughter, heart, and soul into her class — you don’t just learn to cook, you feel like you’re part of something much more meaningful.

Bottom line: This is more than a cooking class — it’s a cultural immersion, a heartwarming encounter, and an experience you’ll never forget. Go on an empty stomach and prepare to leave full, happy, and inspired. If you’re in Bangkok, do not miss this. You will not regret it!

Miss you chef — thank you so much for helping create such a beautiful memory for my brother and I. You’re an amazing person and we won’t forget you!!

reviews.text:
An Unforgettable Family Adventure!
​
​We just returned from an incredible trip on this liveaboard (Koon9), and I cannot recommend it highly enough also for families—even those with mixed interests! From start to finish, the experience was seamless.

​Exceptional Organization & Diving
​The handling of our booking was perfect, and the logistics (including the hotel pickup & drop off) were smooth and stress-free. Once on board, we were greeted with such warmth.

The cabins were comfortable, and the diving was top-tier. I want to give a special shout-out to my guide, Aoy; her expertise and personality made every dive truly memorable.

​Fun for the Whole Family
​What made this trip truly special was how well they catered to everyone:

​For the Non-Diver: My husband absolutely loved the snorkeling opportunities. He felt fully included in the adventure.
​
For the Little One: Our 5-year-old son was completely "spoiled" by the entire crew! They were so attentive and kind to him, which allowed us to relax and enjoy the trip knowing he was in great hands.
​
A Small Note on Dining
​The food was delicious and well-prepared.
My only very minor suggestion would be to include a bit more authentic Thai cuisine. The menu seemed slightly tailored toward guests from other Asian regions, and as lovers of local flavors, we would have enjoyed a few more traditional Thai dishes.

​Summary
​Overall, this was a fantastic experience. We felt valued as guests and well-cared for as a family. We are already looking forward to our next trip with this team. We will definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hey Sandra, 
Thanks for coming back to us after 5-6 years and bringing your boys this time!!
We're stoked that you had a great time, and Aoy is a wonderful lady, personally, underwater, on board and with kids!!!

Cheers,
Jamie

reviews.name: Krystal Kappeler
reviews.text: Funny and knowledgeable staff on Manta Queen 1, and great experience for the price!  Our only liveaboard comparison is Aggressor in another part of the world, which was 3x the cost, but an incrediblly comfortable liveaboard experience. Manta Queen 1 is clean, wonderful open-air seating for meals, quality authentic Thai food (but would have loved labels for what food was gluten-free for my wife's allergy), and large bathrooms with open-air windows in stateroom showers, which kept everything smelling fresh. We felt the steep steps between the 3 floors, limited seating on top deck, tight tank set-up, very firm mattresses, and their dingy set-up makes this more suitable to a younger crowd with younger knees. The dives where we could do giant stride and return via dingy water tow and climb back up the ladder were much more achievable. Several divers hit 100 and 900 dive milestones and the chef's celebrated them at our meals, which was really neat! Our Thai dive guide, Tik, was absolutely fantastic in every way!!! He was attentive to our group's preferences for aquatic life, professional, and he is incredibly skilled at pointing out hidden marine life. Best marine life we've ever seen (1000+ barracuda schools, nudibranch, 3 octopus, huge schools of tiny and medium fish, largest guitar fish I've ever seen, incredible night dive with reef tip sharks and larger than life lobster)! Book directly through the shop or via Liveaboard, not No Troubles Just Bubbles like we did; most of our information was not shared with the dive shop so we had to communicate everything from our gear needs to food allergy (which was too late b/c the food supply had already been purchased and it was hard to communicate what did or did not have gluten once on board - but not Manta Queen's fault, as they were great at labeling vegetarian... if No Troubles Just Bubbles had shared that info ahead of time it would not have been a problem. We did have some issues with billing (likely because of going through No Troubles Just Bubbles) - we tried to pay for everything (partial gear needs, etc.) ahead of time, were only allowed to pay for part. This caused staff some confusion around what needed paid, and we ended up having to wire transfer money for my wife's nitrox after our trip, because it was missed. But overall, very good experience, and would recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hey Krystal & Garrett and thanks for your review, and we're stoked that you had a great trip on one of our most-popular boats.
Indeed, space is limited on boats and things like steep steps and seating are affected by this. Mattresses are always hard on liveaboards in Asia, and you're certainly not the first to comment on this. I'm not sure if the reason is because they're cheaper, maybe they last longer in this climate, or maybe they are better than soft beds to prevent seasickness.
However, we're sad that your booking experience wasn't up to your expectations. May I address each item at a time?
- Holly clearly marked your food allergy on the booking form, plus the KSA team regularly log into our database to check these things. Therefore, they were told.
- Holly gave the gear info to KSA along with your pick up, and as you know she followed up on your (slightly-late pick up) due to KSA's delay
- Finally, for the billing. All of our guests pay for park fees, gear and Nitrox at check in or on the boat, and this is because park fees need to be paid in cash, plus people often change their minds about Nitrox and/or gear between booking and the start of the trip. KSA called Holly to ask her to follow this up with you guys, saying that one of you had paid for Nitrox, but not the other. This was because the guys on the boat forgot to charge one of you for it. Holly then spent her time to help fix the issue, enabling KSA's accounts to be cleared.
Holly is both sad and disappointed that her efforts didn't meet your expectations, but for the future we can all learn from this.
In any case, we would again like to thank you for choosing us, for your review, and we will endeavour to be even-more diligent going forward.

reviews.text:
The most incredible experience I ever had. Did 1 PT with Superbon and 2 with Nong-O. Both incredible teachers, patient, kind, and very down to earth. They taught me more in 1 hour than I could learn in weeks back in the US.

I understand their sessions may seem pricy but if you have experience and want to adjust your game to another level I highly recommend (I have 7 years experience and fought before)

If you are a complete beginner it may make more sense to do the group classes or train with someone less expensive- just my two cents.

Super clean facility and the nicest staff. Highly recommend showing up 30-40 mins early to stretch, drink water (you can buy for 20 baht for a big cold bottle) and to get accommodated. Traffic in Bangkok is unpredictable so prepare for that if you are coming from far away.

reviews.name: Grace K
reviews.text:
It's a great club.

The trainers work super hard to make sure you have a good experience. I don't think I had a single PT that only lasted 1 hr.... They always gave me extra time - I had PTs with Jay (Je Yodthongthai - 3x Rajadamnern Champion 🤯) and Puri (Petchpupa - One Championship fighter 😎). Plus plenty of coaching from many other experienced coaches/fighters in the classes.  There's a nice balance of pushing you to do better whilst having fun.

If you're there to train you are treated with the same attention and respect regardless of whether you are a beginner or experienced fighter. The turnover of students is naturally quite fast since most people are just visiting but because you're all in the same boat all the students are incentivised to be very friendly - I met some lovely people 😊.

Also it's clean. Shout out to the people keeping the place clean yo 🙏🏻💪🏻.

Also to the ladies working in reception too - sorry for the bad spelling: Taptim, Jade, Tongtaa and Bai (?nickname Daisy - superb camera woman!) and Tongkaa. They were welcoming, extremely competent and helpful. Nothing was too much trouble and I really appreciated their kindness. They even got flowers for everyone on Valentine's Day - you guyyys 🥰

And to all of the trainers with a special shout-out to the ones who helped to make some great memories.  Jay 🥰, Puri😈, Jeng🕺🏻, Armin🤯, Baiphet🤩 and Beer😎. Thank you for pushing me to do better, keeping me motivated and teaching me new things whilst keeping me safe (not a single injury- thanks guys!).... as well as making me smile so hard that my face still hurts 😂.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had an amazing training session at Superbon gym! The trainers were incredibly attentive and took the time to help correct my technique, which I really appreciated. It was inspiring to train alongside some legendary fighters and watch them work. I learned so many new things and could feel my skills improving throughout the session. reviews.name: St Prwt
reviews.text:
Had the privilege to train with Khun Kru Petchmorakot and I had an amazing learning experience with him here. The gym is easy to get to and plenty of parking space if you got a car. Mind you, it's completely outdoor in the area, so your car will take direct sunlight.

It seems like private trainings are 'directed' or 'led' by your Kru based on his assessment of your skill. This is not done explicitly. My suggestion would be to communicate with your Kru openly before the session (during warm ups, etc.) what you're looking for and what kind of pace you might want to go with.

That is what I didn't do. I think he kinda figured out that I'd trained a bit of western boxing, so he ramped me UP!!! the entire session. lol. It was a nonstop striking training with the only break available is the 1 minute between the rounds -- not during. I was completely gassed.

So it's my fault that the session pace went really fast (the way he called which shots to take) and I was doing an entirely new stance and new guard as suggested by Kru. So I was processing a lot of new information simultaneously which could've been avoided and could've made the session more effective for my level as a complete Muay Thai beginner had I communicated with him properly.

That would be my only tip if you're coming here for the first time, especially for a 1-1. All in all, it's an amazing Muay Thai gym that you'll be learning from real competing or competed Muay Thai fighters. I've booked another class just now cause I'm definitely coming back.

reviews.name: Jon Aneza
reviews.text:
Superbon Training Camp offers an authentic Muay Thai experience with a focus on traditional techniques and high-quality training. Whether you're a seasoned fighter or a complete beginner, this gym provides a welcoming environment and a range of classes to suit different skill levels.

The gym is well-equipped with a variety of training tools, including heavy bags, Thai pads, and a ring. The cleanliness of the facility is top-notch, with regular maintenance ensuring a hygienic environment. The locker rooms and showers are functional and well-kept, though they could benefit from more frequent updates.

The coaches are highly skilled and experienced. Many have backgrounds in competitive Muay Thai, and their expertise is evident in their teaching. Classes are well-structured, focusing on technique, conditioning, and sparring. The coaches are attentive and provide personalized feedback, which helps in improving technique and performance.

Membership fees are reasonable for the quality of training provided. There are options for drop-in classes, monthly memberships, and long-term packages. which is a nice bonus for those looking to commit for the long haul.

Would I recommend this gym? Absolutely. If you’re looking to immerse yourself in Muay Thai or enhance your skills in a supportive setting, Superbon Training Camp is a great option.

reviews.name: Alexandra Ramírez
reviews.text: Excellent gym! Really helpful coaches who will go out if their way to help you improve your technique and drills! I was training twice a day for a week and can’t recommend it enough! It’s clean and spacious and you train among superstars! Very friendly atmosphere and the areas are well ventilated! Only con is it’s quite far from the centre so if you’re there to train ideally book the camps accommodation which I will do next time! I’d love to see a class with more advanced students and harder sparring for those who want to start getting in the ring themselves 💕 otherwise the group class is superbly well structured from stretching and warming up, then shadowboxing, to the coach and bag drills to sparring and it truly welcomes all levels! ☺️

reviews.text: If you’re looking for professional and friendly instruction for all levels, then Superbon’s Training Center is for you. The trainers make you feel noticed and push you to be better.  The gym is clean, modern but still feels old school.  The only downside is it takes about 30 minutes to get to from downtown BKK. Once you are there it’s worth the drive.  I only wish I had more time training there. Next time I’m back in Bangkok, I will return.

reviews.text: Had a great time training at superbon. It was fun and at the same time intensive. The trainers cared to show proper technique and were all patient while pushing you. reviews.text: Strongly recommended! Im a Muay Thai enthusiast, i always enjoy visiting different Muay Thai gym whenever i travel. Workout and have fun will always be my main aim. reviews.name: Chee
reviews.text:
Exceptional Muay Thai Training with Passionate Instructors!

I've had the incredible opportunity to train at this Muay Thai center, and I couldn't be more impressed. The level of passion and dedication that the instructors bring to each session is truly remarkable. From the moment I stepped in, it was clear that they genuinely care about helping their students succeed and reach their fullest potential.

The instructors here are not just skilled practitioners; they are true mentors who take the time to understand your goals, strengths, and areas for improvement. Their personalized approach to training ensures that every session is tailored to your needs, making the learning experience both effective and enjoyable.

What sets this training center apart is the unwavering commitment the instructors have towards their students' progress. Their energy and enthusiasm are contagious, creating a motivating atmosphere that pushes you to give your best effort every time. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced fighter, you'll find their guidance invaluable.

I can confidently say that my journey in Muay Thai has been transformed by the dedication of these instructors. If you're looking for a place where passion and expertise combine to create an exceptional training experience, this Muay Thai center is the perfect choice. reviews.text:
Had a great time training at this muay thai gym. It doesn't matter if you are a beginner or seasoned practitioner, you will have a good training session. Roughly about 25-35 minutes from downtown city center. I recommend taking a Grab motorbike to get there quickly especially when traffic is bad.

The classes are structured for 2 hours.
10-15 minutes, warm up and stretching.
3-4 rounds of pad work
3-4 rounds of bag work
3-4 rounds of sparring

Not necessarily in that order. Followed by some conditioning and stretching once more to cool down. Really enjoyed training here. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Vellesya
reviews.text:
Even though Superbon lost to Tawanchai in their competition, that didn’t make my husband any less interested in trying Muay Thai training at Superbon 🥊😋

He actually got into it after watching tons of YouTube videos people doing 3-month or longer boot camps at Superbon. So, of course, he had to try it himself!

He joined a single training session, and from what I observed, the schedule is very punctual ⏰—it starts at 5 PM and runs for 120 minutes. And don’t worry, even if you’re a complete beginner, you’re absolutely welcome here! 🙌 The coach first gathers everyone together (around 40-50 people) to teach the fundamentals and correct form. Then, the group is split into smaller sections for more focused training.

The atmosphere is super fun and incredibly multicultural! You’ll meet people from all over the world 🌏

If I had to sum it up: this experience is a must when visiting Thailand!

reviews.text:
We had an absolutely incredible experience at A Lot of Thai Cooking School with Chef Yui in Chiang Mai.

From the moment we arrived, everything felt warm, welcoming, and beautifully organized. Yui is not only an amazing cook, but also a fantastic teacher. Her explanations were clear, patient, and easy to follow, even for beginners. She made sure we understood the ingredients, techniques, and flavors behind each dish — not just the steps.

We learned how to cook Pad Thai, Khao Soi, Tom Yum Kung, and Mango Sticky Rice, and every single dish turned out delicious. It was so rewarding to cook authentic Thai food from scratch and truly understand the balance of flavors that makes Thai cuisine so special.

Beyond the cooking, the whole experience felt personal and joyful. We laughed, learned a lot, and left feeling inspired (and very full!). If you’re visiting Chiang Mai, this class is a must.

Thank you, Yui, for such a memorable and meaningful experience. We will definitely be recreating these dishes at home!

reviews.name: Jeanette Grube
reviews.text: Amazing experience with our family!  Kwan and Yui were so friendly.  Yui is incredibly talented and so knowledgeable about cooking.  She passed along many great tips!  Your family or group can choose 4 different dishes (from a list of about 20) to cook and eat during the class.  They pick you up at your hotel (if you are in the city center) and welcome you to their home for this adventure.  Do not miss this once in a lifetime experience!!

reviews.name: Diane Murphy
reviews.text: This was an amazing cooking lesson and super experience with Yui, a small group of 6 people, we cooked 4 individual dishes which we then ate.  Khao Soi and Mango Sticky Rice were my favourites, would definitely recommend. Yui and her husband collected us from our hotel and brought us back. Look forward to booking again next time we are in Chiang Mai.  Looking forward to cooking the recipes at home with the cook book and tips Yui gave us.  Tip. Don’t eat too much before the lesson - food so good

reviews.name: Zach M
reviews.text:
Chef Yui is an incredible teacher and storyteller. Within the first few minutes of arriving at her home, my wife and I felt like we've known Yui for years. She's a very welcoming person that brings positive energy and a great sense of humor. It was just my wife and I in our class, but I think that made for very enjoyable discussions, both food and non-food related. Also, come hungry since you'll be cooking and eating a lot.

Yui is a talented chef and knows the ins and outs of making great Thai food. Some notable things were her attention to where individual ingredients come from and how that can affect the dish, her problem-solving ability to look for the root cause of an issue and address it, and the small technique changes that would typically be difficult to follow solely from a book but have an impact on the resulting dish.

After the cooking class, she took us to the nearby market where she gets many of her ingredients and explained the differences and similarities between certain ingredients.

Overall we really enjoyed our time with Yui and would consider A Lot of Thai a must try experience for anyone who loves Thai food and wants to learn from one of Thailand's best!

reviews.name: R S
reviews.text: This cooking class was easily the highlight of our time in Chiang Mai. Yui was so patient, easy to follow, and a wonderful storyteller. We enjoyed our time with her so much, and we hope we have the opportunity to learn from her again. This was the best food of the whole trip!

reviews.name: Mary Avery
reviews.text: The cooking class was educational and more than I thought it would be. Chef Yui was very patient, her instructions were clear and simple. Most of all her personality was just delightful. I am by far not a cook and I felt like one in her class. I definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Farah Hannah
reviews.text:
Chef Yui did an amazing job at hosting us. The group was not too big, just the four of us which is great as we get more attention and help from Yui.

We made 4 dishes, Pad Thai, Chicken with Cashew Nuts, Red/Green Curry Chicken and lastly she will make for us a mango sticky rice.

Honestly for some one like me who doesn’t cook it’s amazing how fun it was and she made everything so easy, with preparing for us all the ingredients and taking us through step by step thoroughly how to cook the Thai dish. Had fun eating all our dishes as well after.

Yui is an amazing storyteller as well, little did I know already 5 hours had passed by, as she told us stories of how she learnt to cook from a very young age - and even sharing with us tips and tricks in the kitchen. Her mini kitchen is also very clean and tidy, which is great for someone OCD like me. Will definitely come back to learn from Chef Yui how to make more dishes! She really teaches you how you can cook anywhere!

At the end, she also brought us to the market nearby to show us the fresh ingredients and some ingredients that only Thai markets carry.

Thoroughly enjoyed myself and it was money definitely well spent, thanks to Yui for welcoming us into your home, and really pouring your heart and soul into teaching cooking to me (an idiot who doesn’t cook at home) 😂

reviews.name: Sami M
reviews.text: Chef Yui is a great cook and storyteller. The class was so fun. Make sure you come hungry because you will make LOTS of food!

reviews.name: Lorenzo Ferrazzano
reviews.text: We took a private cooking class with Chef Yui at A Lot of Thai and it was one of the highlights of our trip. Yui is an incredible teacher, super funny, and patiently helped us with every dish. We made Khao Soi, Tom Yam Goong, Pad See Ew, and Sweet Sticky Rice with Mango, and everything was amazing. I can’t recommend this enough!

reviews.name: Love Food & Travel
reviews.text:
We did the cooking class and food market tour with Yui- her husband Kwan collected my family (we have two teenage daughters) from our hotel and dropped us back.
We cooked a chicken stir fry, pad thai and green and red curry. She also demonstrated how to prepare the mango with sticky rice which we also ate. Needless to say we were so full after eating all the food but it was all so delicious we could not-not eat everything!!. Our advise would be to skip breakfast 🤣🤣 and you’ll only need a light supper if anything that evening.
Yui is a professional chef with years of culinary experience. She has worked with famous international chefs (Jamie Oliver and Gordon Ramsay have asked her for advise/recipes), has made guest appearances on popular TV cooking shows (Masterchef) and is an acclaimed food critic…despite all these accreditations she is incredibly modest and a genuine and lovely person with a real passion for food and the science behind cooking.
We all found her so interesting and inspiring- and we all felt confident we could replicate the dishes we made again at home.
The cooking stations were perfect and well equipped- we felt we were in a traditional Thai home and felt very comfortable.
This was a memorable experience and we feel honoured to have been taught by the best!
Not to be missed if you are coming to Chang Mai.

reviews.name: Brian Fuerst
reviews.text:
Chef Yui did a great job about teaching how to make Thai food, not just recipes.  We started off at the market teaching me about the different Thai ingredients.

After 24 years of doing this, she knows what she is doing.  When we got back to her house, everything was set up for the first dish.  She showed me how to cut the things up and then she cooked the dish and then let me try to cook it.

We ended up cooking three different dishes and I received a cook book that had all the recipes cooked and many more.  This is a great place to spend part of a day eating and gaining some cooking skills.

reviews.name: Rachel Simon
reviews.text: We had such a great time taking Yui’s cooking class! She was an excellent teacher, and the meals we made were beyond delicious. Such a cool experience!

reviews.name: Joel Plavin
reviews.text: Best cooking class ever.  Chef is funny, patient and very clear instructor.  We will be able to recreate yummy Thai dishes at home.    She even took us to the market to buy ingredients that we can take home.  Highly recommended experience

reviews.name: Isaac Fisher
reviews.text: A friend saw my partner and I were visiting Chiang Mai and recommended we take Yui’s class.  There may be cheaper options, but as you’ll see, this was 100% worth it. We got picked up at the hotel and had an excellent cooking experience. Yoi worked hard to show us how to modify recipes to be able to do it in our own countries.  When we left I felt much more prepared to cook some amazing Thai dishes when we get home. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Clare Green
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful private cooking class with Chef Yui! From the moment we met her, she was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and full of fascinating stories that really brought the experience to life. She even took us around the local market, explaining ingredients and sharing her knowledge of Thai food and culture, which we absolutely loved. Cooking with her was fun, relaxed, and so informative. A truly memorable experience that we’ll cherish, highly recommend!

reviews.name: Noemi
reviews.text:
I think it’s my 3rd or possibly 4th time here over the last 15 years. There are many cooking classes in Chiang Mai, so why come back to this one? The food is fabulous, the setting lovely, quality of ingredients and care for every single details is top notch. But what makes this stand apart from any others is Yui who runs it with her husband Kwan.

There is no better place to learn how to make with ease some iconic Thai dishes. But this is the ONLY place where you also get invaluable understanding of the chemistry and physics of cooking, philosophy of life, and dozens of cooking tips which carry over beyond Thai cuisine. All this while having fun.

Now you know why I keep coming back!

Edited: back again and learning something each time. It’s one thing to make good food, a number of people can teach you that. But to understand the food you make, well, that’s something Yui masters.

reviews.name: Leigh Strong
reviews.text: A fantastic class where you learn the basics of Thai cuisine and get to prep and cook four courses. Yui, the teacher and owner, is enigmatic, inspiring and highly skilled. All the dishes prepared use fresh local ingredients and taste phenomenal. As a break from the kitchen heat,  Yui takes you to her local market to show you how bustling it is and where you can sample what's on offer. Essentially, think of the ripest most succulent fruit and veg that you get here in the UK - their out of season produce tastes better! A cookbook is also given to you so you can replicate the dishes at home, that is if you can source the ingredients (alternatives are listed). All in all, a well run and brilliantly fun experience.

reviews.name: Charles Lammers
reviews.text:
We are a couple visiting on our honeymoon from Colorado, USA. A Lot of Thai: Home Cooking Class was definitely the highlight of our Thailand trip, thus far. Chef Yui picked us up  from our hotel in a beautiful vintage VW bus and took us to her home/school where we were guided through the methods to cook Pad Thai, Tom Kha Coconut Soup, Panang Curry and Holy Basil Chicken. We made all sauces as we went along and Yui shared a background on each of the ingredients, including alternate ingredients to use once we return home if certain local ingredients are difficult to acquire.

In addition to a wealth of Thai cooking knowledge, Yui was kind enough to accommodate our numerous requests for photos of ourselves with our creations and shared a lot of her background with us, including her experience as a judge on an internationally known cooking show.

Chef Yui shares a personal connection with all who cook with her, which made this class feel very special. We HIGHLY recommend this experience to other couples, but could see families and smaller groups enjoying this experience as well. Thanks, Chef Yui!

Tips for those interested in this experience:
-For four dishes, the experience took roughly 3 hours, so plan a window of about that much time.
-There is no obligation to eat all of the food prepared if you get too full.
-English was the spoken language for our lesson and there was no issue understanding dialogue at all.
-The environment is VERY hygienic/clean with regular handwashing and proper food safety practices being followed by all participants.

reviews.name: Michael Best
reviews.text: The best cooking school in Thailand with Yui , the funniest, kindest, warmest instructor you will ever meet.

reviews.name: Erica Tucker
reviews.text: Excellent experience all around. From the food market visit to the mango sticky rice ending, everything was super tasty and we felt like accomplished chefs ready to try it at home! Pick your favorite day by the menu! Whole foods, no short-cuts here!

I was so impressed that I also signed up for a PT package with him, and I’m excited to see results over the next 3–6 months with such a professional and friendly coach.

The facilities are absolutely top-notch one of the most luxurious gyms in Bangkok! They have everything you could need: a pool, wall climbing, salt room, sleeping pods, ice shower, steam room, and even complimentary attire if you forget yours. The equipment is excellent, the place is very clean, and all the staff, from coaches to reception, are incredibly friendly.

I highly recommend Virgin Active and give this team a full 5 stars! Thank you for such a professional and welcoming experience.

We were also invited to watch Xmax trainers fight on two evenings which was an amazing experience!! We had 3 fights and won them all by knockout!!!

The trainers at Xmax are also so welcoming, talented and professional, no matter what level you are training at they can adapt to you. They are also friendly and funny! We made such great friends and I would definitely go back and train with them!

reviews.name: JKD London
reviews.text:
I arranged a private 6-day Muay Thai Kickboxing camp for 20 of my students in Aug 2019, including 7 nights accommodation in the adjoining XMAX hotel.

XMAX arranged for 7 instructors to provide 4 hours of training each day.

All the trainers are highly skilled, accomplished competition fighters, really professional, and made the hard training a lot of fun with jokes and laughter.  We were lucky to see 3 of the instructors compete in local competitions in Chiang Mai, and all 3 took wins home.

The facility is huge, and well equipped, with 2 huge training areas with hanging kicking bags, 3 boxing rings, a cage, filtered water, gym area and pro-shop where you can buy top quality Thai martial arts equiment including boxing gloves, hand wraps, shin pads, kickpads, belly pads, t-shirts and shorts (and  much more).

The XMAX hotel is new, safe and clean, with a swimming pool and hidden away among nature with its' own lake.  There are 3 restaurants on-site, and additional coffee shop and restaurant 2 mins walk round the corner when you get hungry after all the hard training.

I would highly recommend XMAX and the on-site accommodation and restaurants for anyone really serious about training with an authentic and reputable Muay Thai martial arts school.

XMAX, XMAX, XMAX... HAPPY HAPPY  :-)

reviews.name: Chanatip Pongsatornkajorndee
reviews.text:
*** แนะนำ แนะนำ แนะนำ ***

ปกติไม่ค่อยใช้บริการสปา หรือนวด/สระผมเลย แต่เนื่องจากคุณอาชอบใช้บริการ จึงพามาใช้บริการที่นี่ ประทับใจมากๆเลย แพคเกจไม่แพงอย่างที่คิด

โดยจะมีให้เราเลือกทั้งหมด 6 สูตร (เลือกมา 1 เพื่อใช้ในการสระผม)
- Swan Relax Sunset
- Swan Plumeria Flower Fresh
- Swan White tea Organic
- Swan Rice Milk
- Swan Coconut Original
- Swan Sakura Fresh (ผมเลือกอันนี้ หอมซากุระมากๆ)

ขั้นตอนแรก จะเข้าไปในห้อง ให้นอนบนเตียงนุ่มๆ สบายๆ แล้วก็จะเคาะกระดิ่งเบาๆ บริเวณหู ให้ความรู้สึกดีมาก จากนั้นก็จะใช้ น่าจะเป็นขนนกยูง มาลูบบริเวณใบหน้า ดวงตา ผ่อนคลายจริงๆ

ขั้นต่อไป ก็จะเปิดน้ำอุ่นเพื่อเตรียมสระผม พร้อมกับนวดให้อย่างผ่อนคลาย

ขั้นต่อไป ก็จะใช้แผ่นมาสก์หน้า แล้วให้เรานอนผ่อนคลายประมาณ 10-15 นาที จากนั้นก็ มานวดหน้า และล้างหน้า สระผม ตามลำดับ

ขั้นตอนสุดท้าย ก็มาเป่าผม โดยเราสามารถเลือกได้ ว่าจะให้ดัดผมตรงไหม หรือว่าไดร์เป่าผมให้แห้งธรรมดา ก็เป็นอันเสร็จเรียบร้อย

ที่นั่งรับรองเย็นสบาย เปิดแอร์ฉ่ำๆ สำหรับท่านที่นำรถยนต์มา สามารถจอดที่บริเวณหน้าร้านได้เลย

พี่ๆน้องๆที่ร้าน ให้บริการอย่างดี เป็นมืออาชีพ มีอัธยาศัยดี มีใจให้บริการ ขอชื่นชมครับ

ไว้จะมาใช้บริการบ่อยๆนะครับ,,
reviews.textTranslated:
***Highly Recommended***

I don't usually go to spas or get massages/hair washes, but since my aunt loves them, she brought me here. I was very impressed! The package wasn't as expensive as I thought.

There are 6 different treatments to choose from (I chose one for the hair wash):
- Swan Relax Sunset
- Swan Plumeria Flower Fresh
- Swan White Tea Organic
- Swan Rice Milk
- Swan Coconut Original
- Swan Sakura Fresh (I chose this one, it smells strongly of sakura!)

First, you go into a room and lie down on a soft, comfortable bed. They gently ring a bell near your ear, which is very relaxing. Then, they use what seems to be peacock feathers to gently stroke your face and eyes – truly relaxing.

Next, they turn on warm water to prepare for the hair wash while giving you a relaxing massage.

Following that, they apply a face mask, and you lie down to relax for about 10-15 minutes. Then they massage your face, wash your face, and wash your hair again.

Finally, they blow-dry your hair. You can choose whether to straighten it or just have it blow-dried. That's it!

The waiting area is cool and comfortable with air conditioning. If you come by car, you can park in front of the shop.

The staff are very friendly. Excellent service. Professional, friendly, and service-minded. Highly commendable.

I'll definitely be back for more services.

reviews.name: Pantiwa Tanprasert
reviews.text: จองคิววันนี้ 16.00 สรุปมาถึงพนักงานดันไปจองคิววันพรุ่งนี้ ขับรถจากแม่โจ้มาหวังจะมาใช้บริการสรุปคือมาเสียเที่ยว เสียทั้งเวลา และความรู้สึกมาค่ะ

ownerDescription:
Thai massage is a form of bodywork that originated in Thailand.
A foot massage is used on the muscles located around the front and back of the feet. Techniques such as acupressure, frictions, skin rolling and trigger pointing are used to help treat acute pain, post injury, post-surgery and scarring.
An aromatherapy massage is a type of massage therapy that uses essential oils to promote relaxation and well-being.
Body scrub at a massage parlor is a rejuvenating treatment that gently exfoliates your skin, removing dead skin cells and impurities.
A face beauty treatment that cleans and improves your skin tone and texture with the use of foam ,scrub,lotions,masks and massage therapy.
Pedicure and manicure are scrub, cut and colors.

reviews.text:
Peaceful and relaxing massage business and a super clean atmosphere. The massage table linens are clean, which is greatly appreciated.

The owner Pimpa is sincere about massage therapy and her business. She has good and consistent technique and she worked with my body structure with ease.

I felt relaxed and at one point went to a deep relaxing sleep state. Her technique is not the typical "No pain. No gain." style that some therapists perform in Thailand. But she does have strong delivery at the right points.

I had a one hour Thai massage which is a good value for the price. Next time I will try for 1.5 hrs. This was my first time but I'll be back for sure.

reviews.name: おんちゃん
reviews.text:
I completed the Basic Thai Massage and Thai Oil Massage courses. The school is located in a very safe area, and the accommodation next to the school was only a one-minute walk away. There were also plenty of restaurants and a local market nearby, so I never had any trouble finding food or shopping for daily necessities.

This was my fourth massage school in Chiang Mai, and personally, CNF was the best one I have attended.

Napa and Beam are incredibly kind teachers, and their classes are thorough and easy to follow. I learned far more than just the techniques in the textbook, as they shared many valuable insights and practical skills from their experience. They were also always willing to answer questions in detail.

I truly enjoyed learning from them and have grown very fond of both of them. I’m already looking forward to the next time we meet. ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely words.
We truly enjoyed having you in class and are so happy to be part of your massage journey. Thank you for your trust, kindness, and support.
We already look forward to seeing you again! 😊🙏

reviews.name: Mike Bravado
reviews.text:
Beam and Napa are a mother daughter duo with soft, gentle, patient and caring feminine energy. Their space is very welcoming and they were patient enough to answer any questions I had without making me feel rushed or awkward. Their English is very good and their massage technique mimics their character - very healing

It feels like they are in this line of work not just for money, but to pass along the healing qualities and lineage of Thai and Chinese body and energy work.

A special touch I haven’t seen before is at the end they had not just hot tea but also a fresh young coconut and mango waiting for me.
They also let me relax for as long as I wanted after.

If you’re looking for a place that genuinely cares, this is it
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your generous review and for sharing your experience. We are happy to hear that you felt comfortable and well cared for during your visit.
We appreciate your support and wish you good health🙏

reviews.name: Pieter Wynen
reviews.text:
I've had a Chi Nei Tsang massage with Beam and was extremely impressed. I've had these type of massages before, but this massage felt like complete in so many ways.
People can be skillful and knowledgeable, which she definitely is -she know what she's talking about-, but feeling the pressence and safety is in my opinion something you can't learn, and -for me- essential for this type of practice.
Also the room being created to talk afterwards about what showed up for me and for her (from medicine/therapy perspective) was wonderful.

I recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words and for taking the time to share your experience. I truly appreciate it.

reviews.name: L S
reviews.text: Very nice staff and good massage, especially when you look for help for a specific issue. Was there already two times and will come again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your kind feedback. I truly appreciate your trust and look forward to welcoming you again

reviews.name: Brooks Call
reviews.text:
I received two abdominal detox massages from Beam two weeks apart. The procedure is pretty intense but the benefits were noticeable, accruing over days after the procedure. My guts literally shifted into new positions. Old pain gradually disappeared. Highly recommend.  It's expensive for a massage here, but this is a technical and highly energetic procedure that takes complete concentration on the providers part - every movement felt intentional and intuitive.
Went back for a reflexology, wife got neck and shoulder. Our only regret in our trip to Thailand is not going here more.
There will be pain and discomfort, but they are driving it out of your body instead of soothing it for a moment. An accupressurist once told me "I'm going to give you a months worth of pain in ten seconds, then the pain won't come back." I kept this in mind and it really helped 😁
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for sharing your experience. 😊

I'm truly grateful for your trust and happy to hear that the treatments helped you. It was lovely meeting both of you, and I'm honored to have been part of your Thailand journey🙏✨️

reviews.name: Maya
reviews.text:
Adore this place so much. The moment I walk into the shop, I flet relx already by the colours and all the decoration in the space. The place its full of light and bring energy.
Napa and beam its so warming and loving and caring during the class or outside the class.  I learned oil massage and Chi Nei Tsang here. It was beyond my imagination.
I am not only learned the skill and also the gentle power of hand movement.
thanks for letting me more awaer of body and look life as new eyes.
More greatful and compassion generate within me.
Iooking forward to have more learning and receive massage here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words. Looking forward to seeing you soon! ☺️
