reviews.text: Napa, founder of CNF massage school has the most gentle way of teaching. She taught me Thai Yoga level1 most patiently, dilligently, after one week i had great improvements in posture and strength. Napa gives unconditionally, and her service is relentless. Every morning she brings her students fresh Thai delicate fruits and home made coconut dishes, always with a smile, and her daugher and other staff is super friendly and professional. A perfect combination of professional training and tasting the luxurious feeling of Thailand relaxation. I love her <3

We are appreciate your support 🙏 
Hope to see you again soon.

She had a lot of patience and it’s very experienced and what she do, I for sure recommend this Massage school to everyone 👌

Teacher Napa shares all her knowledge openly and kindly. I was met with kindness throughout my course. I was served with teas and good energy everyday :)

reviews.name: Tiffany Sue
reviews.text: Completed a basic thai massage course here. Napa is a wonderful teacher who is patient and caring. Everyday she provides tea and snacks and always give me time to rest and take notes. You learn directly one on one from the teacher so she can correct your massaging immediately. I hope I can take more classes here in the future. 🩷
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words and for sharing your experience. It was a pleasure to teach you, and I truly appreciate your trust. I look forward to welcoming you back for more classes in the future.

reviews.name: Doris
reviews.text: Returning to CNF was the most important part of this Chiang Mai trip.Reconnecting with Kru Napa and meeting Kru Beam for the first time was wonderful.Under their expert hands, my family and I felt completely realigned.After completing the insomnia massage that night, I had a great night's sleep.The next day, the long-standing strain and blurriness in my eyes were finally relieved.We only managed to fit four massage sessions into this trip, and without a doubt, every single one had to be at CNF.I miss it already.I will definitely be back.Wishing both teachers good health, and I look forward to the day we meet again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your beautiful words. 🤍
It truly means a lot to us that CNF was part of your Chiang Mai trip, and we’re so happy you and your family felt the difference.

Wishing you good health always, and we’ll be waiting to welcome you back to CNF again. Until next time! 🥰🙏🏻✨

reviews.name: Minol
reviews.text:
I took the advanced Thai massage class by teacher Napa in CNF.

I have been learning Thai massage for 2 years. I studied at several massage schools in Chiang Mai and work as a Thai massage therapist in Japan.

I think the unique thing of CNF is the one-on-one lessons. By receiving a massage directly from the teacher and then immediately massaging the teacher back, you can get immediate feedback and posture corrections.
I believe it’s most efficient way to learn techniques.
But if you already learn massage in class, you know it’s usually rare to give and to receive massage directly with teachers.

I recommend CNF for all levels and especially people who learned basic of massage already and have questions about details.

It was an incredible opportunity for me to receive massage for 5days by very experienced teacher and could ask many questions that had been gathered in my mind over the past two years.

Napa, Beam, thank you very much for generously sharing your deep massage knowledge and always welcoming me not only student but also as a friend.
I’m very happy that I could find this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the amazing review. Your kind words truly mean a lot to me and inspire me to keep doing my best! 
See you soon ☺️

reviews.name: Jules Rozenwajn (Jules Seizart)
reviews.text:
One of the best teacher I ever had for traditional Thaï massage. As professional therapist, I highly recommend Napa for her precious skills, she’s brave and take care of her center as I never saw one before.

Just pay attention, she’s not taking part of Loi Kroh traditional Thaï anymore. She owns her center with her family.

Thanks Napa for your time 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🥰

reviews.name: Alan BD
reviews.text: Wonderful traditional Thai massage and therapy. They offer many treatments for specific conditions. Their experience in training is top quality. Book with Napa and she will guide your specific massage needs.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Alan so much for your kind words. We’re truly happy to hear that you enjoyed the traditional Thai massage and therapy. It means a lot to us that you value our experience and training.

We’re especially grateful for your trust in Napa. You’re always very welcome, and we’d be happy to take care of you again whenever you visit.

reviews.name: Erik Strøm Hansen
reviews.text:
Having moved to Chiang Mai I was really happy to discover that I really good and professional massage therapist in the neighbourhood. Had a 60 minute thai massage session with Beam and it was a great experience. She really took the time to find out how my body responded and adjusted the treatment to suit me and my needs. I've since been back for foot massage, head massage and abdominal detox massage and I've been really happy with the service every time.

This shop has now become my go-to place for massage in Chiang Mai, and I cannot recommend it highly enough.

Thank you Beam. Tusen takk!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the wonderful review! 
Wishing you good health, and we hope to see you again often. Thank you Erik!

reviews.name: Valerie Trujillo
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a caring and therapeutic touch you have found your place. Whether you’re looking to receive a massage or take a class , CNF is amazing.

As a student: I have had many teachers of Thai Massage in Chiang Mai and what CNF offers is unique and very special. One on one classes with masters of their craft. To get to experience the massages directly from your teacher as well as hear feedback from them when they receive your touch is invaluable. They are able to see and feel the minor adjustments that need to be made to properly execute your moves for optimal benefit and pleasure to your client. I learned things that i didn’t learn from  many hours at other schools in just a couple of hours of my first class.
They are amazing therapists and truly beautiful humans that care deeply about your education.
I cannot recommend them enough and I am SOOO grateful that I came to study with Napa.

As a massage client: Napa has a touch that is so calm and precise. When you receive a massage from her you dont feel like it is just a copy and paste routine. She takes time to see and feel where your limitations are and to relieve them. A truly caring touch informed by many years of practice and knowledge.

Pictured below is an example of the delicious and thoughtful break time snacks that I received during my studies 🫶🏼

Thank you Napa, I will miss you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🥰🥰🥰🙏

reviews.name: Martynas
reviews.text:
Like me, you’ll probably find yourself wandering around the city in search of a massage that embodies everything you’d expect from a great experience—a caring touch attuned to your body’s needs and aches. I’m convinced you’ll leave feeling better than when you arrived, and you’ll most likely end up booking another appointment 😉

Additionally, I was fortunate to study massage here. Having attended over a dozen schools during my three-month journey, CNF stands out as one of the best experiences I’ve had. Their intimate one-on-one approach to teaching fosters an environment where there’s ample time to ask questions and receive detailed answers. All while being patient and understanding.

Thank you, Napa and Beam. I hope to see you again in the near future! 🤗
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Martin for the kind feedback. 
We are also very pleased that you are interested in our school and have been dedicated to learning massage. 
We hope to meet you again soon .

reviews.name: Katya Gopher
reviews.text:

reviews.name: River Wood
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience.
I had two treatments here. One 60 minute Thai Massage with Napa and One 60 minutes abdominal detox treatment with Beam. Before the session there is a foot bath with fresh botanicals and a salt scrub to cleanse the feet. Tea, fruit and coconut water was provided as well to welcome and refresh. There was an intake form before starting the session to support a personal customized treatment. Both sessions were provided with care and skill, very present and intuitive. Lasting benefit. I highly recommend.

reviews.name: Minoru Nakamura
reviews.text:
I recieved Chineitsang(abdominal massage) by Beam.
I’m a massage therapist from Japan and got abdominal massages in deferent places before. But I couldn’t enjoy most of time because of pain by tightness of abdominal muscle and organs. But her gentle and deep touch was very comfortable for me. I really enjoyed it. and I’m very ticklish person especially for side of my body. But I never felt ticklish by her touch. I was very surprised at this. I felt stillness and peace in my belly after her massage. I highly recommend her massage for everyone, but especially people who couldn’t enjoy abdominal massage before because of pain and ticklishness like me.

Thank you so much for giving me a new perspective of massage:)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the review. It means a lot to me, and I truly appreciate it.

reviews.name: Noo Vega
reviews.text:
Wow! If you’re needing to have a quality massage in a lovely environment that is peaceful with gentle music with lovely staff in Chiang Mai then this one is for you. With so many places to choose from in the city this one should be high up on the radar for service & cost.
My husband and I both experienced exceptionally good  foot massages & Thai massages by therapists Duen and Fah , highly recommend these two. It’s so great to come out of somewhere as a couple and both rave about how good our treatments were. Great central location and afterwards we had a lovely free gentle tea with a lovely beautiful crispy treat (I had to buy a tube of these yummy seed snacks!)
Inside you have comfortable reclining chairs for the foot massage and the best bit is that the Thai massage is done on a massage bed that has a face hole! This is a major advantage as most places you don’t have a face hole and it’s on the ground . The therapists were attentive, really experienced and everything flowed so well that the whole experience was brilliant. My therapist (Fah) managed to remove a nice tight knot  out of my shoulder area and Duen has made my husband discover his relaxed body again having been suffering from aches in his back! Well done and we shall return. We have found our happy place for a decent quality well priced massage 👏👏👏

reviews.name: M Lai
reviews.text: Friendly and polite staff, clean and comfortable environment, with relaxing music and nice aroma. They even serve a snack and tea after the massage. Wonderful experience. Will definitely return if I am back in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Rodney Jay Ines
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Massage Land and wanted to share my experience.

Firstly, I found the prices to be very affordable, which is a significant plus. The staff were incredibly accommodating, arranging my appointment on very short notice, which I truly appreciated.

My therapist was exceptionally skilled, professional, and kind. He took his time during the session, ensuring I was comfortable and relaxed throughout the entire massage. I never felt rushed, which made the experience all the more enjoyable.

While the environment could use some improvements, the overall experience and the relaxation I felt during the massage far outweighed any minor drawbacks. I would definitely recommend Massage Land to anyone looking for a quality massage at a reasonable price.

Thank you for a wonderful experience!

reviews.name: Faye Banks
reviews.text: Fah at Massage Land is a first rate masseur. The best massage since living in Thailand for 7 years- I was shocked. The service is kind and friendly too. Pay a visit you will not regret it

reviews.name: 貝貝
reviews.text: 歐買嘎 超蘇胡！Masseuse Leung was so professional, I chose 120 minutes foot and hot oil, and enjoyed every second of it. She also gladly helped cracked my back at the end even though it wasn’t included in my original set. Oh and the massage chair was extra comfy than all places I’ve been!

reviews.name: Kenjisan20
reviews.text:
This massage place is 50 baht more than the usual 300 baht (per hour) at other establishments in Chiang Mai. Is not much of an increase but you’d expect a bit better service or environment.

I visited here a year ago and it was fine so I returned this time. I booked a 2 hours Thai massage but unfortunately I had to asked for the massage to stop after the first hour. It’s because the masseuse was just touching the same area continuously without applying any pressure, aiming pointlessly, and felt like she didn’t want to be there, just bad energy so I could not have a relax state of mind. I’ve been to many massage establishments in Thailand and have to say this was one of the bad ones. Reading other negative reviews, seems like I may have encountered the same bad masseuse that others complained about. Luck of the draw I suppose, and to be fair it could happen else where.

Aside from the disappointing experience, the place is clean and the cashier/receptionist is very kind, and refunded my 2nd hour. Would have been nice if they refunded the full 2 hours. So 2 two stars for this review.

Will I visit here again or recommend friends to visit? Probably not as there are better establishments in the near by vicinity in Old Town.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your honest feedback. First and foremost, please accept our sincerest apologies for the disappointing experience you had. We are truly sorry that the massage did not meet your expectations and that you felt a lack of energy and pressure during your session.

We appreciate your kind words regarding our cleanliness and our receptionist’s service. Regarding the masseuse you mentioned, we would like to clarify that the senior staff member often referred to in older negative reviews is no longer working with us. The therapist who attended to you is a new member of our team whom we initially felt confident in; however, it is clear that their performance on that day was not up to our standards or your needs.

We value your long-term support since your visit last year, and we would like to make things right:

Full Refund: Since you were only refunded for the second hour, we would like to refund the remaining first hour as well. We believe you shouldn't have to pay for an experience that wasn't relaxing.

A Second Chance: We would love to invite you back to give us another try. If you decide to return, please let us know in advance, and we will personally select our best therapist with strong, consistent pressure to ensure you receive the high-quality Thai massage you deserve.

Please contact us directly via Line: @090mtyrf /Email: lumruay.massageandspa@gmail.com / Tel 081-7946142 so we can arrange the refund and discuss how we can welcome you back.

We hope to have the opportunity to restore your faith in our spa.

Warm regards,

The Management Massage Land, Chiang Mai

reviews.text:
I’m giving this place two stars only because of the really cute and professional receptionist. Unfortunately, everything else was terrible. I booked two one-hour oil massages for my parents, but my mom ended up receiving only about 20 minutes of Thai massage, which is a much cheaper service. because the masseuse didn’t even listen to what the receptionist told her.

This was my parents’ 3rd massage during their trip to Chiang Mai, and the therapists kept checking the clock and barely did any actual massage movements, just lightly touching without real technique. Overall, a very disappointing experience. I would never come here again and definitely do not recommend it.

reviews.name: Alan Lofthouse
reviews.text: I don't know whether this is the best massage in Chang Mai because I've not had another one or a Thai massage before but what I can tell you is that my experience was top class. Warm polite welcome. Professional and courteous staff who helped us navigate to the massage area. We had a Thai massage and a back and neck massage. The area was clean and lit just right. Everyone was quiet and it was super relaxing. The masseuse was brilliant. He felt areas of tension and gently manipulated me to get the area moving well. I was really impressed and then at the end we got green tea and a biscuit. The price was really good for the experience we got. An hour of being pampered was well worth it.

reviews.name: צדף הרץ
reviews.text:
I’ve had many massages before, but this was my first time receiving a massage from a male therapist — and it turned out to be a truly wonderful experience.
He was attentive, gentle, and precise, with great sensitivity to my body’s pain and tension. I felt completely safe, respected, and deeply relaxed.
The place was very clean, peaceful, and the staff were all kind and professional.
Highly recommended for anyone seeking a high-quality, healing massage experience.

reviews.name: 황주하
reviews.text:
We visited as a couple.
An elderly woman gave me the massage, but she was simply rubbing aimlessly without applying any real pressure. I couldn’t feel anything — it felt like she didn’t want to be working at all. Her technique was sloppy and unprofessional, and she didn’t even massage the left and right sides evenly.

The male masseur who worked on my boyfriend applied so much pressure that he started sweating from the pain. It was uncomfortable and excessive.

These are not professional masseuses. It seemed like they were only there to make money and were just going through the motions.

To be fair, the shop itself is clean and the staff are friendly. The crispy snack and sweet potato tea offered after the massage were nice.

But overall, it was a complete waste of money — 600 baht for nothing. I’d rather throw that money on the ground.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your incredibly detailed and honest feedback. We are profoundly sorry that your visit as a couple resulted in such a terrible experience and want to offer our deepest apologies for the unprofessional service you received.

It is unacceptable that you felt your time and money were wasted, and we fully understand why you feel that way. We were particularly concerned to read your descriptions of both therapists:


We want to assure you that the **elderly female therapist** you described is the same individual mentioned in other critical reviews, and she is **no longer an employee** at our shop. She was unable to meet our standards for professional consistency and technique.


We appreciate you noting the **cleanliness of the shop** and the kindness of the staff. However, we know the quality of the massage itself is what truly matters.

We truly hope you will give us another opportunity to provide the excellent service you expected.

เป็นครั้งแรกที่ได้เปิดประสบการณ์การนวดหน้าจากผู้เชี่ยวชาญแบบคุณปอย ประทับใจตั้งแต่การรับนัดจัดคิว การส่งรายละเอียดต่างๆ ทั้งเรื่องนวด และเส้นทางการมาที่คอนโด

แม้ว่าจะไม่มีหน้าร้าน และแอบตื่นเต้นนิดๆ กับการไปรับบริการที่ห้อง แต่ทุกความกังวลก็หายไป นอกจากการจัดห้องได้น่ารักมากแล้ว ยังได้รับการเอาใจใส่ในทุกสิ่งอย่างที่คุณปอยตั้งใจให้บริการ ระหว่างการนวดรู้สึกสบายใบหน้ามาก หลังจากนวดแล้วไม่มีความผิดปกติใดใด ไว้จะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time experiencing a professional facial massage like Ploy's. I was impressed from the moment I made the appointment, from scheduling to receiving detailed information about the massage and directions to her condo.

Even though she doesn't have a physical shop and I was a little nervous about receiving the service at her place, all my worries disappeared. Not only was the room beautifully decorated, but Ploy also showed me incredible attention to detail in every aspect of her service. During the massage, my face felt incredibly relaxed, and there were no noticeable problems afterward. I will definitely be back for more services.

reviews.name: Pair Pairgii
reviews.text:
ไปนวดหน้าครั้งแรกค่ะ จัดเต็ม 2 ชม. กับคุณปอย(คนนวด/เจ้าของห้อง/เพื่อนสาว555)นวดดีมาก ไม่มีกั๊ก บอกรายละเอียดหลายอย่าง นวดบ้านคุณปอยเอง สะอาดมาก ก ล้านตัว สถานที่ปลอดภัยมากค่ะ มีแค่คุณปอยกับเรา เดินทางสะดวก ตอนนวดสบายจนหลับแต่พยายามตื่นอยากซึมซับความรู้สึก 555
หลังนวดแก้มยกค่ะ ยกเลย คิ้วยกด้วยค่ะ ไม่เจ็บนะ แค่ตึงๆ หน้าเบามาก อาจจะไม่ได้เห็นผลในครั้งแรกทุกคนนะ แต่ค่อยๆทำดีที่สุด ไม่กล้าใช้เข็ม ตัดสินใจมาดีกว่าที่คิดมากๆ จริงๆไม่อยากรีวิวนะคะกลัวคิวเยอะ 555
reviews.textTranslated:
I went for my first facial massage. It was a full 2 ​​hours with Khun Poy (the masseuse/owner of the place/my girlfriend, lol). The massage was amazing, she didn't hold anything back, and explained many details. The massage was at Khun Poy's house, which was incredibly clean (a million times cleaner!). The place felt very safe; it was just Khun Poy and me. It was also conveniently located. During the massage, I was so relaxed I almost fell asleep, but I tried to stay awake to fully absorb the feeling, lol.
After the massage, my cheeks were lifted, really lifted! My eyebrows were lifted too. It wasn't painful, just a little tight. My face felt so light. You might not see results on the first try, but it's best to do it gradually. I didn't dare use needles. It was such a good decision to come, I'm glad I did. I really didn't want to write a review because I was afraid of getting too many clients, lol.

reviews.name: Nutthida JOY
reviews.text:
สวัสดีค่ะ วันนี้ขอรีวิวจัดเต็มกับการนวดหน้าครั้งแรกในชีวิต (ฉบับคนไม่เคยเข้าคลินิก) เรามีสภาพผิวหน้าที่แห้ง และมีสิวเสี้ยนเยอะตรงจมูก มีสิวอุดตันด้วยค่ะ เลยเลือกโปรแกรมนวดหน้าดีท็อกผิวโปรตามแนบเลยค่ะ
ความรู้สึกระหว่างนวด : มือคุณปอยนวดลงน้ำหนักมือแต่ละส่วนทั่วใบหน้าต่างกันค่ะ มีหนักเบา กลิ่นมาส์กหอมมาก ส่วนตัวชอบมากๆ เหมือนได้รับการใส่ใจ (ความรู้สึกส่วนตัว)
ความรู้สึกหลังนวด : หน้าเบามากค่ะ ผิวสัมผัสนุ่ม และรู้สึกว่าหน้าสะอาด (คุณปอยให้ดูสิ่งสกปรกที่ออกมาเยอะมากค่ะ) รู้สึกดีมากๆ เลยค่ะ
หลังจากตามมาจากรีวิวที่เพื่อนบอกต่อ ตอนนี้เราจองนวดดีท็อกครั้งต่อไปเรียบร้อยค่ะ🥰
ปล. เรารีวิวจากความรู้สึกจากสภาพผิวหน้าของเราเองนะคะ คุณปอยไม่ได้ขายตรงหรือหนักอะไรเลยค่ะ พร้อมกลับบอกให้เรากลับไปดูแลตัวเองด้วย เพราะความสวยเริ่มต้นได้จากตัวเรา เราอยากให้เพื่อนๆ ที่ผ่านมาลองสักครั้งค่ะ นอกจากจะนวดดี สถานที่สะอาด ห้องน้ำสะอาดมากค่ะ และยังได้รับพลังงานดีๆ กลับบ้านด้วยนะคะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Hello everyone! Today I'm sharing a full review of my first ever facial massage (from someone who's never been to a clinic before). I have dry skin and a lot of blackheads on my nose, as well as clogged pores. So I chose the detox facial massage program as shown in the attachment.
My experience during the massage: Khun Poy applied varying pressure to different areas of my face, from light to heavy. The mask smelled amazing. I really loved it; it felt like I was being taken care of (my personal feeling).
My experience after the massage: My face felt so light, soft, and clean (Khun Poy showed me how much dirt came out). It felt so good!
After following a recommendation from a friend, I've already booked my next detox massage. 🥰
P.S. This review is based on my own experience with my skin condition. Khun Poy wasn't pushy or trying to sell anything. She even encouraged me to take care of myself because beauty starts with ourselves. I want to encourage anyone who comes across this to try it at least once. Besides the great massage, the place is clean, the restrooms are spotless, and you'll also leave with positive energy.

reviews.name: Nu Gussy
reviews.text: เป็นครั้งแรกที่เปิดประสบการณ์การนวดหน้า ประทับใจมากๆ เราเลือกนวดแบบศาสตร์หัตถดาบส นวดสปายกกระชับปรับรูปหน้า อย่างแรกคือก้าวเข้าห้องไปคือห้องสวยมาก หอมสุด (ใจอยากถามเลยค่ะใช้กลิ่นอะไรค่ะ) คุณปอยก้ออธิบายแนะนำได้ดีมากๆ พอนวดแล้วรู้สึกผ่อนคลายมากๆ สบายหน้า สบายหัว นวดจนเราหลับไปเลย หลังนวดรู้สึกโล่งสบาย ต้องมีครั้งต่อๆไปแน่นอนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time experiencing a facial massage, and I was very impressed. I chose the traditional Thai massage technique, a spa massage for lifting and contouring the face. First thing I noticed was how beautiful and fragrant the room was (I really wanted to ask what scent they used!). The masseuse, Ploy, explained everything very well. During the massage, I felt incredibly relaxed; my face and head felt so good, I even fell asleep! I felt so refreshed and relaxed afterwards. I'll definitely be back for more!

reviews.name: Thanaporn P
reviews.text:
ได้นวดกับคุณปอยครั้งแรก ประทับใจมากๆ ตั้งแต่ก่อนเริ่มนวด ระหว่างนวด และหลังนวด คุณปอยแนะนำและให้ความรู้เกี่ยวกับการนวดหน้า การดูแลผิวหน้าหลังจากนวด ได้มากขึ้นจริงๆ ค่ะ
ขอเป็นลูกค้าประจำต่อเนื่องเลยนะค้า ❤️😊🥰
reviews.textTranslated:
I had my first massage with Khun Poy and I was very impressed. From before, during, and after the massage, Khun Poy gave great advice and shared a lot of knowledge about facial massage and post-massage skincare. I really learned a lot!
I'll definitely be a regular customer! ❤️😊🥰

reviews.name: Metzine Pwy
reviews.text: บรรยากาศร้านเงียบสงบ ผ่อนคลาย ห้องน้ำสะอาดมากๆ เป็นร้านนวดในดวงใจ ประทับใจการบริการมากค่ะ คนเป็น introvert แบบเรา รู้สึกถึงความเป็นส่วนตัวมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: The atmosphere is quiet and relaxing, and the restrooms are very clean. This is my favorite massage shop. I'm very impressed with the service. As an introvert, I felt very much at home with a great deal of privacy.

reviews.name: อัฒฐดา ศรีเสริม
reviews.text: พึ่งเคยนวดหน้าครั้งแรก ประทับใจมากค่ะ รู้สึกเลือกร้านถูก คุณปอยเป็นกันเองมาก และบรรยากาศตอนทำสบายสุด ๆ หลับไปเลยค่ะ คุณปอยนวดหน้าได้ละเอียดมาก สิ่งสกปรก สิวเสี้ยนออกจากรูขุมขนจนหมด ชอบผิวหน้าหลังทำมากค่ะ กลิ่นมาส์กก็หอมอ่อน ๆ ไม่ฉุนมาก โดยรวมดีทุกอย่างค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time getting a facial massage, and I was very impressed. I feel like I chose the right place. Khun Poy was very friendly, and the atmosphere during the treatment was incredibly relaxing; I even fell asleep! Khun Poy did a very thorough facial massage, removing all the dirt and blackheads from my pores. I loved how my skin looked after the treatment. The mask also had a lovely, subtle scent that wasn't too strong. Overall, everything was perfect.

reviews.name: Warunee Sripodok
reviews.text: มาลองนวดหน้าครั้งแรกก็ประทับใจมากเลยค่ะ รู้สึกได้เลยว่าผ่อนคลาย สบายผิวมาก คุณปอยเจ้าของร้าน เป็นกันเองพูดคุยน่ารัก แนะนำเทคนิคการดูแลผิวหน้าให้ด้วย บรรยากาศดี มีความเป็นส่วนตัว แนะนำเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I tried a facial massage for the first time and was very impressed! I felt so relaxed and my skin felt amazing. The owner, Khun Poy, was very friendly and lovely to talk to, and she even gave me skincare tips. The atmosphere was great and very private. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Piyachart Maikaew (Yuii)
reviews.text: จองคิวได้แล้ว มาวันธรรมดา นวดดีท็อกซ์ ผ่อนคลาย หลับไปเลย ห้องจัดแต่งน่ารักมาก ไว้จะกลับมาใหม่แน่นอน ลองโปรแกรมอื่น ๆ บ้าง ใกล้บ้านนนทบุรี ชอบเลย
reviews.textTranslated: I booked an appointment and came on a weekday for a detox massage. It was so relaxing, I almost fell asleep! The room is decorated so cutely. I'll definitely be back to try other programs. It's close to my house in Nonthaburi, I love it!

reviews.name: Nichaphan Jiraanantachat
reviews.text: การบริการดีมากค่ะ ประทับใจมาก คุณปอยนวดหน้าดีมากค่ะ หลับสบายและยังได้ความสวยด้วย น่ารักเป็นกันเอง สถานที่สะอาดบรรยากาศดีมาก แล้วจะแวะมาบ่อยๆนะคะ
reviews.textTranslated: The service was excellent, I was very impressed. Poy's facial massage was amazing; I slept so well and felt beautiful at the same time. She was lovely and friendly. The place was clean and the atmosphere was great. I'll definitely be back often!

reviews.name: Pitchayarat Wanvuttikul
reviews.text: ประทับใจมากค่ะ บรรยากาศเป็นส่วนตัว นวดสบายจนหลับ ทำแล้วรู้สึกว่าครีมบำรุงซึมได้ดีกว่าเดิม ผิวดูอิ่มน้ำขึ้นแบบเห็นได้เลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I was very impressed. The atmosphere was private, and the massage was so relaxing I fell asleep. After the treatment, I felt like my moisturizer absorbed better and my skin looked noticeably more hydrated.

reviews.name: Khingkha ̈
reviews.text: เป็นประสบการณ์นวดหน้าครั้งแรกที่ประทับใจมาก เราเลือกจองมาเป็นเวลาหลังเลิกงานคือถูกใจสุดๆ เหมือนได้ผ่อนคลายจากการทำงานมาทั้งวัน นวดเพลินจนหลับไปเลยค่ะ สถานที่ก็สะอาดตกแต่งอย่างดีให้ความรู้สึกเป็นกันเองสบายๆ คุณปอยก็ให้คำปรึกษา ให้การบริการและดูแลเป็นอย่างดี เราเดินทางด้วยรถไฟฟ้าก็สะดวก มีครั้งต่อไปแน่นอนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first facial massage experience and it was amazing! Booking an appointment after work was perfect – it was so relaxing after a long day at work. I even fell asleep during the massage! The place was clean, well-decorated, and felt very friendly and comfortable. Poy was very helpful, providing excellent service and care. It was also conveniently located near the BTS Skytrain. I will definitely be back!

reviews.name: nutthachon sunprakhon
reviews.text: ระบบการจองชัดเจน ราคาบริการมีให้เลือกหลายโปรแกรม สถานที่นวดเป็นห้องคอนโดรับลูกค้าแบบไพรเวท สถานที่สะอาดมากกกก ตกแต่งน่ารักมากกก คุณปอยพูดคุยแนะนำหลายๆเรื่อง (ไม่ใช่แค่เรื่องนวด) มานวดครั้งแรกประทับใจ มีส่วนลดวันเกิดให้ด้วย ขอบคุณอีกครั้งนะคะ ตั้งใจจะมานวดมือล้วนอีกแน่นอนนน ❤️❤️❤️
reviews.textTranslated: The booking system is clear, and there are many service programs to choose from. The massage place is a private condo, very clean and beautifully decorated. Poy was very friendly and offered many recommendations (not just about the massage). I was very impressed with my first massage experience, and they even gave me a birthday discount. Thank you again! I definitely plan to come back for another manual massage. ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: Pranisa Theanthong
reviews.text: เป็นการนวดหน้ากัวซาครั้งแรก ประทับใจมากเลยค่ะ  คุณปอยเจ้าของร้านเป็นกันเอง น่ารักมาก  บรรยากาศห้องน่ารัก หอมอ่อนๆ สะอาด เรียบร้อย  ตอนนวดรู้สึกผ่อนคลายมาก (จนเผลอหลับเลยค่ะ) และชอบมากอีกอย่างนึงคือ ใช้น้ำมันหอมละเหยของ doTERRA ด้วย สดชื่นมากๆค่ะ  หลังนวดเสร็จรู้สึกผิวหน้านิ่มๆ รอยดำรอยแดงของสิวจางลงนิดนึงด้วยค่ะ คุณปอยให้คำแนะนำการดูแลผิวหน้าหลังนวดอย่างถูกวิธี บริการดีมากๆเลยค่ะ แนะนำให้มาลองนวดหน้ากับคุณปอยกันนะคะ (ปล.มีแนะนำสถานที่มู ขอพร สิ่งศักดิ์สิทธิ์ด้วยนะคะ)
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time getting a Gua Sha facial massage, and I was very impressed! The owner, Khun Poy, is very friendly and lovely. The room has a lovely atmosphere, a subtle fragrance, and is clean and tidy. The massage was incredibly relaxing (I even dozed off!). I also really liked that they used doTERRA essential oils, which were very refreshing. After the massage, my skin felt softer, and my acne scars and dark spots seemed to fade a little. Khun Poy gave me great advice on proper post-massage skincare. The service was excellent! I highly recommend trying a Gua Sha facial massage with Khun Poy. (P.S. She also recommended places to visit for blessings and good fortune!)

reviews.name: Bo Bhornrat
reviews.text:
นวดกัวซา ครั้งแรก รู้สึก เบา สบาย ผ่อนคลาย รู้สึกผิวหน้านุ่ม และสะอาดสดชื่นขึ้นด้วยค่ะ

บรรยากาศ ดีมาก เป็นกันเอง ให้ความรู้สึกเหมือนมาบ้านเพื่อน จัดสถานที่ได้สะอาด เรียบร้อย เป็นสัดส่วนดีมาก ให้บริการทีละคน private มากๆค่ะ

การเดินทางสะดวก มีที่จอดรถ (ค่าจอด 20บาท) หรือจะมารถไฟฟ้าก็ได้
reviews.textTranslated:
My first Gua Sha massage felt light, comfortable, and relaxing. My facial skin felt softer, cleaner, and fresher.

The atmosphere was great, very friendly, and felt like visiting a friend's house. The place was clean, tidy, and well-organized. They provided one-on-one service, making it very private.

It's conveniently located with parking available (20 baht per parking space) or you can take the BTS Skytrain.

reviews.name: นายอรุณ พรรณวิญาณ
reviews.text: ร้านสะอาด บรรยากาศดี รับทีละคิว ไม่ต้องห่วงเรื่องคิวชนกับคนอื่น เดินทางก็สะดวก มาได้ทั้งรถไฟฟ้าและรถส่วนตัวเลย
reviews.textTranslated: The shop is clean, the atmosphere is nice, and they serve customers one at a time, so you don't have to worry about overlapping queues. It's also conveniently located, accessible by both the BTS Skytrain and private car.

title: Lp Beauty spa huahin
ownerDescription: Body Massage , Foot Massage , Facial Massage , Body Scrub , Manicure , Pedicure , Nails Gel , Pedicure&Foot Scrub , Eyelash Extensions , Waxing , Brow wax , Brow wax&Tint , Brow Lamination , Luxury Foot Spa
address: 4, 122 Hua Hin 98 Alley, Tambon Hua Hin, Hua Hin District, Prachuap Khiri Khan 77110, Thailand
plusCode: GXX6+WW Hua Hin, Hua Hin District, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
✨️Overlay Builder gel Moding GB25✨️
Booking 10:00am -  20:00pm
☎️ : 061-863-8355 

🏡Location :

reviews.name: Lia
reviews.text:
Very unprofessional experience.

The gel manicure started peeling after only 5 days, showing poor quality work. When I returned, I was initially dismissed and told the technician had left during working hours. Only after insisting did they agree to address part of the issue.

Later, I came back to have the gel removed from my toenails and was told to return in 2.5 days because they were “busy” which was not true. There were no clients, and the staff were clearly avoiding me.

When I first raised the issue in front of other customers, they behaved normally. However, when no clients were present, they refused to come out, and eventually one staff member came out and started yelling at me, saying she “doesn’t like me,” while the other staff were laughing.
She didn't listen to me at all she was just yelling. First time I encounter this type of behaviour in Thailand.

Overall, very poor service, dishonest behavior, and completely unprofessional staff. I would not recommend this salon.

Upd

I strongly disagree with your response.

I have had my nails done in many other salons without any issues, and I have also seen similar complaints about gel peeling in local expat groups regarding your salon.

I remained calm throughout the situation and did not behave rudely or aggressively. It is also not true that I refused to listen to your staff — the situation escalated when your staff started shouting at me and laughing.

I did not return for additional service. I only came to have the gel removed, which was applied by your salon.

I was asked to wait, and I did. However, during that time staff remained behind a closed door and did not respond. I knocked to get clarification, and at that point the situation escalated when staff came out and began shouting at me.

I also did not do anything to any staff member’s phone, as you claimed.

If there is CCTV footage showing otherwise, I would appreciate it being reviewed, as I am confident it will reflect what actually happened.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 1. Your nails are very thin, so thin that the gel polish won't adhere. What do you want me to do? It's your nails, and we've already taken responsibility for that. 2. We avoided you because you behaved rudely towards my staff. You said removing the gel polish only takes 5 minutes, which is completely untrue. reviews.text:
Came here based on reviews. My massage was good, but my husbands wasn’t so leaving an in between review.

There are a number of beds upstairs separated by curtains where most massages take place. We opted for 90 minutes, a mixture of Thai and Oil massage. My therapist was very good, firm in areas I asked her to be and good pressure throughout. By comparison, my husband said his therapist spent most of the time talking to the other therapist next door.

So maybe luck of the draw or you can ask at reception when booking?

One thing I did find frustrating and would be some friendly feedback to management is that as and when new people arrived or left for their massages, I found they and their therapists to be quite noisy. Whilst I get that this happens, I think reminding therapists to speak quietly / whisper would encourage the same from other clients too, to enable a more relaxing experience throughout for everyone.

Would come again.

reviews.name: Anna Sebastian
reviews.text:
The worst massage I’ve ever had.
I went for a 1 hour foot massage and was shocked by the experience!
My “therapist” was a really old lady who could barely walk, she couldn’t speak a word of English and had 0 technique.
She was randomly gliding her hands in very uneven motion (like she was just applying lotion)  and the whole time she was staring out the window/entrance door, just looking out and gliding her hands, then when I requested the lady behind the counter to ask this woman to increase the pressure, she started digging deep into my legs and I was in pain! I’m telling her it’s hurting and she’s laughing at me!!
I just wanted it to end, I sat there hoping at some point it would get better.
I’m sorry to leave a bad review, but save yourself the time and money if you’re considering this place as the only reason I went there was because Kim’s massage next door where I wanted to go was fully booked out for the day. And this was my last day in Thailand.
Ended my trip with a horrible massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Regarding customer issues with massage services, we can solve a problems by changing the masseuse. However, we cannot resolve complaints about the masseuse's Age. The age of our staff is beyond our control. Customers who opt for Thai massage should understand that each masseuse has different skills and pressure techniques. Some masseuses may apply gentle pressure, while others may apply firm pressure.

For sure you paid for the service it mean you can have the right what you paid, you can request a change of masseuse at the front desk for that session if you don't like it since begin. However, if you only request that the masseuse apply more pressure and then complain that it's too painful when masseuse more power, we can't imagine what you want.

reviews.name: Micaela Nguyen
reviews.text:
R and R Massage offers a distinctive take on traditional Thai massage that sets it apart from the typical experiences found in California. Unlike the common practice of standing on your back, their approach leans towards a blend of sports, deep tissue, and trigger point massages. One noteworthy feature is the ability to customize the intensity level, allowing clients to choose between medium and hard pressure.

My personal encounter with a 'hard' massage left me with mixed feelings. While I appreciated the thoroughness in addressing knots and tension, the intensity bordered on the verge of unbearable, leaving me sore for a few days. The variation in each session keeps things interesting, as the therapists employ different techniques, ensuring that no two massages are exactly the same.

Sue, who administered my last two massages, showcased skill and attentiveness. The late operating hours, closing at 11 pm with the last appointments at 10 pm, make R and R Massage a convenient choice for those seeking a post-work or evening relaxation session.

One unique aspect of the massage experience is the use of stretches in unconventional positions. These maneuvers aren't meant to be misconstrued as anything sexual but rather explore the limits of your body's flexibility. The language barrier in communicating the desired intensity can be a hurdle, but overall, the staff is accommodating and aims to meet individual preferences.

Considering the affordability at 350 baht for a 60-minute session, R and R Massage offers exceptional value for the quality of service provided. Despite the occasional intensity surprises, the unique experience and skilled therapists make it a worthwhile stop, especially for those looking for a distinct Thai massage encounter. Don't miss the chance to give them a try, conveniently located across the street from Tiger Muay Thai.

reviews.text:
WARNING: DO NOT VISIT THIS PLACE. This is NOT a legitimate massage establishment. If you are looking for a real, professional Thai massage, DO NOT GO HERE. What happened to us was sexual assault. Please read everything below before you consider visiting.

My husband and I went to this massage place in Phuket Old Town because it looked nice from the outside. What happened there still makes us feel sick.

Right away, the woman assigned to me was rude. She snapped at me: "Next time pick oil massage, ok? Thai massage hurts." I've had Thai massage many times before - I know exactly what it is. Her attitude was hostile and dismissive.

Then it got much worse. The woman turned all the lights completely off. In the pitch dark, the male masseur laughed. Why would he laugh? The woman turned the lights back up slightly, and they started massaging us very poorly while talking to each other and looking at their phones, even answering phone calls. Already this felt completely wrong.

Then the man said something to the woman and she immediately turned the lights back down to almost complete darkness again.

That's when he started touching my husband's PRIVATE PARTS! Over and over. This wasn't accidental. This was deliberate sexual groping under the cover of darkness during both the leg and arm portions of the massage. My husband was in deep shock. He didn't know what to do. He just froze and pretended to sleep, hoping it would stop. He felt humiliated, violated, and dirty.

When it was over, the woman looked at me with this knowing smile and asked, "Your husband?" Like she knew exactly what had just happened. But at that moment, I had no idea what had occurred and just felt that something was terribly wrong and disturbing.

My husband left shaking. He explained everything to me. He felt ashamed even though he did nothing wrong. He was sexually assaulted. That's what happened. They assaulted him and, of course, we had already paid before knowing what would happen.

We've had authentic Thai massages all over Thailand. This wasn't that. They don't deserve any customers or positive reviews. They don't deserve to have those beautiful traditional Chinese decorations and interior design. That facade only makes people who want a decent, relaxing, authentic Thai massage feel deceived and hurt. Don't be fooled by the respectable atmosphere they've created! This is something predatory and disgusting pretending to be a legitimate massage parlor.

Do not go there! My husband is still dealing with the trauma of what happened. This place should not be allowed to operate.

reviews.text:
DO NOT GO THERE!!!
It was my second time there and it's the worst experience ever! I've been in thailand for more than 1 years and been trying massage everywhere, this place looks fancy but once you start your treatment it turn in a night market, 1 hour pf massage they talked with each other loud and non stop, people moaning 2 cabins away, I took a couple massage with my girlfriend, between the massage one of the masseuse went out, came back in and left the curtain open, we didn't noticed at first because we were laying face down! I could hear people coming in and out just behind and they definitely saw me and my girlfriend butt naked while going to their cabin! So unprofessional, they should be sued for this, there is no privacy, you pay for a treatment but end up being expose to public. I say this with confidence because when I finished and walking out I saw people butt naked getting their massage down. Once again they are so noisy and the treatment nowhere close relaxing and enjoyable. Lastly, worst of all, it's been 24 hours and I swell on my vertebrate and it's very painful, can't even touch there, I said soft but the masseuse's been running her elbow on my vertebrate. This is not massage, this is torture. I don't understand how this place is still open and operating. Don't waste money there, there are many options across the street.

reviews.text: I took the 3.5hr spa package at 17:30hr. The whole session felt like eternity. So if you want the long spa package, better to do it earlier. Since i had the spa package, i had the treatment room on the top floor which was exclusive & quiet. The massage, jacuzzi, steam bath were ok-ish but i did not like the facial treatment. It says on the package description "facial massage" and i literally thought it was just a facial massage of maybe 15min. Turned out to be a full-fledge facial session from cleansing to scrub to this/that mask/cream. No, i did not enjoy the "facial massage".

reviews.name: g.p
reviews.text:
I recently had a massage that was rather great and reasonably priced. However, the experience was marred by the chatty masseuse. They were talking at their usual volume throughout our 1 hour and 30-minute session, rather than whispering which I felt is polite if they really had to have a conversation.

Even though the massage itself was alright, we couldn't rest or nap and fully enjoy the session due to the constant noise.

Even more unprofessional was the behavior of the elderly group of masseuse. When a guest in another section let out gas, she loudly broadcasted it, causing her group of masseuses, including mine, to laugh out loud I felt bad for the other customer, as it’s only natural that such things might happen when you’re being tugged and stretched.

Overall, if you don't mind the chatter, this place would be fine for you.

reviews.name: S B
reviews.text:
My Husband and I chose a 60 min Thai Massage followed by a 90 min Oriental Deluxe Facial today.
Before we had our treatments, I specifically told the therapists not to talk amongst each other if we are going to share a room and I put this on Google translate to ensure they understood. They advised me that they will not, BUT they did and by the look on my face my Husbands therapist knew to stop however this did not stop them from muttering to each other throughout our experience.

1. Did not wash our feet or provide slippers prior to the treatments.

2. No special clothes were provided for the Thai Massages. 20 minutes was spent patting our backs with a towel.

3. During our Facials they missed out a key step (black head removal) I then brung this to both of their attention and they replied, you both don't need. It doesn’t matter if they think we don’t “need it”  we’ve paid for that package specifically and not the cheaper package which did not include that step. They then proceeded to include this but had I not have noticed, this would have been missed.

4. They also left out massaging our ”legs massage” which was also part of the Oriental Deluxe package and when I challenged my masseuse about this at the end of the service   She said that she included this in my Thai massage. Which was a completely different service! She then disassociated herself with answering any other questions and stopped engaging with me whilst my Husbands Therapist pretended like she couldn’t hear.

DON’T PROMOTE PACKAGES WHEN YOU CANNOT COMPLETE A PACKAGE SERVICE WITHIN THE REQUIRED TIMEFRAME.

It’s a shame, because although the services were not great I would have still tipped, but that was sheer disrespect at it’t finest and we will NOT be returning.

As I was leaving I asked for her name and she ignored me and said “Sit I do massage” AS IF I WAS GOING TO LET HER TOUCH MY LEGS AFTER THAT!

I also want to mention that they all look miserable, uninterested and OLD, lack enthusiasm and warmth.

DO NOT GO HERE, Sabai Sabai is only doors away!

reviews.name: Daniel Yates
reviews.text: Went for an Oriental massage, and having had a few massages from other countries, this was by far the best and most thorough I’ve experienced for its price point! Also found the masseuse to be friendly and entertaining!

reviews.text: Had a great massage here yesterday morning with my brother in law. We had sports massage with coconut oil massage for 2hrs. Very good and felt great afterwards. Only thing I would add is I'd prefer the curtains fully closed around me for more privacy as I find it easier to relax when I know no one is looking at me. reviews.name: Kulook Hannah
reviews.text:
I came to this massage place because I saw good reviews. I even waited 30 minutes before getting a massage, but I didn’t mind since the ratings were so high. Once we went in and started, my friend did Thai massage. We had to ask before they gave us clothes, and the curtain wasn’t closed properly, so there was no privacy at all because other people can see your body.

During the massage, when the therapist massaged my thighs, I couldn’t stop laughing because I’m sensitive. The therapist stopped and gave me a very sharp look with some words which I don’t understand,I felt so rude. Yet they were chatting and laughing with other therapists, so I really don’t understand why they treated me with such disrespect.

And also before the massage, one of the therapists used a scrub to wash my feet. However, both of my feet already had abrasions, and they still washed them very roughly, which was painful and uncomfortable.

This was the worst experience I’ve ever had. Even though the massage technique was decent, the staff’s attitude was extremely rude, and it completely ruined any sense of relaxation or enjoyment.

ownerUpdates.text:
Five weeks. 150 hours.
You begin by learning Thai Massage. Then you add more. More techniques. More positions. Walking Massage. Body Balancing. Bone Setting.
But collecting techniques is not the point of the program.
The interesting part begins when you have enough tools in your hands to stop thinking only about the tool.
By Week 4, you are reinforcing what you have learned, correcting weak points, adding more techniques and beginning to put the different approaches together.
Your attention starts moving away from:
“How do I perform this correctly?”
toward:
“What am I feeling?”
Then comes Week 5.
You begin working with real clients under supervision. And suddenly, the body on the table does not care what was on yesterday’s lesson plan. 
You have to listen. Observe. Choose. Work. Notice the response. And sometimes change direction.
That is the progression of the Sirichan Therapeutic Bodywork Practitioner Program:
The training is shaped by more than 30 years of clinical bodywork practice in Thailand.
It runs only once each year, with a maximum of 12 students.
5 weeks · 150 hours · 39,500 THB at Sirichan Thai Healing Center, Chiang Mai, Thailand.
Curious? 
👆 Explore the full 5-Week Practitioner Program

THE FACE IS NOT A FORMULA.

Chantra, the facial signature of Sirichan Thai Healing Center, is not one routine repeated on every client. You learn to read the face first, then choose the work.

Developed by Dr. Sirichan over 30+ years of clinical practice, Chantra is a complete manual facial treatment for experienced hands-on practitioners who want more precision, sensitivity and adaptability.

What you will learn (5 days)

Facial observation and assessment
Muscle, fingertip, jaw, eye-area and forehead techniques
Neck and shoulder work
Soft-tissue, connective-tissue and lymphatic techniques
Pressure, rhythm, duration and positioning
Complete Chantra treatment practice

The question changes from "What movement comes next?" to "What does this person need here?"

Your eyes assess. Your hands listen. Your technique responds.

How it works
Demonstration, repetition, supervised practice, correction. Maximum 8 students, so everyone gets personal correction.

Who it is for
Massage therapists, facialists, beauticians, spa professionals, bodyworkers. Previous hands-on massage experience is required.

20,000 THB (tuition included) · Maximum 8 students

To apply, email connect@sirichan.org with your full name and your massage/bodywork experience.

You come to learn a technique.
We teach you how to use it.
Looking to deepen your bodywork practice and move beyond basic routines? 
At Sirichan Thai Healing Center, you’ll master more than just movements - you’ll learn how to truly listen and respond to the body. 
Whether you want to specialize in a specific modality or take your skills to a master level, explore our training options:
➡️ Abdominal Massage
➡️ Chantra Face Massage
➡️ Amataros
➡️ Tok Sen
➡️ Herbal Ball Therapy or 
➡️ the full 5-Week Therapeutic Bodywork Practitioner Program
Different courses. 
Same underlying approach.
Technique is only the beginning. You learn it, practice, receive real-time corrections, and practice again. Once the movement becomes second nature, your attention shifts to what truly matters:
✨ What do I actually feel?
✨ How is this area connected to another?
✨ How is the body responding right now?
✨ Should I hold, adjust pressure, shift position, or adapt my technique?
What sets our training apart:
🤲 30+ Years of Clinical Wisdom: Rooted in real therapeutic practice from Thailand. 
🤝 Serious Training: High focus, precise correction, and deep repetition.
🫶 Light Atmosphere: Shared meals, open questions, laughter, receiving treatment, and connecting with a community of passionate practitioners.
If you are ready to step away from simply collecting more certificates and start broadening the way you work, join us in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Martin Wilfer
reviews.text:
Sirichan Thai Healing Center in Chiang Mai offers holistic, full-body treatment – a combination of traditional Thai massage, therapeutic bodywork, and targeted treatment of specific complaints.

I originally came in for just a single session because of neck pain. Nui then treated me so thoroughly and helped me with issues I hadn’t even been aware of. Now I can breathe more freely, feel lighter in many movements, and I’m no longer so stiff.

This isn’t a typical “wellness” massage. You come here when you want to bring your body back into balance for the long term – with real, lasting results.

It’s a shame I could only fit in three sessions before moving on – I’d honestly come every week if I could. When I’m back in Thailand, I’ll definitely return. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Conscious Design & Architecture
reviews.text:
After six years of living in Thailand, I finally found what I had been looking for—and much more. I have had many massages throughout my life, but my experience with Dr. Noi was completely different.

Her treatments combine authentic traditional Thai massage and Thai medicine, taking the whole body into consideration rather than focusing only on individual aches and pains. After just a few sessions, my body felt much more balanced and comfortable.

I especially recommend the abdominal massage and the traditional Thai tools Dr. Noi uses. They helped me feel significant relief in my lower back, neck, joints, and throughout my body. The treatments also helped calm my nervous system and gave me a deep sense of relaxation and well-being.

I am extremely satisfied with Dr. Noi’s holistic and deeply healing approach. I highly recommend her treatments to anyone looking for more than an ordinary massage. This is holistic healing treatment.

reviews.name: Chantelle Cassar
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of learning from Nooy, and I can confidently say she is a truly wonderful teacher. Her knowledge, patience, and passion for massage therapy made every minute of the learning experience enjoyable and enriching. She creates a comfortable and encouraging environment, and her teaching style is both clear and hands-on. I walked away not only with new skills but also with a deeper appreciation for the art of massage. Thank you, Nooy, for your guidance and inspiration!

reviews.name: Helena
reviews.text: Dr. Nui does really amazing therapeutic and pain relieving medical massage! I’ve sprained my right ankle dozens of times to the point where i hold so much fear and tension in those tendons. Whenever i recieve bodywork i just tell the practitioner to avoid that area normally because i don’t trust people to touch it. After a 2hr session with Dr. Nui my foot felt like it had been through the car wash (brand new!) and felt pleasant like there was more space in it. I actually went to her for help with tendinitis in my OTHER foot so I didn’t even expect this. And my other foot also felt so much better too :) the session was painful but she definitely knows what she’s doing! Trust the process

reviews.name: Grant Martens
reviews.text:
The Professional Face Lifting class was an amazing learning experience. I’ve studied Head and Face massage at several other Thai schools, and I even teach it at my own school. But I signed up for this course as much to learn from Dr. Nooy as to explore this specific modality.

And now I've just completed an incredible two-week, 60-hour journey learning Traditional Thai Abdominal Detox Massage with Dr. Nooy.  I have never been more exhausted from learning, but never been more satisfied with how much I have learned in these two weeks.

From day one, I was blown away by this Dr. Nooy's techniques. Not a single technique overlapped with what I already knew from hundreds of hours of studying Thai massage. Plus Dr. Nooy’s teaching style focused on identifying what needed to be addressed rather than simply memorizing a sequence without considering the client’s unique needs.

I was fortunate to be her only student for the Abdominal course, which meant that Dr. Nooy taught me at the speed I could understand. In the first week I did feel a bit overwhelmed, but after countless hours of working with clients that she brought in for me, by the end of the second week I was doing 2-hour treatments using techniques that were all new to me.

The abdomen is essential to Traditional Thai Medicine for a number of reasons, but this is the first school and the first teacher who has not only given me practical techniques for working the abdomen, but, more importantly, helped me understand how to assess and treat what needs to be done for my clients.

I haven’t even returned home to Canada yet, but I already have numerous bookings from clients eager to try both the Thai Face Lifting and the Thai Abdominal massage treatments. I highly recommend these courses to anyone looking to learn from a true master in the field.

I am forever grateful that I found Sirichan Thai massage school. Thank you Dr. Nooy for the gift you have given me.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Grant. Yoy are an absolute star student and I am so grateful for your dedication in sharing Thai ancient healing wisdom. Thank you! Nooy

reviews.name: Marc Garcia
reviews.text: I booked a course in this school after reading how good it was to learn from an expert doctor from a family of doctors, with focus on the feel and healing aspects of massage in their website, instead of just techniques. After travelling to Chiang Mai and starting the course I discovered all what the website said was a fraud. The doctor was not teaching the course, and instead what they offered was a super basic poorly implemented course on massage techniques. At no point we were taught why we were doing the technique, what were the benefits... It was just shown by the instructors how to do certain massage technique, and then we repeated it, half of the time without anyone looking at us or giving us feedback. Similar to what you would get by watching youtube videos on Thai massage and practicing with a friend. After telling them about this, I was told that the course wouldn't be very different if the doctor was teching, and I was offered to be able to cancel the rest of the course, but I still had to pay for the first week. A good deal for them, not very good for me. The school also has poor standards on hygene, I would have appreciated if people were asked to wash their feet before having to give them a foot massage. Not a good school, there are surely much better options in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We regret that your experience did not align with your expectations. When you shared your concerns with us in person, we immediately offered a refund, which you accepted with appreciation.

As we explained, Week 1 is designed to establish a strong foundation before progressing to more advanced experience-based learning—this is true for any professional training course. Our programs are specifically structured for individuals who are or wish to become professionals, as clearly stated on our website. Given this, it seems our course may not have been the right fit for you, and we understand that your review reflects that frustration.

While we cannot change your experience, we remain committed to delivering high-quality professional training with full transparency about what we offer. Your feedback has helped us refine our communication, and we sincerely wish you the best in your continued learning journey.

reviews.name: Carlo Crestani
reviews.text:
Being already a certified massage therapist, I was looking some who could teach me new skills and techniques. So I chose Dr. Nooy's clinic in order to learn the art of traditional thai massage and bone setting.
After taking the courses, I can only recommend Sirichan clinic and dr. Nooy to anyone who wants to seriously study massage in order to be able to heal others. Not only were the lessons very comprehensive, but Dr. Nooy has always been available to explain the details, demonstrate the techniques and clarify all doubts.
Certainly what distinguishes this course is a great attention to the correct learning of the student and the application of massage techniques as a real tool to help the client heal. Furthermore, during the practice I had the opportunity to follow and massage various people and clients of the clinic, immediately putting into practice what I had learned. This is really a big plus, since in many massage courses you usually only practice with other students. Here, however, you have the opportunity to put into practice what you have learned on real cases, under the careful supervision of Dr. Nooy. Furthermore, the atmosphere is pleasant, familiar and relaxed, which certainly favors learning.
If you are looking for a traditional Thai massage course or if you are looking for someone who can help you solve physical problems through this art of care, look no further and trust the Sirichan Clinic.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you ka, Carlo, for this beautiful review. Enjoy your new techniques and tell us how it goes.

The facility felt old, and the walls were very thin—you could clearly hear people slamming doors and chatting, which made the experience far from relaxing.
My therapist was Chai. Before the session began, I asked for strong pressure. He applied strong pressure for a few minutes, but then it became very light—essentially just rubbing oil on my skin with zero pressure. I asked again for stronger pressure; he adjusted it briefly, but once again returned to light rubbing. He did not use a variety of techniques, just repeatedly worked on the same areas in the same way, which made it feel like he was simply trying to kill the time rather than provide a proper massage. The session also ended 10 minutes early after I refused whatever special massage he offered me.
Overall, paying 1100 baht for a 90-minute oil massage was extremely expensive given the poor skill, bad service, and outdated facility. For 650–900 baht, you can find much better massages almost anywhere in Chiang Mai. This experience was a complete waste of my time and money.

reviews.name: KYUNGAH KANG
reviews.text:
On February 17, I originally had a reservation at 9:30 PM at Kim’s Massage No.5. However, when me and my daughter arrived, we were informed that they couldn’t provide service because of a power outage in the area. While searching on Google for the latest-open massage shop nearby, we happened to find this place just a 6-minute walk away.
Sometimes during travel, unexpected moments turn into even better experiences than planned — and that’s exactly what happened here. The staff were incredibly kind, the place was clean and comfortable, and I met a cheerful, highly skilled therapist. In just 90 minutes, she found my long-standing problem areas and did her absolute best to treat them. I could genuinely feel her sincere desire to help and heal through her massage.
If I visit Old Town again, I will definitely come back to this place only.
Pro tip:
If you give your tip before the massage instead of after, you may receive even better service.

reviews.name: Ohm Ohm
reviews.text:
I visited this place a few days ago. The masseuse had no idea how to massage; it wasn't comfortable or relaxing at all, and the prices were quite high. I booked a 2-hour aroma massage, but the therapist tried to offer me 'other services' and practically forced me to leave a 3,000 THB tip against my will.

This was my first time getting a massage in Chiang Mai, so I didn't complain right away, thinking this might just be the norm here. However, after trying other massage shops, I realized that nowhere else behaves this disgustingly. That's why I came back to write this review about my experience.

I absolutely do not recommend this place. The staff has zero massage skills. Furthermore, not only the masseuse, but the receptionist also aggressively pressured me into buying a 6-hour course. To be honest, I was genuinely scared. I have never had a massage therapist offer sexual services during a session before.

Edit: Even though I already attached a photo of the room I used, you still have the nerve to say I wasn't a customer. You are truly shameless.

reviews.name: Jasmine Franklin
reviews.text: I booked a 2‑hour aroma oil massage last week for 10:30am and was kept waiting while the receptionist told me the ‘room wasn’t ready.’ Around 10:47am the therapist actually arrived from outside, then immediately took me back, so it felt like they weren’t honest about the delay. The massage itself was just light oiling and press‑and‑hold with almost no real pressure or technique, and my body didn’t feel worked on at all. Staff were polite, but between the misleading check‑in and the poor quality of the massage, I wouldn’t return or recommend this place if you want real therapeutic bodywork.

reviews.name: Richard Gray
reviews.text:
The massage here is quite inconsistent quality. The first time I went it was very good, hence two stars and not one. The second time, I had two hours and the masseuse didn’t even touch the top of my legs. How can you take two hours and miss that large muscle area?? Also, she spent a lot of time on my hands and arms instead. Why bother getting me to fill a form and indicate areas of focus if your masseuse ignores it?

With around 3-4 members of staff there, they had the time to joke around with each other, but not to even ask how the massage was.

Second issue with the second visit today - the receptionist seemed so desperate for us to urgently pay to the point where it was rude. She awkwardly tried to get us to pay in advance when I paid at the end last time. Then while we were sat drinking the tea they gave us, she interrupted us drinking the tea, while I was in the middle of eating the melon, again desperately telling us we need to pay, with the card machine in hand. Very weird…
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We apologize for any inconvenience, we have to get the customers to pay in advance because there are many times that the customers finish the massage at the same time, so it will be very busy. the most important reason, we do not want to interrupt the customers while they're relaxing with their tea after finishing the massage. However, We have to appoligze for the inconvenience again. We will definately fix this problem in the future, and hope you will come back again.

reviews.name: Lail Toub
reviews.text:
I stumbled upon this place as I visited Cafe Kantary next door and didn't regret my decision!!

The prices are a little bit higher than other massage places, but it is worth it!

The place is clean, smells good, and the facility is well maintained. It's not the average walk-in-walk-out massage store.

I got the 60-minute Thai massage for about 450Bhat, and I left the place feeling relaxed. The massuest knew the pressure points well, massage pressure was perfect, and she even pinpointed where I needed a few extra minutes of massage due to the stiffness on my shoulder left from carrying my travel tote bag.

I requested no hair and face massage, and my request was respected.

They wash your feet gently before the massage and provide a clean pair of outfit to wear. The massage oil was my preference, which filled the room with a pleasant scent. Sipping on hot soothing tea and some biscuits is the perfect way to end a massage.

(The picture is blurry because I was running for my Grab 😂)

The masseuse lady was so kind and the other ladies too, they made me feel at home and we're very friendly with me. We had a good laugh when they discovered how ticklish I was 😆
The Thai massage was so healing, it helped relaxing the muscles in my legs, my back, hip. There was even a part where the lady released tension in my head and neck. I recommend this place and will go back myself as well. Good value for money, good vibes.
