ownerUpdates.text:
FACIAL TREATMENT
Better than any selfie Filter.

Deep cleansing, scrubbing, masks, massage, and more creams than you knew existed. 

Basically, we do all the things you tell yourself you’ll do at home but never do. Leaves you glowing like you’ve actually been sleeping properly.

FOOT MASSAGE

Because your feet deserve better than flip-flops.

Your feet did all the walking. 
Let’s reward them. Pressure points, reflexology, and some poking that feels weirdly good. 

You’ll leave floating, wondering 
why you don’t do this daily.

1 Hour = 300 Baht

👉 Tap 'Learn more' to see our full menu and secure your spot.

OIL MASSAGE
The art of melting stress away.

Long, flowing strokes with warm oil that feels like silk on skin. 

Muscles melt, stress dissolves, and you drift somewhere between dream and nap. It’s relaxation in liquid form.

THAI MASSAGE
Like yoga, minus the sweating and chanting.

The classic. We stretch, bend, and press you into shapes you didn’t know you had. It’s like yoga without doing the work. 

You’ll walk out taller, looser, and strangely at peace, like you’ve been rebooted.

1 Hour = 300 Baht
Book online or just walk in.

HEAD, BACK & NECK MASSAGE
Because headaches weren’t on your holiday list.

That heavy head? We lift it for you. Stress melts down your spine as our hands untangle your travel knots. Expect a mix of “ouch” and “ohhh yes” that ends in deep, dreamy calm. Get your reset at Somphet Massage in the Old City.

The Doorway to Sanity

Leave the Old City street chaos exactly where it belongs: outside.

Step through this door and surrender your tired, temple-hopped legs and heavy backpack shoulders. The AC is perfectly chilled, the smiles are genuine, and our therapists actually know how to fix you.

You’re exactly one step away from the best Thai massage near Somphet Market.

reviews.name: Stella Jones
reviews.text: Amazing massage!! We walked in and were in the massage bed within 10 mins. Everyone was incredibly nice and the massage was so relaxing. She was also able to get a lot of my knots out. One hour Thai massage was 300 baht and it was incredible! There is also a barber and nail salon here too. Wish we were staying longer so we could come back! Thank you!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Stella.

We’re glad we could welcome you quickly and get you settled in without much waiting.

Even better that the massage helped you relax and convinced a few stubborn knots to finally let go.

It sounds like Chiang Mai gave you plenty to do and not nearly enough time. If you ever come back, we’ll be here with the massage beds, the nail salon, and the barber still waiting for you. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Annabella Dickson
reviews.text: Came here after several days of exploring thailand and they did an amazing job. Massage was very relaxing and they targeted areas that definitely needed some extra attention. Wouldn’t go anywhere else but here! Seriously the best 😊.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Annabella.

Several days of exploring Thailand can turn the body into a travel suitcase with legs, so we’re glad the massage found the spots that needed extra attention.

“Wouldn’t go anywhere else” is a huge compliment, and we truly appreciate it.

Come back anytime your Chiang Mai adventures start collecting in your shoulders again. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Briony Hooper
reviews.text: Wonderful! We walked in off the street and were warmly welcomed by the professional staff. Husband and I both had the Thai massage and we were both very satisfied with the quality of service. Left feeling loose and relaxed. Highly recommend in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Briony.

Walking in off the street and floating back out a little looser is exactly how a Chiang Mai massage day should go.

Glad both of you enjoyed the Thai massage and felt well looked after by the team.

We really appreciate the recommendation and hope to see you both again someday. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Bobbi Kraham
reviews.text: A terrible experience from start to finish. The worst massage I had in Thailand. Look elsewhere if you want a private relaxing massage. I cut my massage short and could not get out of there fast enough. There is not enough space around the massage table for the therapist to move around so the curtains were constantly  being opened and closed and flapping against different parts of my body. At one point, the curtains were fully opened and I was completely exposed from the waist up to a man who was standing there waiting for a massage. They put him on the other side of my curtain so I had to walk through his space when he was exposed as I departed. Extremely unprofessional and I left far more tense than I started.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Bobbi,

You are completely right, and we owe you a sincere apology. You came to us to relax, and instead, you left feeling stressed and uncomfortable. That is entirely on us.

We usually pride ourselves on providing a peaceful, highly private environment, but we clearly dropped the ball during your visit. Your privacy and comfort should be an absolute guarantee, and we are so sorry that our poor space management made you feel exposed and forced you to cut your time short.

Thank you for your blunt honesty. It was a tough read, but a necessary wake-up call. We have already adjusted our setup and reviewed our privacy protocols with the entire team to ensure our space is managed with the respect and care our guests deserve.

I hope you will come back to see, that we already fixed it.

We are truly sorry we let you down this time, but we appreciate you helping Somphet Massage do better. 🙏

reviews.name: Shaun Jones
reviews.text: Great place! Very clean and reasonably priced. We had haircut, massage and nail services. Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Shaun.

Haircut, massage, and nails in one visit. That’s not a quick stop, that’s a full Chiang Mai maintenance day 😄

Glad you found the place clean, fairly priced, and worth the visit.
We’d be happy to welcome you again anytime. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Sana Rehmani
reviews.text:
AMAZING experience!! P’Sai my therapist was SO skilled and I woke up this morning with no more pain and feel so refreshed 🥰 Will be back again before I leave chiang mai, sadly was only in chiang mai for a few days or I would have stayed longer.

I have been to so many places in bangkok in the past few months and nothing compares to this massage place 🫶🏼🫶🏼
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Sana.

Waking up without pain is the best follow-up message we could ask for.
We’ll pass your kind words on to P’Sai. She’ll be very happy to hear this.
Comparing us to all those Bangkok massages and still coming back says a lot.

If you make it back before leaving Chiang Mai, we’ll be ready. If not, we’ll save your spot for next time. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Canon C. (Kitty Kitty)
reviews.text:
We had a great one hour oil massage here, and fell into a deep sleep and felt completely relaxed afterwords.
The staff was friendly and very polite.
We definitely would love to come back again sometime.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Canon.
Falling asleep is the best review we could ask for, that means the massage did its job.
We’re glad you felt completely relaxed and well cared for.
You’re always welcome back whenever Chiang Mai calls again. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Lauren Vaughan
reviews.text: Wonderful, simply wonderful. I had the head, neck, and back massage for 1 hour for 350 baht. It was beyond professional, clean, and welcoming. I will return this week. Be sure to tip!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Lauren, we love everything about this review — short, sharp, and straight from the neck and shoulders 😌

Thanks for noticing the small things: the cleanliness, the welcome, the care. And yes — tipping your therapist goes a long way, and they always remember it 😉

See you later this week. We’ll have the head, neck, and back ready for round two. 😃🙏

reviews.name: Poser
reviews.text: Just had a really good massage, very professional and got all the right spots! Well needed after my Muay Thai training
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for stopping by.

Muay Thai training and relaxed muscles rarely happen in the same sentence, so we’re glad we could help with that 😄
Happy to hear the massage hit all the right spots after training.

Come back anytime your body starts arguing with you again. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Frauke Seidenberg
reviews.text:
Massage diappointing and not very professional. Was finished after 45 minutes (instead 1 hour), ambiente very loud when other guests come in talking and chatting loudly and you get your foot massage directly behind them in the entrance room.
I had already many massages in Thailand,  but this one was by far the worst.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Frauke, for sharing your thoughts.
We are sorry the massage did not meet your expectations.

For clarity, we checked the security timestamp at the counter and your session ran from 16:10 to 17:10, so you did receive the full hour.

It was a little louder at the beginning because a group arrived, but the room settled after a few minutes and stayed quiet for the rest of your visit.

Your masseuse that day was Prim. She is one of the most requested members of our team and is known for consistent, careful work.
We understand that massage feels different for everyone and respect your experience, even if it surprises us based on what we saw and what other guests share. 🙏

reviews.name: Bodhi and Ellie
reviews.text:
Honestly this was the nicest experience for us. We went an hour before they closed and they were so accommodating, so lovely and BEST massage ever!
I can say for sure I would go back everyday if I could, surreal experience. Thank you to our two - the other staff that were there were so nice and had a good laugh with them too. We couldn’t speak Thai apart from thank you & hello. They taught us how to say sorry because they were apologetic they didn’t know a word for “water cooler” in English but we can’t string a sentence together in Thai- so we were most apologetic of that! Ha ha - loveliest people ever. Thank you again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Bodhi and Ellie.
Your review made us smile. Sounds like language lessons and massages make a good combo after all.

I’ll let the team know their “sorry” lesson was a success.
Next time you’re in Chiang Mai, we'd love to have you back for round two… maybe we’ll work on “water cooler” together. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Mirthe Schroder
reviews.text:
Highly Recommended!

I had an amazing experience at this massage salon! The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, making you feel relaxed from the moment you arrive. The massage was excellent, with the therapist tailoring it perfectly to my needs. The atmosphere is calm and soothing. I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Mirthe — reading this honestly made our day!

We believe a good massage starts before the massage, so we’re glad you felt relaxed the moment you walked in.

Huge thanks for the kind words about our team and atmosphere — we’ll make sure your therapist hears it too.

Can’t wait to welcome you back next time you’re in Chiang Mai! 🙏😃

reviews.name: Jinny Yang
reviews.text: yesterday I fainted right outside this shop, and the manager kindly looked after me until I regained consciousness. I came back to thank them and get a massage today. The lady who did my massage got an excellent technique, and the shop was very clean and comfortable. They kept checking if I was feeling better today which is so warm. Truly grateful for such a warm and caring place.❤️❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Jinny, we’re so glad you’re okay.

It meant a lot to see you walk back in today feeling better.
Thank you for trusting us both with your well-being yesterday and your massage today.

We’ll be here if you ever need a safe, caring place in Chiang Mai again. 🙏😃

reviews.name: Tom Buckingham Shum
reviews.text:
Very quiet and peaceful and made us feel very welcome. Fell asleep in the first half then was ready to cry in the second half. They know how to work muscles and its the BEST massage I’ve had ever.
A bit cheaper than other places around too!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for this, Tom!

“Fell asleep… then almost cried” is honestly the perfect summary of a massage that actually got into the right places.

Happy, the calm vibe and the muscle work both did their jobs on time.
And yes, being easier on the wallet doesn’t hurt either.

If you’re back in Chiang Mai, we’ll be ready for whatever mood your muscles bring next. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Attila Luczó
reviews.text: We had an amazing foot massage!We recommend them for everybody who cames to Chiang Mai!👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Attila.

An amazing foot massage is a pretty good way to experience Chiang Mai.
We’re glad you enjoyed it and appreciate the recommendation.

Hope to see you again when your travels bring you back this way. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Sarah Phillips
reviews.text: I received the feet, neck, shoulders, and back Thai massage for an hour and loved every second of every minute. My lower back def feels better as does my body overall after a lot of walking today.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you, Sarah. That’s how a Thai massage should feel after a day on your feet.
Not just relaxing, but like your body got its own reboot.
Glad we could bring your lower back back to life. Come see us again when Chiang Mai wears you out. 🙏😀

reviews.name: Coral Young
reviews.text: Booked a full body thai massage and it was amazing! The masseuses are experts and really take their time working through all the knots and tight areas. My favorite part was the back stretches and massage. Highly, highly recommend to anyone visiting Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Coral, we’re glad we got to battle the knots and win 😌

The back stretches are one of our favorite parts too — it’s like your spine gets to breathe again.

Thanks for the kind words and the double “highly recommend”, we’ll take that as a standing ovation.

If you’re ever back in Chiang Mai, your knots know where to go. 😃🙏

reviews.name: Marilyn Geraghty
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! I came for a wash, cut & blow-dry & am very happy with the results. The hair wash itself (& head massage) was beautiful & they managed to bring life back to my very dull & damaged hair. I'm delighted with the result & would definitely come back again :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Marilyn,

We know it’s taken us a whole year to reply to this. Let’s just say our team is much better with scissors and massage oils than we are with keyboards!

We are so happy to hear we could bring some bounce and life back to your hair. The head massage during the wash is definitely a crowd favorite here at Somphet Massage, and we're thrilled you enjoyed the full salon treatment.

If your hair ever needs another rescue mission next time you're exploring the Old City, we'd love to welcome you back to our chairs! 🙏😀

reviews.name: Callum Brunskill
reviews.text: I've been travelling around Thailand for a month, had many massages now and this was the first time I felt genuinely relaxed. The hot oil massage was excellent.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Callum, you just made our therapist’s week.

That means a lot to us, especially after a full month of massage testing across Thailand 😄

We’re glad the hot oil massage gave you a real moment of calm.

If your travels bring you back to Chiang Mai, we’ll be right here - oil warm, room quiet, pressure just right. 🙏😃

reviews.name: Brianna Eller
reviews.text: My friend and I had an incredible experience here!! All the staff were so welcoming and the traditional Thai massage was life changing! If you’re in Chiang Mai, I would definitely recommend visiting here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Brianna, “life-changing” is a big word — and we’re seriously honored it came from your visit 🧘‍♀️

Huge thanks to you and your friend for stopping by. Traditional Thai massage isn’t always gentle, but it does know how to hit the reset button.

If Chiang Mai brings you back again, you know where to find us. Same crew, same welcome — and probably the same sore shoulders waiting for round two 😉

Thank you 🙏😃

reviews.name: andrea parkin
reviews.text:
Not worth a star! I went as it had good reviews.
Not private (my husband was expected to undress behind a curtain which was clearly see through), the workers chat while with customer.
Plenty more quality massages in the area.

reviews.name: spx
reviews.text: Stopped by for a quick foot massage after days of walking around Chiang Mai, and it was exactly what we needed. The massage was incredibly relieving—our tired feet felt so much lighter and refreshed afterward. Simple, effective, and definitely worth it if you’ve been on your feet all day.

reviews.name: Alice Meier
reviews.text: Super nice place, clean and with good price! Massage was very nice with good quality of cream and oil.  The owner Khun Arm very friendly and amazing helpful. Our bike battery was low and he help us to recharge it. Thank you very much 😇

reviews.name: pao pao
reviews.text: Great service and amazing technique! The two therapists were professional yet very witty and friendly. Plus, they serve tea and treats at the end. A must-visit!

reviews.name: Lucas XY
reviews.text: Brand new Thai message just opposite Pingviman Hotel. 250 Baht per hour for traditional Thai or foot massage. The staff were good but not that skillful.

reviews.name: Yvonne Watkis
reviews.text: Went for an hour of foot/calves/shin massage.  Owner kneaded in all the correct places to release muscle cramps. Strokes are long and deep. Am here for 3 weeks, will definitely be visiting this studio again.  Tea served afterwards.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for review.Hope to see you soon.

reviews.name: chin
reviews.text: Amazing foot massage—so relaxing and refreshing. My feet feel brand new. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Noah
reviews.text: The massage was really good and strong. The ladies were nice and funny and listend to personalized request. She really kneaded me like dough. Didn’t need an appointment or anything just walk in. We got a hot tea after aswell.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for review

reviews.name: Maryam
reviews.text: The masseuse was excellent and gave a fantastic oil massage and worked superbly. Had the one hour oil massage. However when I am paying above market average for the oil massage which is 350-400baht around the area, I expect better service. I paid 500baht and apart from actual massage, ambiance was poor. The place was not very clean and sorted. I was given a massage in room upstairs and it needed to be better. Perhaps better lights, better sheets, the place begged for a better ambiance for this rate. I put on my own music to get in the mood for the massage and to feel serene and truly enjoy it. Have had 300baht massages with better ambiance and engaging of all senses because massages are an experience. Once again, the masseuse was so good. It was the overall place which left me feeling a bit meh afterwards. If it had been a 300baht massage I would have been okay with it.

reviews.name: Lawrence Hazzaa
reviews.text: Really nice message place next to my hotel, clean and respectful. I got a Thai message for 1 hour and it was wonderful. Would be happy to go back there again. And got some nice tea and biscuits at the end.  I recommend it.

reviews.name: Maayan Kuple
reviews.text:
I had a massage here, the masseuse was very professional, a very nice 70-year-old woman, who, despite her age, was strong and gentle in just the right amount. Her English is very good, so I could tell her which muscles hurt and she worked in a very professional and pleasant manner.
I feel so calm and peaceful, and my body feels so good after (:
Highly recommend ☺️ especially with the old lady 🌸✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you for review. I glad to hear that and thanks for support our staff.

reviews.name: Cherine
reviews.text:
I usually don't write bad reviews but to avoid anyone else wasting their money and time... I got one hour back and shoulders massage and this was the worst I've ever had.

I got A LOT of massages so I know how it should feel, the masseuse was pressing on my spine and after telling her please don't crush my spine; she couldn't understand English+ she kept on doing it.

She didn't have any proper back massage techniques whatsoever, just pressing on the back for 30 mns, literally.

I could feel that she had no idea what she was doing. It was sometimes painful on the shoulders but not the pain that you're supposed to feel.

I left feeling more stiff and with more pain that I came in with.

Anyway, there are many other great places in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
I am sorry that this happened and I promise that this kind of incident will not be repeated and I will strictly discipline the employees.  However, I am sorry for what you have received.
All of my employees have name tags on their chests. If possible, please tell me their name. (To be fair to other employees) Thank you for your honest review. I will improve it as soon as possible.

reviews.name: julianne gange
reviews.text: We must have had at least a handful of massages here during our few days in CM.  The staff really know what they are doing, the venue was clean, and the prices were fair.  Excellent tea to cap off your service.  We would highly recommend this massage parlor.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the review.
 I'm so glad to hear this.

reviews.name: Renata Barnes
reviews.text: Had 2 Thai massages and both were great. 1st was in late afternoon with a man that really worked on my problem areas. 2nd was in the morning with my woman masseuse that listened to me when I said I wanted it strong. It was great! My daughter and I enjoyed a good laugh with them and we loved the ambience. We highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the review.
Regards,
Mr.Armz
Owner of Blue clover massage

reviews.name: João Pedro Scalco Macalos
reviews.text:
We were massaged by two people that didn't look to work permanently in the place. They looked stressed, in a rush, and not familiar with the place (someone else had to come to turn off the lights after 20 minutes to make the atmosphere more pleasant).

It wouldn't matter much if the massage was good, but it wasn't. Very repetitive, and often simply painful. Went for a relaxing massage and left worse than before.

The cherry on the cake was seeing them leaving on their motorbikes right after our massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
I apologize for my mistake. I will improve and develop our staff.
We have 2 branches (They're our staff) Thank you for the review.
Regards,
Mr.Armz
Owner of Blue clover massage

reviews.name: Amelia Adams
reviews.text: I had a really nice massage here, I had the ‘foot, back, neck and head massage’. You got some clothes to change into which were quite comfy and the masseuse was so lovely and knew exactly what she was doing. Felt so relaxed and my back has never felt better!

reviews.name: Marisa Norton
reviews.text: Great place! Had my first Thai massage here and it exceeded all my expectations! I am mad at myself for being in Thailand 5 whole days before I got one!!! Would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Monique Wong
reviews.text: Bit of possible suspect tactics here. We specified thai massage but weren’t given the pants and shirt, then they started to put oil on us. Perhaps a communication thing but watch out the indoor menu card doesn’t show the ‘promo’ price 250bhat per hour. Was not asked re pressure, had to self advocate for deeper pressure. We didn’t do our research, looks like next door could be better
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm sorry about the incident. There may be miscommunication. Thank you for your review. I will use it to develop and improve. lovely customer

reviews.name: khamkong mahawon
reviews.text: Nice massage place🥰 They have promotions and discounts!

reviews.name: P Chan
reviews.text: Worst massage experience! We went there in the afternoon and booked for 2 hours full body oil massage. We went to the second floor in a small room which was fine because it was just myself and my husband. However, the room is really hot and stuffy where the aircon wasn’t working and it feels like in a oven and the staffs just switch on two small fans but it was still hot and we were sweating even before the massage begins. During the 45 mins, one of the staff was so busy with walking in and out to settle her stuffs (phone calls, tune the music) where I couldn’t enjoy at all. At about the 55 mins, there’re other people come in and speaking loudly. Our curtain was not closed and we were having full body massage which were naked and just cover by a small towel. Totally lack of privacy and staffs were lack of the attention to protect our privacy as I do not know if it was a male who walked in and I was naked! When I checked the time again and realised it has been an hour so we requested to cut off from 2 hours and stop immediately. Horrible experience especially for female who is planning to visit here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
I sincerely apologize for having overlooked the issue, it was a mistake, and I will make sure it doesn’t happen again. I will improve and develop our staff. Thank you for the review.
Regards,
Mr.Armz
Owner of Blue clover massage

reviews.text:
Na een aantal weken schrijf ik toch deze review omdat ik me besef dat ik het niet fijn vond wat er tijdens de massage gebeurde. Ik had een mevrouw die mijn grenzen overging wat betreft mijn intimiteit. Er werd bijvoorbeeld voorgesteld om mijn borsten te masseren en er werd erg dichtbij mijn intieme delen gemasseerd. Tevens zat deze vrouw erg vaak op haar telefoon en leek ze de aandacht niet bij het masseren te hebben. Achteraf verliet ik de massage met een onprettig gevoel en nu besef ik dat mijn grenzen overschreden zijn.
De eigenaresse is overigens erg aardig en mijn vriend geeft aan een prettige massage te hebben gehad.
reviews.textTranslated:
After a few weeks, I'm writing this review because I realize I didn't like what happened during the massage. A woman overstepped my boundaries regarding intimacy. For example, she suggested massaging my breasts, and the massage was done very close to my intimate areas. She was also constantly on her phone and didn't seem to be paying attention to the massage. Afterward, I left the massage feeling uncomfortable, and I now realize my boundaries were overstepped.
The owner is very kind, by the way, and my boyfriend says he had a pleasant massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm sorry this made you feel bad. I will improve the masseuse. Hope you come back to travel and give it a chance. I have read the reviews and am very sorry.🫶🏼😭

I had an excellent experience at Bua Mantra Thai Massage.

The environment was clean, and well-maintained, creating a truly relaxing atmosphere. The staff were professional, courteous, and attentive, ensuring comfort throughout the entire session.

The massage was delivered with great skill and precision, combining authentic Thai techniques with the right level of pressure to effectively relieve stress and muscle tension.

I would highly recommend Bua Mantra Thai Massage to anyone seeking a professional and quality wellness experience.

reviews.name: Luke Baroody
reviews.text: Love this place! Great training for beginner and experienced students alike. I’ve taken numerous classes here and always walk out with a smile on my face. The staff are very welcoming and the trainers are top notch. Can’t recommend these guys enough 🥊

reviews.name: Michael Dolan
reviews.text:
I am a Muay Thai beginner and took two 1 on 1 lessons at Thaphae and enjoyed them both.

Nok was my trainer for both sessions, and I highly recommend him. He does a great job finding the right balance of making the lessons, fun, informative, and challenging (in a good way).

Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Anthony Whelan
reviews.text:
An excellent gym with great coaches, who are very skilful, who are very friendly and welcoming.

The training is great and beginners are catered for with a separate class, everyone is welcome regardless of age or experience.

There is a great atmosphere and everyone is very friendly.

Thank you for welcoming me and teaching me, I am going to miss the training.

You will learn a lot in this gym

reviews.name: Raksha
reviews.text: Love this gym! The coaches are incredibly skillful and committed to helping you learn. They make sure the 1h40m class is packed with exercises to help you become a better fighter, whether you're a bginner or seasoned muay thai boxer. They meet you where you are. I have an old ankle injury and they adjusted some exercises for me so I could still train. Truly amazed and thankful for the technical instructions, the jokes and the kindness. Also, amazing to see Kongkiat fight and win at Thaphae Boxing Stadium. The only thing I regret is not having said goodbye as I had to leave abruptly due to changed travel plans. They have definitely ignited a spark within me and I will continue training. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: mai max
reviews.text: I’ve been training for over three years, and honestly, this place is a hard pass. The coaches are super unprofessional and just seem like they're phoning it in. The gym itself is cramped and honestly pretty gross. To top it off, they don't even bother with a cool-down or stretching at the end, so I left feeling completely wrecked and sore as hell. Save your money and go somewhere else.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback，we are sorry that the class did not to meet your expectations we would，however，like to clarify that cool-down and stretching are a standard part of our group classes，We take the quality of our training and the cleanliness of our gym seriously， we will continue working to provide a good  experience for all our guests

reviews.name: Daniel Bernardi
reviews.text: Amazing trainers and super experience overall. Multiple sessions a day. 450 bath fair price. You will sweat and learn a lot.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your comments and look forward to seeing you again.

reviews.name: SEAN
reviews.text:
Amazing gym, professional trainers with love in their hearts, and safe, clean, and sports-orientation atmosphere.

I highly recommend if you're visiting Chiang Mai to join this Muay Thai gym. The trainers are very thorough, spoke good English and gave excellent instruction and support to my son 13 year old son - Dylan.

We will definitely join another 10 day series of Muay Thai lessons once we return to beautiful Chiang  this Winter .

reviews.name: Christian Pozzi
reviews.text: I would give more than 5 stars if I could. Clean gym,  great instructors who can adapt the intensity of the training to every participant, plenty of 1:1 time with great emphasis on good technique, nice safe atmosphere, one feels welcome from the first moment in this gym. I trained here 5 days, would definitely recommend.

reviews.text: Amazing gym  , had my first Muay Thai lesson a 1-1 session with kiss , he was great trainer , everyone in the gym was welcoming highly recommend even if you are a beginner

reviews.name: Maurice Rehu
reviews.text: Had an awesome week here training before heading back to New Zealand. Professional team, made me feel welcome, trimmed down 2kgs, learnt some skills and drills. Highly recommended them. Thank you Thaphae Muay Thai Gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your comment and look forward to seeing you again.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your comment and look forward to seeing you again.

reviews.name: AYE-1 DV
reviews.text:
I really like the pace of the group class and how its structured. The warm up are stretching followed by foot work drills. Followed by drilling technique, pad and bag work. Then you close it out with a range of exercises from battle rope to core workout and cool down stretch.
The gym has its own type energy bc its off a busy street with alot of foot traffic, people walking by watching. The instuctors are nice! I dont know if there is a "best" gym in Chiang Mai officially. But ill say this, i trained at Thaphae MT Gym  twice bc of the atmosphere and trainers!  The sessions flow smooth! Great place to train!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your support. We are very happy to leave you with a good memory

reviews.name: Jean Diaz
reviews.text:
Went to a morning class here and it was great! Coach was knowledgeable and friendly. The class itself was well paced, and provided a good balance of conditioning and technique. It’s also pretty great that you don’t have to hold pads (this seems to be more of a western thing).

Class structure also allowed for some technical sparring, which is always a good time. I would recommended to beginners, intermediate and advanced levels!

It’s also in a great location so if you want to eat something after class it’s pretty easy to find something nearby.

Thanks for having us!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your appraising！Looking forward to seeing you again

reviews.name: Shuli Dernis
reviews.text: We went with no experience and our instructor sky was very patient. He made the lesson very fun. I definitely recommend to tourists looking to try something new and fun!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your lovely review! We’re happy to hear that you enjoyed our service. Please come back again anytime!

reviews.text:
we booked an one hour 2 by 1 lesson with coach Am (sorry don’t know the correct spelling).

He was really professional, knowledgeable and friendly as well, we have no thai boxing experience before but we had a really good experience here.

They also have a group lesson which is cheaper and no need to book in advance, highly recommend the class here, and will definitely come back for more lessons:)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your evaluation and encouragement! Looking forward to your next visit

reviews.name: A. Anderson
reviews.text:
If I could give it a 10 stars I would.
I was excited that I found this gym which is only 3 minutes walking distance from my hotel so I attended the morning class (8:30am) the first day when I arrived in Thailand.
The facility was clean and there were not many people in class. There were two instructors at that time and they both were friendly and took their time to teach you the techniques.
The class starts with a warm up then shadow box after that each person gets a one on one mitt work then blocking drill practice with a partner. Finally it wraps up with 5 min core and stretch.
I paid 350 BHT for a 1.5 hrs group session.
It is an open gym so it might get hot and humid in the summer time but there are lots of fans going. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Ben
reviews.text:
First time ever trying Muay Thai and I couldn’t have chosen a better place. The trainers were professional, motivating, and explained everything clearly.
Even as a beginner, I felt welcomed and supported the whole time. Amazing experience — definitely five stars!

reviews.text: This was my first time here. There are plenty of massage shops along the street, but I chose this one and had a foot massage and an aroma deep full-body massage. Everyone was friendly. reviews.name: Jack Magnus

reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had at Chiang mai! She is very professional, friendly and knowledgeable about the techniques (and your knots). My sore muscles felt so much better, and she even did more time without extra charge! Wholeheartedly recommend 🥰

reviews.name: Adardasit
reviews.text:
The best massage in whole chiang mai. Lovely ,warm therapist, and very professional . She has special kinds of treatments. I never felt like this after a massage, feel like a weight has been lifted from my body .

Edit: aside her professional treatment she is also the sweetest person

reviews.name: Connie Kou
reviews.text: A hidden gem! Had excellent Thai massage and felt very relaxed and stretched. The owner and her staff were very friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: ong
reviews.text: The massage I received from SUE on February 11, 2024 was the best massage of my life.  SUE's Thai massage was very precise and the technique was amazing.  If you want an authentic Thai massage, I recommend you visit.  I received a Thai massage of much better quality than the price.  Once again, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to SUE.  thank you

reviews.name: Ms. Eve B.
reviews.text: We had two excellent massages each of the last few days. Thai massage and then coconut oil full body massage on another day. It was relaxing and my sore spots were fixed gently. Aum and Naie ladies took care of us. The place is very clean all the linens and clothes that were given to us to use during a massage were laundered and smelled good. Calm music in the background. Plus we got to laugh a bit afterwards as we shared family info. The swelling from my ankles from a long trip yesterday was gone by the end of a two hour massage.Thank you ladies! A true Thai experience.

reviews.name: Paul Goodwin
reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience for my first ever traditional Thai massage. Aum made me feel very relaxed and at ease. She is a very experienced and qualified masseur. The rope binding and taping massage was an amazing experience that I look forward to having again. I can very highly recommend Thanyaras Healthy Massage. You can't go wrong here.

reviews.name: a v
reviews.text: Went for an amazing head, neck and shoulder massage. They know what they're doing. I'm just sorry I didn't discover Thanyaras earlier. Everybody is extremely lovely and warm, and makes you feel very welcome and taken care of. I can't wait to go back.

reviews.name: Phanusorn Chancharoenchai
reviews.text:
Excellent place for thai massage.
The staffs were very nice and friendly.

I have a problem of myofascial pain with taut band at my back and shoulder.

The massage was very good.
The staff excellently focused on my shoulder.
The price was worth the quality of massage.

I took 2 hours of shoulder massage and feel really better after massage finished.

Really recommend this place.

reviews.name: vesna petric
reviews.text:
I’ve been to this massage place several times, and every visit leaves me feeling rejuvenated and uplifted. The owner, Khun Aum, is truly exceptional—her skill and genuine care set her apart. She’s a kindhearted professional who has consistently helped me with my sciatica, especially during times of intense pain.

Khun Aum expertly combines various techniques, including compression points, stretching, and massage, and she always ensures the pressure is just right. Honestly, her methods surpass those of my chiropractor! My last two visits included a two-hour session with a mix of coconut oil massage and Thai herbal hot compress, which worked wonders—my pain practically vanished.

I was so impressed that I even purchased Thai herbal compresses from her to continue using them at home, and they’ve been incredibly helpful.

I can’t recommend this place enough. If you’re seeking effective relief and a relaxing experience, this is the place to go. I’ll definitely be back! Thank you Khun Aum🙏

reviews.name: Mark Brazil
reviews.text:
I was blown away by the excellent therapeutic massage here.
The belly organ portion of the massage was life changing.
I left a 100 baht tip because the therapist spent extra on me.
5+ stars!

reviews.name: Jamie Greenaway
reviews.text: Somtines you strike gold, and with Thanyaras it happened. I’ve had many massages in my time and this was right at the top with the best, the owner is highly skilled and has that special sensitivity to give you a massage that’s not just from the standard routine but will take the time to find all your sore bits you didn’t know you had and works them out. A genuine great masseuse. On top of that, having a train to catch and no taxi’s available, her son gave me a lift to the train station! What lovely people, I will certainly be back 👏👏👏👏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much..

reviews.text:
Im lucky that I have found this gem of a massage shop.

The owner is so knowledgeable and friendly she doesn’t follow a routine but feels what needs to be fixed.

After just a few times she has fixed my bad shoulder which my Dutch physiotherapist was not able to.

Kop khun krap 🙏

reviews.name: Paige O'Connor
reviews.text:
This gym had a nice balance of Thai and Western style training--there's a mix of solo bag work, pad rounds with trainers, and coach-led drilling.

My first day didn't feel quite as warm and welcoming as it did at other gyms in Thailand, and felt a bit chaotic as it was downpouring and the mats became very slippery. That said, I felt the trainers were really attentive to me. As a 5'1" woman, it's not always easy to find a sparring partner-- they always made sure I had someone or would send in a trainer to spar/clinch with me. Shout out to the friendly Canadian coach who clinched with me and gave me a lot of pointers.

They asked if I was interested in fighting after my first class, which kind of surprised me (I've never fought before). I wasn't in town long enough to consider it, but spoke to two other women who had good experiences fighting out of Hongthong.

I also took a private lesson with Joe and liked his energy and philosophy.

Overall, I'd recommend the gym to anyone with intermediate experience--there are a lot of really experienced trainers and fighters here. If you're a beginner, I'd recommend going early to get a rundown of the class or you might feel a bit lost.

Thanks for having me, I'm, looking forward to returning to the gym if I'm back in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Enji Shaher
reviews.text: Amazing community and the best place to train in Chiang Mai in my opinion! I learned a lot from both the krus and the students, from beginners to advanced. I also took private sessions with Kru Game. He’s a patient and positive teacher, and his style builds muscle memory effectively. A great place for deep learning in a supportive, safe environment. Can't wait to come back soon!

reviews.name: Martin Santiago
reviews.text: Super great gym, the vibe is awesome. The trainers are skilled and friendly. Whatever level you are at, they have people here for you. 5/5 stars, can’t wait to visit CMX again and train at Hongthong.

reviews.name: Scott Anthony
reviews.text:
Legit muay thai gym in Chiang Mai with highly skilled trainers— Joe is a master at muay thai and some are still actively fighting so you get to learn from and train alongside the best.
Hongthong has a real family vibe, the team genuinely take care of you, whether you’re just starting or looking to fight.
The local stadiums are just down the road so it’s very convenient for fighting in Chiang Mai.
Also the on site accommodation is clean and right next to the gym. Scooters are also available to rent from coach Fab 😁
Highly recommend

reviews.name: storm
reviews.text:
As someone who has spent the last 22 Years training and competing in martial arts around the world, I can without a doubt say Hong Thong is an exceptional Muay Thai Gym. The students are respectful, there are no bad egos floating around, the trainers are great, they take the time and make the effort to help you perfect where you are lacking. The facilities are top-class and what you would expect from an elite Muay Thai gym.
I am surprised that they have even had a bad review because they have been so accommodating to me and my friend, who came to Thailand to specifically train Muay Thai and Fight

reviews.text: If you want to work with the best instructors in Thailand this is the place to be. Phenomenal instructors. They also just add ice bath, massage, and swimming pool. They also have accommodations. You can stay at the school while you train.

reviews.name: Peter Le
reviews.text:
Seemed like a place for beginners or those newer to fighting. YMMV but I didn't like that they seemed to offer people to fight very quickly, staged group running for 20 sec for social media content, and didn't really make corrections for many students with some pretty lackluster technique. It was pretty dirty too, with leftover chicken wings and trash from a party the night before still on the mats in the morning.

I do know people that are good fighters who've enjoyed the training but it wasn't good when I visited for a couple sessions.

reviews.name: Aino Laakso
reviews.text:
The gym facilities were really good, and the location is great.

Unfortunately, my overall experience was not positive. The gym advertises itself as beginner-friendly, but that was not my experience at all. I have some basic Muay Thai experience, but when the instructors asked at the beginning of the class if there were any beginners, I chose to say that I was one.

At first, everything was fine. We practiced some basic techniques and did a bit of pad work. However, after about 45 minutes, the instructors seemed to forget about us. The class is two hours long, and we were simply told to hit the bag, with no guidance. The next time I saw a instructor, there were only about 30 minutes left.

At the end we did some light sparring with other beginners, but no one explained how to spar properly or gave us any instruction. Overall, it did not feel beginner-friendly at all. I felt unwelcome, and if the gym does not want beginners, it should not advertise itself as such.

Considering the 400 baht fee, the experience was very disappointing.

reviews.name: MUAYTHAI PATRAS
reviews.text: One of the best gyms that can someone go to level up on muay thai. Great clinch work every day with explanation for every detail that can help from beginners to fighters

reviews.name: Shannon Morgan-Wilson
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at HongThong Muay Thai in Chiang Mai for over a year now, and it truly feels like home. The trainers here are incredible,  knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in helping every student improve, no matter their level. Joe and the whole team make you feel supported and challenged at the same time.

The atmosphere is what makes this gym so special. It’s a real mix of hard training and good energy, fighters, travelers, and locals all training together and cheering each other on. You get proper traditional Muay Thai, but also a strong sense of community and friendship.

The gym is clean, well-run, and in a peaceful area not far from the city. Over the past year I’ve seen my technique, fitness, and confidence grow so much thanks to the coaches here.

If you’re serious about Muay Thai or just want to experience real Thai training with amazing people, I can’t recommend HongThong Muay Thai enough. This place has become a huge part of my life.

reviews.name: Random Name
reviews.text:
The staff were friendly and welcoming, and we were perhaps the first customers of the day. But, neither me or my girlfriend felt like we got our money's worth of massage at this upscale place...

My neck&shoulder massage was 300฿, I was so terribly jammed that I was ready to pay extra to get ease soon. But half of the time the masseuse was rubbing my butt, arm fats, legs and anything else but my neck and shoulders. It was a bit here and there, inconsistent, sometimes upper body, then lower and then upper again. The less than 30% of the actual neck massage was good, though. For this price I'd expect some really good oils, but not a drop of oil was used. Despite her young age, she spoke barely any English. The worst of my neck pain went away, but she could've done much better.

My Thai girlfriend also didn't enjoy her leg massage, which she described as just strange pulling and rubbing instead of massage.

The blue (lotus?) tea and sugared mango after the massage was nice, but could've been fresh mango and not frozen one wrapped in plastic.

Overall, a very mediocre massage for a premium price, but good service.

I asked for a neck, shoulder and foot massage. I think the massage lady did everything that I didn't ask for. I didn't get my neck massaged until I indicated that my neck was sore.
Feet were ignored altogether.

The lady left the room for a while so I figured it was over.
My husbands massage was still going though and we chose the same areas.

I still had to pay the full amount although I don't believe what I got was worth what I paid.

My rating was 1 originally,  but after multiple messages from the massage salon, I have increased it to 2.

I reiterate, this was the worst massage that I've had. There was even an instance while we were having our massages that someone knocked on the door and entered. She then proceeded to have a conversation with my massage therapist.  Directly after that, the massage therapist left.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ms. Judy,

Thank you for your review. While we regret that your experience didn’t meet your expectations, we would like to provide some clarification. The misstep on our part was not communicating clearly that your request included both a neck-shoulder and foot massage. Aside from this, the therapist followed the standard steps and provided the best care possible within the session time, stepping out briefly for few minutes to wash their hands as part of hygiene protocol before continuing with a head massage. Unfortunately, it appears you left the room prematurely, assuming the session was over.

We’ve made every effort to address your concerns, including providing evidence and offering a discount as a goodwill gesture, which you declined.

We respect your opinion but hope others understand our commitment to providing quality service. Thank you for your feedback, and we wish you the best.😊🙏

On 13 July

This was my first time trying Muay Thai, and it was incredible! Asawamongkol Muaythai Gym responded quickly and patiently to my inquiries, and their pricing was more affordable than other gyms, so I decided to give it a try.

The 90-minute session was well-structured: 15 minutes of warm-up, basic techniques, and then practicing punches and kicks. The instructor was friendly, patient, and encouraging, offering positive feedback while correcting my form. We finished with a 15-minute cool-down stretch.

Read some good reviews here and decided to have my oil massage and thai massage here, BUT please save your money and go somewhere else! this place is such a disaster!!
Therapists and receptionist wasn't friendly at all, what is worst is that when i got my oil massage, the other therapist just open the curtain in the room as they like, no privacy at all and i cant relax at all.
They did not wash your feet before massage, this is the first massage i get in whole Thailand that go straight to massage without cleaning customers feet, not hygienic at all!
It is a massage parlour but they cook in the same building, imagine having your massage and the background noise is someone cooking and chopping, and the heavy cooking smell...
The therapist that was giving me massage was playing with her phone during my thai massage session, i caught her few times, then when it comes to oil massage you can smell the burnt smoke from the tools they are using, maybe too little oil to burn or whatever, i seriously want to give zero star if i can, the worst massage i have so far in thailand!

reviews.name: Francesca Laurita
reviews.text:
I have been doing Muay Thai for 5 months and trained at King Muay Thai for 3 months.
When I arrived to Thailand I was a beginner, but I improved a lot and fast.

The gym is new and really clean and this shouldn't be given for granted.

Since I am traveling I do not have my equipment, but the gym has gloves and shin guards available.
The training includes warm-up, stretching, shadow boxing. Then in rotation: pad work, bag work and fitness exercises.
Sparring can be done on request. Then trainers will ask you to do again final exercises and stretching.

The teachers are very attentive to technique, friendly and funny 😊  they have been my family in Chiang Mai.
Trainers are well motivated to teach, this is also something that shouldn't be given for granted. Some trainers in other gyms are not so motivated.

You can do single entries, carnet with multiple entries and open per week or month.

It is also the cheapest gym I found in Chiang Mai, but it offers one of the highest quality service in the city. Honestly some gyms are crowdy, some gyms are dirty and they cost double the price.

Absolutely recommended.

title: Manasak Muay Thai Gym
ownerDescription: Muay Thai Gym in Chiang Mai run by multiple Muay Thai World Champion Manasak Pinsinchai
address: 295 Charoen Muang Rd, Wat Ket, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
plusCode: Q2P6+PG Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Ulli
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ "World-class training with a personal touch!"
I spent 10 days training at Manasak Muay Thai Gym, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish.
The Team:
A huge highlight is the head coach, Manasak himself. He is a true Muay Thai legend who is still incredibly active on the mats, teaching and sharing his world-class skills daily. Lisa does an amazing job as well—she handles the entire organization seamlessly and is also heavily involved in the training, bringing great energy to the gym.
The rest of the coaching team is equally impressive. They all train at a very high level and have a great way of explaining techniques. Plus, they are incredibly friendly and funny, which makes the hard work a lot of fun!
The Gym & Community:
The facility itself is beautiful and well-maintained. I also really enjoyed the pleasant community of training partners. Many of the other students are highly skilled, which created a very motivating and professional environment for every session.
Whether you are looking to learn from the best or just want a great atmosphere to train in, I can’t recommend this place enough! 🥊🔥

reviews.name: Callum
reviews.text:
After training at a few different gyms throughout Thailand, Manasak Muay Thai has been my favourite gym and feels like home. The training is amazing and the trainers, whom some are still actively fighting, are also amazing! This helps a lot having amazing high level sparring/ clinching partners.

The trainners are dedicated to showing new techniques and improving old ones.

Whether you are a beginner or a professional fighter, Manasak Muay Thai has many great opportunities available :)

reviews.name: Daryl Ong
reviews.text: Having trained at Pinsinchai gym in Bangkok, it was a must for me to visit Kru Manasak and Lisa when I visited Chiang Mai. I did privates with Kru Manasak which involved technical drilling, padwork and sparring. Lisa was extremely welcoming and we had a great conversation. The gym is clean, spacious and well-maintained and as for Kru Manasak, his popularity speaks for itself and I learned so much from him in a short span of time. I can't wait to visit again!

reviews.name: Alize Ml
reviews.text: I did a lot of research before deciding to go to Manasak. I wanted somewhere I could improve my technique, not overcrowded with random tourists, clean and friendly. I’m glad I chose this gym and attended PTs and group classes. I’ve learned a lot, coaches were always there to push me when I was getting tired or correct my form. Chiang has been an amazing coach for PTs, and I liked how Dod pushed me to the next level during padding. Thank you Manasak team!

reviews.name: Jorge Ribeiro
reviews.text:
I've been here today for a single training session because my trainer back home recommended this gym. As I'm traveling around Thailand, I paid a visit.
Big structure, even dorms for people taking training as something more serious. There are several trainers giving the students an awesome experience.
They lend gloves and wrist wraps for those who don't have or are just traveling lightweight like me.
The training session takes 2 hours and has both physical (skipping, abs) and technical work (punching bags, pad work and clinching). If I had more time in Chiang Mai, I'd certainly improve my skills by training here more.

reviews.name: Aleksandra Paunovic
reviews.text:
Manasak Muay Thai is my favorite gym in Thailand. I’ve been training across the country for the past 9 years, and this gym stands out as the best I’ve experienced in terms of training quality, atmosphere, and real fight opportunities.
What makes this place special is the balance between professionalism and a relaxed, welcoming vibe. There are many trainers in each session, so you get a lot of different styles, and every single one of them is not only highly skilled but also genuinely kind and fun to train with.
The training is authentic and structured, but still adaptable for all levels, whether you’re a beginner or an experienced fighter. If you’re serious about improving and possibly fighting, this is one of the best environments you can find.
It’s a gym where you feel comfortable from day one, but at the same time you’re pushed to improve every session.

reviews.name: Amrith Krishna K A
reviews.text:
Had an incredible experience training at Manasak muaythai gym . The coaches are very experienced, professional, and always push you to your limits while keeping a positive atmosphere. The sessions are intense and technical , perfect for all level , even if you are beginner, intermediate or professional the trainers adjust the training accordingly.

The gym has a strong team spirit, and everyone is supportive inside and outside the ring. I’ve improved so much in my time here. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chiang Mai who wants real Muay Thai training!

reviews.name: C T
reviews.text:
we’ve heard great recommendations about Manasak Gym and it really lives up to its reputation!

we trained every morning for a week - not overly crowded, but still a good number of people (students and fighters) and get a good workout.

sessions are straightforward: 2 hours of skipping, stretching, bag work and at least 3 rounds of pad rounds (3–4 mins), followed by drills, clinching, sparring or more bag work depending on the day. you work on conditioning (200 situps, 100 pushups, etc.) after class.

trainers are friendly, warm, and attentive. if you’re new, they’ll be patient to guide you. if you’ve been training for a while, you’ll get a more intense/technical pad work and/or interesting combos, and sparring with them is controlled, technical, fun yet challenging. Kru Manasak is especially detailed in his explanation even when breaking down something as fundamental as gauging distance, stepping in, and the mechanics of the drill. most, if not all of the trainers are still actively competing, and speak fairly good english (some even speak mandarin!).

we also did PT - you can share what you want to work on and they will match you with the right kru (depending on availability). similar structure to the group class but condensed into an hour and they will advise you on your strengths, areas for improvement and sharpen your technique.

P.S. the gym accepts cash only and you’re advised to book in advanced via WhatsApp, DM, etc.

P.P.S. there are several cafes, bars, eateries (the local food is great), convenience stores, lodging options and even home-based laundry service conveniently located near the gym too!

reviews.name: Nina Velic
reviews.text: I loved every minute in Manasak gym! Very professional, yet friendly and approachable team members. Trainers are great and I am grateful for the transferred knowlegde (especially to Dod and Chiang). During my stay, there were students of different levels of knowledge, from beginners to professional fighters. This is definately the place I will be coming back to.

reviews.text: Love Manasak Gym! Great vibe, clean space, and super motivating. Big thanks to Golf the trainer—he’s knowledgeable, supportive, and really pushes you to do your best. Be back soon and  Highly recommend! 💪

reviews.name: Livio Di Rocco
reviews.text: Fantastic gym just a kilometer from downtown Chiang Mai; I trained there for three months. The instructors are true professionals, with whom I had a great experience. If you love Muay Thai and are passing through Chiang Mai, you can't miss Manasak Muai Thai Gym💪💪

reviews.name: Steven Htut
reviews.text: Highly recommended gym. We did a private group session here, and there were five coaches waiting for us. Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. We had mixed experience levels in our group, and no one felt left out or intimidated ( maybe a little) 😂

reviews.name: Ash Guest
reviews.text: I spent two weeks at Manasak and absolutely loved my time there. The training is tough and  technical, and I learnt loads from the trainers whilst I was there. It's also a really friendly atmosphere. The other people who were training were also great and I found that all the sparring rounds were fun and technical. I also felt that I was taken seriously as a female athlete, with lots of other women training there too. Lisa (who helps to run the gym) is lovely (and also an absolute weapon herself), and all the trainers were great. I did a private session with Chiang which I would definitely recommend. Overall I highly recommend Manasak Gym if you're looking for a gym in Chiang Mai. Will be back next time I'm in Thailand!

reviews.name: Jenny Chan
reviews.text: Me & my partner have had the best time training at Manasak. Very welcoming gym, amazing trainers who work with you and your experience in Muay Thai. I would highly recommend Manasak whether you’re an absolute beginner or experienced. We’ve done 1:1s and group classes and found both to be very enjoyable. We can’t wait to be back training here again!

reviews.name: Ali
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Manasak Muay Thai Gym for about two months now and have had a really great experience so far. The trainers are knowledgeable, supportive, and do a great job working with all skill levels.

Classes are well-organized, challenging, and fun, and I’ve definitely seen improvement in my technique and overall fitness. The atmosphere is welcoming and respectful, which makes it easy to stay consistent and motivated. If you are coming to Thailand and have aspirations to fight, this is the place to prepare yourself. The Krus will get you ready to compete, whether it is your first or fiftieth fight.

The private trainings here are valuable as well, and really help with sharpening technique. Shoutout Kru Ton and Kru Chiang for the great privates!!!! 😋😋😋🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼

Really happy to be training here and would highly recommend it to anyone interested in Muay Thai!!!! 100000/10. ❤️🙏🏼

reviews.name: Nikita Shaw
reviews.text:
I was recommend this gym by multiple people so went to a morning group class. The place is huge with lots of equipment which is great. The coaches were obviously very experienced and it seemed like there were multiple locals/fighters there training too. Unfortunately it was the biggest class of any I’ve been to across Thailand. I spent the first hour of the class warming up or hitting a bag alone as everyone rotated doing pad work with the trainers. I’m assuming there were just too many people to manage as I was rushed to do quick pad rounds last (after noticing I hadn’t had a turn) while everyone else moved on.

You can’t deny the trainers are great and the gym looks great. But in the 2 hours I didn’t get any 1:1 time with a trainer to comment or help improve any of my technique. Even when paired up with others it was hard to know if anything we were doing was right.

So, not for me. I prefer more intimate training where you get 1:1 time with a coach. I didn’t feel like I got what I’d paid for here.

reviews.name: Jemma Sharp
reviews.text:
Been living in Thailand for a year and I keep coming back to Manasak. I love it. The classes are structured and well organised. It’s a great facility and a great atmosphere.

It’s such a privilege to be training with a group of coaches who are still fighting at high levels across Thailand. They’re passionate and if you work hard they will give you a lot back. They are also good fun to be around.

I’ll 100% be coming back in the future. Anyone serious about improving their Muay Thai should come here too.

reviews.name: kevin solorzano
reviews.text:
This was my first Muay Thai gym in Thailand. I trained in Sweden for 3 years and ended up learning more here during 1 month. This is the best gym in Chiang Mai, run by real fighters. Every coach fights!! I had my 2 first fights under this gym and I won both by KO. I wasn’t the only one with these results, almost everyone that fights under Manasaak wins!
I recommend this gym for everyone, experience doesn’t matter! This is a welcoming and dedicated authentic Muay Thai Gym.

I want to thank Manasaak and Lisa for your wisdom and welcoming. I’m definitely coming back for you guys! <3

title: The Oriental Spa at Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok
subTitle: เดอะ โอเรียนเต็ล สปา แอท แมนดาริน โอเรียนทอล แบงค็อก
description: Luxury spa in a teak building at a high-end hotel with treatment rooms, vitality pools & lounge.
ownerDescription: Our spa offers pioneering therapies rooted in a holistic philosophy and is frequently voted among the best in the world. Guests here will discover the pleasures and benefits of treatments based on traditional Thai and modern Western techniques in our restored century-old teakwood house. The exclusive and luxurious Oriental Spa blends the ancient culture and rituals of the Orient with treatments that are performed on a traditional-style floor mattress. Guests begin their experience with a short boat ride to the Spa, which is located across the river from the hotel. They are welcomed with a soothing tea and then enjoy a private consultation that allows the therapist to tailor treatments to guests' individual needs.
address: 597 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
plusCode: PGF6+R8 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Papada Seehabut
reviews.text:
I really loved the service here. The place is beautiful, unique, and very relaxing. Every staff member was friendly and professional. While waiting for my room, I was able to use the sauna, which impressed me a lot.

The massage program was great, and it also included healing balls, which made me feel especially relaxed. I also appreciated the therapist’s after-treatment advice and recommendations. Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I would definitely come back again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Papada Seehabut

Thank you for sharing such a gracious reflection of your visit to The Oriental Spa.
We are delighted to know that every element of your journey, from the serene surroundings to the attentive care of our team, contributed to a truly memorable experience. Creating an atmosphere that feels both refined and restorative is at the heart of what we do, so it’s especially rewarding to hear that this resonated with you.
It is also wonderful to know that the thoughtful touches and holistic elements of the treatment enhanced your sense of wellbeing, and that our team was able to provide meaningful guidance to extend the benefits beyond your time with us.
Your kind words are sincerely appreciated, and it would be our pleasure to welcome you back for another indulgent escape in the near future.

Warm regards 
Wael Malki
Senior Director of Spa and Wellness

An unforgettable experience! The location right by the river is genius and the treatment room was absolute top tier – you can really feel that this is a ritual, not just a service.

A 90-minute massage effectively turns into a 3-hour retreat with all the intro and relaxation time included. Honest note: The massage technique itself isn't cosmically different from other high-end places, but the surroundings and atmosphere are unmatched. Top of the tops. Highly recommended!

Thank you sincerely for sharing such a beautiful review.

Thank you once again for your generous recommendation. We hope to welcome you back soon for another restorative escape by the river.

With warmest regards,
Wael Malki
Senior Director of Spa and Wellness

reviews.name: Ekaterina Nurtaeva
reviews.text:
We visited the spa with my husband for a Thai massage in December, 2025. We booked at the last minute through the hotel’s WhatsApp chat, and it was very convenient, they still had availability.

Getting there was part of the experience: a private boat ride from the hotel with no queues or waiting to cross the river.

The spa itself feels like a little kingdom, with parrots in cages and beautiful trees all around. Everything is very well organized, some staff help you with your shoes, others take care of the registration. The massage takes place in a private room with its own bathroom. I had a traditional Thai massage in pajamas and really enjoyed it.

The place feels carefully preserved, as if the design and spirit of the past were intentionally kept alive, like stepping back 70 years in time. After the massage, we were invited to a relaxation room at the very top of the house, where they served tea and sweets.

A lovely experience overall. I really liked it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ekaterina Nurtaeva,

Thank you very much for choosing The Oriental Spa, Bangkok, and for taking the time to share your outstanding feedback. 

We’re delighted to hear that your visit began so smoothly with our convenient booking service and the private boat journey across the river. It’s wonderful to know that the tranquil surroundings, the heritage charm of the house, and the care of our team all contributed to a memorable experience. We’re especially pleased that you enjoyed your traditional Thai massage and the peaceful time in our relaxation space.

Your kind words mean a great deal to us. We look forward to welcoming you and your husband back for another restorative escape.

With warmest regards,
Wael Malki
Senior Director of Spa and Wellness

reviews.name: Monica’s Taste
reviews.text:
We had a pleasant experience at this spa, though it didn’t quite exceed our expectations.

Service: The staff were highly trained and attentive from the moment we arrived. The shoe locker system was well-organized with numbered slots. We were welcomed with refreshing drinks and cold towels, and they even asked about our massage preferences beforehand, which was a thoughtful touch.

Atmosphere: The spa exudes a luxurious wooden aesthetic, creating a serene and inviting ambiance. Everything was impeccably clean and well-maintained.

Massage: The massage itself was good, and the staff were skilled. Despite only opting for a 60-minute session, he still felt relaxed. However, compared to other spas we’ve visited, it wasn’t the best experience we’ve had.

Room: The spa room was well-equipped, clean, and had everything needed for a comfortable session.

Gift & Snack: After the massage, we were given two snacks and a hot drink. The rice puff snack with sugar and salt was especially delicious. We also received a Yadom inhaler and some useful stretching techniques, which was a nice bonus.

Location: If you’re staying at the Mandarin, you can take a boat across the river to reach the spa. Alternatively, driving there takes about 15-20 minutes, depending on traffic.

Overall: While the experience was enjoyable, I had higher expectations from this spa, which is why I’m rating it 4 stars.

reviews.name: Lenny H
reviews.text: The spa at Mandarin Oriental is the best I’ve experienced in Bangkok. You can arrive early to fill out a health questionnaire, enjoy some drinks and snacks, and fully relax before your treatment. I had a 90-minute massage in a private room, featuring the most comfortable and spacious infinity massage bed I’ve ever experienced. Although the session was only 90 minutes, it felt like I entered a state of deep sleep. I can’t wait to come back for a second visit

reviews.name: Anna M
reviews.text:
We were taken by the hotel’s boat to the spa across the river. We were greeted by someone who helped us find our way to the spa house. The gardens leading up to the spa house were beautiful.

The interiors were traditional with wood everywhere. It was quiet and serene. The place was quite clean. The staff were polite, friendly, and gentle in their talk and behaviour.

I chose the Spirit of Isaan (2.5 hours) and a facial treatment (1.5 hrs) so it was almost the whole afternoon but so worth it. I was feeling quite relaxed after.

The only slightly challenging part was communicating with the lady giving me the treatment as her English was quite limited and on a few occasions, we had to keep repeating to each other what we were trying to say so that the other person could understand. She was very nice though.

It wasn’t the best spa treatment I’ve had, it was good, not bad at all though. I was on vacation and I was relaxed and feeling good about everything.

We were given herbal drinks and a snack before and after treatments.

reviews.name: John Ye
reviews.text:
The spa at mandarin oriental was an amazing experience. I had high expectation for the spa and it didn’t disappoint. My therapist had the softest hands and she was highly skilled and professional, constantly checking my comfort. The Qi balance was very effective, I felt relieved right after and also improved my sleep on the day. Overall it was a luxurious and enjoyable experience.
Area for improvement would be the architecture. The walk from the pier to the spa is strange, and there are lots of stairs inside the spa. Didn’t feel like a space designed for serenity.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your thoughtful review and for choosing to experience The Oriental Spa at Mandarin Oriental Bangkok.

We are delighted to learn that your treatment met your high expectations and that the Qi Balance therapy delivered such immediate benefits. Your kind words regarding your therapist’s skills will certainly be shared with our team.

We also sincerely appreciate your candid feedback regarding the spa’s architecture, the walk from the pier, and the internal stairways are invaluable and help us look more closely at how the physical journey to the spa can better reflect the serenity and harmony of the experience itself. Please be assured that guest feedback such as yours is carefully reviewed as part of our ongoing efforts to improve.

We truly hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back for another restorative and luxurious visit in the future.
Warm regards,
Wael Malki
Senior Director of Spa & Wellness

Starting from the boat ride in the river, walking between the plants and the amazing buildings, reaching to the spa location. They have considered every detail in the experience and service. Welcoming drink is really good. The massage rooms are a thai style and everything you need is provided in the room including the shower room and toilet. Not to forget that they are really really good in the massage and oil choices. After finishing your session you will enjoy a warm drink and a snack in the relaxing lounge.

reviews.text: Super luxurious spa and massage place. Like the ambience and professional treatment. The 90 min massage went by so quickly, but I felt that the massage is not as good as typical Thai massage I received other venues in frequented in town.   The masseur kind of massaged with some patterns rather than feeling the pain (stiff) points then phasize the areas.

reviews.text:
The best spa experience ever had
From welcome you to massage and after service
Everything is perfect
