reviews.name: bi ainosusa.
reviews.text: I visited this spa a long time ago. It was a dreamlike experience. From the moment I stepped inside, I was enveloped in the fragrant scents of herbs and other aromas, and the massage felt as though I were walking on the cloud. It’s definitely a place I’d love to visit again someday.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear bi ainosusa.,

Thank you for choosing The Oriental Spa and for taking the time to share your kind feedback. We're delighted to hear that the soothing atmosphere, aromatic scents, and massage left such a lasting impression. It’s truly heartwarming to know you’d love to return. We appreciate your kind words!

We look forward to the privilege of welcoming you again. Please do not hesitate to contact us directly at mobkk-spa@mohg.com for any future needs.

With warmest regards,
Wael Malki
Senior Director of Spa and Wellness

reviews.name: YiYin Wang
reviews.text:
The oriental spa has always been my dream list, and this year I finally visited as my own birthday treat, I was all the way in awe of the staffs from the hotel entrance - you will take a magical boat shuttle to the spa house, just from this it is dreamt to me already.

Even before the massage started I already feel rewinded.

I have to especially mention the impeccable hospitality I received from the receptionists, Praifon and Amy, their genuine smile at the very first second warmed my heart, they put so much effort in all details just to make sure I feel wonderful, and they introduce their selection with passion, just whet I showed a little interest. I couldn’t resist to pick up some more gift to myself!

My masseuse Noom is also impressive, he glow with a unique serenity, I was surprised there are a 10 min meditation to begin with my treatment, and it made so much difference, in fact, I might never meditate so deeply ever.

All his movement and strength are completely in sync with my heart, i will never be able to describe, until a point I had tears in my eyes out of the deep comforting feeling. I’ve never feel so cherished.

Lastly I have to thank to the manager Benz, I took my time really to chill at the relaxation area, probably 30 mins or more.

When I finally ready to walk out, I saw Benz, Amy, Praifon and all the lovely staffs holding the happy birthday sign, and sang the song for me! I was totally shocked, and feel so bad that I probably let them wait long time, and of course extremely delighted, I feel so special.

Really thank you for this experience, from the bottom of my heart. I can’t wait to keep coming to back to this « home ».

reviews.name: La Emperatriz
reviews.text: I had high expectations about my experience at the spa, I went the day of my birthday and they promised me a upgrade room with a milk bath for me and my husband as a birthday gift, I was excited however it was my first time in the city and we got lost and were behind schedule I decided to make it to the spa, since it was my treat for my celebration, the service was really good and everyone was really polite, the location is gorgeous and well organized definitely an A+ location, the ladies that did our massage were amazing, sadly I will go with two stars since they didn’t deliver what they promised & I was disappointed. Besides that thanks for everything

reviews.name: Y. C.
reviews.text:
Even you don’t live in mandarin oriental, try!
One of the best spa in BKK that I’ve ever tried.

It’s a bit hard to find cause it’s across from the river. Will suggest to take the boat from mandarin oriental hotel (easier!) I walked from the mall near by but it’s a bit hard cause you’ll need to enter from the car park and walk from the back the spa building.

I booked a facial treatment and it was amazing. The welcome drink is pleasant!
The room was set perfectly. I fall asleep during the treatment (but got waken up by the tree cutting sound, otherwise it will be perfect) We were rushing after the the treatment otherwise sitting there enjoying a cup of hot tea will be nice.

Will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Shinji Hayashi
reviews.text: Cannabis Relax and Restore — that’s what I chose for two hours. It’s pricier than a typical massage, but absolutely worth it. I definitely recommend trying it here.

reviews.name: T T
reviews.text: Love the service. Professional, attentive and hospitalised staffs! Also love their super effective treatments that leave my body feeling light and much better. No body pain after. Hugh quality organic material. Dont forge to try their scrub. The salt scrub is amazing!

reviews.name: Mihika Biswas
reviews.text: The service was amazing and very accommodating. The massage itself was very relaxing and they kept my skin issues in mind for the facial. The staff were also kind enough to save my insignificant looking hat which I had forgotten but means a lot to me and send it to my separate hotel.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mihika Biswas,

Thank you for choosing The Oriental Spa at Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok, and for taking the time to share your kind feedback.

We are delighted to hear that you had a wonderful time with us. Your belongings are always treated with the utmost care and safeguarded, and we are pleased to know that you have received your hat. I will be sure to share your compliments with our team members, who will be delighted to know that their efforts were appreciated.

We look forward to welcoming you again. Please do not hesitate to contact us directly at mobkk-spa@mohg.com should you require any assistance in the future.

With warmest regards,
Wael Malki
Senior Director of Spa and Wellness

reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Or's classroom is fun, lively, and a party-like experience. No stress! I'm happy and have also built merit. When I give massages to neighbors and the elderly, they praise me for my good, detailed massage, hitting every muscle, and improving my condition. They also say that the teacher is very skilled at passing on her knowledge to her students, who have been able to continue to help society.

reviews.name: Benny Chao
reviews.text:
Easily one of the most disappointing massages I’ve had. The masseuse spent an unreasonable amount of time walking around the room or adjusting the cloth instead of actually massaging. Multiple times I opened my eyes wondering why nothing was happening, only to see them just standing there.

The pressure was completely inconsistent. Occasionally it was suddenly too heavy, but most of the time it was so light it felt like no real effort was being made. There was no flow, no technique, and no sense that the masseuse was paying attention to what they was doing.

It wasn’t the absolute worst massage I’ve ever had, but it easily lands in my bottom five. I honestly can’t tell if this was a last-minute replacement or if this is just the standard here, but either way, it’s not a place I’d return to or recommend.

reviews.name: valentin cld
reviews.text:
Great Muay Thai gym!

I trained there a few times as a beginner and had a really good experience.

The atmosphere is amazing and very welcoming. The coaches are excellent, professional, and really adapt to everyone’s level, from complete beginners to professional fighters preparing for competition, which makes it perfect when you’re starting out.

The owner is also super friendly and creates a great vibe in the gym. Everyone is nice, and the place is clean, well organized, and well equipped. I definitely recommend it!

reviews.name: SamLHC
reviews.text: Such a clean gym with modern equipment. staff are super friendly and took real care of me - feels like a family! The trainers cater to your skill level, and there are group classes for beginners and advanced fighter. I learnt so much here and I will defo be back again!

reviews.name: Alex Abramov
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a great experience at this gym and would highly recommend it to anyone, no matter the level.

I arrived around 1:00 pm and spoke with the owner, who was extremely friendly and helpful. I was interested in joining the group class, which starts at 4:30 pm, and he kindly allowed me to stay and train at the gym until the class began — something I really appreciated.

When the group class started, there was a good mix of foreigners and locals, and the atmosphere was very welcoming. The session began with a proper warm-up: stretching, running, jump rope, drills, and some very light sparring just to get the body moving. No elbows, no knees, and no mouthguard needed — perfect for warming up safely.

Then came the toughest (and best) part: bag work and pad work. The coaches really pushed me to my limits and beyond. I personally did 3 rounds of pad work (out of 5), and each round ended with 20 kicks. Brutal, but extremely satisfying.

The coaches are very professional and clearly passionate about what they do. Their energy and motivation really transfer to you during training, which makes the session even better.

The gym itself is clean, well-maintained, and equipped with new equipment. I noticed the gym being cleaned at least twice while I was waiting for the class, and again after — cleanliness is clearly a priority here.

The location is also very convenient, with a 7-Eleven nearby and a small, cozy park close to the gym.

Overall, an excellent gym with a great atmosphere, strong coaching, and solid training. Highly recommended for all levels.

P.s they also have adorable and friendly dog

reviews.name: Ken
reviews.text:
I trained at this Muay Thai gym for 5 weeks in Chiang Mai, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish.

What really stood out was how the training was tailored to my needs. The trainers paid attention to my level, my strengths, and the areas I needed to improve. This wasn’t generic pad work — they corrected my technique, balance, timing, and conditioning in detail. I saw clear improvement in my kicks, boxing, and overall sharpness over the 5 weeks.

From day one, I felt very comfortable. The atmosphere is welcoming and supportive — it truly feels like a family. The trainers push you hard, but always in a positive and respectful way that builds confidence and discipline. The boss is very friendly and approachable, which sets the tone for the whole gym.

He even gave us a discount on stadium tickets so we could go watch fights, which made the experience even more special. It shows they genuinely care about giving students the full Muay Thai experience, not just the training.

I also met many people from all over the world. We trained together every day, got to know each other, and became friends. The international environment combined with local Thai fighters creates a motivating and inspiring atmosphere.

This gym became more than just a place to train — it became part of my life in Chiang Mai. I will definitely be coming back every year.

5 stars without hesitation.

-Ken from Australia

- Everyone there was very nice and as a student I was offered discounted tickets to the fight tonight at the stadium.

Great experience! Definitely would recommend to everyone!

The gym is clean and it’s great way to meet with nice people !

reviews.name: Aengus Oconnell
reviews.text: I can’t wait to come back to my family every one here is the best. I stayed 2 months training, eating and living here I’ve thought about it every day since I’ve left. Enough said!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Brother,we miss you terribly.We think about everything you did here,training together,cooking together,going out together on weekends,and going to the muaythai matches together,We hope everything go well for you in the UK.we'll always be here waiting for you to come back,This is your second home,Xlion family！

reviews.name: Chance Phillips
reviews.text: Best gym in Chiang Mai all the trainers are very welcoming and accommodating to all skill levels from beginner to advanced and the owner is super friendly. There are many high level trainers and they make sure all students get necessary attention. The training sessions are intense but trainers are very funny and keep the atmosphere fun. The gym is spacious and has amazing facilities including a full weightlifting/cross fit area and a cafe in the front.

reviews.name: Michael Parsons
reviews.text: Best gym in Chiang Mai 100%. Me and a couple friends did 10 sessions and quickly built relationships throughout the gym, it really feels like a close community due to their welcoming nature. The facilities are brand new and you’re wearing cleaned and new-feeling gloves, wraps and shin pads. Massively recommend to anyone staying in Chiang Mai!!

reviews.name: Joe Venuta
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Xlion's group class for anyone wanting to try Muay Thai or continue their training.

My girlfriend and I showed up to the 9:30 group class after running into Rocco (the owner) the night before. We chatted with him and he sold us discounted tickets for the Muay Thai stadium we were going to anyway. Rocco and everyone at Xlion are super nice.

This was our second Muay Thai class ever. All gloves/wraps were provided and the class had a mix of experienced folks and beginners like us.

The class started with warmup and stretching and then taking us through some striking forms. We then moved to the hanging bags and worked on specific punches/elbows/knees/kicks. There were 3 coaches so we got lots of individual tips.
The rest of class alternated between 1on1 hitting pads held by coaches (my favorite) and individual bag work. We ended with some core strength and stretching.

Overall the class was super fun and informative. I felt like I made progress even as a (still) total beginner.

Other unexpected bonuses:
-free t shirts with our class! (I don't know how long this promotion will continue)
-discounted tix to Loi Kroh stadium (I don't know if this is always a thing!)
-cheaper class than elsewhere
-the gym dog is super cute
-the gym has state of the art weight training equipment and Rocco told us we could work out there after class.
-great playlist going during our class
-got to see pro fighters preparing for their championship fight at Loi Kroh that night.

reviews.name: Bastian Igelhaut
reviews.text: Great place! Nice staff! Very new equipment! So much fun!

reviews.name: Louis Escudié
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Xlion enough! It is hands down the best Muay Thai gym around.
The facilities are top-notch with high-quality and well-maintained equipment. A huge bonus is that they also give you access to weightlifting and calisthenics gear, making it a complete training spot.
Plus, if you're a beginner or just traveling, they conveniently lend you gear like gloves, wraps, and shin guards for free, which is incredibly practical.
The coaches are super friendly, highly pedagogical, and make sure the sessions are perfectly adapted to all fitness and skill levels.
On top of that, the group classes have an amazing vibe, it’s a really cool environment to meet great people while getting a solid workout.
Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced fighter, Xlion is the place to be 🦁!

reviews.name: Narka Narka
reviews.text: I loved this place! I did Muay Thai for 2 weeks here. They take it very slow but they are very skilled. They have a lot of patience and overall I wish I could stay here longer but I’m going back to America😟. But if your looking for fast strong and nice Muay Thai with skilled trainers and beginner friendly, Xlion Muay Thai gym is your place!

reviews.name: Nicky
reviews.text:
For two months I followed Muay Thay class. I discover that my body could do more than I thought.
With Xlion, you will be train by professional trainers who genuinely care about your evolution and have a strong knowledge of this martial art.
A special thanks for the owner Hao who made this place. More than a businessman, he’s like a grand cousin who take care of everyone.

Without any doubt I recommend this place.

reviews.name: Katherine Delgado
reviews.text:
I joined this gym after reading the positive Google reviews, and they turned out to be completely true. Everyone here is friendly, welcoming, and professional, and the atmosphere is great.

The classes were well organized and structured, and you can tell the trainers really know what they're doing.

Training here was one of the highlights of my time in Chiang Mai. I would definitely recommend this gym to anyone interested in Muay Thai.

reviews.name: Lata
reviews.text:
10/10 experience at this Muay Thai & CrossFit gym. The team is friendly, helpful, and creates a positive, high-energy environment ⚡️

1:1 Training: I bought a package of 1:1 classes and have been training with Nampu, who has been incredible. Our sessions rely heavily on visualization and demonstration, which has actually helped me learn and improve much faster. He’s patient, highly observant, and excellent at catching small details to help refine your technique day by day.

The Gym: The equipment is state of the art, the gym is clean, and everyone is respectful. Whether you’re doing private training, CrossFit, boxing, or group classes, you can’t go wrong

An awesome experience all around. I highly recommend this gym to anyone looking to train seriously while still having fun.

reviews.name: thibz b
reviews.text: One of the best crossfit/gym I’ve ever been. This place had everything I needed for my open gym drop in. The location is perfect and the people working there were the friendliest and most welcoming I’ve ever met. It’s very new so their material is top notch and they are still adding new gear every week.

Brand new and beautiful muay thai gym,

Good vibes 👍👍

I will see Mayu again!

reviews.name: Jeff
reviews.text:
Amazing experience at Wonder Massage! The environment is clean, cozy, and very relaxing.

Dew is absolutely wonderful. She is beautiful, friendly, and very professional. She really knows how to take care of customers and makes you feel relaxed and happy. One of the best experiences I’ve had in Bangkok.

If you come here, I highly recommend asking for Dew. I will definitely come back for her again.

reviews.name: Kenji
reviews.text:
Wonder massage is my go to place whenever I travel to Bangkok.

Staff is always friendly and a good selection of menu.

This time JESSIE caught my eye with her aura. She didn't need fancy dress to stand out from the crowd. She was standing there with a signature Bangkok elephant pants with confidence.

The moment I got into the room with her, it turns into a   mini honey moon.

She's sweet and dovy but at the same time she hungers for your domination.

reviews.name: Hansi
reviews.text: I booked two ladies at this place. Receptionist always polite and nice. First time the girl looked like in the picture and completed service as promised. Second time girl didn't look like in the picture and service was not as promised. She was nice though.  In the second time I got an upgrade with the room but the warm water couldn't be adjusted in the bathtub. It's average but not more.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
First of all, thank you for your review as this informative feedback allows us to improve our services further. We are very sorry you did not receive the level of service as expected. If you could, please let us know the name of the second lady that you had so that we can rectify the issue so that it does not happen again. 

We would like to remind that if you are not at all happy about any of the services rendered, please let the counter staff know so that we can rectify the issue immediately or at least compensate for a future visit.

reviews.name: Petch
reviews.text:
I was at this place on Sept 2023. Massage was great and service was excellent. The girl was hospitable and was able to fulfil any request I demanded.

The problem was that during the last half an hour of the massage, the masseuse keep checking her phone if the time was up. It would be better if they installed a clock on the watch to solve this issue. Wish that the girl was not so stingy with the time though.

Another problem was that on the menu they indicate that there is a 2 hour massage but when I went there maximum was 1.5 hour. Because 1.5 hour is definitely not enough.

I wish that this shop give discounts and offers like what others shops are doing like a new year discount or student price. I sincerely hope that this shop thrive because they were really friendly during my latest visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We have in fact put clocks in all the rooms for sometime now so you should not be facing any problem with the masseuse checking the phones any longer. The menu you pictured is a very old menu where we had the 2 hour option when we first commenced operations. We have a maximum of 1.5 hours for our shower and bathrooms but we do have 2 hours for our panorama room. We do hope you will visit us again soon.

reviews.text: Jessie is a very nice girl who can completely satisfy your desires. She doesn't come often, so I suggest making an appointment in advance.

reviews.name: Thomas Schmidt
reviews.text:
I have been here the first time. The reception is very professional, the women beautiful and the overall process easy and straight forward.

The woman I chose was very nice and friendly.

However… From the beginning I had a huge sense of rush. The shop is to crowded which gives a lot of pressure to the women.

I could see she was constantly checking her phone and eventually I understand why, after a certain time someone was knocking on the door. It was very difficult for me to finish like that.

I like it relaxed and easy. If you don’t mind the pressure it’s the perfect place, but for me it’s too much.

I might come back eventually on a quieter day.

When I was finished there were already 6 men waiting so I understand the issue.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much ,we are looking forward to see you again. We also have a new outlet, Deep. You could visit that outlet as it is larger and less crowded at peak hours

reviews.name: Anthony Thai
reviews.text:
Visited a month ago and had one of the best massage experiences I've had for years in BKK.  Attention to detail spot on, attitudes from the girls first class, and the line up one of the best you will find.  Lady I chose was perfect in every way.  I left very happy and recommended the place on a very active forum of which I am a member.

Fast forward a month, and not such a good experience.  I had made a booking, but booking page doesn't allow you to see the girls unless you have a log in detail.  So no point in booking.  I arrived, they asked if I had a booking, I replied yes, but they didn't ask my name ... so booking service seems pretty hit and miss.

Lady was fine, service good.  I paid 2900 for 90 minutes.  Looking at my watch when I left the building, I was surprised to see I had only spent 70 minutes in total from arrival to departure.  So massage about 65 minutes at most.  You have cheated me out of 25 minutes.  Not great.

I' m still leaving a good review, because service is good, girls are good and rooms clean and tidy and my first visit was excellent.    But don't take customers for granted and make sure the ladies use the clocks they are provided with or timers on their phones.  It's clear they are trained well ... so please don't ignore the time keeping as it's not a good feeling to feel cheated.  You ask all customers when they leave if everything is ok, so you clearly know what you are doing in terms of keeping customers happy, so I was surprised to have been short changed timewise, but didn't realise until I was outside.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
First of all, thank you for coming back to Wonder and giving us the opportunity to serve you again. We would like to address the issues you had with us this time around:

1. We implement a password protected page to protect, as much as we can, the privacy of our ladies and hence only give passwords to customers who request it from us. Please contact us privately by email, Telegram, or Line, and we will gladly send it to you. Although you may have made a booking but did not specify a lady, our staff would have ushered you directly to view the ladies available.
2. We have investigated the timing issue you had and indeed, the lady you chose did finish the massage earlier than the time you paid for and we sincerely apologize for that. The lady was new and did not follow our SOP for the time allocated. Nevertheless this is ultimately our shortcoming and we will ensure that this does not happen again for new ladies.
3. With this in mind we hope that you can accept our apologies and we would like to offer you a 30 min discount on your future visit to compensate for this error. Please show this review to our staff if you do visit us again so that you may claim the discount.

We would like to take this opportunity to again thank you for visiting Wonder and very much hope to see you again.

reviews.name: Laurence Del Papa
reviews.text:
Visited the shop today.  Met Kim, a very nice Bangkok girl.  She speaks some English, so it's easy to talk to her.  Kim is really focused on customer satisfaction, and I had an amazing time.  1.5 hours is not enough.   I hope the shop adds a 2 hour package to their menu.

The room was clean and fresh.  The shower cubicle was also good.  Big enough for 2, and nice hot water.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We are glad you enjoyed your time with us. We do have two hour packages with our Panorama room. Do give that a try the next time you come

reviews.name: Joe Chiu
reviews.text: It was my first time to experience Lesbian service and I chose Kim. She has a friendly service attitude and good skills. She is very attentive to the guests' feelings and the massage is also very good. I had a good alternative experience in Thailand this time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much .we hope service you again.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for visiting us and we're so happy to hear you had a great time at Wonder. We hope to see you again soon!

reviews.text:
The ultimate bespoke wellness experience in Bangkok! I’ve been to many luxury wellness spots, but The Sukhothai Spa is truly in a league of its own. It feels like a hidden paradise where stunning architecture and natural elements fuse together right in the heart of the city. You have to book with Khun Faii and Khun Taro—their level of expertise is absolute mastery.

Reiki with Khun Faii: An incredible emotional release. She guides you to select stones placed on the body to channel energy, followed by a card reading that leaves you feeling intensely connected to yourself. Super fulfilling.

Bespoke Journey with Khun Taro: Hands down the most personalized treatment I’ve ever experienced. He customized the entire session based on my birth month element (ธาตุเจ้าเรือน) and current body condition. He picked an oil to replenish exactly what I lacked that day, utilized the facilities perfectly, worked out every single knot, and even gave me lifestyle tips alongside a tailored drink to optimize my system.

You can genuinely feel the difference in quality and skill here. Huge thanks to the team for creating an incomparable sanctuary. Don't just look at the reviews—book it, you won't regret it!

Of course, a massage is a personal experience. One practitioner's technique won't feel the same to every client and no one can expect to find the right practitioner first time. I've tried several massages before I found the one that is perfect for me (sadly the last weekend of my holidays). It doesn't mean the others weren't good, they just weren't the perfect one for me.
It seems to me there are some unfair reviews here. If we're clear about our wishes and expectations and treat the young men who provide a great service here with the respect they deserve, then we will have an enjoyable and satisfying experience.
I'm certainly very happy and satisfied with the service I received from Blue Dolphin Massage and Tan and will be back next year.🙏❤️

reviews.name: Daniel O
reviews.text:
I have come here for years and prior to now it was always great. It has gone considerably downhill though.

I went for a massage the other day- when I got in I stated that I only had credit and confirmed that was ok. (Note: I have always paid and tipped credit for the last 6 years here,  but I always like to reverify)- I was told yes. I paid upfront for the massage with card no issue.

At the end of the very average skilled massage I was told by the masseuse (who is the one I previously stated I only have card to and who charged me upfront) that tip could only be cash. Again, note that I have paid tip on card at this shop for years. I did not have cash on me and basically had to be followed around to an ATM to withdraw- cost me an unnecessary ATM fee and withdrawal I did not want.

The masseuse was a nice guy so I don’t think it was malicious but very frustrating none the less. Additionally the shop is more expensive than other shops on the street in all aspects- the massages cost more than others-they now charge $80 additional baht for a private room (again never had this charge in the past). The tip requested was more than double what was requested at other shops on the strip for the same/better quality. It feels like this shop has become a place to Nickel and Dime you for no reason. Sad to see my favorite former shop has come to this, but take it from me and go to one of the many other shops on the street- save money and hassle.

EDIT to respond to owners message- 1. I was told by the masseur for “private room” it was $80 THB there was nothing VIP about the room. It looked the same as the rooms I have been in over 10 times prior at Blue Dolphin and never with an additional fee- by saying “private room” the assumption is left that the other rooms would be not private.

2. I have tipped on credit every single time I have ever visited the spa for the last 5 years. I don’t care about a 3% charge or anything like that. I also made it clear up front before ever walking into a room that I only had credit and no cash- it was the first thing I said even before a menu was handed, so in no world should the masseur have taken me back to a room knowing he couldn’t get tipped if I don’t have cash and told him that up front. Also $2500 for tip when shops across the street are the same for half or less is insane. Especially when the massage and room are already more expensive.

You can disagree with the review but it’s all fact. I was a big fan of this place. Sad.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
This is an undeserved bad review:The reason you cannot pay tip in card is because we have to pay tax on money we actually don't keep. Easy to understand, isn't it?
You selected a vip room with private bathroom, so the extra charge is 80 bahts. It is clearly written on the menu and you read it. Why do you complain afterwards?We have standard rooms with common bathroom as well.

reviews.text:
Very authentic Thai massage salon located on the edge of the city, directly on a busy main street. Once you step inside, the atmosphere completely changes – it’s calm, quiet, and relaxing.

Please Cash only payments.

The interior is a bit older and simple, but everything is very clean, well maintained, and smells good. You can really feel that this is a genuine local massage place, not a tourist trap. The air conditioning was slightly on the cool side, but not a big issue.

The staff is very friendly, smiling, and professional, and they speak English well enough to clearly explain the treatments and prices. The massage ladies are highly skilled and experienced – you can feel they really know what they are doing.

Prices are very fair and affordable, roughly 250–500 THB per hour for most massages, depending on the treatment. Body scrubs starts at 500 up to 1000 Baht for 90 min. Considering the quality, this is excellent value for money. Free drinking water is provided, which is a nice touch, and a free foot wash is always included.

From the menu you can choose between:

Traditional Thai massage

Oil massage

Head, shoulder & foot massage

Foot massage & scrub

Aroma massage

Sport massage

Aloe Vera after-sun massage

Coconut oil massage

Hot oil massage

Herbal compress massage

Facial treatments and body scrubs

There is also comfortable seating for foot massage and a relaxed waiting area.

Overall, highly recommended if you are looking for a real, authentic Thai massage with great prices, friendly staff, and a calm atmosphere once inside. I would definitely come back.

They washed your feet before the massage and washed their hands in the middle of the massage before proceeding with massaging your head and face. The price is also a bargain compared to other places. My first massage was exceptional. It felt like a massage I'd get from a premium spa. The masseuse was an expert at applying the right pressure, speed and routine. It was excellent. I loved it very much that I came to get a second massage. The second time I went was a rather a disappointment (a different masseuse). She seemed rushed with her quick movements and didn't follow a standard routine. For example, she was doing my back and suddenly moved on to my arm, but then back to my back again. I don't know why but she used like a hot oil / menthol like Vicks to massage my neck and head. The smell was so strong that I couldn't breath using my nose, and used my mouth to breathe instead. She also massaged my breasts, which is rather uncommon in my experience of Thai massage.

reviews.name: Hasmarliah Hassan
reviews.text: Best Massage I had on my Phuket Getaway. Strongly recommend this place! The masseuse did so well. I was so amazed. Thank you for the great experience!

reviews.name: Morten Olsen
reviews.text:
The worst foot massage I’ve ever had in Thailand. She used her knuckles and was way to hard. I told her, she not understand. Manager told her so that helped a little. But sadly still an amazingly bad massage. Where I wasn’t able to relax because it felt so unpleasant. Half of the massage was also not on the foot but and my legs and thighs.
The first 5-10 minutes the masseuse also was way too much focused on talking to other staff and laughing.
Was sitting bad on the chair, masseuse did not offered to adjust chair or give me a pillow even though she could see I was wiggling around. Maybe I was just super unlucky considering all the other good reviews. But for me it was a 1 stars experience. Had so many good massages elsewhere.

reviews.text:
During our trip in Thailand, we tried massages from different places. This was the best one!
This is a quiet and cozy place and everyone is so welcoming and hospitable.

I got the foot massage which involved some streching my shoulder and back . It was much needed and was phenomenal. They massaged first with tiger balm which helped with soreness and pain. My massage was done by Nam

My husband got a back and shoulder massage and we get it often back home in Canada and this was just amazing, it helped release knots and pain he had for a while.

It was soo good that I came back the next day and got a full body oil massage and face massage  which was soo relaxing that I almost slept off multiple times.

Anyone staying nearby, 100% recommend this place. Must visit

Ideal date night - massages here, walk along the beach and amazing pad thai  at jeeds around the corner.

Siam Spa Sleep & Salon offers a truly distinctive relaxation experience.

We pay close attention to every detail and to your individual needs, as we believe the head is a vital center that connects the balance of body and mind. reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Siam Spa Sleep & Salon, we would like to provide further details regarding our unique Shirodhara procedure, which includes a premium hair spa treatment.
​Shirodhara 60 mins – May Promotion: 1,999 THB (Regular price 2,200 THB)
​Our signature 6-step process includes:
​1. Chest, Neck, and Shoulder Massage: Starting with a relaxing massage to release upper body tension.
​2. Scalp Stimulation: Using specialized tools and massage combs to prep the scalp.
​3. The Shirodhara Ritual: A specialist gently swings a brass pot to pour a warm blend of Coconut and Argan Oil onto the forehead—the "Third Eye"—in a rhythmic, continuous stream to balance the mind.
​4. Hair Wash & Treatment: Cleansing and nourishing the hair using premium Davines products from Italy.
​5. Hair Mask & Water Halo: While the hair is treated under the "Water Halo" ring, we provide a hand and leg massage for total body relaxation.
​6. Blow-dry & Styling: Finishing with professional styling to your preference.
​Regarding your recent visit (12:45 PM – 2:15 PM), the total service time exceeded 90 minutes as we aimed to provide a comprehensive experience. We understand you may have felt that the specific oil-pouring (Shirodhara) portion was shorter than expected; however, we designed this package to ensure every minute of your session provides the highest value across all treatments.
​If you prefer a longer duration specifically for the Shirodhara oil-pouring ritual, we highly recommend our 120-minute Shirodhara packages (please note that these are currently at regular price).
​Siam Spa Sleep & Salon sincerely apologizes for any dissatisfaction you experienced. We truly value your feedback and will use it to improve our services further.
​Thank you for choosing us.

I had an excellent body oil massage 💆‍♀️ by Ms. Amy on Tuesday. She is friendly, plump with long pony hair. Amy was very attentive and asked if I felt okay and whether the touch was too strong for me. 💕

Amy has a strong thai massage experience. She knows what she does to the body. Her hand movements have rhythm and flow. She said my back is so stiff, and she will make sure it feels soft after her therapy. She cracked my backbone 3 times, my stiff back a few times. She was strong, but she didn't hurt me at all. 🌸

If you read this review, request Amy.

My partner, on the other hand, wasn't as lucky as his masseuse was not as good as mine.

This is a family massage spa, and it can attend many customers at once. They were many people when I arrived, but there were enough therapists for me. It is located adjacent to the Wine Connection restaurant. 🍷

I was lucky to get a private room. There is a shower room for those who just had an oil massage.

reviews.text: After a long day of fishing, I found myself sore and sunburned. I needed a massage and found Namah Spa very close to the Mercure where I was staying. reviews.name: Gabriel Foong
reviews.text:
The place was pretty comfy and nice, but the masseurs weren’t. We came around 11pm knowing that they’re not closing til 3am, but the sign on the door said until 12am. We went in and asked for foot massages and they told us to wait for 30mins for our turn coz of the crowd (not sure is to deter us) but we only waited for only 2 mins until our turn after agreeing to the wait. Not sure if the masseurs here are overworked, but they weren’t putting any effort when massaging. We overheard them complaining about overtime and they weren’t pleased when new customers walk through the door. When we asked for a firmer pressure they complained to each other in Thai, mixed with some terms that we understood, which obviously was about the request. My friend weren’t getting a good massage overall and paid something that’s not even worth half the price. It was 700baht for 90 mins session which is higher than the average here in Bangkok btw.

Won’t recommend to whoever that really looks forward to a good massage.

reviews.name: MT
reviews.text:
Hands down the best message place in Pa Tong, Phuket, really close to the central busy area and Bangla street!

The place is clean, peaceful and relaxing. The Thai massage itself was incredible— perfect balance of deep pressure and flow. The therapist was highly skilled, attentive, and clearly knew exactly how to work through tight muscles and stress points. I walked in stiff and sore and walked out feeling lighter, looser, and genuinely refreshed.

They give you a little survey beforehand to file with information about pressure preferences and problem areas, and the entire experience felt thoughtful and personalized rather than rushed. The prices of the messages are reasonable but you might have to pay a little extra if you want additional services like shower and so forth. Still very affordable.

If you’re looking for a great Thai massage—not just relaxation, but true bodywork and renewal—this is the place. I can’t recommend it enough and will absolutely be coming back next time I’m in Thailand !

reviews.name: M Abalos
reviews.text:
Foot massages are abundant in Patong, Thailand. For newcomers unsure of which spa to choose, it’s best to price-check if you have some time. Check out the establishment’s interior and exterior, its ambiance, and familiarize yourself with the services offered. As my cousin always says, “The place has to call you.”

During my recent visit to Patong in 2023, Anahitaa Spa caught my attention. Although I’m not particularly loyal to any spa, I found myself returning to Anahitaa. In fact, during my last visit to Thailand, I visited a variety of spas, going to one to three times a day.  Interestingly, the spa next door to Anahitaa is owned by the same people.

Anahitaa Spa is spacious and well-equipped with numerous beds and chairs. The air is filled with a pleasant scent, and the decor is clean and inviting. There are also a few massage therapists ready to provide services for large groups, like ours. When comes to tipping, the massage therapists are grateful and humble with whatever you give. They actually do not expect.

It’s important to note that not all massage therapists are created equal. Each has a unique sellllt of skills, so it’s crucial to communicate your expectations beforehand. Personally, I prefer massages without deep or heavy pressures or the use of knuckles or elbows. Overall, my massage experiences at Anahitaa Spa have been consistently positive.

Thank you, Noy!

Give Anahitaa Spa a try! 👍🏼

Make sure you ask for Noy, she’s absolutely incredible. Her technique and care were unmatched. I left feeling relaxed, and refreshed.  The place is clean, cozy, and the staff are super friendly and professional.

I’m honestly planning to come here every single day during my stay. It’s that good. Huge thanks to Victoria for the recommendation, 10/10 experience! Do yourself a favour and ask for Noy, she's the best of the best !

After 10 minutes my wife wanted to stop her massage, because it was not only a terrible massage, but also she could (literally) feel that the person on top of her was a man…. reviews.name: Kevin Taylor
reviews.text: This is a very clean and safe environment to relax and unwind. It is a young business in a busy park of Unley Road. The staff are friendly and attentive to your aches and points of tension. They are guided by you as to the amount of pressure you can handle. Don’t let language be a barrier to your experience of a Ruamm Thai Massage. As I said, it is a young business and it deserves our support. They are always striving to improve so give them a chance.

reviews.name: Alex Evans
reviews.text: Worst massage I've had in Thailand, no pressure or technique, really fast, didn't really focus on the area i asked to. Stopped after 30 minutes and he wanted to charge for full 90 minutes, after speaking to another staff member ended up paying 60%. Maybe the other masseuses are better?

reviews.name: K T
reviews.text: In 2025 I had walked the Camino Santiago and I had a fall. I broke my knee. I traveled home with aid. But I had a 5 day stop in Bangkok… best thing I ever did! I stayed at Blue Chang House… a must for economic accommodation!!!! Wonderful staff and great care and assistance. Went to Ruamm Thai Massage for help with my knee and foot massage. OH! FANTASTIC. OMG… broken knew aside… my feet… foot massage….. care and sensitivity to my leg issues… they were fantastic.!if you are in Bangkok You must seek out Ruamm Thai Massage…. You will not regret it.

reviews.name: Moises Bessalle

Best
RUAMM Thai Massage - Khaosan

The price is fairly good and a discount if before lunch. The herbal tea after you're finished is a nice touch.  There is a toilet in the back and street parking in the front. Overall a good little place we'd return to.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much to came to our place..and support us..welcome back na ka ..

reviews.name: Georgia W
reviews.text: This is my favourite massage place in Pattaya. I have been to so many and I always love coming here. They welcome me with water and you get a lovely tea after. Peaceful music playing and have a no phone policy so no one is making a lot of noise on their phone. The ladies and men are smiling and always welcoming. The owner is such a kind lady and you should support this business as they are wonderful ! Their foot scrubs are great, body scrubs are revitalizing, foot massages and oil massages I would also recommend! Back and shoulder is very good if you have any tight muscles. Good prices and high quality service. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for being here and let us to service you. We hope to see you again as soon as we can

reviews.name: Yves Fraiture
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience here! The masseuse was incredibly skilled and truly knows her job. She knew exactly which points to massage, and I felt completely revitalized afterward. I came in with back pain from sleeping in a bad position, and when I left the salon, the pain was completely gone! I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a professional and effective massage. :-)

reviews.name: Jam Jam
reviews.text: I had a positive experience with both foot massage and Thai massage. The prices were very reasonable, and the environment was clean with friendly staff. However, if you are looking for a spa with a pleasant ambiance, this may not be the right choice, as there was a lack of scent. We were served with nice welcome drinks. I love it

reviews.name: Brendan Peterson
reviews.text: Hands down the best massage establishment in Pattaya. They are located a little out of the way compared to Pattaya City, but well worth the 10 minute trip. The ambiance is spectacular. The business opened up 6 months ago and is going to take off once the word is out about how amazing the massages are. They also have a loyalty program- get 1 massage free after 10 massages. PERFECT!

title: The Shore Serenity Spa Phuket
ownerDescription:
Serenity Spa, a classic example of modern elegance complimenting the warmth and sincerity of ancient Thai culture......a vision, a feeling, an awakening.
Soothe your muscles, enhance your beauty and reawaken your spirit. Serenity Spa features elegantly appointed private rooms incorporating Herbal Steam and outdoor plunge Baths, tucked within shimmering reflection pools and a lush green landscape.
address: 16 Kata Noi Rd, Karon, Maung, Phuket 83100, Thailand

The atmosphere was calming, the therapist was amazing, and I left feeling completely refreshed. Highly recommend!

reviews.text:

What really surprised me is when she was doing the massage in the head, I removed the towel above my eyes and I saw her using her phone while massaging me with hand, I ask her are you seriously using her phone and she laughed, honestly I’ve never been to a place to relax and left this angry

I highly recommend not to go to this spa As they are not taking their job seriously

reviews.text: ประทับใจมากค่ะ พึ่งเคยมาเรียนพิลาทิสครั้งแรก สอนละเอียด สอนโฟกัสร่างกาย เข้าใจง่าย ชอบมากค่ะ สถานที่ minimal มากๆสวยมากกกก มีถุงเท้าขายด้วย ถุงเท้าน่ารักมากๆ💖✨

reviews.textTranslated: I've been here many times. The studio is beautiful, the vibe is great, and every corner is perfect for creating beautiful content. It's Instagram-worthy.

reviews.name: pimmada yodkrisri
reviews.text:
เลือกดูแลร่างกายด้วย Pilates ดูแลจิตใจด้วย Sound bath กับ Reine มา 2 เดือนแล้ว เริ่มมาจากชอบ Mood and tone ที่นี้เลยอยากมาลองเรียน เป็น Pet friendly ด้วยสามารถพาลูกสาวหมาอ้วนมาเรียนด้วยได้
เลยมีโอกาศได้ทดลองเรียนทุกคลาส 1:1 , Duo
Mat pilates ครูมาอะ ครูเมจิ ครูนุ้ย ทุกคนสอนดี
คอยช่วยปรับท่าจัดท่าให้ถูกต้อง ไม่เคยมีบาดเจ็บ
ท่าสวยท่าไหนที่เราพอทำได้ครูก็จะช่วยให้ลอง
ท่าไหนเรายังไม่แข็งแรงพอครูก็จะยังไม่ให้ทำ
ครูที่นี่ใจเย็น ยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใสน่ารักทุกคน
แนะนำใครมาลองเรียนชอบทุกคน เป็นพลังบวกที่ดี ส่วนตัวชอบเรียนที่นี้มาก ได้รับพลังงานดีๆจากสถานที่และผู้คนที่นี่เยอะมาก 😊🤍
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been taking care of my body with Pilates and my mind with Sound baths at Reine for the past two months. It started because I loved the mood and tone here, so I wanted to try a class. It's also pet-friendly, so I can bring my chubby dog ​​to class with me.
I've had the chance to try every class, from 1:1 to duo sessions.
For Mat Pilates, instructors Ma, Meiji, and Nui are all excellent teachers.
They always help adjust and correct my posture, and I've never gotten injured.
If there are poses that look good and that I can do, the instructors will help me try them.
If there are poses that I'm not strong enough in, they won't let me do them yet.
The instructors here are all patient, cheerful, and lovely.
Everyone I've recommended to try a class here loves it. It's a great source of positive energy. Personally, I love learning here. I receive so much positive energy from the place and the people here. 😊🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวนะคะ น่ารักมากๆ ยินดีที่ได้เป็นพื้นที่ฮีลใจให้กับคุณเค้กและอ้วนนะ นะค้า💖💖💖 ลูกค้าของสตูเราน่ารักสุดๆ

reviews.textTranslated:
I've finished two courses, for a total of 17 classes, and haven't written a review yet! 😆 The studio is lovely, clean, and tidy. There's also plenty of parking.

I've met several teachers, and they're all great. Each has their own distinct style and unique skills. 👍🏻 I'm gradually seeing the studio grow, and now they have so many group classes to choose from—it's overwhelming! 🤣 Great! I'll continue to support them and I'm looking forward to their second branch! 👀💪🏻

reviews.name: natrawee doungkawe
reviews.text: Best sound healing in rayong reasonable price. เป็นการ ผ่อนคลายด้วยเสียงบำบัด ซึ่งในระยองมีไม่กี่ที่ แต่ชอบที่นี่เพราะว่าบรรยากาศสบายคล้ายสปา และยังเป็นพิลาติสสตูดิโออีกด้วย แต่ละเดือนจะมีตารางไม่เหมือนกัน ลงไว้เกือบทุกวันที่มี sound healing เพราะแต่ละครั้งจะได้ประสบการณ์ที่ไม่เหมือนกัน บางคนก็หลับไปเลย บางทีกล้ามเนื้อตึงตึงก็หาย ใช้ทั้งขันธิเบต และ crystal bowl etc ตอนจบมีให้เปิดไพ่ oracle ด้วย  เหมือนเป็นการล้างพลังงานลบที่เจอมาทั้งอาทิตย์ แล้วก็ให้รางวัลกับตัวเอง คล้ายๆกันมาทำสปาด้วยเสียง ความเหนื่อยเมื่อยล้า บรรเทาลงอย่างดี ครูที่มีประสบการณ์ในการตีขัน และมีความตั้งใจ เสียงของขันไปกระตุ้นเซลล์ที่ประกอบด้วยน้ำในร่างกาย ให้มีการสั่นสะเทือน และตอบรับคลื่นเสียงของแต่ละคนแตกต่างกันไป ชอบทุกครั้งที่ไปทำเลยค่ะ ส่วนไพ่โดยปกติส่วนตัวไม่เชื่อ แต่อันนี้แม่นอย่างน่าอัศจรรย์
reviews.textTranslated: The best sound healing in Rayong at a reasonable price. It's a relaxing sound therapy experience, something not many places offer in Rayong, but I love this place because the atmosphere is so comfortable, like a spa, and it's also a Pilates studio. The schedule changes every month, but I usually book sessions for sound healing because each session is unique. Some people even fall asleep, and sometimes muscle tension disappears. They use Tibetan singing bowls and crystal bowls, etc. At the end, they offer an oracle reading, like a way to cleanse yourself of negative energy from the week and reward yourself. It's similar to a spa with sound; it effectively relieves fatigue. The instructor is experienced in making the bowls and is very dedicated. The sound of the bowls stimulates the water-based cells in the body, causing them to vibrate and respond to sound waves differently for each person. I love every session. As for the tarot cards, I don't usually believe in them, but these were surprisingly accurate.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบพระคุณมากค่ะ รีวิวน่ารักมากๆเลยค่ะ ชื่นใจสุดๆ ☺️💖🙏🏻 ยินดีที่ได้เป็นพื้นที่ฮีลใจให้ลูกค้านะคะ

Yoga & Pilates Studio with Soundhealing

ฝึกลมหายใจไปพร้อมการทำความรู้จักร่างกาย ในรูปแบบต่างๆ ทั้งศาสตร์โยคะ พิลาทิส หรือการทำความรู้จักลึกๆไปกับพลังงานในร่างกายของเรา ด้วยขันทิเบต

เพื่อให้ร่างกายรู้สึกของเรารู้สึกดีขึ้น โล่งขึ้น ไม่ใช่แค่บนแมท แต่คือชีวิตจริงๆที่อยู่ข้างนอกแมท อย่างน้อยก็ทำให้เราขึ้นบันไดแล้วเหนื่อยน้อยลง หรือวิ่งได้ดีขึ้น ร้องเพลงได้นานขึ้น 😊

reviews.name: Patty Kul
reviews.text: I liked it when the teacher taught me retain breathing — felt like I was really with myself and at peace.

reviews.name: S. Naivikul
reviews.text: เรียน private yoga กับครูลูกหมูมาได้ครึ่งปี ได้เข้าใจพื้นฐานต่างๆ มากขึ้น ในคลาสมีทั้งการฝึกลมหายใจควบคู่ไปการยืดร่างกายแก้ปัญหาเฉพาะของแต่ละคนค่ะ ไม่มีพื้นฐานก็มาเรียนได้นะคะ ครูสามารถจัดคอร์สให้ได้ค่ะ ส่วนสถานที่ก็เลือกได้ว่าอยากเรียนที่บ้านครูหรือให้ครูมาสอนที่บ้านเรา
reviews.textTranslated: I've been taking private yoga classes with Teacher Lukmoo for half a year now and have gained a better understanding of the fundamentals. The classes include breathing exercises combined with stretching to address individual needs. No prior experience is necessary; Teacher Lukmoo can create a customized course for you. As for the location, you can choose whether you want to study at Teacher Lukmoo's home or have her come to your home.

reviews.name: Lalada Taweephol
reviews.text: เรียนโยคะกับครูลูกหมูมา 2 เดือนกว่าได้ ร่างกายยืดหยุ่นดีขึ้นมาก แข็งแรงขึ้นด้วย ครูลูกหมูสอนการหายใจแบบต่างๆเพื่อปรับใช้ในการใช้ชีวิตประจำวัน มีความรู้ให้เสมอ เลิฟมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: I've been taking yoga classes with Teacher Lukmoo for over two months now. My body is much more flexible and stronger. Teacher Lukmoo teaches different breathing techniques that can be applied to daily life. She's always sharing valuable knowledge. I love her very much!

reviews.name: Nidchavee Nonarin
reviews.text: ครูลูกหมูสอนดีมากๆ สอนการหายใจที่ถูกต้อง ทำให้การเล่นโยคะ เป็นไปอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพและท่าโยคะช่วยให้ยืดเหยียดร่างกายได้ทุกส่วน  รู้สึกดีมากๆ ชอบมากๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Lukmoo is a great teacher! She taught correct breathing techniques, making yoga practice very effective. The yoga poses help stretch every part of the body. I feel great afterwards; I really like it!

reviews.name: Ryu sako
reviews.text: มาเล่นโยคะกับครูลูกหมูครั้งแรก ได้รับประสบการณ์ใหม่ๆ เรื่องการฝึกหายใจ ช่วยให้เราหายใจได้เต็มปอดมากขึ้น หายใจอิ่มมากขึ้น จะช่วยเรื่องการหายใจได้อิ่มและนอนหลับสบาย
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first yoga class with Teacher Lukmoo, and I gained new experiences, especially regarding breathing exercises. It helped me breathe more fully, allowing me to breathe more deeply, which will contribute to better breathing and more restful sleep.

reviews.name: Madam Donna
reviews.text: ดีมากกกกค่ะ  เมื่อก่อนหลีกเลี่ยงโยคะตลอด  จนได้มาฝึกกับครูหมู ฝึกการหายใจ ยืดเหยียด ดูแล เอาใจใส่ดีมาก  จากไม่ชอบ กลายเป็นรัก❤เลยค่ะ..แนะนำ แนะนำ
reviews.textTranslated: It was amazing! I used to avoid yoga, but then I started practicing with Teacher Moo. She taught me breathing techniques, stretching, and provided excellent care and attention. I went from disliking it to loving it! ❤ Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณครับผม 😊

reviews.name: Sangrawee
reviews.text: ครูพี่หมู สอนดีมากค่ะ ตั้งแต่ให้นักเรียนรู้จักการหายใจ จากนั้นก็ค่อยๆสอนด้วยท่าต่างๆ ชั่วโมงเดียวโดนเส้นเลยค่ะ ใครปวดเมื่อย เส้นยึด มาที่นี่ได้เลยน้า แนะนำเลย เดินทางสะดวก
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher P'Moo is a great teacher! She starts by teaching students how to breathe, then gradually teaches various poses. In just one hour, we were hitting the right spots! If you have aches, pains, or stiff muscles, you should come here. Highly recommended! It's also easy to get to.

reviews.name: Thanit Nilayodhin
reviews.text: ฝึกโยคะกับครูลูกหมูช่วยกลับมาบาลานซ์ร่างกาย-การหายใจของตัวเองอีกครั้ง  บรรยากาศสบายๆ สิ่งที่ชอบมากๆคือ บางsession ครูจะปิดท้ายด้วยการใช้ essential oil สร้างประสบการณ์ทางกลิ่นเพื่อให้เรา grounded และ relaxed มากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: Practicing yoga with Teacher Lukmoo helped me regain balance in my body and breathing. The atmosphere was very relaxing. What I really liked was that some sessions would end with the use of essential oils, creating an olfactory experience to help us feel grounded and very relaxed.

reviews.name: sujira Thongpoon (Kanan makeup)
reviews.text: พึ่งหัดเล่นโยคะ คุณครูลูกหมูสอนดีมากเลยค่ะ  สอนการจัดระเบียบร่างกาย ที่สำคัญเลย สอนหายใจให้ถูกหลัก ชอบมากๆค่ะ 🥰
reviews.textTranslated: I just started practicing yoga, and my instructor, Ms. Lukmoo, is amazing! She taught me proper body alignment and, most importantly, correct breathing techniques. I love it so much! 🥰

reviews.name: Pattaragorn Pechdeechanadej
reviews.text: ครูลูกหมูสอนกำหนดลมหายใจ ทำให้ฝึกการให้ใจได้ดีขึ้นมาก แนะนำครับ
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Piglet taught breathing exercises, which greatly improved my mindfulness practice. I recommend it.

reviews.name: Maninphan Yamananon
reviews.text: สำหรับคนเล่น weight training การไ้ด้มาเล่นโยคะ ลมหายใจ ทำให้รู้สึกถึงการผ่อนคลาย กล้ามเนื้อ จากคนหายใจตื้น ช่วยให้หายใจได้ลึกขึ้นมากครับ
reviews.textTranslated: For people who do weight training, practicing yoga and breathing exercises can help relax muscles. It can help those who breathe shallowly to breathe much deeper.

reviews.name: Pp Kts
reviews.text: มาเรียนครั้งแรก ดีมากค่ะ เข้าใจง่าย ครูสอนดี โดนเส้นตรงจุดเลย แนะนำเลยค่าเป็นกันเอง❤️
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first class and it was great! Easy to understand, the teacher was excellent and got straight to the point. I highly recommend it! The atmosphere was very friendly ❤️

reviews.name: Chonkana Noppakunsomboon
reviews.text: ได้เหยียดยืดจากวันทำงาน ทำให้ผ่อนคลาย ครูน้องหมูใจเย็น ช่วยจัดท่าให้ถูกต้อง และช่วยสอนเรื่องการหายใจไปพร้อมกับการเคลื่อนไหวร่างกาย
reviews.textTranslated: Stretching after a long day at work was relaxing. Teacher Nong Moo was patient, helped me maintain correct posture, and taught me breathing techniques while moving my body.

reviews.name: Faipasabali
reviews.text: สตูใหม่ สะอาดมาก มีอุปกรณ์เพิ่มเติม บรรยากาศดี เหมาะกับการเรียนโยคะมากค่ะ ครูสอนดีมาก
reviews.textTranslated: The new studio is very clean, has additional equipment, and a great atmosphere—perfect for yoga classes. The instructor is excellent.

reviews.name: Por Samransukrat
reviews.text: คุณครูหมูสอนสนุกค่ะ ปรับเปลี่ยนการสอนตามความต้องการและความสามารถของนักเรียน ผู้ฝึกที่ไม่เคยเล่นมาก่อนก็สามารถเล่นได้อย่างสนุกและถ้าเล่นไประดับที่ต้องการพัฒนาร่างกายแล้ว คุณครูก็ปรับการสอนให้เข้ากับการเล่นของเราค่ะ ที่สำคัญที่สุดการเล่นโยคะกับคุณครูหมูจะเน้นเรื่องการใช้ลมหายใจ ทำให้รู้สึกว่าสามารถควบคุมอารมณ์ ควบคุมลมหายใจให้ นิ่ง สงบ หลังจากฝึกจะรูู้สึกผ่อนคลายมากๆ Recommend
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Moo's classes are fun! She adapts her teaching to the needs and abilities of her students. Even those who have never practiced before can enjoy it, and if you want to progress to a higher level of physical development, she adjusts her teaching to suit your needs. Most importantly, yoga with Teacher Moo emphasizes breathing techniques, which helps you feel more controlled and calm in your breathing. You'll feel incredibly relaxed after each practice. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณนะครับ คุณนักเรียน 😊

reviews.name: Keng Neverwait
reviews.text: ชอบการการฝึกยืดเหยียด ออกกำลังกายมาตลอดแทบไม่เคยยืดเหยียดเลย  ช่วยได้มากคับ เฉียบ👍🏽
reviews.textTranslated: I enjoy stretching exercises. I've been exercising all my life but I've hardly ever stretched before. It helps a lot! Awesome! 👍🏽

reviews.name: Taliltip Teswiruch
reviews.text:
เรียนสนุก ผ่อนคลาย หลับสบายมากคร่า 😜
ครูใจดีมากๆ แก้จุดที่ตึง ปวด เลิกไปร้านนวดได้เลยค่า
reviews.textTranslated:
The class was fun, relaxing, and I slept so well! 😜
The teacher was so kind and helped me with my tightness and pain. I can now stop going to massage parlors.

reviews.name: กันตา สังขวิสิทธิ์
reviews.text: สะอาด ที่จอดรถสะดวก ครูสอนดีมากๆเลยคะ🥰
reviews.textTranslated: Clean, convenient parking, and the teacher was excellent! 🥰

reviews.name: Azuji Karoo
reviews.text: ครูลูกหมูอัธยาศัยดีมาก ยิ้มแย้ม เป็นกันเอง ต้องลองมาเรียนแล้วจะรู้ว่าโยคะมีอะไรดีๆกว่าที่คุณคิด ^^
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Lukmoo is very friendly, always smiling and welcoming. You should try a class and you'll realize yoga has more benefits than you think! ^^

reviews.name: จั๊กกะบุ๋ม
reviews.text:
ครูสอนดีมาก ใครที่ไม่เคยฝึกและเขินที่จะเข้าคลาส มาเจอครูหมูเลยค่ะ

รักษาอาการออฟฟิตซินโดรมดีมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The instructor is excellent. Anyone who has never practiced before and is shy about joining a class should definitely meet Instructor Moo!

It's very effective in treating office syndrome.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณค่า คุณนักเรียนน 😊

title: โซลฟิต พิลาทิส อุดมสุข (Soulfit Pilates UdomSuk)
ownerDescription: สตูดิโอพิลาทิสแบบ 1-on-1 ที่ดูแลโดยครูผู้เชี่ยวชาญอย่างใกล้ชิด ใช้อุปกรณ์ครบครัน มาตรฐานระดับโลก ทุกโปรแกรมออกแบบเพื่อเสริมความแข็งแรง แก้ไขอาการปวด ฟื้นฟูการเคลื่อนไหว และปรับสมดุลร่างกาย

reviews.name: Xing -
reviews.text: Really good experience. K. Bell is amazing.

reviews.name: Gezbel P.
reviews.text: Kru Gebale is an amazing Pilates instructor — fun, attentive, and very caring. She teaches the right techniques and even shares tips for practicing at home. The studio is clean, private, and easy to reach. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: NiCkzz 4ever
reviews.text: Great place, teacher jhew is very helpful and supportive. Highly recommended!!

reviews.name: Chanisa VI
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, super clean, and teacher Gbell is very caring.

reviews.name: T. J.
reviews.text: Good

reviews.name: Lalita
reviews.text: เพิ่งมาเรียน 1on1 กับ soulfit แฮปปี้มากกกค่ะ และมาเจอครูไอซ์ด้วยน่ารักมาก สอนสนุกและมีการวางแพลนการสอนที่เหมาะสมกับเราให้แต่ละคลาส ก็ลงเรียนด้วยยาวๆไปเลยค่ะ และที่นี่ไม่ยัดเยียดขายคอร์สด้วย ถ้าใครที่ลังเลอยู่แนะนำเลยค่า💗🩰✨
reviews.textTranslated: I just started taking 1on1 classes with Soulfit and I'm so happy! I also met Teacher Ice, who is incredibly lovely. She's a fun teacher and creates well-planned classes that suit me. I've decided to continue studying with them for a while. They also don't push any courses on you. If you're hesitant about buying classes, I highly recommend them! 💗🩰✨

reviews.name: May Lin
reviews.text: เคยออกกำลังกายมาหลายรูปแบบแล้ว และนี่คือครั้งแรกที่ฝึกพิลาทิส ได้ข่าวว่าเปิดใกล้บ้าน รีบจองคิวมาฝึกเลย ที่นี่สะอาด เครื่องใหม่มาก น่าใช้ น่าลองทุกเครื่อง มีห้องแยกเป็นสัดส่วน แต่ละห้องโปร่ง กว้าง คนชอบถ่ายรูป ต้องกดชัตเตอร์รัวแน่นอน ปัญหาคอบ่าไหล่ตึง ไหล่ห่อ กล้ามเนื้อไม่ยืดหยุ่น พิลาทิสช่วยได้จริง ได้เหงื่อด้วย ครูฝึกมีความเชี่ยวชาญเฉพาะทาง คอยดูแลตลอดทั้งคลาส ปลอดภัยหายห่วง
reviews.textTranslated: I've tried many different types of exercise before, and this was my first time doing Pilates. I heard a place opened near my house, so I quickly booked a session. The place is clean, the equipment is brand new, and everything looks great and worth trying. There are separate, spacious rooms, perfect for those who love taking photos – you'll be snapping pictures non-stop! Pilates really helps with neck, shoulder, and back tension, rounded shoulders, and muscle inflexibility. And you'll sweat a lot! The instructors are highly skilled and specialized, providing excellent supervision throughout the class, so it's very safe.

reviews.name: Akharadet I0
reviews.text: ครูจีเบลสอนดีมากค่ะ ใส่ใจรายละเอียด คอยแนะนำและออกแบบ personal program ให้อย่างดีเลย ครูน่ารักใจเย็น เป็นกันเองมากค่าา ✨
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Jibel is an excellent teacher. She's attentive to detail, provides great guidance, and designs personalized programs. She's lovely, patient, and very friendly! ✨

reviews.name: Rasha Mediene
reviews.text:
This was the only place I could find in Pai offering aerial yoga and Pilates yoga. Trust me, I searched.

I ended up trying both and while the area and vibe were great, aerial yoga just wasn’t for me. Pilates yoga though? That had me sweating, stretching, and using every part of my body. It’s a full-body workout that uses your own body weight, and I really felt the difference after just a few sessions.

Classes are one hour long. When I was here, the schedule was:
•	Pilates yoga: Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday from 8 AM to 9 AM
•	Aerial yoga: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday from 5 PM to 6 PM

The space is beautiful & tucked away from the noise, surrounded by nature, with peaceful mountain views. It’s the kind of place that makes it easy to stay present.

The instructor, Elisha, is amazing. She really knows her stuff and cares about every person in the class. She’ll help correct your form if something’s off, but she’s also really gentle and understanding if you’re working with injuries. I had just gotten stitches removed from my knee less than two months ago and let her know I had to modify some moves. She worked with me and made sure I felt comfortable the whole time.

I paid ฿1500 for a 10-class pass that’s valid for one month, which was a great deal. I believe the drop-in price is ฿300 per class, but you can message Elisha directly on WhatsApp to get the most up-to-date info or book a class.

If you’re in Pai and want to do more than just stretch and breathe, if you actually want to move, this is the spot.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 😊

Each class was thoughtfully designed, seamlessly blending physical postures with mindfulness and meditation techniques that left me feeling rejuvenated and balanced.

The center itself is a beautiful oasis, surrounded by lush greenery and tranquil views, providing the perfect setting for reflection and growth. I particularly enjoyed the sunrise sessions, where the beauty of nature enhanced our practice and set a calming tone for the day.

Additionally, Aaadi offers workshops and holistic therapies that complement the yoga experience, allowing for deeper exploration of mind and body. The sense of community among fellow practitioners was also a highlight; everyone was supportive and encouraging, creating an environment of connection and shared growth.

If you’re in Phuket and seeking a profound yoga experience, look no further than Aaadi Yoga Center with Master Deepak Yogi. It’s more than just a yoga studio; it’s a sanctuary for transformation and self-discovery. I left feeling renewed and inspired, and I can’t wait to return!

She was incredibly attentive, knowledgeable, and encouraging throughout. I also got to try new exercises I hadn’t done before, which made the session both challenging and exciting.

Ellie was also so lovely and welcoming, and together they created such a great atmosphere. Fon & Ellie made me feel completely comfortable from start to finish, and the whole experience had the best vibes.

I left feeling stronger, more confident, and genuinely impressed by the quality of the instruction. I would highly recommend this studio  to anyone looking for a personalised and effective Pilates experience in Krabi!

This studio had a truly tranquil energy that resonated deeply with my idea of what yoga should be, beautiful in its simplicity and grounded in purpose. The atmosphere felt authentic and aligned with the essence of the practice, something I had been hoping to find for a long time.

The instructor’s presence and knowledge stood out immediately. For the first time I actually received meaningful corrections after trying multiple studios across the country. The attention to detail and genuine care for proper alignment made all the difference. It wasn’t just about going through the motions, but it felt like a real practice, guided with awareness and intention.

This isn’t the kind of place where people show up just to say they “do yoga.” It’s for people who actually want to practice yoga. And that’s what makes it so rare and worth coming back to.

I still remember how peaceful and grateful I felt when I left your studio. I’m truly thankful for this beautiful memory.

reviews.text:
One of the best private pilates studio, offering a truly personalized experience. What sets this studio apart is the expertise of the trainer, who is a qualified physiotherapist with an impressive level of knowledge and skill.

I visited the studio to address my snapping hip problem, and she carefully examined my condition before designing a personalized training program tailored specifically to my needs. Remarkably, I felt significant relief from my issue after just the first session.

And yes, on some days, you might be lucky enough to be greeted by Bondy, the studio’s adorable Samoyed. His cheerful welcome adds an extra dose of charm to an already fantastic experience.

I highly recommend Bondy Pilates Studio to anyone looking for professional care and outstanding results.

reviews.text:
Studio สวยงาม สะอาดไม่รก มีเครื่องครบ
เป็น private class เรียนกับครูแนน เป็นกันเอง พูดเก่งให้กำลังใจเก่ง มาครั้งแรกไม่รู้สึกอึดอัดเลยค่ะ

ส่วนตัวเป็นคนที่ออกกำลังกายบ้างอยู่แล้วและเคยเล่นพิลาทิสมาบ้างแต่ไม่บ่อยเพราะรู้สึกว่าค่อนข้างน่าเบื่อ แต่มาวันนี้ไม่น่าเบื่อเลยค่ะ ครูแนนจัดค่อนข้างหนักในกล้ามนื้อกับท่าที่เราทำไม่ค่อยได้ เกร็งสุดๆ ขึ้นลงทุกเครื่องสะใจดีค่ะ

ชอบตรงที่มีการปรับเปลี่ยนท่าทางและความหนักเบาของแต่ละคนนะคะ รู้สึกได้ถึงความใส่ใจในการสอนค่ะ

เรื่องการเดินทางสะดวก มีที่จอดรถ
ใครอยู่แถวนี้และลังเลอยู่แนะนำเลยค่ะ ดีมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
The studio is beautiful, clean, and clutter-free, with complete equipment.
It was a private class with Instructor Nan. She's friendly, talkative, and very encouraging. I didn't feel awkward at all on my first time.

I already exercise regularly and have tried Pilates before, but not often because I found it somewhat boring. But today was anything but boring! Instructor Nan pushed the limits on my muscles with exercises I'm not usually good at. It was intense, going up and down every machine was so satisfying!

I liked how she adjusted the exercises and intensity for each person. You could really feel the care she put into teaching.

The location is convenient, and there's parking available.
If you're in the area and hesitating, I highly recommend it! It's fantastic!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 💖🩷 ขอบคุณนะคะ

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 💖💖💖 ขอบคุณนะคะ

reviews.name: Jetaime V. (JETAAMM)
reviews.text: พิลาทิสคลาสส่วนตัวกับนักกายภาพบำบัด เพิ่งลองมาเล่นครั้งแรกส่วนตัวชอบมากเลยค่ะ ร้านบรรยากาศดี อุปกรณ์สะอาด เดินทางง่ายโดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งชาวโซนปิ่นเกล้า จอดรถได้ฟรี2ชม. คุณครูแนนใจดีอดทนสุดๆ แถมยังให้คำปรึกษาเรื่องออฟฟิศซินโดรมได้ดีมากๆๆๆๆ (ทางนี้หลังตึงก้นตึงสุดๆ 😂😂😂) และมีโค้ชพิเศษ น้งบอนดี้มาให้การต้อนรับแบบเป็นกันเองสุดๆ ทางร้านมีโปรทดลองเล่นสำหรับมือใหม่ด้วย แนะนำให้มาลองกันนะ 🫶🏻🫶🏻
reviews.textTranslated: I recently tried a private Pilates class with a physiotherapist for the first time and I loved it! The atmosphere is great, the equipment is clean, and it's easy to get to, especially for those in the Pinklao area. Parking is free for 2 hours. Instructor Nan is incredibly kind and patient, and she gave excellent advice on office syndrome (my back and glutes were super stiff 😂😂😂). There was also a special coach, Bondy, who was very welcoming. The studio offers a trial class for beginners. I highly recommend trying it! 🫶🏻🫶🏻

We are more than an hour to wait so we decided to come here and get a nice relaxing massage!

The ladies are super nice when you go in and you greet them!!

The lady that I had for them she was very nice but very soft touch and I wanted somebody to do it more deeper massage!

One of the reasons I didn’t care for this massage places cause they didn’t have proper oil massage tables all the tables that you were laying in were for Thai massage not for oil massage!

฿700 for an oil massage and not on an oil massage table!
So it wasn’t comfortable at the end when she did the neck because there was nowhere for her to grab onto like they way they do if you’re on a proper oil massage table!

I don’t feel like I even got a massage to be very honest! I was just disappointed cause I really needed a massage from my whole body was aching from exercising and of course your daily wear and tear!

We went here because it was convenient I don’t know if there’s another massage shop in the area but there was three of us!

There’s only one room I believe where we were all in and then there’s a private room so you can see the photos I’m not sure what those are for but I wish we would’ve had those! They would give the ladies room to move around!

I would recommend to come here for a Thai massage - not necessarily an oil massage!

reviews.text: Soni provided an exceptional Thai massage experience. She was highly professional, communicated well in English, and applied just the right amount of pressure throughout the session. reviews.name: Oat Monroe
reviews.text:
For the price, what we got just wasn’t worth it. Thai oil massage at 1,400 per person is already more expensive than many well-known spa chains with multiple branches. But instead of getting that more premium, personalized service you’d expect from a standalone place, it was the opposite.

We came as a pair (2,800 total), and the oil massage required being fully undressed, yet there were no private rooms—just a shared space with other guests, including men on nearby beds with just curtain between us. No showers available either, which is a basic standard for oil massages. That alone is a big red flag.

The staff didn’t really know how to handle small issues that came up. For example, there was no proper face cradle—just a neck pillow covered in faux leather, and when you're lying face-down on it, you can’t breathe at all. And being naked in a shared room with male guests, the therapist didn’t even help cover me properly when I had to sit up. I had to protect myself. That’s just unprofessional.

They did ask if there were any areas I wanted them to focus on, but it made no difference—nothing was addressed. I could tell the therapist was trying to do a good job, but the actual technique wasn’t impressive. It was the first time I walked out of a massage and didn’t leave a tip. What we got felt like a loss, not a treat.

Oh, and there’s no parking either.

There are way better options out there—cheaper, more complete, and better value all around. I wouldn’t recommend this place.

reviews.name: Tanjid Mowla
reviews.text:
I discovered this hidden gem of a place randomly due to its proximity to Bangkok Hospital. I was genuinely blown away by the quality of the massage, especially by the therapist Aysha. She is exceptionally skilled and has deep knowledge of acupressure techniques. I have had many great massage therapists over the years in Sydney, but I have to say that Aysha is undoubtedly the very best of the best. I have a jaw condition called TMJ (clicking jaw) for the last 5 years and she was able to fix it with acupressure just after 1 session. After the session I felt like I was floating on clouds.

I also took my sister here and Aysha was able to fix her forearm pain after one session. My sister wears hearing aids and Aysha was kind enough to adapt her communication and speak louder so that my sister could take off her hearing aids during the massage. My sister felt completely comfortable throughout the experience. It is very rare to find someone so talented and genuinely caring. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Quite far from everything, but if you have a car or bike, it might be worth a try. The price seems reasonable. It appears to be Chinese-owned—not entirely sure—but there are lots of Chinese prints everywhere.

The pool area is nice, though there are only a few sun chairs. The staff is super nice and welcoming.

However, a HUGE downside is the lack of a designated smoking area. Most of the guests seemed to be Chinese or Korean, and many smoked frequently, including near the pool and even on the room terraces. The smoke spreads everywhere, which is far from pleasant. This alone made me drop 1–2 stars.

The rooms are very spacious.

So, if you’re looking for a quiet location and don’t mind the smoke, this could be the place for you.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: I booked this hotel as part of my stay in Chiang Mai as I came here to train boxing. This is rated as a 4 star, however in my opinion it is closer to a 3 star. Pros: 1.The service was really good. Everyone is helpful and talks with a smile. 2. The room is huge! Alot of space.3.The location isn't too far from the centre. I enjoyed the quiet nature of this place. 4. Welcome fruit was a nice touch 5. It's close to the airport. Cons: 1.Very dated and weathered, needs a much needed update. 2. Alot of signs was in Chinese only, I locked my passport in the safe by accident because I couldn't understand the notice. 3.There are ALOT of warning signs around the whole place. Penalty for this penalty for that. Even a penalty if you accidentally start your period and soil the sheets accidently. This was not welcoming.4. The cleaning was subpar, I would get fresh towels and the bin emptied. But the bed sheets weren't changed once I was there for 6 days. Limescale in the bathroom. 5. The pool bar is closed and the pool towel area is closed. I say closed lightly, it's not used at all. I was confused about where to get my pool towel from and I was directed to the bath towels back in my bedroom6. The pool is in the middle of the hotel rooms therefore creating a epicentre for sound to travel. Anyone having any conversation can be heard and echoed if you are at the pool. If it wasn't for the genuinely lovely staff members I probably wouldn't have stayed longer than a day. The warning signs tipped me over.

Breakfast spread was quite poor and staff mostly is non english speaking. Concern - I had a situation with spa. First day I used1.5 hours and while massage was OK the lady kept talking/laughing/joking making it hard to relax, she even make repeated comments "you sleep hahshahss, dont sleep ok !!".. Since my knee was still hurting I booked next day slot however I waited 20 mins for her arrival. There was some confusion which they did not inform. Eventually she was rushy n panicky in service and hurt my knee.. upon which i just had to walk out midway, since she wasnt understanding my request to stop pressing on one point for 10 mins. It is also important to highlight that the spa price for similar services in the city is 100 to 300 baht depending on location, and here was 1000 baht for 60 mins. The spa owner came to apologise or check next day but again unable to understand English clearly.Situation 2 - while we did the suite room, it smelled at a particular time, being close to sewer.
