reviews.name: Tanya K
reviews.text: Hidden gem in a beautiful and serene neighborhood, waking up to birds singing and good Thai & Chinese style breakfast buffet. Staff is very friendly, rooms are clean and spacious, easy to get Grab or Bolt taxi or rent a scooter at the resort. Just around the corner there is a Chinese restaurant, they make delicious Yunnan style BBQ skewers, we kept going back there as the flavour is just so yummy and addictive!! About 15 minutes walking distance, there's Rimping Supermarket, Lotus, Mae Hia Fresh Market, and various restaurants, coffee shop & bakery. Also close to many international schools in Hang Dong district.  Minutes drive to Chiang Mai Night Safari, a great place for family and kids! We would definitely come back & stay at Vdara Resort & Spa again!!

reviews.name: Bikepacker M
reviews.text:
This place is very classic in Thai style and I loved that. It has a beautiful pool and little gardens with lots of green plants which bring joy and life. The room was very spacious and clean with a nice bed, a small fridge, and a kettle.  I really enjoyed staying in my room while listening to music, reading my book, and jounaling with a cup of hot tea.
The breakfast was fabulous. They provided fresh fruits, vegetables, freshly brewed coffee along with preordered meals. It was perfect!
Their service is more than enough because the staff are very attentive trying to help customers out and they are smiling anytime. Their communication in English is quite good. I had no problen with communicating with the staff.
One thing I am not very happy about this hotel is that it seems like a smoker-friendly or smoker super-welcomed place. I saw several customers smoking sitting outside the balcony and by the pool. I was able to smell strong smoke even when I was in my room.
I feel so sorry about the hotel which has a great atmosphere with lots of green and colorful plants. I am certain this place would  attract much more customers if the atmosphere of being green is in tuned with some clean air without any smoke. If this place keeps the policy of smoking-fine on the property, I won't come back again. What a loss for me!

Very good experience. Kru Pooky do it for more than 8 years now. She also do lots of free teaching with different centers as she believes in this way
She cares about all students in her class and always walking and correcting their positions .
She is very kind and friendly person as well and if you are new in Phuket and looking for someone friends, I suggest to join her class

reviews.name: Emeline Tantiwattanakit
reviews.text:
Simply but Extra ordinary Yoga class by Professional trainer- Kru Pooky.

I will review by parts why I love this Yoga class:
1.The Trainer - Kru Pooky, she is so beautiful yoga professional. Her figure is so gorgeous and no doubt why ahe is Yoga trainer. With her based experience on Yoga over 10 Years more, her classes are amazing and fun. Her positive energy is energize us in class to complete an hour session with positive passion and plenty of bath of Sweating.
2. Simply but extra ordinary, Kru Pooky she design the session differentiating daily so we are surprised and never get bored.
3. Organic and good ventilation locations - high ceiling, eve no air-con but it is good that the building is designed with a good ventilation. It’s location in town, bypass road at Samkong, Phuket
4. Times options: 2 session per day. Morning: 8.30-9.30a.m. And Evening: 7-8 p.m. every Mon-Sat.
5. Course price is reasonable. Many options you can contact Kru Pooky.
6. Classmates are diversifying, but they all are lovey with positive energy. New coming will be easily to blended in. Most if them are permanent yoga playing.
7. Friendly and welcome of foreigners
8. Yoga is not about stretching and  but mindfulness, balancing, concentration and focusing of breathing (i feel of calm like meditation). So it is meaningful for the person who are looking for stress release and get healthy in the same time.
Let’s join us to be a classmate to share good vibe energy … see ya.

reviews.name: Rujira Wittayarungrote
reviews.text: Highly recommend! I came here with zero experience for a 10-session private class. The instructor is wonderful—very patient and kind. They take things step-by-step, which I love. After just four classes, I’ve improved significantly!

reviews.name: Dew Suwanwong
reviews.text: I kinda nervous when i just applied for this yoga place cuz i have absolutely no basic .but it strangely surprises me.  The teachers are very helpful and incredibly friendly. The vibe in the class always nice everybody happy and funny.  Totally love it  . Always have fun here

reviews.name: Jonathan Isaac
reviews.text: Have done 5 private session with Kru Pooky and have thoroughly enjoyed the sessions. Have felt a big difference from when I first started my sessions with her. Highly recommend this

reviews.name: games prunty
reviews.text: Much appreciated to gain more techniques from yoga class as I get a good foundation to maintain my interests in practice for health and this studio provides  morning and night sessions with an affordable price. Good to visit during a holiday in Phuket also

reviews.name: なみ
reviews.text: Nice place for yoga and relax your mind. This yoga class makes me feel like I be born again!

reviews.name: Asia Ferraro
reviews.text: Lovely place 🧿🥰

reviews.name: Phuri Koranee
reviews.text: It's such an amazing place. The instructors are lovely and most willing to give advice.

reviews.name: 廖美华
reviews.text: gooooood！！！the teacher is nice and easy going

reviews.name: A AllAroundTheWorld
reviews.text: Very good teacher!

reviews.name: Sbgdvbs Bvvsb
reviews.text: Good yoga!!

reviews.name: chutima saitong
reviews.text: Kru Pooky is my yoga instructor help me correct posture  & my physical therapist .🩵🩵🩵

reviews.name: Maneepan Tantipornsawad
reviews.text: 💞🧘‍♀️รักโยคะ เพราะช่วยให้ร่างกายมีการยืดเหยียดคลายกล้ามเนื้อ เลือดลมหมุนเวียนการหายใจดีขึ้น ประทับใจครูผู้สอนและเพื่อนร่วมคลาส มีความสุขทุกๆครั้งที่ได้มาเรียนที่นี่
reviews.textTranslated: 💞🧘‍♀️I love yoga because it helps stretch and relax muscles, improves blood circulation and breathing. I'm impressed with the instructor and my classmates. I'm happy every time I come to class here.

reviews.name: Niphittha Pechphuang
reviews.text: “ เรียนได้ 4 วัน เราไม่ปวดไมเกรน หายจากอาการปวดหน้าท้องถึงปลายขาจากการปวดประจำเดือน เดิน ทำกิจกรรมปกติได้ มันเซอร์ไพรส์มากที่การฝึกโยคะช่วยเราได้“ ขอเล่าประสบการณ์ปกติเป็นคนปวดหัวไมเกรน ตอนก่อนเป็นประจำเดือนจะปวดหัวล่วงหน้า 3 วัน ต้องทานพอนสแตนตลอด แล้วพอประจำเดือนมาก็ปวดท้อง ปวดตั้งแต่หน้าท้องถึงปลายเท้าเดินยังแทบไม่ไหว เราเลยเริ่มเรียนโยคะ เรียนได้ 4 วัน เราไม่ปวดไมเกรน หายจากอาการปวดหน้าท้องถึงปลายขา เดิน ทำกิจกรรมปกติได้ มันเซอร์ไพรส์มากที่การฝึกโยคะช่วยเราได้ ใครเป็นเหมือนเรา ลองเรียนดูนะคะ ราคาไม่แพง ครูใจดี แล้วทุกคนจะติดใจเหมือนเรา
reviews.textTranslated: “After only 4 days of classes, my migraines are gone, and the abdominal and leg pain from menstruation is gone. I can walk and do normal activities again. It's so surprising how much yoga has helped me.” Let me share my experience: I usually suffer from migraines. Before my period, I get headaches for 3 days in advance and have to take Ponstan. Then, during my period, I have severe abdominal pain, from my stomach to my feet, making it almost impossible to walk. So I started learning yoga. After 4 days of classes, my migraines are gone, and the abdominal and leg pain is gone. I can walk and do normal activities again. It's so surprising how much yoga has helped me. If you're like me, try it! The price is affordable, the instructor is kind, and everyone will love it like I did.

reviews.name: Sonia David
reviews.text: Сегодня были на третьей тренировке в этом зале и остались очень довольны. Каждая следующая тренировка лучше предыдущей, а самочувствие после нее просто прекрасно. Тело радо такой нагрузке. Мы решили увеличить количество тренировок в неделю с одной до трех и уже предвкушаем следующий визит. Благодарю нашего преподавателя за лучшие занятия йогой!
reviews.textTranslated: Today was our third workout at this gym and we were very pleased. Each workout is better than the last, and we feel fantastic afterwards. Our body is so happy with the workout. We've decided to increase our weekly workouts from one to three and are already looking forward to our next visit. Thanks to our teacher for the best yoga classes!

title: Janym Vegetarian/Vegan Restaurant & Yoga Studio Pai
subTitle: Janym
ownerDescription: Vegan & Vegetarian Restaurant and Yoga Studio
address: 9C2R+RW9, Pai, Pai District, Mae Hong Son 58130, Thailand

reviews.name: Kate Fields
reviews.text: A very lovely restaurant by the park, with an interesting menu! The presentation was beautiful. It was a real treat to have vegan salmon sushi, although the tacos were my favourite. Would love to come back here to try more in the future.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued customer,

thank you so much for taking the time to share your review with us. We truly appreciate your kind feedback and support. Your comments mean a lot to our team and help us continue improving our food, service, and overall guest experience. We’re so happy to know you visited us, and we hope to welcome you back again soon for more delicious plant-based food and good vibes. 

Thank you again, and have a wonderful day!

reviews.name: Marisa Cervini
reviews.text:
The food is fantastic and the atmosphere is excellent – a really beautiful place to enjoy a meal.

The service depends a lot on who is working.
Some staff seem a bit unsure or distracted, and their English is quite limited.

Overall still a great restaurant, mainly because of the amazing food and lovely setting.

reviews.name: Bodhi Hood
reviews.text: Food was good and appreciate the raw food options, portions a little small on the salad, and little heavy on the salt which I didn't like, especially the raw pizza crusts. I think the point of mastery in food is not use excess salt to make things taste good but to make them taste good without need of a lot of salt. I usually never eat salt so maybe I am more sensitive. Thanks again.

reviews.name: Vintageena
reviews.text:
We arrived in Pai and the first thing we did was to come and visit Janym Vegan Restaurant. The design, concept, the space were giving, from the beginning. We ordered different things (see pictures and descriptions) and the food came so fast. The drinks and the dessert were a huge surprise. Such a treat!!!

A bit pricey but it was worth it. Everything felt fresh, delicious, conscious. I will come back for sure. Keep up the good work 👏🏼

reviews.name: Holly Fisher
reviews.text: FANTASTIC VEGAN RESTAURANT! We have been in Pai for two days and have already eaten at Janym twice! The breakfasts are delicious and the matcha is the best we have ever tried. The eggs Benedict is also fantastic and has the most realistic vegan egg I have seen. It’s brilliant. The team are also so lovely and the decor is beautiful. Would recommend to anyone who is vegan or looking for healthy food :) 10/10

reviews.name: Jared Berman
reviews.text: LOVE the mushroom soup, so tasty! But the big highlights are truly the Avocado Toast or the Benedict because they make their own super delicious raw vegan “sunny egg” out of pumpkin / coconut / and a bunch of other stuff and it is totally wild that it is not a real egg. The Tuna Carpaccio is outstanding, they use young coconut and beets and it totes has a real tuna sashimi feel to it. Great bowls and juices too, this is now my weekly health binge spot 🤓

reviews.name: Kawpoon Tanapond
reviews.text: All the dishes I ordered were absolutely beautiful. The mushroom soup is at the top - creamy, mushroomy, and tastes super healthy. Mushroom coffee is also amazing, a must-have.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued customer,

thank you so much for taking the time to share your review with us. We truly appreciate your kind feedback and support. Your comments mean a lot to our team and help us continue improving our food, service, and overall guest experience. We’re so happy to know you visited us, and we hope to welcome you back again soon for more delicious plant-based food and good vibes. 

Thank you again, and have a wonderful day!

reviews.name: Keely Doherty
reviews.text:
Incredible raw vegan food!
Wonderful staff and beautiful atmosphere
I love the variety of drinks, juices, smoothies. All super healthy and clean ingredients in both drinks and food.
The yoga classes are amazing and held in a beautiful space. My favorite is the 8 AM Ashtanga class.
Lots of workshops with guest teachers!
All around such a lovely place to visit while in Pai:)

reviews.name: Martha Schoppa
reviews.text:
Celebrated my 12 year veganversary here and everything was just so delicious, really well tasted and in harmony.

The ambience is also very modern pretty so a nice scenery change to the other more hippie places around.

reviews.name: Bn JN
reviews.text: Very nice modern but stylish atmosphere. The food was good but they didn’t have the sourdough which i wanted to order. But everything else was great.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued customer,

thank you so much for taking the time to share your review with us. We truly appreciate your kind feedback and support. Your comments mean a lot to our team and help us continue improving our food, service, and overall guest experience. We’re so happy to know you visited us, and we hope to welcome you back again soon for more delicious plant-based food and good vibes. 

Thank you again, and have a wonderful day!

reviews.name: Kaye Smith
reviews.text:
What can I say! What a place! Such beautiful decor and ambiance and to have a place where I can indulge in my cacao addiction is heaven! Everything on the menu is delicious, and presented gorgeously, so many gluten free options and vegan! Oh my goodness!

Saturday's you can find musicians jamming with classical instruments and then there is the yoga studio up stairs...

It's an instructors dream! Quality flooring, AC, props, mats, sound system, air purifiers, acoustics. The staff are amazing, helpful, organised, just the best.

The whole place feels like it was meticulously planned out and created inch by inch with love.

I'm absolutely grateful to have found this place!

reviews.name: Hayley Evans
reviews.text: Did a yoga class with Lee which was fantastic, it was challenging in a good way! And then had an iced cappuccino which was delicious!

reviews.name: Apple Young
reviews.text: Janym is an amazing restaurant. Raw Vegan Cuisine. I ordered Creamy Mushrooms Soup and Avocado Toast with Vegan Poached Egg. The food is excellent. The mushroom soup was rich and tasty. The Poached Eggs are made from yogurt and pumpkin which were a surprise. I have never had the vegan eggs this similar to the real thing, especially Poached! And the view is so nice, looking out at the park and playground. Highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.name: Sib Serendipity
reviews.text:
Really nice, clean, stylish vegan AND gluten free cafe at the park. Yoga studio on top with lots of great events/classes.
I had the avocado toast with vegan (of course!) eggs and was surprised that they contained liquid yolk. Nice!
The home made bread from seeds is really nice.
My friend had the eggs benedict. She is an omnivore and couldn't find any familiar flavor in the 'bacon'. But she really liked the mayonnaise and the bread. The egg flavour is very subtle 😅
Friendly service!
Prices above average but good for the quality you get.

reviewContext.Dietary restrictions: all gluten free and no added sugar
reviewContext.Wheelchair accessibility: One step to the terrace another one to the cafe

reviews.name: Siddharthan VGJ
reviews.text: Very good food. Excellent ambiance. Small veg cafe rescued me from non veg county.

Dear valued customer,

thank you so much for taking the time to share your review with us. We truly appreciate your kind feedback and support. Your comments mean a lot to our team and help us continue improving our food, service, and overall guest experience. We’re so happy to know you visited us, and we hope to welcome you back again soon for more delicious plant-based food and good vibes. 

Thank you again, and have a wonderful day!

reviews.name: Kate Chester
reviews.text:
YOU MUST GO (even if you’re not vegan… I’m not 😁)

It opened up a couple weeks ago— the menu is diverse and so fresh. I think the same chef as Cafecito.

Highly recommend the eggs benedict and pizza… seriously I’ve never seen a vegan egg look exactly like a real poached egg. It breaks beautifully!

Also, I asked to peek at the yoga studio upstairs (it’s incredible), will definitely be back to take a class.

reviews.name: Kasham Laine
reviews.text:
Had a juice here while I was waiting for a program to start. Very tasty. (Heartbeat juice: beetroot, carrot, green apple and lime)

This place hosts several weekly events besides offering a few different yoga classes. Great spot to know as it is also the location for Saturday market.

reviews.name: Jessica
reviews.text:
A beautiful cafe, with delicious healthy food and wonderful staff!
A great selection of juices and smoothies. This place makes it so easy to be healthy!
Everything tasted fresh and had great presentation.
I can’t wait to go back and try something else on the menu.
The Yoga upstairs also looks great and I look forward to trying that.

reviews.name: Jay Veron
reviews.text: I came here a few times during my stay in Pai. The food is so so tasty, great options and such friendly and helpful staff. They also have plenty of gluten free choices! There is also a beautiful yoga studio upstairs and I went a few times to Yin classes with Kaye and she is a wonderful teacher in a stunning space. I'll be back for sure!

reviews.name: Andrew Morrissey
reviews.text: Janym Cafe and Yoga Studio is a vibrant haven for those embracing a conscious, new-age lifestyle. With a stylish ambiance, it offers a delightful array of vegan and healthy dishes that are both delicious and nourishing. Their menu, rich in flavor and creativity, aligns perfectly with modern wellness trends. Complemented by a serene yoga space, Janym provides a holistic experience where nutritious food and mindful practice come together harmoniously.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your thoughtful review Andrew!

title: DiveInfo
ownerDescription:
We provide all services for Scuba Diving
* PADI Scuba Diving Courses
* Diving Equipments
* Diving Trips
* PADI Professional courses (Divemaster, Instructor)
address: 1097 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHFH+CX Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: sumala phuchane
reviews.text:
5/5 Stars - Incredible experience with Dive Info!
I just finished a diving session with Dive Info and I couldn't be happier with the experience.
The shop itself is fantastic and stocks great products. All the diving gear was high-quality, modern, and very well-maintained, which made me feel incredibly safe and comfortable throughout the entire dive.
A huge shoutout to Tum, our PADI instructor. Tum is a true professional—patient, knowledgeable, and clearly very experienced. He made sure everyone felt confident and focused on safety while still ensuring we had an amazing time exploring.
If you're looking for professional service and top-tier equipment, I highly recommend checking out Dive Info. Ask for Tum.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for choosing Dive Info! 
We’re truly happy to hear that you had such a great experience and felt safe and comfortable throughout your dive. 

We’re also delighted to hear your kind words about Kru Tum. He’ll be very happy to know that he made your diving experience both confident and enjoyable.

Thank you again for your trust and recommendation. We hope to dive with you again very soon! 🤿✨

reviews.name: Perduto Dimenticato
reviews.text: DiveInfo is a small shop above a cafe. However it has literally everything you need to get started on diving. The staff is very knowledgeable on the equipment and is a diver herself, so she knows what to introduce for beginners. There are also a lot of small stuff that you can buy. It's worth the search
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review!
We’re really happy to hear that you found everything you needed and felt well taken care of.
Our team loves helping new divers get started — hope to see you again soon, maybe underwater next time >_<

reviews.name: Xiaoming Xiao
reviews.text: had a great experience shopping here! The staff were incredibly friendly and patient, I was at the store when they are having sale. They took the time to help me with all my questions and made sure I found everything I needed. Their customer service really stood out, and I appreciated how welcoming and attentive they were. I'll definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visiting our shop, and thank you so much for the review. We're delighted to have had the opportunity to serve you. Hope to see you again soon. ^_^

reviews.name: Art AppleTart
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience shopping/trying out the equipments

The staff is very friendly and patient to serve and assist you before you make your purchases

Highly recommended for new and veteran divers who are looking for a place with a wonder experience to look for dive equipments and dive trips
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visiting our shop, and thank you so much for the review. We're delighted to have had the opportunity to serve you. ^_^

reviews.name: HL
reviews.text: Small dive shop with friendly staff. However, very difficult to find parking. You can try to find a spare spot in the soi. The shop has limited option of diving gears. Also has policy not allow to try on fins. Their dive computers seems to have the most reasonable price compare with other shops.

reviews.name: Gábor
reviews.text: The shop looks small, but it’s very well equipped with everything you might need for diving. Nung was extremely kind and helpful, and I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.name: T. D.
reviews.text: Surprisingly good, small shop with a decent selection for it's size & really friendly people - super easy to get to right at the BTS stop. Just note that you'll have to go through a little cafe and up the stairs to get here.

reviews.name: Jake Wassink
reviews.text: I did the open water course with Tum and I had an amazing experience with him! He was very fun and knowledgeable. His English was perfect and he was a great teacher! Would highly recommend to anyone.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you!
We’re so happy you enjoyed your Open Water course with Tum — he’s indeed a great instructor!

reviews.name: Motomi Nozaki
reviews.text: Nice shop and good variety of scuba accessories. They had really cute headbands. Nice staff.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your kind review!
We’re so happy you enjoyed visiting our shop and found some cute accessories you liked! 😊
Our team will be thrilled to hear your kind words — hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Man Thirawat
reviews.text:
You can find everything about diving here, diving courses, diving gears, diving trips etc. with reasonable price.
Easy access by BTS Thonglor station.
You can check any information via before coming to the shop.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: thank you very much 🙏🙏

reviews.name: Poovadol Orankit
reviews.text: Had an awesome time with Dive Info! The staff were super chill and made everything so easy, from picking gear to planning the dives. Everything was in great shape, and they really know their stuff. Whether you’re new or experienced, they make it fun and safe. Definitely coming back for more dives with them!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review. We will continue to improve our service.

reviews.name: Danielle Yap
reviews.text: I had a great time doing my PADI basic open water. I highly recommend asking for Tum as your instructor - Tum is a fantastic instructor with many years of diving experience. He is very patient, accomodating and very good at explaining concepts and making you feel at ease underwater and knows alot about marine animals
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review, and welcome to underwater world. We hope you have an amazing experience on every dive. 😍

reviews.name: Happy American ABBY
reviews.text: Just bought a divevolk housing from them. Nung was the young lady that helped me and I must say she was super helpful.  I had a great experience with them
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your kind feedback!
We’re glad you had a great experience and that Nung could help you find exactly what you needed ^__^

reviews.name: Nicha Poom
reviews.text:
Nice and cozy diving shop on the second floor (the first floor is a cafe). The staffs here are very friendly and helpful. You can find Diving Equipments, Trips and Courses here with a reasonable cost.

The cafe on the first floor is good too.

reviews.name: Noppadol Kiratipongvut
reviews.text: I learn for Open Water Diving and Advance Open Water Diving course at Dive info. My instructor is very take care with professional coaching. All staffs are friendly and warmly welcome. therefore i strongly recommend for Dive Info if who need to explore the magnificent underwater world  :)

reviews.name: Somruethai Chongsuk
reviews.text: Dream place for scuba diving! Full of diving equipments with good quality and reasonable price. Staffs are very friendly and willing to help. Will definitely go back for scuba gears and liveaboard trips again!

reviews.name: Mairoojak
reviews.text: Highly recommend for someone looking for dive gear / courses. Staffs is very friendly and cheerful. Traveling to the shop is also quite convenient by MRT.

reviews.name: Salarin Kris
reviews.text: Nice and cozy but serious Padi 5 star diving shop/school situated less than 200 meters from BTS Thonglor station. Here you can find absolutely everything about scuba diving, from diving gears to underwater camera equipments and scuba courses and liveaboard trips. Staffs are knowledgeble and super friendly, they even have their own shop mascot, manta the dog 😀. The shop is on the second floor of a cafe, if you cannot find the way up, just ask the cafe staff. 😍

reviews.name: lilly roessen
reviews.text: Amazing dive gear options, super friendly staff! Definitely recommend a visit!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you!
So happy you enjoyed our dive gear and friendly service 💙
Hope to see you again!

reviews.name: Byunnao
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your 5-star review. We look forward to welcoming you again ❤️

reviews.text:

Would not recommend this zone to anyone requiring genuine concentration.

However, this place is still a premium co-working space, regardless of how people behave.

As a premium co-working space, we strive to offer exceptional experiences throughout The Great Room Park Silom.
Thank you

title: ร้านไนซ์ มาสสาจ Nice massage
address: 17, 17 Morakot Rd, Chang Phueak, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50300, Thailand
plusCode: RX3H+2G Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Carrie Yang
reviews.text: Highly recommended! I’ve been here twice and I experienced top massage! They knew how to relieve my body stress. Also the price was kind enough.

reviews.name: Phil Moore
reviews.text: My weekly massage spot. The owner is very nice and offers great oil massage. Their deep tissue is also excellent. Easily the best massage spot in santitham.

reviews.name: Kia Orion
reviews.text: great family massage spot. Nice is a sweetheart and speaks good English. was able to get a deep tissue massage and fix my shoulder. not a happy ending type of spot. Nice is a technician and can massage in a variety of styles. come here for a solid massage and good prices.

reviews.name: Will Langston
reviews.text: Lovely Thai massage. I’ve been to a bunch of massage places in my 3 years in Thailand and this place is above average. If you live in the area, go!

reviews.name: Topher Judd
reviews.text:
I hurt so good. Remind me to never piss off a Thai lady. I'm super glad I got the gentle setting. Because I'm a delicate little flower.
They did a great job. No weird sex stuff. Just good massage. Starteing at 200 going up to 400.

reviews.name: Mr Vengeance
reviews.text:
Very good walking massage. The lady named Cee is very talented. Deep pressure that makes you feel super great the next day.

For anyone who fights muay thai, lifts weights or is a therapist themselves. Her techniques really are magic

reviews.name: Florence Seah
reviews.text: Lady boss is friendly, foot massage is excellent and atmosphere is comfortable and with soothing music. Will come again for body massage next time:))

reviews.name: Simon Fogg
reviews.text: Nice does the best deep tissue massage in Chiang Mai. I’ve been coming here for a few years now and it’s by far the best place I’ve found to get a proper firm massage. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ellen Browning
reviews.text: After trying several places we finally found our massage home. The owner is super friendly, funny and one of the best masseuses I've ever had. She really knows the body. We try to be weekly customers

reviews.name: Lily
reviews.text:
Edit: I've received plenty of massages from See by now, she set the standard, I don't try new places anymore except one master.

Her deep massages are like no other. She doesn't follow the script mindlessly and actually finds and works on the areas that need help. Communication- her English is great and we've had conversations during the session- which I'm usually dead-against but it's fun with her. She's a keeper!

Call ahead for appointment!

👾👾👾👾👾👾👾
Best massage.  Exactly what I wanted and needed. I felt light and grounded after the massage, especially the next day, super flexible.

I underestimated how strong See is. If you ask for a strong massage, you shall receive.

Call and book before you go.

reviews.name: Jimmy James
reviews.text:
Best massage ever! I've been to at least a dozen places, and just finished two Thai massage classes myself, so I know what I like.
Nice Massage offers professional massage in a serene and clean environment. Very friendly staff. The tables have face holes, which are my favorite and far more comfortable when lying face-down, great for sore necks. They provide fresh clothes to wear also.
I opted for a deep-tissue back massage and it was amazing.
The massage was deep and very talented, right to the point of tolerance without ever being too painful. I wish I asked the fellow's name, because he was seriously gifted for sure.
I felt structurally re-aligned after.
Highly highly recommended!

Excellent neighborhood for a vast array of food options too, and Nice Massage is right across the street from the View Doi, one of the best deals on furnished apartments in CM.

reviews.name: Wojtek Ska
reviews.text: Great, strong massage. Very peaceful and pleasent place. Took a back, neck, shoulder massage and i'm gonna be back ;)

reviews.name: Hart-Coded
reviews.text: I’ve travelled the world and lived in CM for five years and never have I had a massage that targets my issue with precision as Mrs Nice does with her high level of skills and sensitivity to read your body and it’s needs. She is a must try whilst you are in CM. Perfection

reviews.name: Rodrigo Alves
reviews.text:
I just had the best Thai massage + oil massage since I arrived in Thailand. Nasee is a great masseur because she has the love to the client, the understanding of all your punctual problems and she works the way through with a lot of focus and knowledge. I will  definitely come back every week to try all the different offers of her menu.
Highly suggest: back, neck, head and shoulder, well at least for now…

reviews.name: Benjamin Maniere
reviews.text: Great massage! Really! So far one of the best massage experience I had in Chiang Mai. Of course the experience always varies depending on the masseuse. The place looks dark and mysterious from the outside, but don't be shy and come-in!

reviews.name: Rebecca Jones
reviews.text: C (massage therapist) was amazing !!! Hands down best deep tissue massage in Chiang Mai that I’ve tried so far. She knew exactly how to target the knots ! It was painful but in a good way. I feel like a new person and will definitely go back again. Highly reccomend. She also speaks great English !!

reviews.name: Mariana Elizabeth
reviews.text: Best Thai massage and deep tissue massage in Chiang Mai! Small family place with full treatment, very professional, AC in the room, very relaxing! Already came here twice and it’s always the best.

reviews.name: Ken Walden
reviews.text: Do not come here! I paid for the head, neck, back, and shoulder massage for 350 baht and it was a terrible experience. I was in pain the entire time and it was never comfortable. It felt as if my masseuse was doing random things throughout the entire massage. Please do not waste your money here!

reviews.name: Steven Mosher
reviews.text: I’ve been in Asia for 3 months, 2 of those in Thailand. C, one of the massage therapist is by far the best therapist I’ve had a massage from. She is profesional and very knowledgeable about the body. She spent 5 different sessions working on my shoulders and a troublesome spot on my lower back. If you like deep pressure she is your go to. I’m bummed that I did not find this shop earlier in my travels. Go here for an excellent massage. They listen, communícate, and tend to your old injuries.

reviews.name: Stephanie MacNeill
reviews.text: Been coming here for at least 3 yrs now. I’m always happy with my massages from Nice. Thank you!

title: Balance Yoga Studio
ownerDescription:
Yoga Studio located at Naraya Lanta Resort Klong Khong Beach.
Offering classes every day in a newly renovated studio for smaller groups of 7 people.
The teacher Stina mainly practice a hatha/vinyasa flow but also yin flow for all levels.

Monday to Saturday 11 am hatha/vinyasa
Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday 6pm yinflow

To book your spot follow the link below
address: 419, Sala Dan, Ko Lanta District, Krabi 81150, Thailand
plusCode: H29P+HH Sala Dan, Ko Lanta District, Krabi, Thailand

reviews.name: Teresa Ferraz
reviews.text:
Balance Yoga by Stina is absolutely fantastic. Stina is an incredible teacher!  warm, grounded, and truly present. You can feel how much heart she puts into what she creates.
It’s wonderful to support projects like this, where yoga and beautiful bungalows come together in such a peaceful, authentic setting. The vibe is calm, welcoming, and deeply nourishing.
I highly recommend it for all levels, whether you’re a beginner or more experienced, you will feel comfortable and inspired here. A truly special place
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Truly appreciate the kindness in the words you took the time to put down 🙏

I am so happy and grateful for the time you spent with me in studio, practicing together!

I can only hope that i get the happiness of doing it again in the future if you would return 🧡

Thank you!
Namaste

Stina

reviews.name: Learn Thai With Ying
reviews.text:
I really love this yoga studio — it’s such a nice and friendly place. Stina, the instructor, is incredibly helpful and supportive.

I’m a total beginner (the kind of person who turns left when everyone else turns right 😅), but she never made me feel awkward. Instead, she made me feel comfortable, relaxed, and completely at ease.

After her Yin Flow class, I felt so relaxed I could almost fall asleep — which is exactly what I need. My body really needs this kind of recovery, especially since I’m often stressed from work and training for long-distance running.

Her classes are perfect for my rest days. I’ll definitely keep coming back. Absulutely recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
This fills my heart with so much happiness!

I am so glad that you feel comfortable and are beeing able to relax and focus on relaxation, connections and acceptance as we move.

So important to give ourselves a brake, as life can be hectic. To show kindness to ourselves,  mind and body.

So happy for the kindness in the words you are taking the time to write 🙏

Mostly happy for the time we get to spend practicing together!

Khap kun maak kha 

Namaste
Stina

reviews.name: Chloe Easton
reviews.text: I had the most amazing experience at balance yoga, Stina has such a warm welcoming energy and in a beautiful studio I really enjoyed my practice
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
This makes me so happy to read and I am truly so grateful that you decided to come and join my practice 🙏

I wish you all the best and hope to see you again!🧡

Namaste

Stina

reviews.name: Giorgia Toscani
reviews.text:
I took a beginner-friendly yoga class with Stina while visiting Koh Lanta, and it was the perfect way to start my day. The studio is peaceful and cozy, with a small class size that made the experience feel really personal and relaxed.

Stina has such a gentle, calming presence and encourages everyone to listen to their body and move at their own pace. As someone relatively new to yoga, I really appreciated her approach—it felt welcoming and completely pressure-free.

After the session, I felt peaceful, grounded, and ready to enjoy the rest of my holiday. Booking was super easy too, which made the whole experience even smoother. I’d absolutely recommend this studio to anyone visiting Koh Lanta—whether you're new to yoga or just looking for a mindful, relaxed start to your day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Giorgia! Thank you so much for the kindness in writing this review but most of all thank you for the time spent and shared in the studio 🍀🙏

I hope you feel inspired to find your own practice, and hope to see you again if you would return to Lanta ☀️

So happy for this, thank you again!

Stina

reviews.text: I have try so yoga class before but I was never able to conect with the class, the yoga or the teacher. She was an inspiration for me.Thats so much for maybe changing my love for yoga I wish I can find a teacher like you some in some other place. Congratulions on your proyect I wish you great success as you deserve

Yoga is for everyone and remember, it is your practice and you have it it you ☀️🙏🧡 hope to see you again and I wish for all the good things for you 🧡
Hugs 
Stina

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you! I am so happy that you enjoyed the time with me in my studio 🙏☀️ and I realy hope that I will have the opportunity to chare time for some yoga if you come back 🙏🧡

reviews.name: Jenny Andersson
reviews.text: Great place for yoga! Stina is super welcoming and the classes suits all levels.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for joining my practice and for the kind words! 🙏🥰

reviews.name: Sarah Wingfield
reviews.text:
We stumbled across Balance Yoga studio on our first day in Koh Lanta. We've been wanting to instil yoga back into our routine since beginning travelling at the start of this year and my god are we glad we found Stina! A beautiful studio and an incredible teacher who has helped both me and my partner reconnect with yoga and helped us find the motivation to continue our practice in self care. We got so much from that first session we came back every evening while we were on the island. So grateful and can't thank you enough. We hope to return in the future and wish you all the best
Sarah and Frances
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
To both of you, truly thank you so much as this means so much for me to read. Makes my heart full and I will miss the time spent together in my studio 🧡 you are lovely persons and I wish for all the best for you. Both on your travels and for when you go back home.
I will keep you posted about retreats in the future as that would be so amazing to meet you again 🧡🧡

Send you my love and appreciation 🙏

Thank you

Stina

reviews.name: Serena Sarch
reviews.text: Incredible yoga class! Great instructor and accessible for all levels. Much needed restorative flow during vacation. Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for finding my studio and that you decided to spend time with me practising 🙏

Thank you for the kind words and it makes me so happy to read!

Wish you all the best and thank you again 🙏

Stina

I left the class feeling peaceful, at ease and much happier- thank you so much Stina for your blessings xxx
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you thank you thank you 🙏 for comming to my studio, charing time with me for some yoga 🍀 I appreciate you for writing this kind words that makes my heart full of happiness 🧡

reviews.name: Anna Huskowska
reviews.text: This is a wonderful yoga studio with a very calm and welcoming teacher. I loved the relaxing atmosphere and felt recharged after the class. Also, the communication via WhatsApp is easy and quick. Thanks for the great experience as part of my holidays ❤️

reviews.text: The instructor was really cute but the yoga was less so, we didn't do a single sun salutation or any kind of salutation, the yoga was 50 minutes including shavasana, I hadn't even started to feel like I was moving and we were already in shavasana, I was bummed because it wasn't cheap either, 400 baht, less recommended

Thank you for leaving a comment and wish you all the best.

Regards 
Stina

reviews.name: Dave Doucette
reviews.text: Tuangpon was very nice and very helpful The sizes of the items I needed were not in stock, but they had them sent the same day. I returned the next day to pick them up. Everything was perfect.

reviews.name: Stewart Beyer
reviews.text: ToCo is simply one of the best in the game. They're focused on the right stuff: marine conservation and safe diving practices with a special emphasis on fun. There's also always a chance to sharpen diving skills when with ToCo. Their dive shop is stocked with the best equipment, and the staff is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. I wouldn't recommend anyone else over them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: You are simply one of the best people in life.

reviews.name: Cody Winterton
reviews.text: Great school! Contacted a couple of days before I was due to arrive sorted out a course for one person and 6 fun dives for myself and Mrs. Competitively priced but a higher standard of training delivered! Dive RAID 🤙🏻

reviews.name: Nat Siri
reviews.text:
Excellent time with Thai Ocean Academy crews!

I bought a BP/W BCD from the shop. They have good options and responsive when asking questions.

I also did 6 fun dives, mainly to try the new BCD. Our dive guide, Dong, was outstanding. He was attentive and made sure my BCD was adjusted to fit perfectly. He even guided me to reduce my weight and I managed to reduce the weight by almost 50%! My trim was better too. It wasn’t just fun dive after all, so glad to learn something and improve my dive skills.

Tim, the owner, also made sure everyone had a great time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you K Nat, hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: Kelvin Kok Keong Tan
reviews.text:
I strongly recommend Thai Ocean Academy for their professionalism and friendliness.
The top-notch equipment and a well organised and clean boat adds to the overall excellence.
Good value for money!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Kelvin

reviews.name: Rafael Mellado
reviews.text:
My wife’s fin broke during our honeymoon  in koh Chang and we needed a new set before moving on to our next leg in koh lanta.

We contacted the shop and they attended us quickly and with various options, we arrived in Bangkok late evening and the problem was solved in no time with a new set of OMS slipstreams🤙🏽

Thank you so much for such amazing customer service ❤️

reviews.name: Daniel Wang
reviews.text: I’ve been buying SCUBA gears at Thai Ocean Academy for several times and I always have a good experience with them. They have products from many different brands you can always find the one for you.

reviews.name: Thalyta
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience diving! Tiger and Rosie were fantastic instructors:patient, knowledgeable, and made my first dive feel safe and enjoyable. I definitely recommend the place and will come back in the future for another dive. :)

reviews.name: Ekaterina Maksacheva
reviews.text: I’ve done several certifications with Thai Ocean Academy and every time has been incredible! The instructors are super professional and so friendly! ☺️ I always felt safe, supported, and in great hands! The boat is nice and comfy, the food onboard is always so yummy 😋, and I love how much they care about diving ethically and protecting nature! Couldn’t ask for a better place to grow as a diver 🤿 the ultimate dive school in Bangkok for me! 🌊💙

reviews.name: erik cozijnsen
reviews.text:
Great day out on the boat today on a DMCR (Thai Government)
Nice food, great owner.
5 stars for the whole day
Thanks Tim and staff for the great day
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Erik, when you coming again?

reviews.name: Gonzalo
reviews.text: Really good dive shop that have everything you may need in stock from all the main brands! The staff was helpful and helped me setting up all the equipment and doing the warranty online for the GoPro. Very good purchasing experience and competitive prices! definitely would recommend it to anyone
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Gonzalo, hope to see you again!

reviews.name: MattZ13
reviews.text: I had an amazing time visiting the shop, staff is really friendly and knowledgeable about diving products , I felt very taken care of and welcomed the second I arrived at the facility , if your looking for diving gear definitely come to Thai ocean to get it , you can test products and make sure they are the right ones for you !

reviews.name: Sarah Dibley
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic! My daughter and I got our Open Water with Tim at Thai Ocean Academy. Since qualifying i have gone back to Ocean Academy for 2 dive weekends - Tim was tuned in to how we were feeling during all of our dives. He is able to identify problems quickly and teach us new skills continually even after qualifying.

Met a few other dive masters/ instructors on the boat also working with Tim and Thai Ocean Academy and all incredibly friendly and inclusive.

Rental equipment is really good quality and well maintained (more experienced divers also mentioned this) and the boat is great. Good layout, well looked after and with 4 showers.

A big focus is on fun, safety and customer care, as well as challenging more experienced divers. Can't rate this company enough.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Excited to see you guys return for your AOW training soon!

reviews.name: owen zandstra
reviews.text: 10/10 service 10/10 equipment and super friendly staff there to help you take care of all do your needs and questions , I highly recommend visiting this shop for all your scuba diving needs or wants

reviews.name: Gavin Butler
reviews.text: Highly recommend diving in Koh Chang with Thai Ocean Academy. We were a group of four (two scuba divers and two snorkelers) and had an amazing day exploring the beautiful waters, reefs and shipwrecks surrounding this stunning corner of Thailand. The staff were extremely responsive in the lead-up to our visit and made everything so easy before and on the day. A great experience.

reviews.name: Ocea Jacobs
reviews.text:
I had the most wonderful experience diving with Thai Ocean Academy!! The dive sites were amazing, including the biggest shipwreck in Thailand that is great for fun photos and tons of fish.

Their boat is really nice with bean bags, and the instructors were very fun, knowledgable and patient. Special shout out to Trent the owner and Paul a super dive instructor.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, I think this review was meant for Koh Chang, I have passed a screenshot to Trent!

reviews.name: elisa
reviews.text: Had an incredible time with toco on the liveaboard! The staff were unbelievably kind, helpful, and made the whole trip feel like a dream. Every dive was well-organized, the sites were stunning, and the atmosphere on the boat was so warm and welcoming. I felt safe and had a great time. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.name: Dale Johnson
reviews.text: They were super accommodating for our group. One of the best adventures we’ve had in Pattaya

reviews.name: pasi pasanen
reviews.text: Tried diving for the first time and it was awesome. Our instructors were really professional and guided us well to diving. Got some cool photos and videos of us aswell. Thank you for Mike and others.

reviews.name: Georg Doert
reviews.text: Highly professional and organized tour with friendly and welcoming staff. The food was very good and the sights were amazing. On our boat there were air conditioned rooms and we had 4 dives a day. We had a lot of fun and enjoyed our stay very much. Would recommend!

reviews.name: Peanut Honey
reviews.text:
Dishonest SPA.

This is a real event happened on 21st May 2026.

Texted them for appointment for two and specifically requested for male therapists and was told all arrangement made.

Payment of 5000Baht made in cash upon arrival (note that my wallet had only 5000Baht prepared for the payment) but was told they only have female therapists after payment was made.

Disappointed and kind of pissed as we travelled quite a distance for the appointment. Requested for cancellation and cash refund despite them trying very hard to persuade us to just go ahead with the female therapists.

I put the cash back in my wallet without counting as they were talking to me at the same time trying hard to persuade me to proceed with the female therapists.

I only realized there was only 4000Baht in my wallet when I reached the hotel and it was too late to confront them.

Not only did this SPA not being truthful about not having male therapist (taking chances that we would proceed with the female since we had travelled all the way there) but also cheated my refund by diverting my attention by kept talking to me at the same time.

I wondered how many customers have they cheated as they seemso well trained with this dishonest skill so smoothly.

Be cautious of this SPA

**********************************

Hi to the person who replied to my post,

1) thanks for doing the initial investigation at 7am in the morning

2) I don't seem to be able to locate your ID bright_kittipan under Line. Is there a typo error? Could you provide me with the QR code instead? Alternatively, you may WhatsApp me since you have my no. as I texted you via WhatsApp yesterday for the appointments.

Thanks.

************************************
23rd May 2026

Hi to the person whom we chatted via WhatsApp.

Thanks for looking into the investigation, sending me the cctv and making the police report.

From the cctv, it shows I looked through the notes and counted the notes which I totally have no impression as I was distracted by the talking to the staff and feeling frustrated about the whole incident and couldn't keep a clear mind with the counting of the notes return. For this , I apologize for indicating wrongly in the above comment that  I did not count the notes before putting into my wallet.

The fact is, there was only 4 pieces of 1000baht and not 5 pieces in my wallet which i didn't touch at all.

Anyways, my main intention of sharing this experience was not to get back the money. I just want all consumers to be treated fairly especially with our request that was already agreed upon.

As a consumer, my take away for this experience are:

1) double confirm your booking and request with the vendor

2) when refund is involved, stay composed and keep a clear mind to make sure you received what you are supposed to.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. After an initial review, it appears there was a miscommunication regarding the male therapists due to unexpected staffing changes.

Regarding the refund concern, we are currently conducting an urgent investigation. If any mistake is found, we are fully willing to take responsibility and resolve the matter immediately.

reviews.name: Tamara Fowler
reviews.text:
After my shoulder was injured during my first massage in Chiang Mai, I was honestly afraid to try again. On my last day, I decided to give it one more chance and go to A&A massage — and it was the best decision.
The therapist&owner at A&A Massage gave me one of the best Thai massages I’ve ever had. Her skill, intuition, and care were truly exceptional — she even “fixed” my shoulder. I’ve had many Thai massages in Asia and the U.S., and she is absolutely at the very top of my list.
Beyond her talent, she is a genuinely kind and generous person who truly wants you to feel better. I’m deeply grateful for this experience.
One tip that I learned: you should book a 90- minute massage vs 1h if you want your whole body attention.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your support. Hope to see you again.

reviews.text: Let's Relax Spa at Renaissance Ratchaprasong is a haven of tranquility. I booked their extensive 120-minute Thai massage and was blown away by the skill and professionalism. The facility is immaculate, the staff attentive, and the traditional techniques left me feeling completely renewed. The complimentary mango rice was a delicious touch. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: L L
reviews.text: Convenient location. Located at the highest floor of Renaissance hotel. Got a 5% discount as booked via GoWabi. Did the four hands massage. Therapist who did the lower body was good. However the therapist for the upper body was pale in comparison - barely focused on shoulder area as per requested. She also had sweaty palms. Bed was not comfortable when lying on your tummy. In most places, the bed would have a hole to rest your head. But not here - was made to lie on a pillow, which one had to rest with your head turned to the left/right (to breath), which puts a strain to the neck (quite ironically at a massage). Choice of background music could have also been better. Overall decent, but improvement needed.

reviews.name: Marissa
reviews.text:
Just had one of the best experiences ever — a 2-hour Thai massage with hot compress, and I feel like a completely new person.

From the moment it started, the therapist was incredibly attentive, adjusting the pressure perfectly to work through all the tension in my shoulders and back. The traditional Thai techniques were both relaxing and energizing at the same time — deep stretches, precise pressure, and a real sense of care throughout.

The highlight was definitely the hot compress. The warmth combined with the herbal aroma melted away any remaining stiffness and left my muscles feeling deeply relaxed. It wasn’t just physical relief — it felt mentally refreshing too.

The entire session was calm, clean, and professional. You can tell they really know what they’re doing.

Highly recommend if you’re feeling sore, stressed, or just want to treat yourself. I’ll definitely be coming back.

reviews.name: May moblie
reviews.text:
I tried the Blooming Life package and was really impressed! 🥰 The staff were very welcoming and polite from the moment I arrived. They asked about my preferred pressure and if there were any areas I wanted them to focus on.

I also really appreciated how attentive they were throughout the treatment, checking in to make sure everything was comfortable. The whole experience felt relaxing and unhurried. I left feeling so light and refreshed. Definitely a great experience, and I’d love to come back again

title: Da’s Organic Farm Hut Thai Cooking School
address: 309 Soi 5, San Na Meng, San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50210, Thailand
plusCode: R3X4+MX San Sai Luang, San Sai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Alexandra Dell
reviews.text:
This was one of the best things we did in Thailand! Da is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable and speaks excellent English. He took us through the recipes we chose one by one, without any rushing and answering all of our questions. We made four super tasty dishes and then got to sit and enjoy them in his beautiful garden.

Shout out to his wife who works very hard behind the scenes and who helped us dish up our plates beautifully. Overall a really lovely experience and absolutely recommended.

reviews.name: Shae Marcus
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for an authentic Thai cooking experience, Da’s Cooking Class was absolutely incredible. We brought our women’s wellness retreat group of 20 women, and it ended up being one of the most memorable experiences of our time in Thailand.

The day started with a visit to the local market, where we learned about traditional Thai ingredients, herbs, and spices. From there, Da welcomed us into his beautiful garden and family space, which instantly felt warm, peaceful, and genuine.

Spending the day cooking alongside Da and his family was such a special experience. They shared not only recipes, but the heart behind Thai cooking and culture. We learned so many authentic cooking techniques and little “Thai cooking secrets” that made the experience feel personal and immersive.

The food was absolutely amazing — fresh, flavorful, and made with so much care. The atmosphere was beautiful, relaxed, and full of laughter. Truly perfection from beginning to end.

Highly recommend for anyone visiting Thailand who wants a meaningful, hands-on cultural experience.

reviews.name: David Figueira Bourton
reviews.text: One of the highlights of our Thailand trip! Da was friendly, knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly. We made four delicious dishes and enjoyed them in his beautiful garden. A big thank-you to his hardworking wife as well - highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jemma Darvall
reviews.text: I had the best time at Da’s cooking class! The food was made with ingredients hand picked from his organic garden and the flavour was unmatched! He also gave us a tour of his garden and explained how he grew everything, he even let us try a few things! Cooking was fun and easy and the results were delicious! We even got to watch the sunset while we ate!! Highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Kimby Yarborough
reviews.text: We had the absolute best day with Da at his farm for the cooking class. So lovely! He picks your up, takes you to the market and talks to you about all the unique spices and veggies. Then to the farm for the cooking class- so wonderful! Would definitely recommend and is a highlight of the trip!

reviews.name: Grace
reviews.text:
If you are looking for the best cooking class in Chiang Mai, Da’s Cooking School is a must!!

Da picks you up and takes you to a local Thai market to shop for ingredients, which is a great way to learn about Thai food culture. Then you head to his beautiful family home surrounded by rice paddies. The setting is peaceful and he shows you his amazing garden full of fresh ingredients he uses in the class.

You cook four dishes and can choose vegetarian or meat for each one. Everything was absolutely delicious and easy to follow, no matter your experience level.

At the end, he sends you a recipe book with everything you made so you can recreate it at home.

One of the highlights of my time in Chiang Mai! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.name: Delaney Dow
reviews.text: We heard about Da's cooking class through a friend, and this ended up being one of our favorite things in Chiang Mai. Da's warmth, energy, and willingness to share his life, home, and recipes with us is something we will cherish forever. For the half day class you are picked up from your accommodation, taken to a local market, and then back to Da's home to see his organic garden and do the cooking class. It was great to have Da guiding us through the market and answering all of our questions about Thai produce, lifestyle, and general culture throughout the afternoon. If you want an authentic experience that supports local small businesses with a fantastic person this is a great option. Thank you, Da!

reviews.name: halligan rountree
reviews.text: Cooking with Da was such an unforgettable experience. He is so sweet and showed us around a local market before taking us to his quiet farm where we cooked dishes that we got to choose specifically for what we wanted to cook. Da and his wife are so welcoming. After seeing all the beautiful temples, Da’s class was a great way to enjoy a different side of Chiang Mai. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Caity Brems
reviews.text: Cannot recommend enough, the perfect afternoon/evening filled with beautiful ingredients, a wealth of knowledge and delicious food. The garden is so gorgeous and he is an amazing cooking teacher

reviews.name: Alex Bernstein
reviews.text: We chose this class over a few other options due to the intimate atmosphere, and certainly made the right decision! I’ve done other cooking classes, and this one felt the most authentic - Da invited us into his home/farm where we met his family, and we happened to be the only ones that day which made it more intimate and special. The best part is that he actually shared a lot of interesting info about the local area’s culture and history. 100% recommend!!

reviews.name: Stephen Fox
reviews.text:
Absolutely wonderful! We were picked up from our accommodation by Da and taken a short drive to the market for some ingredients. Da was very informative about all the produce we saw in the market. After this we drove to Da's farm hut where we were offered a coffee and a tour of the farm. We then commenced the cooking! What a fabulous experience! Step by step instructions helped us cook everything from scratch. 4 dishes each. My partner and I had such a great time. Then we ate what we created. DELICIOUS!!!

Da's brother was there to help us too. Both guys are so genuinely warm and funny! Really nice men.

highly recommend to anyone wanting to spend a brilliant few hours and learn some proper thai cookery.

10/10

reviews.name: N Jansen
reviews.text:
This is the most authentic and relaxing cooking class available in Chiang Mai.

Da is a great person with a calm and happy energy. His farm/garden is a great place, a quite retreat about half an hour away from the city center.

The class starts with a tour to the local market. Seeing Da do the shopping for the class while telling us s bit about all the produce being sold was a great start of our day.

The cooking class itself takes place in Da's outside kitchen (under a roof) in the middle of his beautiful garden. Nothing was rushed, we even made our own curry paste from cratch.

After feating on our, self prepared, four course meal Da brought us back to our accommodation. We could not have been more happy with this class and the surroundings.

Best cooking class in town. Without a doubt.

reviews.name: Jerry Chang
reviews.text: Great Thai cooking class. After Da picked us up from hotel. He then takes us to the local market to show us different Thai produce and also buy some of the ingredients for the cooking (the rest is from his garden). You get to do one curry, one soup, one stir-fry and one desert dish. It’s fun and awesome experience. 在上課前，先會去當地市場買食材。泰菜教室是在主人家農舍上。可以學到咖哩、東陰、泰式甜點。全英文教學。非常建議。

reviews.name: Maya Gerlach
reviews.text: Wow! This was the best tourist activity I did during my 2 months in Thailand. Da facilitates a wonderful cooking class for small groups (it was only my friend and I!). Going to the market was a highlight as Da was able to answer our many questions. His garden/home is gorgeous and the food was amazing. I can not recommend this class enough! If you do the afternoon session, make sure to bring bug spray.

reviews.name: Francesco Turri
reviews.text: This is for sure one of the best experience ever in Chiang Mai. Came here with kids, amazing class Da and Da’s family are just great.

reviews.name: Rymi11
reviews.text: Da and his brother Sart (sounds like Sah), were absolutely amazing. I can't recommend this experience enough. I was fortunate enough to be able to get the place to myself for the day, and both of the brothers kept it lighthearted, fun, and educational. I asked many questions and for each question i asked, they were eager and willing to explain. Not to mention the food they helped me make was absolutely amazing 🤌. If you're looking for a great place to start cooking thai food, please consider giving these guys a try. I promise you won't regret it 😊

reviews.name: Amber Palframan
reviews.text: We had a great afternoon learning to cook with Da! He took us to a local market so we could buy the ingredients we needed which was a lovely touch and interesting to see it from a locals perspective. He was very tentative with us and shared lots of knowledge on the ingredients. He showed us around his garden as well.  There was a very wholesome family feel to everything, his wife prepared the ingredients for us so it was even swifter!

reviews.name: Chris Ciliberto
reviews.text: My wife and I had the most amazing time with Da. He picked us up in Chiang Mai city and we headed to a local market outside of the city. Da showed us all of the ingredients we would be using to cook our meal and explained the differences between the products. It was a very cool and educational experience. It also taught us about thai culture and how to purchase items at the market. We then went to Da's garden at his home in the country where he showed us the ingredients we would use it  the dishes we would cook. Da's home felt like home to us and his family was so sweet and polite. We cooked the best meals and we even got to take home his cookbook!! We would highly recommend this to everyone who is interested in learning how to cook thai food!!

reviews.name: Deann Rivarde
reviews.text:
Da is very kind, knowledgeable and professional, and his passion for organic farming is obvious.  He picked us up and dropped us off for no additional charge. His facility which included an outdoor kitchen, organic farm and lotus pond were all charming. Da and his brother were entertaining and helpful. Da's brother walked us through the farm and pointed out various vegetables, herbs and fruits that would be used during our cooking experience. We chose the 4 things we wanted to prepare for our meal including soup, main meal, dessert, and of course a curry. Da worked with us to prepare a vegan meal and made sure not to include any foods we were allergic to. He also includes a recipe book that includes all choices from his menu and some other favorites, like papaya salad.
We had a great time and the food was delicious and filling! I would highly recommend this authentic cultural experience.

reviews.name: Julian Neira
reviews.text: Extremely recommended!!! Da is a lovely person, he does his work with care and love. You will learn how to cook Thailand’s staple dishes at Da’s home, surrounded by nature and far from the noise in Chang Mai.

I chose this place based on chat gpt recommendation, but unfortunately my experience was very disappointing.

I booked a 2-hour foot massage, and throughout the session, the therapist’s nails were actually hurting me. When I mentioned it, instead of addressing the issue professionally, she laughed about it with the other staff and then continued in the same way, which felt quite disrespectful.

For the price they charge—similar to places like Pradara, the experience is significantly worse. At Pradara, for example, the service feels much more thoughtful and professional (they even offer tea at the end), which highlights the difference even more.

Also, basic comfort is lacking—many of the chairs don’t recline properly, which makes a long massage quite uncomfortable.

Overall, I found the reviews misleading and wouldn’t return.

reviews.name: it's me
reviews.text:
I had a great oil massage on my first visit, so I decided to go back on my last day to try their herbal compress (1.5 hrs / 800b). Who knew my relaxing time would turn into a nightmare…

- Was told to wait 10 minutes but ended up waiting 40 minutes! And since they already made me change into their clothes, I couldn’t exactly walk out 🤡

- There’s a “Keep Quiet” sign on the wall - may I ask if it’s for the customers or the masseuses? Please translate it into Thai too because it’s a full-on gossip session 😂 How am I supposed to enjoy my “Number One Massage” in peace?

- I am quite sensitive and I felt the itch on my body after the herbal compress. Questionable hygiene…

- And the worst part - they tried to cheat my money. My 1.5hr massage became a 1hr session, but they still charged 800b. When I pointed it out, the manager claimed 1 hour was 800b (girl, it’s clearly written on your signboard). She pulled a whole oopsie act - checking her notes, flipping the menu, pretending to be confused… Luckily, I had a screenshot as proof and got my refund. Also, my massage was 55 mins 🙂

There wasn’t an ounce of apology, I was simply dismissed out of the store.

Tip! Do visit earlier before 9pm so it’s less likely to have any waits and your session wouldn’t feel rushed. Both masseuses were decent, but the herbal compress definitely isn’t worth 800b - go for the oil or Thai massage instead!

reviews.name: Fazdli Gabriel Jamal
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of visiting Number One Massage Place on Phetchaburi Rd in Bangkok recently, and I must say it was a truly delightful experience. The first thing that struck me was the staff's friendliness. They greeted me with warm smiles and made me feel at ease the moment I walked in.

The variety of therapeutic massage options available is one of the establishment's highlights. They have it all, whether you need a deep tissue massage, a relaxing Thai massage, or any other type of treatment. The variety ensures that you will be able to find the ideal massage for your needs and preferences.

But it wasn't just the number of options that impressed me; the quality of the massages was outstanding. The therapists were highly skilled and knowledgeable, and each massage was delivered with precision and expertise. I was at ease knowing that I was in capable hands.

Furthermore, the service at Number One Massage Place was flawless. Everything was handled with care and professionalism from the moment I arrived until the moment I left. The staff was meticulous in their attention to detail, ensuring that my comfort was prioritized throughout the entire session.

Overall, I highly recommend Number One Massage Place. The welcoming staff, wide range of therapeutic massage options, high quality, and impeccable service make it a top-tier destination for anyone looking for a rejuvenating and relaxing experience. Whether you're a local or a visitor to Bangkok, don't miss out on this exceptional establishment.

reviews.name: Adrian Aung

I’m a kind of picky person who is always looking for aroma oil + thai massage at the same time.. In last year, i accidentally found Khun Mira’s shop, and her skill was so excellent.

Before that, i have tried a lot of massage in chaingmai, but nobody like she does as a professional. After I had got her massage, i recommend some of my friend who really need a great massage service. They also had tried with her and heard the same feedback as me…I really happy to hear that and Khun Mira never mees up my expectation over a year..

So if you are finding a great massage service in Chiang Mai, you should try at least one at there !

reviews.name: Mohamed Parham Al Awadhi
reviews.text:
Some people learn a skill. Others embody it. That was my experience with Mira.

I had a traditional Thai massage one day and an oil massage the next, and both were outstanding. What impressed me most wasn't the pressure or the techniques—it was the quality of her attention. She listened through her hands. Time and again, she found areas of tension without me saying a word, and each part of the treatment felt intentional rather than routine.

To me, the difference between a good massage and an exceptional one is presence. When someone is fully present, their hands communicate something that technique alone cannot. Mira has that presence. You never feel like you're being processed through another appointment. You feel genuinely cared for.

By the end of each session, my body felt lighter, my breathing was deeper, and there was a sense of ease that stayed with me long after I left.

If you value someone who approaches her work with humility, care, and genuine dedication to her craft, I wholeheartedly recommend Mira. She has my deepest respect, and I look forward to many more sessions.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the wonderful review, and we're glad to have been a part of making you feel better after the massage. See you soon! Thank you so much🙏❤️

reviews.name: Natcha Jiratananun
reviews.text: Love this gym! Great atmosphere, super friendly staff, and excellent coaches. I’ve been coming here regularly and always have a great experience. The coaches are supportive and know how to push you while making training enjoyable. Highly recommend 🙌🏻

reviews.name: Fo
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful first experience at Base Amarin for the Base X class. From the moment I arrived, the staff were incredibly friendly and made me feel so welcomed as a first-time visitor.

The coach brought amazing energy to the class and did a great job motivating everyone to push to their limits. I especially loved how well-designed the workout was, making full use of all the facilities available rather than focusing only on weights.

One feature that really stood out to me was how the class performance was recorded including the weights lifted, time spent on the bike, skiing, and other stations. That was truly impressive and something I had never experienced before. It added such a thoughtful and motivating touch to the workout.

The members joining the class were also very athletic, which created a strong and inspiring training atmosphere.

The shower facilities are nicely equipped and very convenient, especially before heading to work later, although the toilet is located outside. The waiting area is a little small, and I would love to see them expand into a bigger training center in the future.

Overall, a fantastic experience and definitely a place I would return to.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We‘re so happy to hear you enjoyed your first session, Taya!

We will share your kind words to the team and look forward to seeing you back at BASE soon 🙌🏼

reviews.text: I’ve been a member at Base for 10 years and have been training with Coach Sugar for the past 7 years. Great facilities, well-designed programs, an amazing coach, and a supportive team of staff. Grateful to be part of this community! 💪

reviews.text: I have been a member here for 6-7 years already. The best place for group classes. The coaches know what they are doing and pay great attention to your form. The staff are super friendly. The facility is one of the nicest among Bangkok gyms.

reviews.text: I’ve trained here 3 times a week for the past two years and I love it here. Great place, nice atmosphere with natural light, big open space and high ceilings. Nice and friendly staffs with professional and knowledgeable coaches. Base is also one of not so many place in Bangkok where you can learn calisthenics too.

reviews.name: Tom Nanthabhakwanich
reviews.text:
If you told me two years ago that I’d voluntarily drag myself to the gym after work or with hangover just to suffer through squats, sled pushes, kettlebells… I’d have laughed. 😂 But here I am, constantly coming back to BASE Bangkok!

Every coach brings amazing energy, knows exactly when to push you to go over your PB even when your only response is ultimate side-eye 😒🤣

The front desk team deserves a shoutout!! they’re always smiling, friendly, attentive, and somehow remember EVERYONE! It feels less like walking into a gym and more like being welcomed by friends.

BASE somehow keeps every class fresh, challenging, and fun. I always leave feeling stronger… or at least questioning my life choices in the best way possible. 😂

If you’re looking for a gym with incredible coaches, amazing staff, and a community that makes you actually want to come back, this is it!!!

The facilities are clean and equipment is like new. The Base events are a lot of fun and promote a collective team atmosphere. I would recommend anyone to buy a trial pack and check it out for themselves.

reviews.text: A gym that can help you become stronger and build your muscles. A variety of classes are offered. Its location is right at the spot, Amarin Gaysorn, which is very convenient.

reviews.name: Tawinkarn Ariyavaradhorn
reviews.text:
I’ve joined BASE since 2018. I’ve been to other functional gyms and Base is my most favorite gym in Bangkok.

The classes are well structured according to your needs. Basecamp, the signature class, is a good mix of cardio and strength training while Base Build is great for strength training. All levels of fitness are welcomed as the coaches are very professional and attentive. The location is also a plus. The facilities and shower rooms are great.

Above all, the community here is awesome and motivating, no matter it’s Personal Training or group classes. I highly recommended Coach Ohm for hybrid training and Coach Punch for strength training.

I read some of 1 star reviews despite the fact of being late to the class - well, being on time is a basic respect which cost you nothing, isn’t it? ;)

reviews.text:
Good vibes.
