reviews.name: arin Spanond
reviews.text:
I visited Base Bangkok for the first time today and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience with one of your front desk staff members.

There were two ladies at the front desk. One of them was very friendly, welcoming, and professional. However, the other lady, who was wearing glasses, was extremely rude from the moment we arrived.

As soon as we entered, she stared at us without greeting or welcoming us. When we approached her regarding our booking, the way she spoke to us was shockingly rude and unprofessional. Her tone, attitude, and manner of responding made us feel very uncomfortable and unwelcome. We were simply trying to ask about our booking, yet she responded with obvious irritation and a dismissive attitude.

As first-time visitors, this was a very poor first impression of your gym. I honestly do not understand why a front desk staff member, whose role is to welcome customers, would treat guests in such a rude manner.

I would also like to mention that the Hyrox instructor was excellent—very kind, friendly, and professional throughout the session. The class itself was enjoyable, which makes the contrast with the front desk experience even more disappointing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback, Arin.

First, we’re pleased to hear that you enjoyed the HYROX class and that the coach made such a positive impression. We’ll be sure to pass on your kind words to the team.

Having reviewed the situation, the issue arose because an attempt was made to attend the class using another person’s ClassPass account. As per the ClassPass policy and our agreement with them, we do not allow this. The policy exists to protect against misuse of the platform, including the use of accounts, credits, and free trial offers by individuals other than the registered account holder. This policy is set out by ClassPass and is also communicated through all of our booking channels, including on every listing and email communications.

We appreciate that being unable to use the booking as intended was frustrating, particularly when you were hoping to train together with your friend. Our team explained the policy and offered an alternative drop-in option, which was ultimately purchased so that the class could still be attended.

That said, we’re sorry to hear that you were unhappy with the way the interaction was handled. While our team must apply booking policies consistently, we also expect every conversation to be professional, friendly, and respectful. We’ll review the situation internally and continue to coach our team on handling these types of conversations with more empathy.

We stand by our decision to enforce the booking policy, as applying rules consistently and fairly is important for all members and guests. However, we regret that the overall experience left you with a negative impression of BASE.

We wish you all the best with your training.

reviews.name: Sukhum Cheff Truengtrachitkul
reviews.text:
Unlike other reviews, my experience here was a complete mess. The class I took overlapped with a previous event, where they were handing out free ice cream and food, making the space overcrowded, chaotic, and noisy. This delayed the start of my class and completely threw off my expectations. Meanwhile, people from the earlier session were still hanging around, eating, chatting, and creating a distraction.

To make things worse, the class structure was all over the place—the speaker wasn’t loud enough, and it felt like a freestyle session where members just did whatever they wanted, debating their own variations instead of following the agreed workout flow. Honestly, it was a total shitshow. : )
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Sukhum — we apologize that today didn’t meet your expectations. We had an event which meant the studio space was busy. We will take the feedback to make our future events smoother and not take anything away from your experience.

We hope to see you back at BASE soon.

Best wishes, BASE Team

Enjoyed learning freediving with Scuba Mhee Freediving. Was in Bangkok for a vacation and the flexibility of their schedules allowed me to add in a free diving certification to my trip! The team were really nice and provided transport (with slight top up) to the beach for the open water dive. reviews.name: Arahcap Nasiarkmil
reviews.text:
I took the PADI Basic Freediver course here, and the instructor taught me breathing techniques very well, clear, easy to understand, and never pressuring me. Whatever level you're at, they give helpful advice for further improvement. Thanks to that approach, I was able to improve my Static Apnea from 2.01 to 3.40 in my last attempt without pushing myself too hard or feeling stressed.
The other topics in the course were also taught in a relaxed and fun way. The instructor even added extra lessons, like walking underwater while holding a weight, which became a fun little challenge during training. And during every session underwater, the instructor always tried to take nice underwater photos of me creating my great memories.
I would definitely recommend this diving school to anyone who's just starting out or unsure about freediving. You can absolutely take a course here. This is from my own real experience, and it was truly a great one. In fact, I'm already thinking about where to take my Advanced Freediver course next. and I’ll probably do it right here.
As for other services, if you want to practice apnea techniques, since it's not safe to train on solo. They allow you to come in for pool sessions for just the pool fee. And if you still have any questions outside course, you can always message them.
Thank you.

reviews.name: Nina Kochmarik
reviews.text:
This salon became our favorite spot during the whole vacation.
Beautiful interior, relaxing atmosphere, and very professional service.
All the staff are friendly and open-hearted.
Special thanks to the administrator, May — she is such a lovely and warm person!

reviews.name: flynn melody
reviews.text: sino massage I booked a 60-minute deep tissue massage, and my therapist was exceptional. They knew exactly how much pressure to apply—never too harsh, but firm enough to work out the knots I’d been carrying for weeks. By the end, my shoulders felt lighter, and that constant ache in my lower back was gone. What I loved most? No rushed transitions; they let me take a few minutes to relax afterward with a cup of hot herbal tea, which made the whole experience feel like a mini retreat.

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Lion Carew
reviews.text:
My partner and I came here for a drop in and we loved our experience. The drop in was 120TBH. The staff are really friendly! My partner didn’t bring the proper shoes and the staff let her borrow some running shoes - so kind.

They have a cafe which I loved. I enjoyed an americano before our workout.

The spaces are really clean, the equipment is great, and it wasn’t very busy when we went. We were there on a Friday at around 10am.

They have a great weights and machine area, a functional fitness area, and an area for classes.

They also have some lockers.

Highly recommended if you’re staying in this area. We will be returning for sure.

reviews.name: JP (Cynthia)
reviews.text:
This gym has two entrances: one facing the road, the other facing the parking lot. I saw local Thai people coming in and out of the parking lot door, which was convenient because they didn't have to go all the way to the street yo enter the gym.
Once, I was heading to the parking lot door to get something from my car, but a short personal trainer blocked my way. He said "no" in a stern voice. I explained that I was just going to get something from my car, but he didn't allow me to finish my words and shouted "No, No, No" again in an angry tone. I had no choice but to give up. Soon, Thai people were coming in and out of the parking lot door again, and he pretended not to see anything. Interesting!
This is probably the difference between insiders and outsiders?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are so sorry for your bad experience. We always try to treat everyone equally. 

Sometimes if it is raining outside we open up the back door for people to use. But if it’s not raining we want everyone to go in and out through the main door to pass the check in counter. Sometimes our staff go in and out through the back door throughout the day.

Either way, I’m sorry that you felt the staff was rude or unfair to you. We try to be friendly, polite and fair to everyone. Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We hope to do better for your next time.

reviews.name: Nidhi Nair
reviews.text: My husband and I got a classic Thai massage done here and loved it. The two ladies are quite attentive to which of your muscles are knotted and how. This has also been the only place I’ve had my hip flexors and lateral quad muscles massaged so thoroughly. Would definitely go back, especially at that price point.

reviews.name: Alisa Mankovska
reviews.text:
I tried a full body massage for the first time, and it was absolutely amazing! The massage was deeply relaxing, and afterward I felt so light and calm.
The second time, I went for a back and shoulder massage along with foot reflexology. The therapist carefully worked through all the tense areas, and after the session I felt incredible relief and lightness in my back and shoulders.
I highly recommend this place. I really enjoyed my experience and will definitely come back again!

Ladies are so adorable 🤩

reviews.name: Nicole Brittain
reviews.text: The BEST massages in Phuket!! We are returning customers who only see Ploy & her team when in Thailand. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Mickael Mounaix
reviews.text: Excellent massage from Ploy, very clean place and very hospitable. The place has 4 beds, with fans and aircon. reviews.name: Mariana Vašutová
reviews.text: Absolutely delighted with the massage I got. Professional and relaxing. It’s a small salon with nice and friendly staff. Seems more authentic than other salons around. I definitely recommend getting the back and shoulders massage- you won’t regret. Thank you! 🫶

reviews.name: Ewelina Kuprel
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! I've been trying so many other places in Bangkok and Phuket and all over the world but this was the best back massage I have ever had. I'm fully recommend this place to you and hopefully I will come back there as well. Thank you U2 so much for fixing my painful back. Hope to see you soon again and all good luck.

reviews.name: Ann Ng
reviews.text: Went with my family (including our small child) and had a really great massage (Thai, oil, head and shoulder). Best we've had in Phuket. reviews.name: Monica Butterworth
reviews.text:
This is a small business in a quiet street off the main road Karon Beach. The two ladies who operate the business live above with their families. I am an older Australian lady and I had a different kind of massage every other day whilst on holiday and I thoroughly recommend this business. The girls are kind and friendly and adjust the treatment to suit each person. My son and his wife had daily massages and enjoyed them.  1 hour $12AUD They also do manicures and pedicures.

The adjacent laundry is a very useful service as it is hot and clothes need laundering daily. $2 kilo. These girls are really hard workers and I wish more people knew about the U2 massage and laundry service.

reviews.name: Brenda B
reviews.text: This place is great! I didn't want to spend a ton of money on laundry at my resort, so I came here. Before picking up my clothes, I also took advantage of the massage service which was really relaxing. The ladies working here are extremely nice.

reviews.name: Vince Gaggiano
reviews.text: We’ve been visiting the girls at U2 for many years and I’m happy to share this review now that they’re on Google! Their massages are great and the kids love them too. Hair braiding every time we visit is a must and the manicures and pedicures are highly recommended. Although they used to be on the main strip at the Karon Stadium, now they’re only a 5 minute Tuk Tuk ride away at Soi Patak 14. The money for the ride fare is well worth it!

reviews.name: Sean McHugh
reviews.text: Fabulous massage, and lower prices than you’ll have to pay in the main tourist area. Prices start at 200/250 Bhat for a half/hour Thai massage. I had the back and shoulders every day for 300 bhat, and was in a state of bliss the whole time! They have a menu in English and in Russian.

reviews.name: Tilden Remerleitch
reviews.text:
I tried to work here but just couldn’t.
The wifi speed ranged from 30-60mbps, it was ok for computer work but my boss kept saying I was cutting in and out on the zoom call.
Other than that- the coffee station only has instant coffee, u have to pay extra for coffee downstairs. Atmosphere is like a warehouse.

I had to quickly grab from here to a coffee shop w/ good wifi to salvage my next work meeting 😅. 289 is just too much for what little u are getting.

reviews.name: Ros C.
reviews.text: Good space, in peace area, lots of parking and the co-working space is comfortable to use, internet can handle video meetings no problem, AC is good, chairs are decent, it’s has a comfortable working vibe. Ideally for a work needing focus. The staff are nice, coffee is actually good 👌🏾 their bagels are nice.

reviews.name: Dayana Alonso
reviews.text:
9am opens,  and it's a great place to do work, good internet, and free coffee and tea when working.
Does perfect what a hot desk is supposed to do 🤩
Staff friendly helpful let me have my big bag downstairs for the day when I was working

reviews.name: Darja “F.” Orlova
reviews.text:
For me, it was one of the best co-working experiences, if we talk about the balance in price and quality. To feel comfortable while working with my laptop I need 1) comfortable chair, table and sockets 2) access to the drinking water, teapot and fridge 3) phone booths or Skype rooms to make calls 4) some "casual" areas with couches. And this place has all that! What's more, it's located in the center, so you can easily go and have a nice lunch. I was happy to be there! Thanks a lot

P.S. I think there is still a way to improve (e.g. community events), but even now the experience is great!

reviews.name: Rémi Goyard
reviews.text: A very good place for co working !  They have a lot of space. Good wifi and free coffee ! You can buy day pass or more as you want. The situation is good and quite easy to find. Not noisy and they make lunch all together for meeting and sharing.  You should try if your in Thailand not only for traveling

reviews.name: ice nt
reviews.text: Biggest and best co working space in town. Proper working space with high speed internet. Also very quiet and chill. It is much better working here than at cafes.

reviews.name: Will Langston
reviews.text: Chill work space: came but the cafe was closed. Very quiet with plenty of outlets. No person at reception so I’m not sure if Wi-Fi is available or not

reviews.name: Leena Chanvirach
reviews.text: Beautiful, cozy, playful co-working space in CM with good coffee available for sale on the 1st floor. Internet is speedy and the lounge is comfy, all for a few bucks a day!

reviews.name: joe teacher
reviews.text: Fantastic. I taught a four hour ZOOM class and they hooked me up with a private office with AC, a window, and about 29 power outlets. Internet was sharp even with 30 students on a call. I looked at other places and most were more expensive, windowless, poorly ventilated holes. Go here if you need a private meeting space or ZOOM room.

reviews.name: Dean Wormald
reviews.text: It's OK, nothing special. A bit over hyped from everything I've heard of digital nomads saying Punspace is great for networking. I spent 5 hours here, place was close to full and quieter than a library.

reviews.name: Jaxw Ang
reviews.text: The owner is friendly, and they have plenty of desks with extension cables, I purchased a 229thb for a day fee, and I think its worth the price. It's quiet. There are cups and biscuits for one to enjoy. Toilets are clean. Air conditioning is sufficient.

reviews.name: Philipp Molzer
reviews.text: This place offers quiet and decent Internet connectivity.  It's a good place for working remotely from the office.  You can get 24 hour access with fingerprint scanner to open the door.  It has a coffee shop that is rather expensive but typical for Chiang Mai prices these days.  There are a variety of seating options.  Air conditioning keeps it cool.  The Skype rooms are small and hot. Talking is frowned upon but there is a outside room where you can have calls.  2 locations are very convenient and have off street parking.

reviews.name: Damian Mee
reviews.text: I've only been there for events (which btw they host plenty of), so it's hard for me to say something about their regular course of business, but the place is very spacious and aesthetically pleasing. There's a big variety of "working spaces" - you can work on a couch, on a low or a high desk or use a standing desk. They have a freely accessible donations-based minibar and there's a quite nice cafe downstairs.

reviews.name: Mack and James
reviews.text:
This is the best co-working space we used while in Chiang Mai. Compared to the Nimman location, this has a lot more space, desks and Skype rooms. You get access to both locations when you join, but this one is much easier to find a spot.

The environment is fairly quiet and focused. There are plenty of outlets at every work area and reliable, fast internet. Punspace has proper desks and chairs and is much better ergonomically than sitting in a coffee shop for several hours.

We didn't attend any evening events, but there seems to be a time for socializing for those that are looking for that. The is also a good coffee shop on the first floor.

reviews.name: Leann Chan
reviews.text:
Nice, open cowork space with Cafe, meeting rooms and Skype rooms.

The internet is fast, but can be slow at times when people are playing video games and streaming YouTube or Netflix.

It doesn't close for members so a few have made it their home, sleeping on the couches and using the facilities at non working hours.

They've also recently sealed up the space to help the air purifiers do their job during smokey season.

I would recommend this spot despite being pricier than a few other cowork spaces around.

reviews.name: Iain Calvert
reviews.text: Worked out of here for 5 weeks in Aug/Sep 2019. One of the best coworking spaces I’ve been to anywhere in the world. By that I mean if you want to get your head down and work with no interruptions this is the place for you. It was quiet at this time of year so if you’re looking for more of a community/people to shoot the breeze with I’d head to another place in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text: Great coworking in the heart of the city. If you are visiting you need to wait until 9 for staff to be available to set you up for the day. The location is great and the work area is comfortable. There are three Skype rooms available too.

reviews.name: Julius Zeise
reviews.text: Super nice place to work at. :))

reviews.name: Matthieu Aussaguel
reviews.text:
Best coworking space I have ever been to! I spent over 3 months there with my team and I plan to come back on a yearly basis.

I've never been as productive as this in any other spaces I tried (and I tried many, believe me!). It's amazingly well managed by the team and owners.

If you want to get stuff done, this is the place to go! 💯

reviews.name: Gabriel Francesch
reviews.text: Great co-working space. Everything is set up properly to get things done and be productive. It's a good place to meet people who stay and work in Chiang Mai for a few months at a time too.

reviews.name: Danica
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with both the massage and nail services. The staff was welcoming and professional from the moment I walked in. The massage was incredibly relaxing—just the right pressure, and the therapist made sure I was comfortable the entire time. As for the nails, the technician was meticulous and gentle, and my manicure looks flawless even days later.

The space was clean, calming, and well-organized, which really added to the overall relaxing vibe.

reviews.name: Zee & Jo Heit
reviews.text:
The place is nice and clean, with good furnishings, but the staff are extremely lacking in the skills needed to work professionally in this setting.

We feel foolish for having come three times. The first two visits had only minor irritations, but the third time was the worst. We were rushed out more than two hours before closing, and the massages for both of us were so rushed and incomplete that we almost got up and left after just 15 minutes.

If returning customers aren’t welcome, just say so. Was the issue that we were a married couple attending? Would it have been better if I had let my husband come alone? That’s the kind of energy we were met with on our last visit.

reviews.name: Charissa C
reviews.text: It was my first time getting a massage and I enjoyed it. The spa is clean and the ladies are very professional. The receptionist speaks English well and she spent a lot of time for us to explain everything. The price is higher than most places in Thailand but you get good quality time here because they all have certificates. I would recommend to come here!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Charissa,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your time at our spa! We take great pride in providing a tranquil and rejuvenating experience for all of our guests, and your kind words are truly appreciated.
Looking forward to welcoming you back to our spa again.

reviews.text: Poor service, staff speaks no english, has different price for locals and foreigners. Prenatal massage is very unprofessional, just body oiling for 1 hour without any massage technique.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely regret that your experience did not meet your expectations. At SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa, we take every concern seriously and would like to respectfully clarify a few important points.

Regarding your prenatal massage:

The safety and well-being of both mother and baby are always our highest priorities.

Our therapists receive specialized training in prenatal massage, including appropriate side-lying positioning, proper body support, and techniques specifically adapted for expectant mothers.

Unlike a regular massage, prenatal massage requires additional precautions, particularly during the later stages of pregnancy. Our therapists therefore carefully adjust the pressure and techniques to prioritize comfort and safety rather than applying the same deep pressure used in a standard massage.

We would like to reassure you that this gentle approach reflects our commitment to responsible prenatal care, not a lack of professional training or massage techniques.

Regarding our pricing policy:

We would also like to clarify that SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa maintains the same standard prices for all guests, regardless of nationality.

We do not practice nationality-based pricing or discrimination of any kind.

Our only discounted rates are offered through prepaid membership packages, which are equally available to both Thai and international guests. Any difference in pricing is based solely on membership benefits, never on nationality.

We sincerely apologize if this policy was not clearly communicated.

Regarding our hospitality and communication:

Our team receives training in professional hospitality, service etiquette, and customer care. Every guest deserves to be treated with kindness, respect, and equal attention.

We acknowledge that our team’s English communication may not always be perfect, and we sincerely apologize for any difficulties this may have caused. Nevertheless, our staff are genuinely committed to providing attentive and respectful service to every guest.

At SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa, we believe that true professionalism means not only providing a relaxing experience, but also knowing when to adapt a treatment to protect our guests’ well-being.

We value your feedback and will continue improving our communication and service standards. We also hope this clarification provides a better understanding of our prenatal massage practices and our commitment to fair and transparent pricing.

Thank you for allowing us the opportunity to address your concerns.

Warm regards,
Management Team
SHE-WHA Wellness and Spa

reviews.name: Anchisa “Pam” Saikaew
reviews.text:
อยากให้เจ้าของสปาอ่านรีวิวแล้วนำกลับไปทบทวนมากๆค่ะ

ออกตัวก่อนว่าเป็นคนมาตรฐานสูงมากกับร้านสปา เรียกว่าละเอียดกับทุกดีเทล เพราะเรามีความรู้เรื่องการผลิตแชมพูเผื่อสุขภาพหนังศรีษะและเรื่องระบบประสาท เรากล้าเล่าได้อย่างมั่นใจว่าเราพูดบนหลักการ science

ที่นี่เรามาใช้บริการครั้งที่สองแล้ว โดยรวม Therapist น่ารักมาก แต่เราไม่ค่อยประทับใจกับตัวรูปแบบการสปา และ การบริการก่อน-หลังทำจากผจก.

มีสองส่วนที่จะฟีดแบ็ค

1️⃣ส่วนแรก : รูปแบบการสปาไม่ได้มาตรฐาน เราไม่โทษ therapist เพราะมันเริ่มตั้งแต่ตอนดีไซน์รูปแบบขั้นตอนแล้ว / ที่กล้าพูดว่าไม่ได้มาตรฐานเพราะเราวัดจากผลลัพธ์หลังทำ ผมนุ่มก็จริงแต่ ‘ลีบแบนและหนังหัวมัน’ เรามั่นใจว่าผญ.ส่วนมากให้ความสำคัญกับ “ผมไม่ลีบแบนดูมีวอลุ่ม” มากกว่า ผมนุ่ม เพราะลีบแบน=ผมบาง

เราใช้บริการแพคเกจ L 1,399 11 ขั้นตอน

1. ตอนลงแชมพู therapist เกาเล็บแรงมาก เหมือนขูดแครอท จนเริ่มแสบเราถึงบอกให้หยุด และเกาในบริเวณที่เซนซิทีฟคือส่วนบนศรีษะที่ติดกับหน้าผาก เล็บครูดจนถึงผิวหน้าผากเลย
2. therapist ลงเคราตินบนโคนผมแล้วนวด เป่าแห้งหนังหัวก็ยังมัน เหมือนไม่ได้สระผม ผมลีบแบน / มาอธิบายว่าที่ต้องลงโคนเพราะต้องนวด ถ้าไม่มีเคราตินจะทำให้เจ็บ / มุมมองเรานะ ไม่ต้องนวดหัวตอนลงเคราตินค่ะ การนวดจะทำให้เคราตินไปอุดตันในรากผมทำให้ผมร่วงค่ะ
3. therapist นวดแค่ส่วนบนที่ติดกับหน้าผากซึ่งเป็นที่ตั้งของกะโหลกและไม่ได้สนับสนุนความรู้สึกผ่อนคลาย / บริเวณที่ควรจะนวดคือ บริเวณที่มีกระดูกมาบังน้อย มีความนุ่มหยุ่น เช่น ขมับ กลางศรีษะ ท้ายทอย เพราะการไม่มีกระดูกมาบังทำให้เป็นพื้นที่เชื่อมต่อกับส่วนเส้นประสาทเรื่องอารมณ์ผ่อนคลาย

2️⃣ส่วนที่สอง : ขั้นตอนการบริการก่อน-หลังสปา และ attitude ต่อการบริการของผจก.ร้าน

1. เราคาดหวังให้ ผจก.สอบถาม ‘อย่างเฉพาะเจาะจง’ จุดเซนซิทีฟต่างๆ แทนที่จะถามปลายเปิดแบบง่ายๆว่า ‘มีข้อห้ามอะไรไหม’ หลายครั้งเรานึกไม่ออกจริงๆเพราะไม่ได้ทำสปาผมทุกอาทิตย์ การใช้คำพูดเชิงยกตัวอย่างว่า ‘มีข้อห้ามตรงไหนมั้ยคะ เช่น ละเว้นการนวดส่วนไหน เกาได้ไหม’ แบบนี้จะช่วยให้ลูกค้านึกออกได้

2. ตอนเราฟีดแบ็คหลังทำ ผจก.บอกว่า ระหว่างสปาติดขัดอะไรแจ้งได้เลย เราอยากบอกกับร้านและทุกๆร้านที่มาอ่านว่า ระหว่างสปาเรามักจะสะลึมสะลือจนเกือบหลับ หลายครั้งไม่มีสติจะมาอธิบายระหว่างทำค่ะ และนี่คือคำตอบสุดคลาสสิคจากสปาส่วนมาก ยกเว้นสปาที่ high end จริงๆ ผจก.จะพูดว่า ‘ได้เลยค่ะ จะนำไปปรับปรุงค่ะ ขอบคุณค่ะ’ เหมือนเขา prioritize ประสบการณ์ที่ดีของลูกค้าจริงๆเขาเลยเข้าใจว่าลูกค้าฟีดแบ็คเพราะไม่ได้จะกล่าวโทษแต่อยากให้พัฒนา จะได้ใช้บริการกันยาวๆ

3. ตอนแนะนำแพคเกจ ผจก.ไม่แม่นในขั้นตอนเลยค่ะ เราให้อภัยได้แต่มันทำให้ดูไม่มืออาขีพ = ประสบการณ์มันก็ดรอป และเขาพูดข้อมูลสลับไปมา คือแพค L เขียนว่าเลือกมาส์กได้สองสูตร “รกแกะ” หรือ “พรีเมียม คาร์เวีย” การใช้คำว่า “หรือ” แปลว่าเราควรต้องได้เลือก แต่ก่อนทำผจก.ไม่มีการพูดถึงส่วนนี้ พอเราทำเสร็จเรามาถามซ้ำว่า แพค L มีมาส์กคาเวียร์ไหม บอกไม่มี เราเลยเปิดสมุดเมนู และแย้งว่ามันมีนะคะ ผจก.กลับตอบว่า  “ทางร้านใช้สินค้าพรีเมียมอยู่แล้ว” คุณคะ คำว่าพรีเมียมใครก็เคลมได้ค่ะ แต่ความน่าเชื่อถือมันมาจากการที่คุณสามารถอธิบายได้ค่ะส่วนผสมคืออะไรมาจากไหนให้ประโยขน์อะไร หลักการ WHAT WHERE HOW ง่ายๆของ beauty services

📌สรุป :
ยุคนี้บริการเยอะ ร้านที่สร้างค.ประทับใจได้คือร้านที่ personalized กับความต้องการลูกค้านะคะ เราเสียเงินไม่ใช่น้อยอยากได้บริการที่มืออาชีพและตัวร้านคือสปาผ่อนคลาย ลูกค้ามาเพื่อถอดสมอง แทนที่ร้านโยกให้เป็นความรับผิดชอบของลูกค้าที่ควรจะอธิบายข้อห้ามต่างๆ อยากให้ร้านมองว่า “จะซัพพอร์ตลูกค้าอย่างไรได้บ้าง” ถ้าเอาประสบการณ์ลูกค้าเป็นที่ตั้งเป็นอย่างแท้จริง รูปแบบการสปาและขั้นตอนการบริการ จะออกมาเริศเอง
reviews.textTranslated:
I really want the spa owner to read this review and reconsider their approach.

Let me preface this by saying I have very high standards when it comes to spas. I'm very meticulous about every detail because I have knowledge of shampoo production that considers scalp health and the nervous system. I can confidently say that my opinions are based on scientific principles.

This was my second visit here. Overall, the therapist was lovely, but I wasn't impressed with the spa's format and the pre- and post-treatment service from the manager.

I have two areas of feedback:

1️⃣ First: The spa's format didn't meet standards. I don't blame the therapist because it started from the design of the process. I can confidently say it didn't meet standards because I judged it by the results after the treatment. While my hair was soft, it was 'flat and my scalp was oily.' I'm sure most women prioritize 'voluminous, not flat' hair over soft hair, because flat hair equals thin hair.

I used the L package, 1,399 THB, 11 steps.

1. During the shampooing, the therapist scratched very hard with her nails, like scraping a carrot, until it started to sting, so I told her to stop. She was scratching in sensitive areas, specifically the top of my head near my forehead. 1. My nails scratched all the way down to my forehead.
2. The therapist applied keratin to the hair roots and massaged them. Even after blow-drying, my scalp was still oily, like I hadn't washed my hair. My hair was flat and limp. / She explained that applying it to the roots was necessary for the massage; without keratin, it would be painful. / In my opinion, there's no need to massage the head while applying keratin. The massage can clog the keratin in the hair follicles, causing hair loss.
3. The therapist only massaged the upper part of my head, which is where the skull is located and doesn't support relaxation. / The areas that should be massaged are those with less bone obstruction and greater flexibility, such as the temples, the crown of the head, and the nape of the neck. The absence of bone obstruction allows for better connection to nerve endings related to relaxation.

2️⃣Part Two: Pre- and Post-Spa Service Procedures and the Manager's Attitude Towards Service

1. We expected the manager to ask ‘specifically’ about sensitive areas instead of asking open-ended questions like, ‘Are there any contraindications?’ Many times we couldn't think of any because we don't get hair spas every week. Using examples like… 1. Are there any restrictions? For example, are there any areas that should not be massaged, or is scratching allowed? Asking these questions helps clients remember.

2. When we gave feedback after the treatment, the manager said that we could report any problems during the spa session. We want to tell the salon and all other salons reading this that during spa treatments, we often feel drowsy and almost fall asleep, and are not alert enough to explain things clearly. This is a classic response from most spas, except for truly high-end ones where the manager will say, "Okay, we will take it into consideration and improve. Thank you." It's like they prioritize a positive customer experience and understand that customer feedback isn't meant to be accusatory but to encourage improvement so they can continue using our services for a long time.

3. When recommending the packages, the manager wasn't familiar with the process at all. We can forgive that, but it made them seem unprofessional, which diminished the overall experience. They also mixed up the information; Package L stated that we could choose two mask formulas: "placenta" or "premium caviar." The use of "or" implies that we should be able to choose, but the manager didn't mention this before the treatment. After the treatment, we asked again if Package L included the caviar mask, and they said no. So we checked the menu... And when I argued that it did exist, the manager replied, "The salon already uses premium products." You know what? Anyone can claim "premium," but credibility comes from being able to explain the ingredients—what they are, where they come from, and what benefits they provide. It's a simple WHAT WHERE HOW principle for beauty services.

📌Summary:
In this day and age with so many services, the salons that create a lasting impression are those that personalize services to meet customer needs. We're paying a lot of money, expecting professional service, and the salon is a relaxing spa; customers come to unwind. Instead of the salon shifting the responsibility to the customer for explaining prohibitions, the salon should focus on "how can we support our customers?" If the customer experience is truly the priority, the spa experience and service procedures will naturally be excellent.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
เรียน คุณลูกค้าที่เคารพ

ทาง SHE-WHA Wellness & Spa ขอขอบคุณสำหรับความคิดเห็นของคุณ และขออนุญาตชี้แจงรายละเอียดบางประการ เพื่อให้ข้อมูลมีความครบถ้วนและเป็นธรรมต่อทั้งลูกค้าและทีมงานของเราค่ะ

1. เรื่องโปรแกรมและการให้บริการ

เนื่องจากคุณเคยมาใช้บริการในช่วงที่ทางร้านเพิ่งเปิดให้บริการ ซึ่งขณะนั้นมีโปรแกรมและราคาโปรโมชั่นพิเศษ ต่อมาทางร้านได้ปรับรูปแบบบริการ ขั้นตอน และราคาให้เหมาะสมกับโปรแกรมปัจจุบัน

ในการเข้ารับบริการครั้งนี้ คุณได้สอบถามถึงการเพิ่มบริการนวดแขน คอ บ่า และไหล่ ในโปรแกรม M โดยคงราคาเดิม ซึ่งทางร้านได้ชี้แจงว่าบริการดังกล่าวรวมอยู่ในโปรแกรม L และเสนอทางเลือกให้ตามรายละเอียดของโปรแกรมปัจจุบัน

ภายหลังคุณได้กลับมาเลือกใช้บริการโปรแกรม L ทางร้านก็ยินดีต้อนรับและให้บริการตามปกติ โดยไม่ได้มีความรู้สึกติดใจต่อเหตุการณ์ก่อนหน้านั้นแต่อย่างใดค่ะ

2. เรื่องการนวดศีรษะและความสบายระหว่างบริการ

ก่อนเริ่มบริการ คุณได้แจ้งพนักงานว่ามีอาการระคายเคืองตาและไวต่อแสง พร้อมขอให้ปิดไฟภายในห้อง รวมถึงไฟวงแหวนบริเวณเตียงสปา ทางพนักงานได้ปฏิบัติตามคำขอเพื่อให้คุณรู้สึกสบายที่สุด แม้จะทำให้แสงสว่างสำหรับการปฏิบัติงานลดลงอย่างมากก็ตาม

สำหรับพนักงานที่ให้บริการในวันดังกล่าว เป็นพนักงานที่ผ่านการฝึกอบรมตามขั้นตอนของร้าน และได้รับมอบหมายให้ดูแลด้วยเทคนิคการสัมผัสอย่างนุ่มนวล โดยทางร้านมีข้อกำหนดเรื่องการดูแลความสะอาดและความสั้นของเล็บอย่างชัดเจน

ในช่วงเริ่มต้น พนักงานได้สอบถามถึงน้ำหนักและความสบายในการนวด และระหว่างบริการไม่ได้รับแจ้งว่ามีอาการเจ็บหรือแสบหนังศีรษะ อย่างไรก็ตาม เราไม่ได้หมายความว่าลูกค้ามีหน้าที่ต้องแจ้งทุกความรู้สึก แต่ต้องการอธิบายว่า หากพนักงานได้รับทราบถึงความไม่สบายในขณะนั้น ก็สามารถปรับวิธีการให้เหมาะสมได้ทันทีค่ะ

ทางร้านให้ความสำคัญกับความปลอดภัยของลูกค้า และจะนำข้อเสนอแนะนี้กลับไปทบทวนร่วมกับทีมงานอีกครั้ง

3. เรื่องผลิตภัณฑ์เคราตินและมาส์กคาเวียร์

ทางร้านขอชี้แจงว่า ก่อนเข้ารับบริการ คุณได้สอบถามเกี่ยวกับส่วนผสมของมาส์กคาเวียร์ ซึ่งผู้จัดการได้อธิบายว่าผลิตภัณฑ์มีส่วนผสมของคาเวียร์ในรูปแบบผง ไม่ใช่เม็ดคาเวียร์ และเมื่อคุณสอบถามอีกครั้งหลังรับบริการ ทางร้านก็ได้ชี้แจงข้อมูลในลักษณะเดียวกัน

สำหรับขั้นตอนการใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์ ทางร้านมีรูปแบบทรีตเมนต์ที่กำหนดไว้ อย่างไรก็ตาม เราเข้าใจว่าสภาพหนังศีรษะ ลักษณะเส้นผม และผลลัพธ์ที่ลูกค้าต้องการอาจแตกต่างกัน ซึ่งทางร้านยินดีรับฟังและนำไปพิจารณาปรับปรุงค่ะ

4. เรื่องการรับฟังความคิดเห็นและการดูแลหลังบริการ

ภายหลังการใช้บริการ คุณได้ติดต่อกลับมาทางโทรศัพท์เพื่อแจ้งข้อเสนอแนะ ซึ่งในขณะนั้นเจ้าของร้านได้รับฟังการสนทนาร่วมกับผู้จัดการด้วย

ทางร้านได้อธิบายรายละเอียดในประเด็นที่คุณสอบถาม พร้อมทั้งกล่าวขอโทษสำหรับประสบการณ์ที่ไม่เป็นไปตามความคาดหวังของคุณแล้วด้วยความจริงใจ

เราขอยืนยันว่าทางร้านไม่ได้เพิกเฉยต่อความคิดเห็นของลูกค้า และไม่ได้มีเจตนาผลักภาระความรับผิดชอบให้กับลูกค้าแต่อย่างใด

การกล่าวขอโทษของเราเป็นการแสดงความใส่ใจต่อความรู้สึกและประสบการณ์ของลูกค้า ไม่ได้หมายความว่าเราละเลยมาตรฐานหรือไม่ได้ปฏิบัติตามขั้นตอนการให้บริการค่ะ

ท้ายที่สุดนี้

SHE-WHA Wellness & Spa เคารพสิทธิของลูกค้าทุกท่านในการแสดงความคิดเห็น และพร้อมรับฟังคำแนะนำเพื่อนำมาพัฒนาการบริการอยู่เสมอ

ขณะเดียวกัน เราก็มีหน้าที่ดูแลและให้ความเป็นธรรมกับพนักงานที่ตั้งใจปฏิบัติหน้าที่อย่างดีที่สุดเช่นกัน

เราหวังว่าคำชี้แจงนี้จะช่วยให้ผู้ที่อ่านรีวิวได้รับทราบรายละเอียดของเหตุการณ์อย่างรอบด้าน และเข้าใจถึงความตั้งใจของทางร้านในการดูแลลูกค้าทุกท่านอย่างเท่าเทียมและเป็นมืออาชีพ

reviews.text:
I’ve been coming here for over 10 visits, and I’ve always had a great experience. That’s why I chose this place as my regular massage shop and have recommended it to many people.

Unfortunately, this visit was extremely disappointing.

The therapist who worked on me seemed to lack basic massage skills and knowledge. The massage felt rushed, careless, and lacked any understanding of pressure points or how to provide relief. Before the session started, I clearly explained that I wanted extra focus on my neck, shoulders, and upper back. I appreciate that she did spend more time on those areas as requested, but the technique itself was very poor.

The pressure, weight distribution, and timing were all off. She didn’t seem to know how to apply proper pressure or hold it long enough to help the muscles relax. Throughout the session, I repeatedly asked for stronger pressure, but she never adjusted it. As a customer, I don’t understand why my requests were ignored.

When she worked on my legs, she mostly just moved her hands around without applying any real pressure. It honestly felt more like lotion was being rubbed onto my skin than an actual massage.

Even during the head massage, including the pressure point between the eyebrows, she wasn’t able to create any sense of comfort or relaxation.

This was by far the worst massage experience I’ve had here. I spent two hours trying to endure it, hoping it would get better, but it never did.

I am very disappointed and would not recommend this particular therapist to anyone. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously, as this experience was completely different from the high standard of service I’ve received here in the past.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely apologize 
We will improve and develop our services further.🙏

reviews.textTranslated:
I'd wanted to take a Thai cooking class for a long time, but English was a barrier. With Eat, I learned from a talented Thai cook who speaks French.

The class was very well structured. We started by buying the ingredients at the market, then we prepared the dishes we had chosen from the menu.
As a result, we had a very enjoyable half-day, and at the end, we tasted our dishes, which confirmed that Eat's food is delicious. As we left, we received a beautiful cookbook from Eat.

It was truly a great experience.
Thank you to Eat for their friendly and professional approach.

Finally, the place is beautiful and very clean.

reviews.name: Florence Bouchet
reviews.text:
Nous recherchions un cours de cuisine en famille et surtout en français afin que nos filles de 7 et 10 ans puissent suivre et comprendre.

Nous sommes tombés par hasard sur la cuisine de Eat qui nous a concocté un cours de 17h à 21h30. Juste pour nous. C'était vraiment top autant pour le lieu, la qualité d'accueil, de pédagogie, de sympathie que la qualité de ce que nous avons cuisiné, puis déguster ensuite.
Un grand merci à Eat et sa commis pour le Accueil.
Ce fut un très agréable moment.
Je recommande vivement si vous recherchez un cours de cuisine.
reviews.textTranslated:
We were looking for a family cooking class, and especially one in French so our daughters, aged 7 and 10, could follow along and understand.

We stumbled upon Eat's kitchen, and they arranged a class just for us from 5 pm to 9:30 pm. It was absolutely fantastic, from the venue and the warm welcome to the friendly and helpful instructors, as well as the delicious food we cooked and then enjoyed afterwards.
A huge thank you to Eat and their assistant for the warm welcome.
It was a truly enjoyable experience. I highly recommend it if you're looking for a cooking class.

reviews.name: Lucile Artero
reviews.text:
Nous avons vécu une expérience formidable lors d’un cours de cuisine avec Eat, l’épouse de Franck. La journée a débuté par une visite du marché local, très intéressante et authentique. Puis nous sommes passés aux fourneaux dans leur ancien restaurant, un lieu parfaitement propre et agréable.
Au menu : deux entrées, deux plats et un dessert, le tout en quantités plus que généreuses — il nous en restait même pour le dîner !
À la fin, un livre de cuisine nous est offert, regroupant toutes les recettes expliquées pas à pas, avec les ingrédients précis. Parfait pour pouvoir les reproduire facilement chez soi.
L’accueil était chaleureux et l’ambiance conviviale. Franck a également pris le temps de nous partager de nombreux conseils pour découvrir Chiang Mai, qui se sont révélés extrêmement utiles.
Une adresse que je recommande sans hésitation !
reviews.textTranslated:
We had a fantastic experience during a cooking class with Eat, Franck's wife. The day began with a visit to the local market, which was very interesting and authentic. Then we got cooking in their former restaurant, a perfectly clean and pleasant place.

On the menu: two appetizers, two main courses, and a dessert, all in more than generous portions—we even had leftovers for dinner!
At the end, we were given a cookbook, containing all the recipes explained step by step, with the precise ingredients listed. Perfect for easily recreating them at home.
The welcome was warm and the atmosphere friendly. Franck also took the time to share many tips for exploring Chiang Mai, which proved extremely useful. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.text:
《The Best Massage Experience Ever – Incredible Value!》

Honestly, this was the best massage I’ve ever had. I can’t quite recall her name (something like Olive or Olivia?), but her technique was absolutely masterful. My wife was equally impressed and satisfied. The value for money is exceptional, and we’re already planning to come back again and again. Highly recommended for anyone seeking quality relaxation!

reviews.name: Sari Nieminen
reviews.text:
The best massage in town, tailored to your needs. Our family of 3 were so well looked after. Pam was super sweet and cured my shoulder pain. They notice your painful spots and take care of them. Highly recommend!!!
And qute Cats too 😍😺
We went back the next day for neck & shoulders massage. That was fabulous too. Tomorrow back again for something else 🤩 Must try all massages since they are so good.

reviews.name: scubaking007
reviews.text: I have been to a lot of massage shops in Patong over the years and without hesitation this is the best. From body to foot scrub and foot/leg massage (foot/leg is almost daily for me and always the day after scuba diving) it’s fantastic. Clean, professional and they actually listen to you if you have any body issues. All the therapists are great at their job ( Hello Pam 😊).

reviews.name: Rebecca Greco
reviews.text: The best massage in patong! Very kind staff and perfect Massage, no pain and everything very clean and good smelling

reviews.name: Liebe Jeannot
reviews.text: Best massage place with the most fantastic staff!! We are always so well treated here...Sara, Jinny, Olive, Pam and Tuey are such lovely, wonderful ladies 💕

reviews.name: Robert Andrésen
reviews.text:
I went twice to this place. First I took a 90 min Thai massage and it was fantastic, the best I ever had. I think the therapist was Nung and she was phenomenal, identified that I had some pain in my shoulders and paid extra attention to left one that was most sore. The day after I went back and opted for a 60 min neck and shoulder massage. Unfortunately I got another therapist and it was quite mediocre. A lot of oil, soft to medium pressure and more of a general stroking of the back rather than massaging specific muscles. A bit disappointed so not sure if I will go back, if I do I will make sure that I get the same woman than massaged me the first time.

The place is clean and relatively relaxing ambience, but the noise from the busy street can be heard quite well so maybe best to avoid at rush-hour when there is a traffic police officer directing the intersection and constantly blowing his whistle....

reviews.name: Rajan Padiachi
reviews.text: Great professional clean massage centre. Staff pleasant so good and care a lot. Hygiene excellent. Prices really good. Near Zenseana hotel and spa. Have a nail bar on site as well.

reviews.name: Oleg Obraztsov
reviews.text: My husband and I visited this massage salon and were pleasantly surprised by the quality of the massage. The staff were very friendly and kind. The interior is beautiful and peaceful. Thank you to the staff for the service provided.

reviews.name: Julie Egan
reviews.text: The ladies are super friendly! Got my foot massage  my first nail manicure and pedicure and nail polish done! Love them!

reviews.name: Jake
reviews.text: This is the best massage you will ever get in Patong. If you’re a sports person or athlete you will receive the best massage you need to be able to continue to perform at the highest level in your sport 💯. If you’re a tourist and want the best traditional massage with no strings attached then this is the place for you. Me and my wife have been coming to Thailand for over 20 years and this is by far the best service we have received from a massage shop if you pay for a massage you expect a massage and this place i guarantee delivers. Well done guys great shop excellent service

reviews.name: Thibault B
reviews.text: I went there twice during my stay in Patong and I absolutely loved the massages. A 100 more than other massage places but it’s worth it! Had the oil massage and the hot oil massage. Both were good and I felt so relaxed after. Thank you for the professional ladies there.

reviews.name: Anthony T
reviews.text: Came here based on reviews. Paid for 90 minutes, got 80. Therapist coughing through the whole thing, and not very consistent. Could have just been a bad masseuse but honestly, there are a lot better massages available in the area.

reviews.name: Csak Tudatosan
reviews.text:
During our 8 weeks in Thailand we have tried several places and we liked Tanyara the most. Spending a month in Patong we went 3-4 times a week. Mostly we were asking for thai massages and it was always good. Sometimes 10/10 sometimes even better, depending what you like and who massages you.

I couldn't move my arm due to a 2.5 months old fracture in the shoulder (humeral head), I was about 70% after physico-, laser-, magnet- and electro-therapies. When I showed my problem in Tanyara, they redirected me to Nung, who was fixing my muscles, my blocks, all my moves. Thanks to her professionalism and magical moves I am now at about 95%. And I am sure she would fix me to 100% if we could stay longer.

reviews.name: KUNDYZ DAUITBEK
reviews.text: PAM beauty is the top!!! I love her ! I definitely will come tomorrow again!!!

reviews.name: Shekhar Shrestha
reviews.text: A 600 Thai baht sports massage by a lady called Nung de aged me about 20 years. My back, shoulders and hips now have the sort of flexibility normally reserved for 10 year old Chinese gymnastics. She danced up and down my back like a young Stavros Flately but generated the kind of pressure you would expect from Giant Haystacks while inflicting an exquisite mixture of agony, pleasure and relief. I will be back tomorrow. Wholly recommended.

reviews.name: עוז פנטון
reviews.text: Everywhere I do massage I asks for the strongest, and almost everytime disappointed. But here, man, the girl was a BONE BREAKER. For the worst and for the better. The most intense massage experience I had. Besides that, they didnt served tea (as I know from most places) not before nor after🫠

reviews.name: Kunal Ghose
reviews.text: Superb is the word. They will follow your instruction if you request them on pressure and how you want your massage. Very good service. Price is according to the market.

reviews.name: Lafia
reviews.text: Had a really nice foot massage and they were accommodating with my request for a privacy screen. Would definitely come again.

นอน 8 ชั่วโมงแล้ว แต่ตื่นมายังรู้สึกเพลียเหมือนไม่ได้นอน... 
คุณกำลังเจอปัญหานี้อยู่หรือเปล่าครับ? 😴☁️
.
บางครั้ง ความล้าสะสม ที่เราเจออยู่ อาจไม่ได้เกิดจากการนอนไม่พอ 
แต่อาจเกิดจากการที่เรา หายใจตื้นเกินไป โดยไม่รู้ตัว

🧘‍♀️ ทำไมยิ่งเครียด ยิ่งเหนื่อยง่าย? เวลาที่เรานั่งทำงานนานๆ มี Posture ที่ไม่เหมาะสม หรือเผชิญกับความเครียด ร่างกายจะปรับรูปแบบการหายใจให้สั้นและตื้นลงอัตโนมัติ ส่งผลให้ กะบังลม ทำงานได้ไม่เต็มที่ และร่างกายได้รับออกซิเจนไม่เพียงพอ จนเกิดเป็นความอ่อนล้าเรื้อรัง
.
✨ คืนลมหายใจที่สมบูรณ์แบบด้วย Pilates การเล่นพิลาทีสไม่ได้เน้นแค่การเกร็งกล้ามเนื้อ แต่ให้ความสำคัญกับ "การหายใจ" ในทุกๆ ท่าเคลื่อนไหว

🫁 กระตุ้นกะบังลม : ฝึกให้ร่างกายใช้ปอดและกะบังลมได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

หลายคนตั้งใจออกกำลังกายด้วยการวิ่งเป็นประจำเพราะอยากมีหุ่นเฟิร์มกระชับ แม้ว่า Cardio (การคาร์ดิโอ) จะช่วยเผาผลาญแคลอรี ลดไขมัน และ เสริมสร้างความแข็งแรงให้หัวใจและปอดได้ดีเยี่ยม

แต่รู้ไหมครับว่า... การวิ่งเพียงอย่างเดียวอาจไม่ได้ช่วยรักษามวลกล้ามเนื้อ และ บางครั้งยังสะสมอาการตึงตามข้อต่อ สะโพก หรือหลังด้านล่างอีกด้วย

💡 3 องค์ประกอบสำคัญเพื่อสุขภาพและการสร้างรูปร่างที่สมบูรณ์แบบ
หากคุณต้องการให้ร่างกายแข็งแรง รูปร่างสมส่วน สัดส่วนกระชับ และ เคลื่อนไหวได้ดีในระยะยาว ร่างกายต้องการการดูแลที่ครบ 3 ด้าน
1. Cardio (การวิ่ง / คาร์ดิโอ) เน้นเบิร์นแคลอรี ลดไขมัน เสริมความแข็งแรงให้หัวใจและปอด
2. Strength Training (การสร้างกล้ามเนื้อ) รักษามวลกล้ามเนื้อ กระชับสัดส่วน และเพิ่มการเผาผลาญ
3. Mobility & Flexibility (พิลาทิส / ยืดเหยียด) เพิ่มความยืดหยุ่น เพิ่มช่วงการเคลื่อนไหวของข้อต่อ และลดอาการตึงสะสม

เพราะการเปลี่ยนแปลงรูปร่าง และ สร้างบุคลิกภาพที่ดี ไม่ใช่เรื่องของความรวดเร็ว แต่คือผลลัพธ์ของ ‘ความสม่ำเสมอ’ ที่คุณมอบให้กับตัวเองในทุกๆ สัปดาห์
จัดเวลาให้ร่างกายเพียงสัปดาห์ละ 2 ครั้ง เพื่อรีเซตโครงสร้างร่างกาย และ ก้าวขึ้นสู่เวอร์ชันที่ดีที่สุดของคุณทีละสเต็ป ผ่านโปรแกรม Classical Pilates (คลาสสิก พิลาทิส) ที่เราตั้งใจดูแลแบบ Private Pilates เพื่อปรับให้เข้ากับสรีระของคุณโดยเฉพาะ

🌱 STEP 1 : 1 WEEK (The Awakening) ร่างกายเริ่มปรับตัว ระบบไหลเวียนดีขึ้น และ รู้สึกตัวเบา สบายตัวอย่างเห็นได้ชัด 
💃 STEP 2 : 1 MONTH (The Transformation) กล้ามเนื้อแกนกลางชั้นลึกเริ่มจดจำ บุคลิกภาพดีขึ้น แผ่นหลังตรงและสง่างามขึ้น ปรับ Alignment ของกระดูกสันหลังและสะโพกให้สมดุล 
💪 STEP 3 : 3 MONTHS (The Mastery) แกนกลางลำตัว (Core Muscle) แข็งแกร่งอย่างชัดเจน สรีระเฟิร์มกระชับ และ คล่องตัวในทุกท่วงท่า ลดอาการปวดหลัง และ อาการปวดเมื่อยเรื้อรัง (Office Syndrome)
ให้ SOL Pilates เป็น Routine ใหม่ของคุณ ยินดีต้อนรับผู้ที่กำลังมองหา ร้านพิลาทิส ใกล้ฉัน ในย่านดินแดง-อโศก

มีโอกาสจะแวะเข้าไปเทรนอีกนะคะ💓🫶🏻✨
reviews.textTranslated:
✅ The studio is adorable, the mood and tone are amazing. Exercising here after work is so refreshing!
💓 Today I trained with Coach Pond, and I was so impressed. She gave great suggestions for beginner students. The training was fun, the exercises were gentle but targeted every muscle. She focused on body control, teaching how to adjust posture for a beautiful body and angle. She's very experienced and explained the differences between Pilates types – it was so engaging!
✅ I highly recommend everyone come. Just receiving the positive energy from the coach is worth it!
For any poses I thought I couldn't do, Coach Pond encouraged me and boosted my confidence. She also took great care and ensured safety.
✅ For those who love creating content, the coach even takes amazing photos after arranging the poses! 🫶🏻

I'll definitely be back for another training session! 💓🫶🏻✨

Where do I even begin… We came as a family and left with the biggest smiles on our faces. From the moment we walked in, the owner and her colleague made us feel so welcome, not like customers, but like people they genuinely cared about. The kindness, the warmth, the attention to every little detail… it was just beautiful.
Their work is absolutely flawless. Meticulous, precise, professional, the kind of quality you’d expect from a top-tier salon, but delivered with a heart. And what touched us most is that they treated every single one of us with the same love and care, no matter the age.
If you’re in Hua Hin and you’re looking for more than just a nail appointment, a real moment of warmth and well-being for your whole family, please come here. You will not regret it, I promise.
We will be back with our eyes closed 🙏 Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for making this such a special memory for us. See you very soon! 🌸✨

reviews.name: Jade Allegra
reviews.text:
My friend and I had a disappointing experience today. We both provided clear reference images and were told the designs were achievable, but as the appointment went on it became clear we were being charged a premium for work that fell far below the standard promised.

I requested a simple cat-eye design and was assured it could be done. I changed my nail shape before the gel was applied, but as more customers arrived, my technician began rushing. If I hadn’t been paying close attention, I wouldn’t have noticed that four nails had been set crooked under the UV lamp. She corrected them, but then rushed through the cat-eye effect—which ended up looking like basic glitter polish rather than what I asked for.

Meanwhile, my friend waited nearly an hour for her pedicure to even begin, as staff repeatedly paused her service to prioritise walk-ins. After almost three hours in the salon, neither of us felt the work remotely matched the references we provided or the price we paid.

Thankfully, we were able to get everything corrected at Valentine Nails. Their team understood the brief immediately, matched the reference images without hesitation, and delivered the level of skill and care we expected in the first place. They genuinely saved us the day before a wedding, and the difference in quality was night and day.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
This is not the level of service and care that we aim to deliver, and we are truly sorry that we fell short. We would really appreciate the opportunity to take responsibility and make things right for you and your friend. PN Nails Hua Hin

reviews.name: Becky Barstein
reviews.text:
One of the best experiences of our trip so far. Everyone said we should take a cooking class and I’m so glad we took this one. Pot, the cooking instructor, was friendly, funny, and patient. His whole team was. We started off at a market where he explained different ingredients to us and then we had a chance to explore.

We drove to his cooking space. We spent the evening learning how to cook an incredible variety of meals. Everything from the ingredients to the cooking materials was prepped and easy to use. I am not a great cook by any means, but I loved what I made (Tom yum, spring rolls, massaman curry, mango sticky rice, drunken noodles - you can pick from a ton of dishes to make.) Door to door drop of service too! They picked us up and dropped us off right from our hotel.

Overall friendly, fun causal cooking class where I learned a ton. If you are looking for a cooking class in Chiang Mai, I would definitely recommend this one.

reviews.name: Danielle Isbell
reviews.text:
I can't say enough wonderful things about Siam Rice! Booking was easy and pick up drop off very convenient.
Nancy is hilarious and makes everyone feeling welcome. We were so impressed how everyone got attention and were able to cook different dishes. We did the evening class and were able to make five different dishes. We were stuffed at the end!
Thank you Nancy and Siam Rice team. You guys gave us a wonderful experience and some great recipes to make!

reviews.name: james elton
reviews.text: Pot was a ton of fun and great teacher. He respected and worked with people in our group who had dietary restrictions etc. the food was very good and he answered so many questions about Thai cooking that my wife and I could never figure out. 5 dishes ends up being a LOT of food -  but the best part was having fun with a lovely group of people from around the world-(we had US, Netherlands, Denmark, London, Russia in our group of 8. This is James wife Carrie . We had so much fun with our group and with pot and Nina ! Our advice is really get to know and become friends with the people in your group ... it’s one of the best parts! And we LOVED the market . I would have liked about 10 more minutes there but I doubt the others in our group would have wanted that. Pot is cheeky without being too cheeky . He makes everyone feel good about themselves and has a way with people . We used a little too much molasses for my taste in the noodle dish😂😂😂😂... but we’re noticing that is very common in actual Thai cooking and they use less in the states. I love panang curry and it was awesome to make it from scratch and it was sooo good ! Can’t wait to make sticky rice for my kids . I just hope I can remember how to make it . One of the keys in knowing how long and how hot to cook things something that will take time to master. Thank you pot ! You are awesome !
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much James hope you enjoyed with thai food at your family and see you again soon any questions when you cook thai food you can contact us all the time. Big hug ♥️♥️♥️

I would highly recommend the cookery school. It is located on there own organic farm.   ANN MARIE

reviews.name: Louisa Zahiri
reviews.text:
It's one of the best experiences I've had in my life.
Everything was perfect ! We took the morning class and cooked 3 dishes and 1 dessert. Good atmosphere and far away from the tourist activity: here we cook for real and we take the time to understand Thai culture and food. Will definitely go back again !!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello Najet
Thank you very much for share your experience cooking class with us here.
And we hope to see you again when all around the world become  not have any Virus.
We will open our cooking school soon.
Siam Rice team.

reviews.name: Georgia
reviews.text: I looooooved my experience here. Did the full day experience, which was 1000 baht and definitely worth every penny. Pot was so genuine and kind, he joked around and made everyone super comfortable! He made it very easy to learn the little details of traditional Thai cooking, and the atmosphere was amazing. So clean yet rustic, organized, welcoming, felt like cooking at home. And the food!!!! It was incredible. I eat a vegan diet and had no problem with the food or with Pot in accommodating/switching anything, felt like a breeze. Such a cool and delicious experience. Would recommend to anyone coming to Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much Georgia You are very funny too.
See you again soon and Enjoy your trip .
Mr.POT

reviews.name: Ben Williams
reviews.text: I definitely recommend this cooking school. You will not leave hungry! It was longer than expected and it was well worth the price!

reviews.name: MG S.
reviews.text:
An amazing cooking experience! Nina was a great host who was funny, engaging, and a great chef. Their half day program allows you to cook 5 meals with lots of choice for each (all for 800 baht). They give you super helpful, clear instructions throughout.
Unlike other cooking classes in Chiang Mai, this one is a family. They have the school at their house next to their farm (where your ingredients come from). You can see their children and pets running around near the house. They treat you like family, not a customer, and ate ready to chat with you whenever you'd like.
Great for vegetarians too.

reviews.name: Shannon Porter
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Siam Rice. We did a half day morning class. Perfect for our whole family. Nina was very kid friendly and was so patient. She made it a fun experience for all of us. Would highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Alexis Zadnik
reviews.text: An awesome day experience! This was my first cooking class while traveling about Southeast Asia. Did the full day course cooked 6 dishes plus a curry paste. You get to eat all the dishes you make, try not to eat breakfast if you can because you will be stuffed all day! Koy was our teacher, she is fantastic! Super funny, laid back, and very informative.

reviews.name: Floris Binneman
reviews.text: This was an authentic learning session with Yam, who knows her Thai cuisine and ingredients 100%. Picked up at the hotel, taken to the market to get some pointers on how and what to shop for when making the dishes ourselves, and then for our lessons dish by dish. Farang have nothing to worry about, YOU control the heat, food can be as mild or spicy as you choose. Great experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much Floris for your review.

reviews.name: Marco Kuster
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a top-tier BJJ gym in the heart of Bangkok, Ohana BJJ is the place to be. Conveniently located near Chidlom BTS station, it’s easily accessible for locals and visitors alike. The dojo, situated on the 5th floor of the Vanissa Building, is impeccably clean, air-conditioned, and well-equipped with spacious mats, changing rooms, and showers. Emma, the owner, provides a warm and welcoming atmosphere, and the coaching team is both highly skilled and supportive. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced practitioner, I highly recommend Ohana BJJ!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the kind words and comments about our gym. We've really enjoyed having you come and train with our morning crew! Hope to see you again soon

reviews.name: Jason Han
reviews.text: I've been to several gyms, and this was the best jiu jitsu facility I've ever attended. They have a feet washing station right next to the mats. It's in a clean and fancy office building. They have showers, unlike most gyms in the United States. The staff was very welcoming and made me feel at ease. The instructions were high quality and very clear and I always got personal feedback when we were drilling. I will definitely return when I'm in Bangkok again. Also, this review was unsolicited, which I appreciate.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Jason - Thank you so much for the fabulous review. Very kind of you. We really enjoyed having you roll with us and were sorry to see you go. We’d all be delighted to welcome you back again soon.

reviews.name: Damon Zhang
reviews.text: I've been to a quite few gyms across different countries, and I have to say, Obana easily ranks among the best. It's probably the top training environment in Bangkok, with both the bathroom and training area setting a new standard for cleanliness. The instructors each bring their unique approach to martial arts, adding to the experience. But what really sets Obana apart is the warm, welcoming vibe. Even if you're only in town for a few days, it's definitely worth a visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the kind words. We really appreciate that you took the time to post this review. We loved having you on the mats and look forward to welcoming you again in the future. Oss!

reviews.name: Meta Martial Arts Academy
reviews.text: Had a great time at Ohana! Did a drop in visiting from the states. Class was awesome as we went over some really good gi technique. The gym is very clean and overall vibes were super friendly. Thank you for having me!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi! Thanks for the lovely review - we really enjoyed having you visit with us and hope to see on the mats again in the future. Oss!

reviews.name: EatSleepPlay
reviews.text:
I've had the privilege of training here during my 2 weeks in Bangkok for work. Great vibe and place, everyone is very comfortable and chill. Felt really welcome here! English lessons.

Coach EJ's style of really breaking down techniques and moves in a detailed and methodical manner is very educational and is great not only for newbies but also experienced people who wants to refine their game.

Coach Eric gives the most practical advice I've heard in a while and is always ready to share what he knows and how to improve others.

The rest of the team here is fantastic, and it's been such a great time. If I'm ever in Bangkok or moving here, I know where to go to!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for training with us during your time in Bangkok, it was our pleasure to share the mats with you.

Take care, and hope to see you again!

reviews.text: Friendly, clean BJJ Gym, turned up paid and did a No Gi session there, would recommend if visiting Bangkok, was easy to find and i used BJJ Network app to find them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review, we're glad you had a great experience and hope you had a wonderful time in Thailand!

reviews.name: Patrick Zuercher
reviews.text:
Fantastic training experience. Adam is a great instructor in every way. He's very skilled, knows how to explain, he's fun to train and roll with, and he's super nice.

The same goes for the students. Everyone I rolled with as a good partner.

Huge plus is the service as well. I could rent a gi and just leave it there to get washed. That was very convenient. I plan on coming back to Bangkok for a few weeks to train here again.

reviews.name: Parisuthi - Tom Jinamornphongs
reviews.text: Having started my BJJ journey for almost 2 years ago, I find Q23 BJJ Academy is the absolute best place to train at.  The classes are taught by very professional coaches (coach Adam and coach Jem) who have both decades of teaching experiences and practical knowledge in competitive BJJ.  Coach Adam has very in-depth teaching method for practitioners who want to learn some serious BJJ skill, at the same time the class environment has a family / friendly atmosphere.  Q23 teaches practitioners of all ages, most of all what children can gain from the class is respect.  The class also welcomes anyone traveling through Bangkok, and I have met many wonderful people from all walks of life who have shared their BJJ skills and experiences from elsewhere and continue to return upon their next visit.  I feel very privileged to have such a skilled BJJ coach teaching here in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Tan Wei Xiang
reviews.text:
I visited just a few days before Christmas and decided to treat myself to a relaxing massage with a festive twist. I came across Boss Massage, where I was warmly welcomed by a cheerful lady Anna, who I believe was the manager. Initially, I felt a bit nervous, but she quickly helped me feel at ease with her friendly demeanor.

When it came time to choose from the ladies available, I found it quite difficult because most of them were decently attractive, especially considering the reasonable pricing. After the service, I can confidently say that for the price, it was absolutely worth it, and I left feeling satisfied.

Although I had seen some negative reviews beforehand, I believe everyone has their own perspective. In my opinion, the positive feedback outweighs the negative, and I think it’s best for people to judge for themselves. You can’t expect top-tier, supermodel-level service for this price range—if that’s what you’re after, you’d likely be looking at high-end options instead.

reviews.name: Vaibhav Singh
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this massage parlour. From the moment I arrived, it was clear that things were not going to go as expected. The therapist, whose name was Orange, seemed completely uninterested and disengaged throughout the session.

Nothing that was mentioned on the website or during the booking process was actually delivered. There was no proper consultation, no effort to personalize the treatment, and the entire session felt rushed and unprofessional. It was a complete waste of time and money.

I booked this session expecting a relaxing and rejuvenating experience, but instead left feeling more stressed and frustrated. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a genuine massage experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re  apologize to hear that your recent experience at our massage parlour did not meet your expectations. We truly regret that you left feeling disappointed.

Orange is one of our more experienced and skilled therapists, and it’s unfortunate that the chemistry during your session wasn’t what was hoped for. 

We understand that every client has unique preferences, and sometimes a mismatch in style or communication can affect the overall experience.

We would love the opportunity to make things right. Should you wish to return, we would be happy to have a conversation beforehand about your specific needs. 

We have a number of wonderful and highly trained therapists, and we are confident that one of them will be a better match for you.

Thank you again for your feedback — it helps us improve.

reviews.name: CAA
reviews.text:
Excellent and Relaxing Experience

Had a wonderful massage—absolutely worth the price! I went here 2 nights straight.

A 1-hour foot massage is just 250 baht, and Thai massage is 300 baht. The location is peaceful, safe, and very clean, even with three quiet and friendly cats around—no smell at all! I truly appreciate their cleanliness and calm atmosphere.  Staff are so friendly. Will definitely come back!

My massage therapist (Mook) has a touch which is a relaxing firmness, enough to send me off to sleep or at least nap.

reviews.text:
Chanced upon another massage shop while making my way back to the hotel. Since my foot was still sore from the walking, I decided to go for a foot massage before heading back to my hotel. There were quite a few customers when I was there.

I opted for the Thai foot massage, which was 250baht for 60 minutes. The masseur that was assigned to me was an elderly lady. Have to say, the massage was enjoyable till I fell asleep. She applies alot strength but it feels comfortable. After the massage, I felt so relaxed, and the fatigue was gone.

Overall, discovered another gem in the area. Wouldn't mind coming back again in the future.

reviews.text: Without a doubt, this is my favorite neighbourhood massage. The level of skill, professionalism, and care is truly exceptional. Every session feels thoughtfully tailored, with an intuitive understanding of exactly what the body needs. The techniques are both deeply therapeutic and wonderfully relaxing, creating a perfect balance of relief and calm. You can tell there’s genuine passion and expertise behind the massage, and I always leave feeling completely renewed, relaxed, and grateful for the experience. A truly outstanding place that I highly recommend.

Also really liked the little arms and shoulder massage we got at the end.
The massage studio has 3 cats who roam around, but they must be trained to not come to clients as they stayed around the non-working personal.

reviews.name: Tara B
reviews.text: Excellent massage. We went for 2 hours oil and Thai balm body massage. It was so comfortable that I fell asleep, a good balance between a relaxing and technically satisfying massage. It opens at 12pm, not 11am on Google

reviews.name: Jesse Romeo Rafanan
reviews.text: Great place good massage and cats

reviews.name: James Seby

reviews.name: Luke Wong
reviews.text: Good ambient music and a comfortable chair to enjoy your massage in. The masseuse were pretty good and overall the foot massage was relaxing after a long day’s of walking. Only downside is that they ended about 15 minutes earlier than expected. They even have a cute Siamese cat roaming the store!

title: University gym
subTitle: BOWNA MUAYTHAI GYM
ownerDescription:
BOWNA MUAYTHAI GYM
ยิมมวยไทยย่านทุ่งมหาเมฆ

reviews.name: Martina
reviews.text: I did 5 trainings in this gym, 3 group trainings and 2 private trainings with Rainbow. The first training was ok but there were lot of beginners so it was too light for me (I do muay thai since 3 years). Then I did 2 trainings in the early afternoon and I recommend this timing, or in the morning, because there were less people and coaches had very individual approach, they adapted perfectly to my level and I enjoyed a lot these trainings. And the trainings with Rainbow were just perfect, the most complete trainings I had in my life, I learned a lot, he corrected a lot of details in my technique and pushed me to train hard. All the teachers and receptionnists are super kind and are willing to help you. I recommend this gym 100% and I will return there the next time I visit Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the 5-star review. Next time, come and practice Muay Thai again. You are always welcome.

reviews.name: Immy
reviews.text: This is such a good Muay Thai gym, one of my favourites in Thailand. They push you hard but it is a lot of fun and very encouraging. I bought a 10 pack of classes, and will return many times :) thank you!

reviews.name: jose antonio lorencio abril
reviews.text:
I've been coming for two months as someone that had never practiced any fighting sports before. Amazing experience! The coaches care about you and really try to teach you the art of Muay Thai.

They don't speak much English, but communication is about the will to understand each other, and they do their best for you to understand.

100% recommend! Best wishes to all the staff.

reviews.name: Justin Vaughan
reviews.text:
I spent 10 days in Bangkok, trained Muay Thai every day and tried 4 different gyms looking for a good experience.
Bowna Muay Thai was the only gym I can recommend from my trip. The gym is big, clean and well equipped. The vibe is very friendly and the coaches pay attention, giving advice and making the effort with each person. They are never on their mobile phones.
Group sessions are 1.5 hrs, a good mix of traditional Muay Thai training, bag work, pad work etc. plus fitness finishers to get extra work in.
Kru Rainbow is fantastic and I can recommend the gym.

reviews.name: Bertram Wong
reviews.text: Had a great morning private training with Kru Jeluwat. I didn’t want to spend much time on cardio since in town only a few days so focused on some clinch, he taught me some throw and did a few rounds of pad work. All around, fun, exciting and a great learning experience!  Will be back next time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the 5-star review. Next time, come and practice Muay Thai again. You are always welcome.

reviews.name: Jason Chen
reviews.text:
Best training in my life. I came to the morning class and I was the only person there, so I basically got a private training with the coach and rainbow for the price of a group lesson.

They were super technical and made sure to correct even small minutiae in my technique.

Note to any Chinese speakers, he also speaks mandarin and even a little Cantonese! I was honestly a little embarrassed because his mandarin is better than mine and sometimes I couldn’t understand him because of that 😅.

Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Shieuhuei Heng
reviews.text:
We came here on a weekday morning and love how quiet, spacious and clean it is! So lucky to have gotten private classes from the instructors as first timers to Muay Thai.

The instructors were really good in teaching and even though we were new, they really pushed us to improve so much in one class.

Really recommend coming here for Muay Thai on weekday mornings if you can! It was our highlight of our Bangkok trip!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the 5-star review. Next time, come and practice Muay Thai again. You are always welcome.

reviews.text: Fantastic gym! Family run and very good vibes 😎 Everyone is so friendly. They’ll push you in the best way. Corrected all my bad technique but were encouraging and supportive. They’ve got lockers and showers and will lend you wraps and gloves. It was a quiet time when we were there and they’d give us private lesson attention for the rate of a group class 🙏 10/10 experience thank you so much I hope we can come back!

All the staff is super friendly and in the gym there is a funny family environment that makes it even more enjoyable to train here.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the 5-star review. Next time, come and practice Muay Thai again. You are always welcome.

reviews.name: Dominik Grünwald
reviews.text:

The trainers are not only incredibly skilled but also super friendly and funny, making every session both challenging and enjoyable. They really pay attention to your technique and are always helping you improve, no matter your skill level.

What makes this gym even more special is the opportunity to be trained by the legendary Muay Thai champion, Rainbow Sor Prantalay—truly an honor! Whether you're a complete beginner or a seasoned professional, BOWNA welcomes everyone with open arms. The prices are very reasonable for the high quality of training you receive.

Highly recommend for anyone looking to learn Muay Thai in Bangkok! 💪🥊

reviews.name: Olymp 007
reviews.text:
This was my third massage in Bangkok, and it was unfortunately the worst.
To start, the lady at the counter was incredibly unfriendly, and they require payment upfront. I opted for the back massage, but unlike other parlors where you are given a change of clothes or the massage is done shirtless, I was forced to keep my shirt on. Had I known this beforehand, I would have changed, as the shirt I was wearing made the experience quite unpleasant. Because of the layers, the massage didn’t feel personalized at all; it was just a series of "presses" rather than an actual „massage“.
Furthermore, despite there being curtains between the mattresses, my therapist didn’t bother pulling them shut. There was basically no privacy, resulting in several moments of awkward eye contact with the person next to me.
I ended up leaving more tense than when I arrived. The only upside was the complimentary refreshments at the end: bananas, two small cookies, tea, and water.

reviews.name: Cer
reviews.text:
Of all the massage places I’ve visited in Bangkok, this one stands out as a true gem! Tucked just moments away from the BTS station, it’s incredibly convenient to find. Being newly opened, the shop is spotlessly clean and beautifully designed with a unique, stylish interior that feels both modern and calming.

What really impressed me was the outstanding value—the prices are very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the massage. I’ve tried several popular spots recommended on Xiaohongshu and Google Maps, but the skill level here surpasses them all, and at a more affordable rate! It’s also worth mentioning that this place comes highly recommended by locals, which says a lot.

But beyond the great massage, it was the exceptional service and warmth of the owner that truly won me over. When I was a little short on cash—just 50 THB—and offered to pay by card instead, the owner kindly waved off the difference with a smile. I’m still so touched by her generosity and would like to express my thanks once again.

Without a doubt, I will be returning here on my next trip to Bangkok. Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Run Hua
reviews.text:
I’ve been traveling in Bangkok for a week and I came to Baan Bangrak Massage almost every single day.

There are four lovely therapists worked on me and all of them are sweet. I know two of their names — Sala and Ni— and I don’t know the names of the other two, but all of them are helpful, and have such wonderful personalities.

Most importantly, their Thai massage skills are excellent. The pressure is strong and precise, exactly how I like it; every session was deeply relaxing and comfortable.

I will definitely return to see them on my next visit to Bangkok.

One more thing，one detail I really love: as soon as you walk in, before the massage starts, they offer a  foot-washing service on their bended  knees.
