reviews.name: Jerv Liu
reviews.text:
Definitely the best massage in Bangkok I’ve ever had and I’ve tried lots for the past 20 years!!! In fact this is the best massage I’ve had in the entire world! So glad I finally found this place. Will definitely come back every time I’m in Bangkok! I am definitely booking my accommodation close to this spa in future so I can have massages here everyday. Highly highly highly recommended!!!

The staffs here are very friendly and professional and their technique is amazing. My massage therapist always targets my aching spots without me saying anything. She is super skillful! She just knows which spots need more attention. My body feels instantly lighter and wayyyy more relaxed. The space here is also super clean and hygienic! It’s newly opened and renovated and completely spotless. Definitely the cleanest massage spot I’ve ever been to in Bangkok. The pillows they use are also super high quality and even better than the ones in 5 star hotels! My stress and body aches are always instantly relieved whenever I visit and I always leave feeling super relaxed and happy! They have the best vibes and are super kind and genuine. I would highly highly highly recommend coming here! Thank you so much again!!! :)

ownerUpdates.text: From soil to smoke. 🧑‍🍳🌿 Connect with the land and discover the ancient art of traditional woodfire cooking at Cookventure Home Cooking Studio. 🪵🔥It’s not just about following a recipe card—it’s a sensory exploration of fresh, hand-picked ingredients and real Lanna heritage

Looking for the best cooking class Chiang Mai? 🍳✨ Join us for an authentic culinary journey! Learn how to cook traditional Thai dishes from scratch with our expert chefs in a fun, friendly, and hands-on environment. Perfect for foodies, travelers, and families!

🎒 What’s included: Fresh market tour, organic ingredients, and a recipe book to take home.

📅 Book your spot today and bring the taste of Thailand back home! Click "Learn More" to see our schedule.

POV: The REAL sound of a Northern Thai kitchen! 🔪🇹🇭

Listen to the rhythm of our student mastering the authentic Northern Thai Larb Moo (Spicy Pork Salad) at Cookventure Home Cooking Studio!

If you are looking for the most fun, hands-on, and authentic Thai cooking class in Chiang Mai, you’ve found it. Whether you want a 1-day farm-to-table experience or are looking to apply for the 5-Year DTV Visa Program, we guarantee an unforgettable culinary adventure.

✅ Local market tour included
✅ Cook your own dishes from scratch
✅ Vegetarian & Vegan options available!

Discover the best cooking experience in Chiang Mai with us. Click the button below to secure your spot! 👇

Another amazing day in the kitchen with these fantastic home chefs! 🍳✨ There is nothing we love more than sharing the joy of authentic Thai cooking, lots of laughs, and delicious food. If you are looking for a fun, hands-on Thai cooking class in Chiang Mai, Cookventure Home Cooking Studio is the place to be! Come pound your own curry paste, master the wok, and create delicious memories with us.

Enjoying another fantastic day in the kitchen! 🧑‍🍳✨ There is nothing quite like sharing the art of Thai cooking using fresh, seasonal ingredients sourced directly from local farms. Whether you're exploring the city or looking for a highly recommended DTV cooking class in Chiang Mai, our home-like studio offers a hands-on, sustainable culinary experience. Come cook, taste, and share a great time with us!

Want to create your own edible masterpiece? Join us in the kitchen! 💛

reviews.name: Marie-Amandine Bhika
reviews.text: I’ve been having the best experience at Apple’s cooking school: the classes are excellent with clear instructions, very friendly co-students and the freshest ingredients. I really enjoy that Apple provides vegan substitutes for all the Thai traditional recipes and the dishes I’ve cooked with her are the tastiest I’ve had in the whole of Thailand! She customizes the recipe depending on what you can or cannot eat (being vegetarian, I really appreciate that!) and your spice tolerance (close to zero in my case 😅), and makes her own ingredients such as chili paste, tamarind sauce, etc. She brings her beautiful, bubbly energy into the room, making each class very enjoyable and uplifting. The space is also very nice, nestled in a quiet street and providing a comfortable working station for each student. Come with an empty stomach as you’ll want to eat your creations up to the last crumb!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this wonderful review! 💛 It brings me so much joy to know you had the best experience at Cookventure Home Cooking Studio. We truly believe that authentic Thai food should be enjoyed by everyone, which is why we love customizing our recipes for vegan, vegetarian, and zero-spice diets! Making our own chili paste and tamarind sauce from scratch is our family tradition, and I'm thrilled you could taste the difference. Thank you for bringing your great energy to our Chiang Mai cooking class. Hope to cook with you again!

reviews.name: C Dome
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend this class enough! From the moment I arrived, Apple  was so welcoming and knowledgeable. We started with a market tour to learn about essential Thai ingredients like galangal and kaffir lime leaves, which really set the stage.

The hands-on cooking was perfectly paced, and the step-by-step guidance made even tricky dishes like Khao soi and Green Curry feel achievable. The best part? Sitting down to eat the delicious meal we'd made ourselves.  If you're in Chiang Mai, do yourself a favor and book this—it was the highlight of my trip!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear C Dome, thank you for making us the highlight of your Chiang Mai trip! We are so glad you enjoyed the local morning market tour and learning about essential Thai ingredients like fresh galangal and kaffir lime leaves. Chef Apple takes pride in making complex dishes like authentic Khao Soi and Green Curry feel easy and achievable with step-by-step, hands-on guidance. The best part is definitely sitting down together to enjoy the delicious feast you created! We hope you continue to recreate these amazing Thai recipes in your own kitchen back home.

reviews.name: Chris Noseworthy
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Rachel K.
reviews.text: This is the cooking experience you want! I highly recommend booking this cooking class. Apple is amazing! She picked me up from my hotel right on time, communication was great throughout the experience. We first visited a local market where Apple showed me different products and answered any questions I had. We then arrived at the house and the cooking stations were perfect! This is truly an intimate, special experience that I will remember forever. I got to learn about traditional Thai cooking techniques and recipes. You get to choose the dishes you want to prepare. I made Pad Thai, Papaya Salad, Tom Kha soup, Panang Curry, and Mango Sticky Rice. Everything was delicious and I am so excited to have the recipes to cook this for my family when I get home. Apple and her family are very kind and truly make you feel like you are a part of their family. You can tell she loves what she does and the food she helped me make is better than restaurants I have had. Thank you so much for the fun day! I loved everything about it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Rachel! I loved having you join us — it felt like cooking with family. So happy you enjoyed everything and can’t wait for you to share the recipes at home! 😊❤️🍽️

reviews.name: Brian Droncheff
reviews.text:
Had to take a "cultural class" for my DTV, but honestly I'm kind of glad I did. I learned a lot, particularly that several of the Thai dishes that I love are reasonably simple to make - and very quick. From a health standpoint, I kick myself for not learning this stuff a long time ago. From a food critic standpoint I've found that the Tom Yum soup that Apple taught me how to cook is substantially better than most I've had - particularly due to her style of actually cutting the lemongrass small enough to not have pieces sharding and stabbing me in my mouth and throat while eating. Thai cooks take note - it's surprising to me how many places have not gotten these small details correct.

Apple was a fun teacher too, good spirits. Also, she was willing to do a vegan menu, came up with vegan variations of all the different dishes. Mainly just replacing meat with tofu and mushrooms - really makes me wonder why people insist on meat - the vegan versions were delicious. It should be noted though, it can be a little difficult sometimes, as a vegan (for the animals), smelling a bunch of sizzling flesh or seeing guts (stomach?) being turned in to some kind of sausage. But as far as teaching goes, Apple did a great job, it was reasonably priced and I was able go get through the DTV requirement - and actually happy with what I learned, it turned out to be even better than just fulfilling a DTV requirement.

Thanks Apple!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this honest and wonderful review! We are thrilled that your DTV cultural class requirement turned into a genuinely rewarding culinary experience. Hearing that our finely-sliced lemongrass technique made your Tom Yum soup the best you've had truly makes our day! 🍲✨

We also deeply appreciate your feedback regarding the shared kitchen environment. We completely understand how the sight and smell of meat preparation can be uncomfortable for ethical vegans. Your insight is incredibly valuable, and we will do our best to be more mindful of workstation arrangements in our mixed classes to ensure everyone feels completely at ease. Thank you for cooking with us, and we are so happy we could support your DTV journey in Thailand! 🌿💚

reviews.name: Marc Howells
reviews.text: Fantastic evening spent with my wife and two teenage children being tutored how to cook Thai food by a very knowledgeable and friendly host (Apple). Don’t eat lunch before you come! A very enjoyable experience!

reviews.name: dfwnjc
reviews.text: Disappointing experience. I paid for a 120-minute massage, but the therapist only worked for 105 minutes. They interrupted the session for a 15-minute break, meaning I lost a significant portion of the time I paid for. Not professional at all

reviews.name: JustTheTruth
reviews.text: For killing time, price is OK. Don't expect professional massage, Myanmar labor mostly.

reviews.name: Suresh Narwani
reviews.text: A gem of a massage place. Highly Professional Thai Massage. Therapist Da gave me  90min Hot oil and was I rejuvenated.  The best part is that there are no hustlers trying to pull you in as in other mediocre places. The price is incredibly low and the staff well trained in giving you the level of massage your body will need. If you want a great massage which is reasonably priced  and do not care for luxurious surroundings May massage is the place to go.

reviews.name: Chris Chen
reviews.text: Good massages services shop but they are shorter than service hours.

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text:
Amazing strength and skill to make each stroke and movement so healing and satisfying! Every masseuse that I have had the pleasure of being a customer to has been beyond 5 out of 5 stars!

I never feel rushed or bothered by the atmosphere here.

And I wish I knew how they keep such an amazing price: foot massage 1 hr : 120 thb!

reviews.name: J0 K
reviews.text:
Its my first time been to here according to the recommendation on the internet
I am so lucky that i have a good massage here today!! The one who perform foot massage for me didnt cheat on time!! That's so fantastic.The power is strong enough for me as well! Highly recommend for the others who come near sukhumvit. It is just within 10mins walk to from terminal 21 to the massage shop.

But one thing, i would recommend the shop to raise the hourly price to 150baht instead because some customers may not give tips! As a result, it seems bit unfair to the staffs who work there! At the same time, as customer, we are not required to struggle a lot on how much tips should be rendered (it seems even you paid  tip at 100baht, they are still not satisfied about it)! Even you raise the price to 150baht per hour, i believe its still the cheapest massage in Bangkok!!

reviews.name: daniel alon
reviews.text:
go to this massage place at least every two weeks, I’ve been there over seven times already, and it’s honestly my favorite foot massage spot in Thailand.

It’s not just the price (which is crazy cheap 150 baht for an hour!), it’s also the quality. That’s literally half of what other places charge in the area.
The staff are super experienced, and their technique is really good, strong, focused, and you can feel they actually put effort into it.

Yeah, the place looks kind of basic and low-budget design-wise, but honestly, for 150 baht, what do you expect? Every time I’ve gone, I’ve walked out happy and relaxed. That’s why I keep coming back.

The staff are Burmese, not Thai, but that doesn’t matter to me at all. They’re just good.

reviews.name: Ferdinand Goke
reviews.text: Thai massage was only 150 baht, can’t beat that. Cheapest Thai massage place I found in the whole Bangkok.

reviews.name: Shayan Naveed
reviews.text:
Decent massage place with cheap prices. I paid 150 baht for 1 hour of Thai massage. I think all the masseuse are from Myanmar. They don’t speak much English.
My guy was ok. Got most of the kinks out but also injured me with one intense massage. They play relaxing music while you get massaged also.
They give you a pj to change into.
Overall, not the best massage place to go but you get what you pay for.

reviews.name: Mar Ou
reviews.text: I think it was the worst massage since I’m in Thailand 37 minutes instead of one hour and he just repeated the same movements please don’t give them any money. We don’t have to support this kind of scam

reviews.name: David Roberts
reviews.text: Easily the cheapest massage I've ever had at 150 baht plus 100 tip, but actually one of the best as well. I am used to women massaging me but had a man, and it was very good. Have no concerns any more and would definitely do that again whenever nearby.

reviews.name: Sarvjot singh
reviews.text:
Really a bad experience. They don’t u deans any English. I had a 90
Minute session and after 90 minutes, felt like nothing happened. They didn’t even clean oil properly with a moist cloth. Came here recommended by someone. He may have had a good professional here in the past.
But I believe cheap is cheap.

reviews.name: Fred
reviews.text:
[Leave a review after 2nd time visit]

1st visit: Oil 1hr (280 bhat+100 bhat tip)
2nd visit: foot 1 hr + thai 1 hr (200 bhat +160 bhat tip)

Experience vary depends on masseur.

Just ok place for cheap massage with low expectation. ( I called for killing time..)

Pros: Affordable prices,
Cons: Less cleaness, less professional

If you really need a good satisfied session, I recommend you to choose other higher level places.

reviews.name: nick critelli
reviews.text:
I visited the shop today and had an amazing foot massage. The masseur was incredibly skilled and applied the pressure precisely. I wish I had booked for two hours instead of the one I had.

The only downside was that the staff inside the shop were engrossed in conversations and using their phones, which made the atmosphere less relaxing than I would have preferred. Despite this minor inconvenience, I’m definitely going back.

reviews.name: Zoe Lee
reviews.text: One of the cheapest places I’ve encountered in Sukhumvit (150thb/hr). Not the place to go to if you want a nice ambience, but recommended if you are just looking for a massage. Seems to have more male masseuses than females ones, and they can get quite chatty. However, the massage pressure was strong and good. Overall positive experience and I’d come back for sure.

reviews.name: Kevin B
reviews.text: First of all, the price is right: 150/hr for Thai or foot massage, 300 for oil. The quality can be hit or miss though, and lately it's been more miss. Today's "one hour" massage ended up being only 50 minutes. When I said something about this to the person at the front desk, he didn't have the English ability to or possibly even the interest in entertaining my complaint.

reviews.name: Gabriel Teli
reviews.text: Just for the price it’s deserve 5 stars, the staff don’t speak a lot English but we laughed a lot. And they’re very good. For the price the service is excellent. Just don’t except to be in a  luxury place and you’ll not be disappointed

reviews.name: Yuji 2024
reviews.text: I watched an influencer's YouTube and came here. It was really cheap. It's less than half the price of nearby stores, and the quality is great. Best value for money!

reviews.name: Minhae Elf
reviews.text: Although this is in soi Sukhumvit 23, this place is clean (you know what I mean). I went with a couple of friend. I did not know this place before. With this low price, I did not expect much but at the end I got a nice masseuse!

reviews.name: Andy Regan
reviews.text: Came here a few times and had massages from the men. Very happy and good price. Most recently was assigned one of the female masseuses and at the end she demanded a tip. I don't come from a tipping culture so I didn't know how to respond or how much is appropriate but don't like to cause trouble or offend when in other cultures so I asked how much I should tip and she said 100! I paid and left, yes I know I can refuse but I felt very uncomfortable and not good about the experience. It's a shame, because i am staying in the area for some time and would have kept on coming back and giving them more of my money but now i feel too uncomfortable to go there again 😔 oh also, she cut it short by 15 minutes, surely if you're going to demand a tip you should at least do the full time?

title: Spirit of Siam Muay Thai
ownerDescription:
Prepare your next fight in Thailand or Just learn and practice for fun, lose weight & defend your self?
Of course is possible: we offer everything you need; accommodation, training and clases adapted to your level and language.
-English
-Thai
-Spanish
address: 261 M.7 Tambon Nongkway, Mae Hia, Chiang Mai, 50230, Thailand
plusCode: PXM2+VR Mae Hia, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Michael Gorski
reviews.text:
Dropped into Spirit of Siam while staying in Chiang Mai and ended up training there for several weeks. Super solid gym with a good mix of local and international fighters from all over the world, so every session felt different and challenging in a good way.

Coach Marco runs the place and leads the classes. He’s very hands-on and knows how to push you without burning you out. The sessions are long (around 2.5 hours), but they fly by. I tightened up my technique a lot and got into great shape without it feeling like a grind.

No ego, good energy, and serious training if you want it. I’ll 100% be back here next year when I’m back in Chiang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks for your feedback Michael, we looking forward to have you back for a longer time.
Until then keep training and stay strong

reviews.name: Robin Shape
reviews.text: One of the best authentic Muay Thai Gyms in Chiang Mai without a doubt. Marrco is a phenomenal coach and figther and will help you leverage your skillset to the next level. He´s a real one.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Rob for your review, looking forward to have you back at our place soon 🙏

reviews.name: Alanna Harley
reviews.text: I enjoyed privates with Marco! The group classes are awesome as well filled with some professional fighters. This is a tough gym. They do strength training Tuesdays, Thursdays & Saturdays  & running in the mornings. & Muay Thai in the afternoon and after the morning runs with Saturdays being the half day and Sundays off for recovery & rest. This gym is for strong people & people who aim to get strong/er. This place is legit if you want to Muay Thai fight. Highly recommend & will be back next year.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Alanna for your review, we looking forward to have you back at the house of pain and training with us, stay strong and see you soon

reviews.name: Mason Teeters
reviews.text: Kru Marco is the real deal! If you are looking for a gym that can combine a friendly and safe environment with traditional muay thai techniques, this is the place for you. You can train at whatever intensity you want. Professional or beginners will feel at home here. Also good for international visitors as Marco is fluent in Spanish, English and Thai
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Mason and hope you can keep coming to training with us at the house of pain

reviews.name: Mark
reviews.text:
Highly recommended. I have spent the past few years training here. Never needed to look elsewhere. I started with ZERO experience (and at age 35) and plan on having fight #7 soon. The journey has been amazing. Both physically, mentally, and spiritually.
Beginners and professionals are treated with the same regard as long as you are consistent with coming to training (dedicated to the art).
Strength and conditioning are professionally designed and tailored to fighters.
Instruction is multi-lingual. English, Spanish, and Thai.
Thank you, Kru 💪🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: You did awesome job and huge improvements during this time, I hope you embrace this experience and use it in your daily life.Stay strong always

reviews.name: alexis cappadoro
reviews.text: This camp is great! I've been to several camps in the city, and this is by far the best in Chiang Mai. The manager is incredibly helpful, and the training is intensive. I highly recommend it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your visit Alex, hope you can comeback next time longer

reviews.name: Ryan Astaphan
reviews.text:
Great Great Great!

The head trainer here explains everything so clearly (he speaks Thai, English, and Spanish). His style is flexible to suit you and he does a great job of making you feel welcomed and comfortable.

Before his life as a trainer Marco was a fighter. First in Spain and then for years living and training in Thailand. He reached a high level of competition. And with that experience he teaches you how to do things flawlessly.

I have nothing but good things to say about him and his gym.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Ryan for your feedback, looking forward to helping you to improve more and more in the muay thai

reviews.name: Salanya Lasagna
reviews.text: I’ve never met a Muay Thai kru more dedicated and nurturing than Marco. He understands the importance of balancing energy which is clearly shown through his training, his life and the way he takes care of his students. It’s been life changing to meet Marco, and learning how to become a warrior through his hard work, his love and his compassion. It’s an opportunity to be training beside him and the team, and I’m honored to be a part of it. Thank you for welcoming me to the family!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback, hope you keep working hard and unlocking more doors to connect with your truly potential 🙏

reviews.name: Sebas Puente
reviews.text:
This gym is the definition of discipline, encouragement, passion, vision, desire, and high standards when it comes to manners and respect. I had the opportunity to train with Marco when I came to Chiang Mai and I was in a rough place in life and he picked me up from
The floor and put me back on track. If you want to be well trained and become a machine this is the temple you need to be at. Hands down to Marco and his passion for the sport.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Sebas you did a good job and improved certain skills that can also be useful for your daily life by training at the gym
With us, hope you are well and keep it safe

reviews.name: metalplayer2505
reviews.text:
This is the best place to train real MuayThai in Chiang Mai, Marco is an experienced fighter and a well prepared professional trainer with great professional fighters and champions on his team.
I've been to multiple muaythai gyms here in Thailand and Spirit Of Siam has been the best one.
If you want to pursue a professional career on MuayThai or just learn this beautiful art, this is the place to go.
I will come back here any time i can 💪💪💪
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Is a place for those who are really dedicated, discipline and hungry for achieving their best version and you are on of those hard workers thank you for choosing us

reviews.name: lucas dando
reviews.text:
This is My third trip to this camp the training here is second to none... girls and guys train here from advanced to beginners and also fighters.
Marco has a strong passion for Muay Thai but also excellent knowledge about all aspects of health, food, recovery and the body. I doubt you would find more flexible humble trainer with as much drive as Marco.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your words Lucas, hope you still coming to join us many more times

reviews.name: Mathias Dschulnigg
reviews.text:
It's the best gym I've ever been to! I was well received by everyone. The trainer marco has such a great knowledge of muay thai and is also a very wise man outside of training.
I was here for a month and enjoyed training with the people here. They are great people there... both as people and as fighters. I have learned a lot.
I would love to come back!
Hope see you soon
Greetings Mathias
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for join us and expend one month at the gym, we looking forward to have you back anytime soon, you are more than welcome 
Stay strong

reviews.name: Joseph Thomas
reviews.text: Outstanding training and mentoring from coach Marco I have been with the gym just over a year now I did have plans to head down south to start my fighting career but there was no need once i came across spirit of siam. the gym and Marco have changed my life for the better I can't see me improving like the way I have any where else I have seen all levels come through the gym and the care and passion for coaching muay thai is giving to all that step through spirit of siams doors I highly recommend this gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
This is just the beginning of what is coming next, keep working hard and stay consistent in your training
🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Jeff Chan
reviews.text: The gym is amazing and training is top notch! Fully equip with everything you need and well maintained. Coach Marco is a gem and helped my students and I tremendously throughout our time in Chiang Mai. His hospitality and knowledge won’t be forgotten. Thank you again! Kaa
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks Jeff for trust our gym and organize your camp here with us.
we looking forward to see you back again soon, appreciate your words

reviews.name: Ryder Offshore
reviews.text: I’ve been to Chiang Mai to learn from Marco twice. Each time I left feeling more confident and inspired than when I arrived. Marco places heavy emphasis on building a strong foundation with the basics. Because of this, I believe that I will carry many of the skills I acquired while training with him for the rest of my life. Thank you for everything brother! Hopefully I will be back to train with you soon.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Happy to hear from you Ryder and thanks a lot for the feedback, looking forward to train with you again and sharing more useful content that helps to improve more and more in the Muay Thai and also in lifestyle

reviews.name: manu ruiz
reviews.text: I was training there with a friend during our stance in chiang mai and we really recomend this place to train and learn muay thai. Good atmosphere and the teacher is always paying attention too you. Very recomendable!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Manu for come to train with us and feel very welcome to join us any other time

reviews.name: Schahla
reviews.text:
This is probably the best gym and the best gym in the world. Marco the trainer and owner is always striving for excellence in himself and for every student. He wont only guide you in your training he is running with you, lifting weights with you, fighting with you and laughing with you. He always searches for ways to improve, he will build a trainings shedule that will include Elements from all kind of sports, be it gymnastics, football, crossfit, anything and everything that can teach you something to master Muay Thai. And he wont only train your Body, he is an incredible Person that will lead you to master your mind and teaches you that the sky is the limit and that you are much stronger than you ever believed, in training AND in life!
This sounds like a loveletter because it is. Marco and the gym will forever have a place in my heart and they will have it in erveryones who has the privilege to train there.

reviews.name: Kevin Sargent
reviews.text: It's rated 5/5 by every reviewer for a reason. Marco is the most technical kru I've worked with by far. This gym also requires the most stamina of any gym I've been to. Many dub it the House of Pain. Physically exhausting workouts beyond what you're used to at other gyms. Make sure your healthy and conditioned before visiting. The gym is loaded with talent so expect to work hard.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate your thoughts Kevin and looking forward to train with you more and more for a near future

reviews.name: Quirin Brettmeister
reviews.text:
The hardest gym I’ve been to, training is of incomparable quality. Trainer Marco manages to create a WHOLESOME training by himself. Highly recommendable.

Thanks for having me.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Quirin for your review and very welcome to join us anytime, we building strong people physically and mentally

reviews.name: Kornkanok Kampek
reviews.text:
The best Muay Thai gym and also the best Coach.
I had a good experience in here, Coach always say don’t give up and keep teaching me how to kick,punch and do exercise I hope one day I will go back to this gym again, really miss coach and friends there ☺️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your feedback Kitty we really like to have you around and train with us, you always put the heart in each training session 💪👏

title: BX12 Boxing Gym
ownerDescription: BOX12, Bangkok’s premium boxing gym
address: 1624 Phetchaburi Rd, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
plusCode: PHX6+FX Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Jack Chan
reviews.text:
Excellent gym for learning the sweet science. Air conditioned gym and convenient location. All staff and coaches are very friendly and care about your progress and improving.
Each group class has stretching, warm up exercises, skipping rope, technical drills, pad rounds with a trainer, and sometimes bag work and/or light technical sparring. Coaches vary exercises according to your fitness and skill level so everyone is welcome and can participate.
Gym is clean and fully equipped with necessary gear, including weights and kettlebells.

reviews.name: JoM
reviews.text:
I try to find a boxing gym wherever I travel and this gym fits the bill! Clean, spacious and has A/C that is appreciated especially if doing a 1.5 hour workout 😅
If you are thinking of getting your boxing workout in BKK come to this place!
The coach and its team are very helpful and will truly give you a workout worth every sweat and will leave satisfied.
I notice they were very patient with a beginner. In regard to someone that has experience- the coaches coach you more to be better!
If I live in BKK, I'll be here everyday! Also, it's conveniently located next to an MRT stop which is a minute walk 👍

reviews.name: Claire Priestley
reviews.text: Quality authentic boxing training in well designed, air conditioned gym. The team are friendly, superb coaches offering a range of classes, for all levels and ages,  personal training, sparring and fight training Regardless of experience or fitness level this is the boxing place to train in BKK. Thanks for awesome training Pleng and team!

reviews.name: Kristina Kotelnikova
reviews.text: Amazing gym, I did a class , died and returned back to life. Good coaches very friendly and professional. Small but perfect gym! You have showers and all the equipment you need. Variable work outs. 100% coming back! Thank you Ting!

reviews.name: Sophie Lombart
reviews.text: We've already been there three times and we'll definitely be going back again! A great gym with amazing coaches who really listen and adapt to your level. The atmosphere is motivating and supportive — you feel yourself improving with every session!

reviews.name: Stas B.
reviews.text:
POSITIVES:
=======================
Amazing gym with great instructors, clean showers, dry and well maintained equipment, good routine that includes guided warmup, intensive conditioning, pad pummeling with great combos, and sometimes light technical sparing.

And the location is amazing as well - less than 1 minute walking distance from the MRT station.

Went there for a month, and was able to spar much better in my gym, after I got back.

NEGATIVES
==================================
The only drawbacks of this gym is the price and the air conditioner.

600 bhat is a bit on a pricy side, but the morning 09:30 time slot is a "happy hour", costing only 350 bhat on weekdays.

I, personally, found the air conditioner too cold for my liking, and even caught a cold a couple of times, in spite of wearing wool clothes from decathlon, especially after getting sweaty and then being cooled by the aircon.

reviews.name: chanakarn rungtao
reviews.text:
great location among asoke , 100 m nearby mrt petchaburi station
> professional boxing trainers
> learn and develop in-deep boxing technical
> body weight & circuit workout  session
> parking lot
>  shower room
;) come and enjoy.

reviews.name: Thanarat MANEERAT
reviews.text: Clean, friendly atmosphere, and competent/skilled coaches.

reviews.name: Ming Kern
reviews.text: Took a private class here and it was amazing !

reviews.name: danny madani
reviews.text: BX12 Boxing Gym is an awesome spot for anyone looking to get in shape, learn real boxing techniques, and train in a motivating environment. The coaches are experienced, supportive, and push you to be your best. The vibe is friendly but focused—perfect for all levels. Highly recommend! 🥊

reviews.name: Mark
reviews.text:
Went for PT the first time with Ten Ten. Very patient and friendly trainer.

Training was enjoyable so we went back again to join the evening class. It was also fun and the rest of the trainers are friendly and patient. Made the whole experience super enjoyable.

Gym is clean and they have shower facilities.

You know the gym and coaches are legit when you look at how their students or members move and throw punches.

Definitely recommend this place to beginners or seasoned boxers!

reviews.name: Edwin Ng
reviews.text:
BX12 is one of the top-notch Western boxing gyms in Thailand. I've been training here since 2022, and it's been an incredible experience. The coaches are highly skilled and professional, creating a welcoming and supportive environment.
The sparring culture is friendly and respectful, making it ideal for boxers of all levels.
Additionally, the training equipment and facilities are among the best in Bangkok.
I highly recommend it to anyone looking to improve their skills or start their boxing journey!

reviews.name: Luke Vella
reviews.text: The gym is big and spacious and has high quality equipment. The coaches are excellent and are all exceptionally skilled with the pads. The group classes are great and everyone is friendly and welcoming to all levels so it's particularly good for beginners.

reviews.name: D Lee
reviews.text: Proper boxing gym for every individuals who wants to give a try and/or contunue their boxing experience. Definitely recommended

reviews.name: HD SM
reviews.text: Clean boxing gym with aircon. Coaches are friendly. I recommend this place for everyone, absolute beginners to intermediate players, from children to elderly, local and foreginers. Also the location is very convenient.

reviews.name: Ma Yi
reviews.text: Coaches are all patience, the Gym is clean and comfortable. I’ve joined the morning happy hour for a month, really enjoyed those time.  I’ve improved my body training, learned basic boxing combos. Really recommend this place.

reviews.name: Matthew Holmes
reviews.text: Amazing boxing gym catering for all abilities. Bx12 create a welcoming and warm atmosphere to ensure everyone can get the most out of their training. I am a competitive boxer and the training is great, but the coaches also cater for newcomers or first time boxers. The staff are extremely friendly and welcoming and the facilities are some of the best I have seen in Bangkok. Would highly recommend bx12 to everyone.

reviews.name: T K
reviews.text:
I've been coming to this gym for around a year now. The coaching staff has been nothing short of exemplary in terms of helping me to develop my boxing ability and reaching my goals. From the very basics of boxing fundamentals to being able to participate in light sessions. BX12 has taught me everything I need to become a better boxer in every aspect.

The coaches are more than happy to give me feedback on specific boxing scenarios. For example, I would ask the coach why do I keep getting hit in the stomach during my sparring sessions. He would then arrange for my next class to focus more on my footwork and defensive maneuvers to help me to avoid body shots as well as understanding timing to counter these incoming shots.

The facility is air con and very clean with showers however, you will need to bring your own towels.

reviews.name: Ronan Mahony
reviews.text: Tried a boxing class here. Instructor was really friendly and catered to my beginner level. I feel like I learned a lot on just one class. Will definitely return.

reviews.name: Arti Sukasem
reviews.text: The gym is very clean. All the gears (hand wraps, gloves) are provided. The trainers are very experienced. This is suitable for all experienced boxers and newbies

title: Tuang thong massage for health
ownerDescription: Thai Massage and Foot Massage massage in a clean cute room across from a beautiful temple
address: 13 Thapae Rd Soi 4, Chang Khlan Sub-district, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXQW+49 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Emily Venus
reviews.text:
On my first week in Chiang Mai I had a foot massage here and it was so good, I felt much lighter in my legs and feet. I didn’t come back for a while because I wanted to try other places while I was here. I’ve been here for four months (studying Thai massage as I am a massage therapist at home) and on my last week have remembered this place and come in for a few full body Thai massages because I have chronic lower back pain. The massages have been incredible. I’ve been massaged by most of the therapists here and they’re all very good. Great varied technique and great pressure and they listen to you if you have specific tensions or pain.
I am confused at some of the one star reviews? I would just ignore them.
This place is the real deal and it is the best traditional Thai massage I have had in chiang mai so far!  Honestly I cannot recommend this place enough, the quality of massage for the price is incredible!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากๆนะคะทางร้านของเรายินดีให้บริการลูกทุกท่านค่ะ 🙏

reviews.name: 樊宇
reviews.text: It was a very good experience. I came across this shop by chance while passing by, and there weren’t many people. I chose a foot massage, but was pleasantly surprised by how experienced the therapist was—it felt amazing. I’d definitely like to come back for another massage next time. If you’re staying near Tha Phae Gate, I highly recommend giving it a try. Although the décor is quite simple, the people feel genuine and down-to-earth. The person who gave me the massage is named La-on. She is a female therapist, and you can ask for her if you come for a massage.

reviews.name: Paul Lomas
reviews.text:
Nan is exceptional at Thai massage.

Just had my second one whilst I am here in Chiang Mai and my body is feeling amazing
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ,ร้านของเรายินดีให้บริการลูกค้าทุกท่านค่ะ 🙏

reviews.name: Raksha
reviews.text: Had a Thai massage. Loved it. No fake tourist trap with a so-called masseuse cracking your neck, or body-to-body massage. You come in, are welcomed kindly by the ladies who work there. They have an outfit they ask you to get changed into behind a curtain, you lie down and just go with the flow. No talk, sometimes she asks you if the pressure is okay. Enjoyed every minute of it. Khob khun ka!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะ ทางร้านของเรายินดีให้บริการลูกค้าทุกๆท่านค่ะ🙏

reviews.name: Foreign Tv
reviews.text: Massage was great, literally fixed my rotator cuff issue and got my right shoulder and wrist (both have metal plates in them) moving further than they’ve moved before. Would recommend definitely but be aware you will be butt naked, masseuse was very intricate and respectful!

title: Sting Hive Muay Thai Gym
ownerDescription: STING HIVE provides the best MUAY THAI TRAINING in Chiang Mai Thailand. Trained by professional MUAY THAI coaches.
address: Sriphum, Arak Rd Old City Tambon Si Phum, Muang, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXVH+WF Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Tanarak Chua
reviews.text:
Price : Cheap. They have gloves and handwrap for rent.💪
Training : beginner friendly. They have "1st time MuayThai tag" and train you separately if you are new to MuayThai, and they have sparring session for an intermediate level as well. No extra price charged. 👏👏👏
Atmosphere : spacious, bigggg, plenty of parking lots. There are things to do as well, such as massage, cafe, and healthy food.🥑
Overall : 10/10 I have a nice experienced from this place. 👏👏👏

reviews.name: chiangmaicharlies
reviews.text:
I am not a gym person (too old for one thing) but I have just looked around Sting Hive and was very impressed.

Very spacious, a lot of equipment and the reviews of those who do use this gym are nearly all five star.  I chatted with the owner who was extremely friendly and helpful.

Without trying it myself certainly a gym I would recommend to anybody who wanted one in Chiang Mai.

Additionally there is a lovely little sandwich and drinks unit with delicious stuff that I did try.

reviews.name: Andrea Pientka
reviews.text: Arrived 20 minutes before the 11 AM session without prior booking and was still able to join. One group session with rented wrist wraps is 350 Baht for 90 minutes. There’s about five minutes of stretching, a bit of warm up and then beginners and more experienced fighters get split into two groups. The coaches were super patient and attentive. They broke the individual moves down into individual steps which made it easy to get the technique right. They took time to correct each of us for form and execution. Afterwards I got maybe four 3-minute rounds of pad sessions with different coaches to practice what I’d just learned. There was a good ratio of coaches to students. We finished with a good 5-10 minutes of hitting the bags, some cardio that got me out of puff and a few stretches. I was sweating but I wasn’t fully exhausted after the 90 minutes and felt good. During individual pad work I would’ve preferred to get corrected a few more times as I’m sure my movements and foot work wasn’t 100% - bit where I want to be pushed a bit more, the next person enjoys celebrating that they get a sense of achievement after learning some basics. All in all, I’d wholeheartedly recommend this gym for beginners. It’s spacious and clean and the atmosphere was really nice.

reviews.name: Mar Riam
reviews.text: I've been coming here for over six months now and I really like this place. You can book both group and private classes. The group classes are a good mix of training + workout, if you're looking to prepare for a fight or like tailored tutoring you can book private classes. The coaches are lovely and I've met so many friendly other students there as well. This place is a community and I've formed a bunch of great friendships due to it. 💛 Sting love!

reviews.name: Hanna Poole
reviews.text:
I didn’t expect to love Muay Thai as much as I did, and Sting Hive is the reason! I ended up spending 6 weeks in chiang mai and it became part of my routine and I can’t wait to be back.

Everyone here is so welcoming and friendly, and it’s perfect for beginners to feel comfortable as they take the time to properly take you through everything safely.

Thanks to everyone I trained with, I miss you all!

reviews.name: Ashley Loiseau
reviews.text:
I had such a great experience training here! The pad work and sparring sessions were excellent
really good balance between pushing you and making sure you learn proper technique. The coaches are super friendly and encouraging, which makes the atmosphere very welcoming no matter your level. Highly recommend this gym to anyone visiting Chiang Mai who wants to train Muay Thai!

reviews.name: Robert S
reviews.text:
Our Muay Thai class was an incredible experience, and we couldn’t have asked for better instructors. After watching a real Muay Thai boxing match the night before, this was something my friends and I were genuinely excited to try—and the instructors made it approachable, fun, and empowering.

Each instructor was patient, encouraging, and extremely skilled, taking the time to teach us proper technique while making sure everyone felt comfortable and confident, no matter their experience level. They broke everything down clearly and made the class engaging from start to finish.

What made it even more special was how personal and authentic it felt—it wasn’t just a workout or a lesson, it was a true cultural and athletic experience. We left with a new respect for the sport and a sense of accomplishment we’ll always remember.

If you’re even considering taking a Muay Thai class, do it—and hope you get these instructors. It was easily one of the highlights of our trip.

reviews.name: Larnia Ryder
reviews.text: I had my first ever Muay Thai session at Sting Hive and enjoyed it so much it became a regular visit during my time in Chiang Mai. The team are all professional, knowledgeable, kind and helpful. The vibe is great here. The facilities are also great and everything feels clean. Can’t recommend enough - thank you!

reviews.name: julie moylan
reviews.text: We had a really good beginner experience at this gym. It was my boyfriend and I’s first time. We all warmed up together before one instructor, PJ, took all the beginners and we did a session in front of the mirror where he brought us through how to properly punch, hook, kick, knee etc etc..I’m left handed which means I couldn’t follow exactly along with what PJ was doing so another coach stepped in beside me and did the movements as if she was left handed and footed so that I could copy her. Once we had practiced that, we sparred with either PJ or the other coach like 2/3 times each. Then we joined the rest of the class, did cardio for 10 minutes followed my a cool down. Overall it was a really good first timer Muay Thai experience. The coaches know what they’re doing, they have really great English, and they’re funny, nice people. The gym is spotless also.

reviews.name: Rafał Gicgier
reviews.text: Cool Muay Thai Gym with cool coaches. Even though the grupes are mixed - it's pretty easy to get a nice training partner or focus on yourself, as parts of the training are trained individually, in the ring.

reviews.name: Aaron T
reviews.text: One of the best Muay Thai experiences as beginner. The gym is newly opened as a branch to Sting club with new, clean facilities and smoothie store alongside. The training drills down on foundational basics and making the most out of your 1.5 hours worth of private training. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Carl
reviews.text: I would like to sincerely express a super big thank you to my coach P. He is extremely dedicated, patient, and meticulous in teaching us, always offering encouragement along the way. He is a very nice person, and I highly recommend him if you are also interested in learning Muay Thai.🥊👍

reviews.name: Dr. Sandra Gewalt
reviews.text:
Overall good. Trainers are good.
If you show your motivation, they support you.
Prefect for tourists who want to play muay thai for the first time.
If you are a fighter who wants to prepare for a fight, this gym will not be for you.
Price is good. Equipment is ok.
They have a late group training at 6:30 pm. If you missed the other Gyms training at 5pm, you can have a light workout here.

reviews.name: Karim Butt
reviews.text:
Used to come here and it was my favorite gym because the instructors were great and the gym was clean.

Came here and brought some friends and quality has gone down. Instructors only trained us for 3 rounds and 1.5 minutes per round. It was 300 baht for 4.5 minutes of instruction. The rest they expect you to jump rope, shadow box and do jump rope. Can do that myself anywhere and don’t need to pay for that.

Won’t be coming back here ever and recommend others choose many of the other great Muay Thai gyms around the area.

reviews.name: Pookkpikk
reviews.text: Sting hive has all the gear you need, plus an Airbnb on-site and a salon. The vibe is super chill, and the staff is really helpful if you have questions. Love this placeee💖🔥🔥

reviews.name: Cindy Kranenburg
reviews.text: Very nice guys and a lot of trainers for the group! They had all different levels at the same time but were great at switching between us! Also nice modern place with good equipment and fans.

reviews.name: Otilia Pandelea
reviews.text: This was my first time trying Muay Thai and I took both group and private classes here. The instructors are very dedicated and I would definitely come back :) Special thanks to Kit for being so supportive and encouraging, he made the experience even better with each class.

reviews.name: Howard Todd
reviews.text:
I think this is my favorite gym in cm at the moment. The trainers Sŏng, Open, Nuea, Cha, Futbon and the rest are really great trainers and the vibe is awesome.

Trainer Michael teaches me super powerful moves like you see in videogame💥
-ฟักทอง

reviews.name: อังคณา เกษรพุด
reviews.text: Today be first time here for me,gym good teacher so kind and professional,have car park and good environment, recommend 👍

reviews.name: Denis
reviews.text:
Facilites are clean and gym is well stocked with modern equipment.

The standard of training overall is poor and the class was disorganised with many 'trainers' participating but nobody taking charge.
Actual Muay Thai training is a small part of the overall class with the other parts consisting of fairly generic bag work and circuit training like push ups and sit ups. Also some of the trainers do not like teaching basics to beginners and as a result they don't give much enthusiasm or energy.

reviews.name: P. Hong
reviews.text:
This was honestly the best massage experience I’ve ever had in Thailand. I was really impressed and would definitely recommend everyone to give it a try.
It’s a Swedish massage, which is a bit different from a typical Thai massage. It feels more like an oil massage that helps relieve tension while also being very relaxing. They also include cupping therapy as part of the session.
The therapist has over 10 years of experience working abroad and has completed more than 3,000 hours of specialized massage training in Canada. So you can be confident you’re in very good hands.
The therapist’s skills are excellent, the place is very clean, and the price is actually very reasonable. Compared to many other Thai massage shops, some are even more expensive. It’s definitely worth every baht.
I really hope this place becomes popular so it can stay open for a long time… but at the same time, I kind of don’t want it to get too popular because I’m afraid it’ll be fully booked all the time haha 😆

reviews.name: Jerry Greer
reviews.text: Not just a Thai massage school - Boonthumme is a spiritual temple for Buddhist chanting and merit offerings. Classes are taught in a watch and experience then practice style that makes for a deeper understanding of the techniques than simply following a play list. I took classes in Thai massage and also Tok Sen over almost 3 week and fell in love with the school and the teachers.

reviews.name: Jamie van Praagh
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Boonthumme Thai Massage School – Hang Dong, Chiang Mai

I’ve been practicing massage for nearly 20 years and studied in Thailand a few times. Most schools just teach fixed sequences and routines — but this place is on another level.

Boonthumme is the most therapeutic and inspiring school I’ve ever attended. It’s not about memorising steps, it’s about reading the body, finding what’s wrong, and treating real problems. That’s a rare skill in Thai massage.

Aon (the founder’s son) and his wife Leela are phenomenal. Their ability to look at someone, see the issue, and work directly on it is next-level. I had major shoulder surgery and chronic pain for years. Without me even saying, Aon spotted the problem and treated it — I felt genuine relief.

This school doesn’t just teach massage. It teaches awareness, healing, and how to really help people. If you’re serious about bodywork, go here.

#ThaiMassage #Healing #TherapeuticMassage #ChiangMai #AuthenticThaiMassage #MassageTraining #Bodywork

reviews.name: Joshua Beneventi
reviews.text: If you know, you know. Pichest is the master! Come with a beginners mind, be patient, don’t take it so seriously, and I guarantee your time invested here will be one of the experiences that you will cherish down the road. His son, Aon, also offers a basic 2 day course to cover the basics of Thai massage, if you don’t have experience… and his daughter in law, Lee, offers a Tok Sen course which I highly recommend as well… another master. 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Mirabelle Arts
reviews.text: What an inspiring place! I spent a few days here as a way to introduce myself to this world. The space is extremely accommodating to curiosity and I felt immediately at ease. From the offering on the first morning (fruit, candles, incense and flowers from the market) to observing a real master at work, I learnt so much is such a short time. The lessons aren’t formally structured but I observed that this allows deep learning to take place. I hope to come back for a much longer time next time. Thank you, ขอบคุณ.

reviews.name: Q L
reviews.text:
I had the incredible opportunity to learn Thai massage from Leela and Aon, the children of the late Thai massage master, Mr. Pichest. Their dedication to preserving their father's legacy is truly commendable. They are not only skilled instructors but also incredibly humble and kind individuals.

What sets their teaching apart is that it's based on specific problems from the students. There are no books or fixed routines to follow. It's a unique learning experience, but it could be a bit of a shock for new students. I recommend coming prepared to adapt and open your mind to this dynamic approach. It's a beautiful way to learn Thai massage because it's tailored to individual needs.

I also suggest saving at least two weeks to study with them to fully absorb their teachings and get used to this personalized learning style. It's a worthwhile investment that will provide you with a deep understanding of Thai massage and its healing potential.

If you're passionate about Thai massage or seeking to learn this beautiful art in a unique and personalized way, I highly recommend Leela and Aon. They are exceptional instructors, and I can't wait to see how their teachings continue to impact my practice.

Lily from U.S.

reviews.name: Bryson Lloyd
reviews.text:
**update** I got news that Ajarn Pichett Boonthume has passed. Very sad 😞 unfortunately you will not be able to receive his incredible teachings although his son and his sons wife leela will still be there, I’m not sure if they will continue practicing in the same manner. They both teach very well and would be worth going to learn from if you can find out if they are still active in the same way. His son may just take over for him.

If you’re looking to further your practice as a healing Practionier.. there’s no better place than here with Ajarn (teacher) Pichest Boonthume. He’s a renowned master for very good reason.

I came here from the recommendation of my Thai massage teacher in the USA and very happy I made the choice to go here instead of a traditional school. Prepare yourself for an entirely different learning experience and preferably do not come here unless you have some amount of training in Thai healing arts or extensive training in healing modalities.

You can optionally train with his son Aon and learn the Thai massage techniques taught in schools if you want to learn the flows and basic techniques (which I definitely recommend if you have no background in healing modalities)

I also took their Tok Sen course with Leela.

Would highly recommend that as well. Was so nice to have personalized instruction and she teaches the vibrational method as opposed to the hitting method. I find it much more appealing

Lastly come here with as little preconceptions as possible and you’ll do well

reviews.name: Owen Sun
reviews.text:
Absolutely DO NOT go to this place — especially if you are a tourist.

I booked a 2-hour Thai massage, but the massage lasted only around 90 minutes. Being shorted 30 minutes is not a small mistake — it feels intentional and dishonest.

The massage itself was even worse. The therapist was extremely lazy and unprofessional. Many times during the session, the pressure suddenly dropped to almost nothing, clearly testing whether I had fallen asleep so they could stop putting in effort. This was NOT about light pressure preference — it genuinely felt like the therapist was not actually massaging at all.

What’s most unacceptable is that this was not an isolated case. After leaving, I spoke with my friend who visited the same spa, and they experienced the exact same thing: shorter massage time and a therapist who barely did any real work.

This place appears to take advantage of customers, particularly tourists who may not notice the shortened time or feel uncomfortable complaining. The service does NOT match the price, and the experience was extremely disappointing.

Save your money and go somewhere else.

title: Lan Po Muay Thai Gym
ownerDescription:
Lann Po Muay Thai Gym offers traditional Muay Thai training for beginners, intermediate and professional fighters of all levels and all nationalities. Our coaches have several years of experience, which they share during our daily group classes or in 1 on 1 sessions. No matter if you want to improve your general fitness level, your Muay Thai skills, prepare for competitions abroad or fight take parts in fights in Thailand.
You will also find a Muay Thai shop on our property, where you buy things like, boxing gloves, shinguards, hand wraps and much more.

reviews.name: Madhava Prasad
reviews.text: For a crash course on what Muay Thai feels like, this is your go to spot. Our aged instructor was a bit fast in teaching techniques and started training on pads and bags. If you aren't interested in sports and agility, this is not the place for you. The training is fast paced and very very quick. Would recommend to anyone who wants to get the feel of how Muay thai works. Recommended with caution.

reviews.name: Thomas Vandewalle
reviews.text:
I have been training kickboxing for 3-4 years and would recommend taking a class here. I followed a couple of group classes here and was amazed about the level of personal coaching you receive. We had 4 participants and 3 trainers. The trainers really paid attention to my technique and corrected me as much as possible.

The exercises were a bit basic but since I lacked the elbow techniques and they were correcting me frequently I'm sure this was more because of my level than anything else. Only thing that would improve the experience is the communication in English. For some details about the technique it would have helped. In the end I would definitely recommend this gym.

reviews.name: Niki
reviews.text:
Our son at 11 decided to join a class here at Lan Po. It was a good experience for him, and he came back here a few times. He was trained by a focused trainer (the owner), doing great with the educational side of things.
UNFORTUNATLY our other son at 13 did not have the best experience here! He was knocked out by the same trainer!! Yes, knocked out... The trainer wanted to take on our son in a round of sparring, after he was told to spar at 30% power, and ended up knocking him out, followed by a loooong talk about respect and life.
This is in NO WAY okay, and unfortunatly we can´t recommend this gym to anyone.
The 3 stars are for the good experience our youngest son had, and we will acknowledge that.

reviews.text: One of the best and most rewarding experiences in Thailand. I was privileged to have a one-on-one session. The trainer is in his 60s and dishes out teeps and hooks as though he were in his 30s. He is a true master of his craft, and I would highly recommend attending a class

reviews.name: Ferditheking “Soup de caramel” Simp
reviews.text:
I trained at this gym for three months, coming in with about one month of kickboxing experience and no prior Muay Thai background. From the start, the level of technical detail and discipline stood out. Training here is very technical with an old-school feel, and the small class sizes—usually fewer than eight people—make a huge difference. Individual attention is high, and if you show up consistently, the coaches genuinely remember you and track your progress.

I trained twice a day, six days a week for the full three months. The conditioning is extremely tough but very thoughtful. It’s not random punishment—it’s clearly structured to build real fight-ready fitness. I’ve never been in better shape in my life, and honestly, one session here felt like five back home. The training is very hard, but always fair.

The gym itself is small compared to larger commercial facilities, but it has everything you actually need: proper equipment, showers, and even an ice bath. The equipment is in great condition. I had my own gear, but you can also borrow equipment if needed.

What really makes the place special is the environment. I came with two friends and ended up making many more. The vibe is serious during training, but very warm outside of it. I felt like part of a family with both the coaches and the management. We regularly did things together after training—eating, playing soccer, just spending time together. The coaches are very kind outside of training, but fully locked in and focused during sessions, which creates a perfect balance.

The confidence I gained here is real, but what impacted me even more is how deeply I learned to respect Muay Thai as an art. This gym truly builds fighters—one of my close friends took three fights while training here and won all three by knockout. That says a lot about the level of preparation.

Even after months of very intense training, I was always excited to come in, whether early in the morning or tired in the afternoon. I grew close with everyone and met people from all over through the gym.

If I had to recommend one gym to someone trying Muay Thai for the first time, this would genuinely be it—it’s very inviting despite the high level. At the same time, it’s also ideal for experienced fighters who want serious technical development and real fight preparation.

I also want to thank Coach J for his help behind the scenes. He was extremely helpful in advising me on lesson options and packages, and also assisted with various practical details. Everything was clear, honest, and well thought out, which made the whole experience very smooth.

The atmosphere at the gym is welcoming, professional, and perfect for anyone who seriously wants to learn boxing — whether you’re a beginner or more advanced. I’ve learned a lot in a short time and felt supported throughout.

I will definitely come back to Lionshead Boxing Gym to continue improving and practicing the sport. Highly recommended! 🥊💪

reviews.name: Jirawat Matchim
reviews.text:
The best boxing gym I've ever been to in Bangkok. I had a long break of almost 9 years from boxing and all sports. Luckily, a friend recommended this gym to me, and I decided to give it a go.

What made me want to come back were the coaches. Especially the head coach, who reminds me of my old coach from when I was active with my training. They are strict enough to push people to give their best, but also very understanding.

The gym also has all boxing gear available for you to borrow if you don't have your own equipment. I highly recommend this place whether you're a complete beginner or someone with more experience.

reviews.name: Sock Teng Ng
reviews.text:
Lion's Head is easily my favourite boxing gym~

The coaches don't make you tired just for the sake of it—they genuinely focus on teaching proper technique and the little details that help you improve. Even the strength & conditioning sessions are tough, but they really push you to become stronger and better, not just exhausted.

On top of that, the vibes are amazing. Great coaches, great people, and such a welcoming environment. I'll really miss training here and will definitely be back the next time I'm in Bangkok.🥊❤️

reviews.name: David Clark
reviews.text: ... more than a boxing gym... after many years of boxing I can say that this place is one of a kind....if you want to learn a sport, get fit, make friends and feel part of a community, then come to Lions Head. Many people are interested in boxing, but do not how to get started. Just come down to the club and talk with the coaches and members. You will be pleasantly surprised. From beginners to fighters, everyone feels welcome and everyone is catered for. Lions Head breeds respect for the sport and respect for each other. After 20 years of training, I continue learn new things at Lions Head ... boxing technique, mental resilience, physical endurance, composure, humility and focus... that is the beauty of the sport and why i keep coming to Lions Head. See you at the club :)

reviews.name: jk
reviews.text:
I’m a beginner who has been training at this gym for about 3 months now, and overall I’ve had a really good experience. The coaches are friendly and patient, and they always take time to correct my basics and give helpful tips during class, which makes a big difference for someone new like me.

The atmosphere is welcoming and not intimidating, and I feel comfortable asking questions or going at my own pace. The location is also quite convenient, especially coming from work.

Overall, it’s a solid place to train and improve, especially if you’re just starting out and looking for a supportive environment 👍

reviews.name: hein zayar
reviews.text: The boxing gym has a very energetic and motivating atmosphere that makes training enjoyable. The coaches are friendly and helpful, especially for beginners learning basic techniques. Overall, it is a great place to improve fitness and learn boxing skills.

reviews.name: Kai Yu
reviews.text: Coach and fighters are very welcomed for everyone even when you are just dropping in for single class. I have only tried three classes including sparring and fighter classes but already feel like I am one of their families in the gym. Recommended to try it. They got two gyms located different places.

reviews.name: Chih-Hao Chen
reviews.text:
I had a great training experience there over the past two months.
All the coaches are friendly and knowledgeable, and they actively correct your movements to help you improve.
I started as a complete beginner in boxing, and now I love it.
Without their guidance, I would still be outside the world of boxing.
I truly appreciate their support and would love to come back for training again in the near future.

reviews.name: Till-Hagen Mugele
reviews.text:
I train at Lion's Head whenever I'm in Bangkok!  What sets this place apart is that you're taken seriously here, even if you're not going to be the next pro boxer.

The coaches are knowledgeable and work with each person individually. The atmosphere is family-like and professional. All the members I've met have been very welcoming and friendly.

Whether you're a beginner or more advanced, everyone gets the attention they need. Highly recommend! 👊🥊

reviews.name: Stuart Daly
reviews.text: I’ve trained across a fair share of gyms in Thailand and Lionshead is definitely a standout for western boxing. Great friendly and knowledgeable coaches. Very accepting of people across all levels and ages. Highly recommended for people living or visiting BKK. 🙏

reviews.name: Peem C
reviews.text: Even tho I’ve only trained here a couple times, I’d say lions head is by far the best boxing gym in bkk and definitely worth your money. The attention to detail is very good here whether you want to train for fitness or for a fight and facilities is also excellent.

reviews.name: Alex T375
reviews.text:
I joined this gym 2 months ago after a long lay off from combat sports. I was welcomed by the coaching staff who have been very accomodating of my individual limitations (post ACL op), even as I have joined general population in the gym.
There are 2 branches of the gym. The Ramkamheng branch is a covered, open air environment with a traditional feel, well equipped with boxing and strength equipment, clean, with showers. The Rama 4 branch is air conditioned with a modern, polished feel, well equipped with both boxing and strength equipment, clean, with showers.
Training is fun and challenging at both venues.
The coaches are well versed and have an intelligent and constructive approach to training the members according to their individual levels and goals.
There are beginner boxers, amatuer, and professional fighters training here, so you should be able to see progress wherever on the curve your skillset currently lies.

reviews.name: Muneer halim
reviews.text: Enjoyed my 1 on 1 with coach Jay. Instead of diving straight into coaching, he asked me to shadow box for 4 rounds and after which, he tweaked the lessons to improve my boxing techniques. Thank you so much Jay. Appreciate it.

reviews.name: kayla gill
reviews.text: I did a Mittmaster course with Lion’s Head and it far exceeded my expectations. Coach J has an intelligent approach to boxing and tailors the course to each student’s evolving needs. I was so impressed by the level of detail, thoughtfulness and support along the way. Anyone who wants to start their path as a boxing coach would be lucky to lay their groundwork with this team.

reviews.name: Pure Swegwan
reviews.text:
Highly Recommended!

Best Western-Boxing gym in Bangkok.
Completed equipment and facility for boxing training such as Ring, heavy bags, boxing gloves(to borrow).
There are both classes for private and group. Boxing's padworks, technique and conditioning are all included. Saturday's technical sparring class is fun and good to improve skills for both beginners and high-level fighters.

Drinking water, parking and shower are also available.

reviews.name: Xiaowen Li
reviews.text: The boxing gym is clean and well-equipped, with a highly professional and patient coaching team. The classes are well-structured, engaging, and practical. The training atmosphere is fantastic, which keeps me motivated every session! I’m really happy to have chosen this gym. Highly recommend it to anyone interested in learning boxing!

reviews.name: Dylan Fernando
reviews.text:
One of the most welcoming combat gyms I've ever been to and one of the best places to be if you want to take boxing seriously.

Coach J definitely runs a tight ship, the place looks brand new and has solid equipment. Literally everything you need (they even have deodorant in the changing rooms)

reviews.name: Todd Kuipers
reviews.text: The team at the gym were excellent.  Bryson provided my daughter with a series of private training classes over a couple of weeks. The gym is well organized and equipped, pretty easy to get to and can work with a wide range of skills. Highly recommended!

title: Kalare Boxing Stadium
subTitle: Nightbarzaar boxing stadium
address: ชั้น 2 Night Bazaar 104/1 Changklan Rd, Tambon Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
street: ชั้น 2 Night Bazaar 104/1 Changklan Rd
plusCode: Q2P2+32 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Kai Sweet
reviews.text:
An absolutely epic night and an unreal experience seeing and feeling the atmosphere of live Muay Thai boxing in real time right in front of you!

The Setup: Went for the 9:30pm show as 2 of us. Paid 600 Baht (~£13) per person. There were multiple fights throughout the night and it ended around midnight. To find it, it's in the back left of the bazaar on the floor with steps going up. Walking up to the desk to get through was a breeze.

What stood out:

✅ The Venue: Got inside and sat down on the top row bench. What a view. There isn't really any fans or air con as it's open air, so it did get quite warm sitting there in the heat. There is a little snack and beverage counter there where you can buy popcorn, water, beer etc. (didn't go up to it so can't comment on prices).

🔥 The Experience: The fights were sick. So cool to watch professionals fight this sport and it was my first time seeing this live. The atmosphere was great and they all did a great job. It's not crazy modern, it's authentic and local, making it a great spot to watch properly.

🙌 The Value: 9.4/10 - Excellent value for a full night of entertainment. Getting a few hours of professional, high-energy live fights for 600 Baht a ticket is a massive win.

The Verdict: Highly recommend to anyone thinking about watching it.

reviews.name: Sydney Mclennan
reviews.text: We had the best time here!! The Muay Thai fights are electric and so fun to watch! We were there for over 2 hours and it felt like 30 mins. I definitely recommend coming here to watch ! Super fun and memorable experience!!! 600 B for regular seats and 1000 B for ringside.

reviews.name: Meged Shapir
reviews.text: A must experience if you are visiting thailand. The fighting night had 10 different fights. You should bring a fan and drinks though because it is hot inside.

reviews.name: Balraj Bhatia
reviews.text: Located in back end of the Kalare night market. Got there early around 8:30pm but the fights didn’t start until 9:30pm. Good fights, very entertaining. Thought we would leave after a few matches but ended up staying until the end which was closer to midnight. No outside food or drinks allowed but they were very nice and understanding and simply asked my drink to be poured into a regular cup so I could bring it inside. They have a small area inside the stadium where you can purchase their drinks. I bought tickets on Get Your Guide but you can purchase them on the spot for 600 baht for stadium and 1000 baht for ringside.

reviews.name: June H Woo
reviews.text: I was in CM for 10 days recently & stopped by 1 night out of curiosity. 1st time attending a ring event. Stayed for all 8 fights. 5 ended by knockout. Most interesting one was a ladyboy vs a foreigner (French). The ladyboy won by decision. The fighting isn't technical as these are more amateur fighters but enjoyed it nonetheless. Paid for the ringside seat for 1000 baht but looking back, I would've preferred the stand for 600 baht. I think better to see the fights from a bit back & from top than ringside where you're looking up & trying to peer through the ropes. The place is small enough where the view from back is fine. I enjoyed it but just giving 4 stars because outside the ladyboy vs French, I couldn't differentiate the other matches. Essentially similar weight class of different Thai fighters. Having said that, I'd go again just to see a different group of fighters. Worth checking out at least once if you're visiting. Good food court downstairs as well.

reviews.name: Lu
reviews.text: It's a very cool experience to watch live Muay Thai fights. It's interesting to see the mix of fighters, including Thais, Chinese, and other internationals. Entry is paid. To make it easier, you can buy the ticket online with a card, and you don't need to print it—just show it on your phone. You can also buy it at the box office on the spot, but in that case, it's better to have cash.

reviews.name: Kenny
reviews.text:
Decent stadium with ok seating but not great seating for long periods of time.  If seated in the general admission section the seats are bleacher style with no back rests and no number assigned for seating.  Be prepared to get close to your neighbor at the beginning of the night but people will leave by halfway through the event.

They do sell beer and other beverages but I saw people bringing in beer from outside (7/11) if you want to save a few baht.

reviews.name: Alicia Jappy
reviews.text: If I could give 0 stars I would. After seeing the Muay Thai matches in Bangkok, we were excited to see them here too. The matches were set up and fake. The fighters were hitting each other to the beat of the music, the first fighter KOd after a light kick to the thigh. Never seen such bad acting in my life. We left in the middle of the second match. Save your money and go to a match in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Kevin Yang
reviews.text: Such an interesting experience. The bench seats are uncomfortable. The stagg toed to pack in more customers by getting all the swearty tourista squeeze together even though there was plenty of space to doread out a bit. The show was good!

reviews.name: Jorgen Frohlich
reviews.text:
Kalare Stadium is located inside the Kalare night Bazaar.

I think the fights and the fighters are better at this arena, they go all in and we saw many knockouts. (Don’t go to Loi Kroh road arena - it’s a scam).

It’s a relatively small stadium and slightly pricey for Chiang Mai.

In most stadiums you can eat, drink, smoke and use restroom, but in Kalare you need to exit the stadium for this and you have to find coins to use the restroom which is annoying if you are in hurry.

I was very impressed with the young fighters here.

reviews.name: Alex Choo
reviews.text: Paid 600 THB for standard seats, which were just long benches on 3 tiers. Even on the back row you are still very close to the ring but it is a little awkward to get out if you are on the top row as you have squeeze past those below.

reviews.text:

Also these fights are more curated towards foreigners only . They hook you by putting one or two non thai (British or USA) fighters which i felt was hilarious as i was there to see thai kickboxing 🤣.

You can book tickets through klook and their own website as well. Around 600baht for the lowest ticket.
