Wonderful experience at the Banyan Tree Spa. It was our first visit, and we were truly impressed from the moment we arrived. A special thanks to K. Eye and K. Nutt at the reception for their warm welcome and excellent hospitality.

The one-hour massage was absolutely amazing. The private treatment room, the calming atmosphere, and the signature Banyan Tree fragrance made the experience feel truly unique and luxurious.

Our therapists, K. Ant and K. Star, were incredibly friendly and highly skilled. Their massage techniques helped relieve all of our muscle tension, leaving us feeling completely relaxed and refreshed.

We would definitely recommend Banyan Tree Spa to anyone looking to treat themselves to a truly memorable spa experience!

reviews.name: Hyejin Kwon
reviews.text:
As a true Phuket lover who has visited the island 14 times, I’ve experienced many spas over the years, including Oasis Spa (Kamala, Laguna, and Kata), Let’s Relax, Orientala, Baray Spa, Chalim Spa, De Flora, Sukko Spa, Carnation Spa, and many others.

But I can confidently say that the massage at Banyan Tree Phuket was the best I’ve ever had in Phuket.

Everything was exceptional — the beautiful facilities, the warm and attentive service, and most importantly, the quality of the massage.

A very special thank you to ANT and SUPHA. Their technique, pressure, and attention to detail were absolutely amazing. I don’t think I’ll ever forget their magical hands!

After trying so many spas in Phuket over the years, finding a place that impresses me this much is not easy. Banyan Tree truly exceeded my expectations, and I will definitely come back on my next trip to Phuket.

Thank you, ANT and SUPHA, for making this such a memorable experience. ❤️

Without a doubt, my No.1 spa experience in Phuket!

reviews.text:
We stayed at Banyan Tree Phuket and had a very disappointing experience overall. This hotel presents itself as a luxury 5-star property, but our stay did not reflect that standard at all.

The manager was rude and not helpful when we raised concerns. Our room had bugs, which is completely unacceptable for a hotel at this level and price point. Pool service was also poor, with no towels available, and in general the service throughout the hotel was very slow.

The spa experience was especially frustrating. We were charged around 10,000 THB for a massage, yet the treatment felt very unprofessional. They did not properly listen to the issues and pain points we specifically mentioned, and the whole experience felt overpriced and disappointing.

Overall, we left feeling very dissatisfied. For a hotel that markets itself as a luxury resort, the service, attention to detail, and guest care were far below expectations. I would not recommend this property based on our experience

reviews.name: 洪坤榮
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at WAYA SPA.
I came with the expectation of relaxation, but unfortunately I left feeling even more tense than before. The therapist appeared to lack sufficient training and practical experience. Instead of creating a calm and soothing atmosphere, the session felt rushed and uncomfortable. Her breathing was rapid, her movements felt heavy and unrefined, and she accidentally bumped into the massage bed during the treatment. This created a sense of nervousness rather than relaxation.
Privacy was also a serious concern. The treatment room did not have a proper door, only curtains separating the space. At one point, after entering and leaving the room, the therapist did not fully close the curtain. With people walking near the restroom area, this made me feel exposed and uneasy. For a spa operating within a five-star hotel environment, privacy and professionalism should be fundamental standards.
Additionally, after the massage there was no request for feedback. This felt like a missed opportunity for quality improvement.
Suggestions for improvement:
Strengthen therapist training, especially in pacing, body language, and creating a calming presence. Relaxation is not only about technique, but also about atmosphere and emotional comfort.
Improve privacy standards by ensuring treatment rooms are fully enclosed or that curtains are securely closed at all times.
Encourage therapists to slow down, especially during the initial foot cleansing ritual, as this sets the tone for the entire experience.
Implement a simple post-treatment feedback process to better understand guest experiences and maintain five-star service standards.

It is difficult to reconcile this experience with the expectations of a spa located in a five-star hotel. I sincerely hope management will review these issues carefully and make the necessary improvements.

reviews.name: Joanne L
reviews.text:
I booked a 120-minute sports massage and was expecting a more traditional, deep tissue–focused sports massage that incorporates myofascial release and targeted pressure on tight areas.

Here, you are asked to change into their provided clothing, and lotion is used during the massage. The style is more a blend of Thai and Swedish techniques with some deep pressure but the strokes are short. There was some stretching at the beginning—mainly focused on the lower body—and a short stretch at the end, but overall the pressure and technique were more moderate.

The therapist did ask about my problem areas, and I mentioned my neck, shoulders, lower back, and glutes. I felt the lower body work was more effective—I noticed improved hip flexibility and some relief in my glutes. However, the upper body work didn’t do much for my neck and shoulder tension.

The massage on the back didn’t address deeper tightness. The neck massage focused only on the back of the neck but the sides of my neck and base of my skull still felt uncomfortably tight. There were also many pauses during the session, which was distracting.

Overall, the massage didn’t align with what I expected from a sports massage. I did enjoy the lower body portion and would recommend if you have tightness around the glutes and hip area.

I've been taking classes with Teacher Mind for over a month now. She's lovely, attentive to detail, and adjusts the poses to suit my body.

The studio is spacious with a beautiful view, fully equipped, clean, and has changing rooms and showers.

reviews.name: MYADECH W.
reviews.text: สถานที่สะอาด เดินทางง่าย ครูสอนเข้าใจง่าย ค่อนข้างRelax ใจเย็นมากๆ มีเครื่องหลากหลายให้เล่น โดยรวมดีงามมากๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The place is clean, easy to get to, the instructors explain things clearly, it's quite relaxing and patient. There's a variety of equipment to play with. Overall, it's excellent.

reviews.name: Ale Nana
reviews.text: เรียนกับครูปริ้นซ์ คุณครูอารมณ์ดีมาก สอนละเอียด ช่วยจัดท่าการเล่นให้ตลอด ท้ายคลาสมีการช่วยผ่อนคลายเส้นยืดดีมาก ประทับใจมากค่ะ การเล่นแบบ 1 ต่อ 1 ทำให้การโฟกัสการเล่นได้ถูกต้องสำหรับเราจริงๆ ตอนตรวจร่างกาย ทำให้รู้ว่าเรามีส่วนเกินที่หน้าท้องเยอะ คุณครูจะออกแบบการเล่นให้เหมาะกับเรา โฟกัสเฉพาะจุด และยืดส่วนอื่นได้ดีมาก ประทับใจมากๆ เลยค่ะคุณครูน่ารัก สอนดี ใส่ใจดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I learned with Teacher Prince. He's a very cheerful teacher, teaches in detail, and constantly helps with posture corrections during the class. The stretching and relaxation session at the end of the class was excellent. I was very impressed. The one-on-one training allowed me to focus on the correct exercises for my needs. During my physical examination, he revealed I had excess fat in my abdomen, so he designed a workout plan tailored to me, focusing on specific areas and stretching other parts of my body very well. I'm very impressed; he's a lovely teacher, teaches well, and is very attentive.

reviews.name: โจพนา
reviews.text: แก้ปัญหาคอบ่าไหล่ปวดได้ดีครับ ด้วยการจัด Balance โครงสร้างร่างกายโดยการ ใช้รูปแบบของพิลาทิส

reviews.textTranslated: It's a new studio with lots of equipment. The instructors offer one-on-one instruction, ensuring focused training and minimizing injuries. It's perfect for beginners in Pilates. The location is conveniently in a mall right next to the BTS Skytrain.

reviews.textTranslated: It helps improve our core body and can be applied to daily life. Coach Tae provided excellent advice and principles.

reviews.textTranslated: The place is clean and beautiful. Teacher Tae and Teacher May are lovely and teach very well. :)

reviews.text:
มาลอง private pilates ครั้งแรก ประทับใจมากครับ

instructor สอนดีและใส่ใจมาก มีการชั่งน้ำหนัก สแกนร่างกาย และวิเคราะห์อย่างละเอียดก่อนเริ่ม ทำให้รู้เลยว่าควรปรับอะไรตรงไหนบ้าง

reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time trying private Pilates, and I was very impressed.

The instructor was excellent and very attentive. They weighed me, scanned my body, and did a detailed analysis before starting, letting me know exactly what needed adjusting.
During the class, they closely monitored and adjusted my posture, point by point.

The venue and equipment were great, clean, and conveniently located. It's easily accessible by MRT (Bang Pho station), then connecting to Gateway Bang Sue and just one escalator ride up.

title: Sunak Baa Muay Thai
ownerDescription:
Sunak baa offers boxing and muay thai classes in a super convenient location 10min walk from thonglor BTS
The gym is located in a private soi at Rama 4 (check Google maps)
All skill levels welcome.
English speaker trainers.
address: 3798 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PH7F+QX Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Graces Ching
reviews.text:
Found this gym tucked close by to where I was staying, messaged on instagram the day before for a private lesson and managed to schedule on the next day - Thai trainer Berm is and was very patient for a beginner female like me! For my second time doing muay thai, it was better than my first experience, Pi Berm was very good at correcting my posture and technique. He was very patient with me to make sure I have the basics right even though for someone who is uncoordinated like me. He will explain in English and demonstrate the reason why a stance is a certain way which makes it intuitive.

Highly recommended for a cosy gym and encouraging environment for beginners starting out! Well equipped gym! Thanks Coach Berm and Alex!

reviews.name: Amed Doukoure
reviews.text:
I spent one month training at this gym and honestly had a great experience.

The team is very welcoming, patient, and pedagogical, no matter your level. Whether you’re a beginner or more experienced, they really take the time to help you improve.

What I appreciated the most was the precision in teaching techniques and the quality of the sparring sessions. Technical, controlled, and always respectful.

Highly recommend this gym if you want to seriously improve your Muay Thai while training in a great atmosphere

reviews.name: Maximilian Böhmer
reviews.text:
I had multiple Muay Thai trainings here. Alex and Berm are world-class coaches with a great experience. They explain techniques patiently, always take the time to help everyone improve, and create a highly motivating training environment. They’re also always in a great mood, which makes every session enjoyable.

The atmosphere in the gym is fantastic. Everyone is welcoming, and there is a great mix of complete beginners and experienced fighters, so you’ll feel comfortable from day one.

The training is intense, challenging, and very effective. I learned an incredible amount in a short period of time and improved my technique much faster than I expected.

If you’re looking for authentic Muay Thai training with outstanding coaches and a friendly, motivating environment, I can highly recommend this gym. I will definitely be back! 👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.name: Sebastian Kehle
reviews.text: I’ve been training at Sunakba Muay Thai for two years now and it’s honestly the best place to train. My friend and I recently did a private training session and it was amazing. The coaches are super knowledgeable, push you to improve, and still make the training really enjoyable. Whether you’re a beginner or more experienced, they make sure you get the most out of every session. Great atmosphere, great people, and top-level training. Highly recommend! 💪🥊

reviews.name: Aymeric Pierre
reviews.text: Hands down the best boxing gym I've tried in Bangkok. The trainers are incredibly attentive to detail, which really helps you make genuine progress on your technique. On top of that, they're super friendly and create a great atmosphere. Highly recommend if you're serious about improving or just want a solid training session while in the city!

reviews.name: 최Charly
reviews.text:
When I went there, I was warmly greeted.

I appreciate how personalized the teaching was though it was a group class. They'd also give me feedback in how I can improve specific aspects of my technique.

There were 2 instructors and they seemed highly experienced with good teaching skills.

I was quite satisfied with the class and would return and can recommend to others.

reviews.name: angelina
reviews.text:
I’ve spent about a month and a half training here, and I feel so lucky to have chosen this gym. The coaches are incredibly attentive ,they give great feedback on technique, guide you through pad work, and host sparring sessions on Fridays.
During my time here, I also got to watch three fighters from our gym compete, which was such a cool experience to watch people I train with fight (inspirational) ! If I ever come back to Thailand, this will be the first place I return to.
So grateful — thank you so much

reviews.name: Daniel Bruce
reviews.text:
I’ve trained at gyms all over Thailand — from Chiang Mai to Phuket and across Bangkok — and I can confidently say this gym stands out from the rest. The moment I walked in, I felt welcomed. The coaches here are not only highly skilled and experienced, but they also pay close attention to detail, ensuring you develop proper technique whether you’re a complete beginner or an active fighter preparing for your next bout.

What really sets this place apart is the sense of community. There’s no ego here — just genuine people who love Muay Thai and support each other. The atmosphere is encouraging, respectful, and inclusive to all levels. Whether you’re just starting or already deep into your fight journey, you’ll feel right at home.

The hygiene standards are excellent — the gym is always clean, and the staff are constantly wiping down equipment and keeping the space fresh, which is something I really value after visiting so many other places.

If you’re looking for authentic, high-quality Muay Thai training in a clean, welcoming, and motivating environment, this is the place. I can’t recommend it enough.

reviews.name: Dylan Kontos
reviews.text:
A++++ 10/10

FULLY HECTIC MUAY THAI GYM!

A must train for anyone living or passing through BKK. Beginnner/intermediate/advnaced - Trainers here will help you progress, while having fun!

- Friendly
- Profressional
- Fight IQ / Femur +++

reviews.name: Sam M
reviews.text: I cannot recommend this gym enough. I’ve been training here for around 7/8 months and each season is more enjoyable than the last. Everyone is so welcoming, the facilities are perfect and you learn so much here. The team teach you at your own pace and ensure you’re content and enjoying yourself throughout. For those considering Muay Thai in Thailand, Sunak Baa Muay Thai is the place for you!

reviews.name: lorren tong
reviews.text:
Excellent muay thai gym! I did 2 private classes with Coach Alex and a group class. Alex was able to analyse my weaknesses and come up with practical steps to improve and drill them in during class.

Suitable for begineers to experience fighters.

reviews.name: David Brunner
reviews.text: I trained at 3 gyms in Bangkok and this was the best by far. I trained at this gym for 2+ months and it was perfect. The trainers/kru's were super welcoming and friendly and were very good at what they do. They knew how to push you to train hard while also being super detail oriented to help improve every aspect of your Muay Thai. If I ever get back to Thailand, I will be coming directly here.

reviews.name: Chanell Deyzel
reviews.text:
This gym was a perfect find!
I’ve trained in a few gyms in and around Bangkok and the trainers here really give you all their effort.
As someone who is relatively new to Muay Thai I found that some gyms weren’t really interested in training me, and my training often felt like a fitness class rather than helping me level up on my skills.
Here, I have been shown how to build on my skills, learn combinations and have everything corrected when needed.
It’s a tough training session but  great fun!
Check it out if you’re in the Bangkok area.

reviews.name: RABIA DOGHMAN
reviews.text: The coaches Kru Berm and Coach Alex are very good and the attention to detail in training is amazing. It’s a gym for all levels. I went there as a complete beginner in Muay Thai and they have taught me everything I know. Super grateful to have found this gym with amazing coaches.🙏🙏

reviews.name: Viliyan Tsvetanov
reviews.text: A fantastic place to train for people of all skill levels. The coaches are friendly and the training environment is very welcoming despite the challenging workouts. The gym itself is well-maintained and clean. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Hannah Decogan
reviews.text:
Great gym and centrally located in Bangkok. I have lived in Thailand for 4 years and have found it hard to find a gym that has a complete class structure. So was really happy to find this place.
The trainer is patient and correct your technique along the way, allowing for maximum improvement.
This gym trains you hard, in an enjoyable and professional way, teaching drills, pads, strength and conditioning etc.
It also has a really friendly atmosphere.
I highly recommend a visit!

reviews.name: John Maguire
reviews.text:
I trained here while I was on holiday and loved the gym. I’m new to Muay Thai and found this gym helped me get better quickly. They understood I was a beginner and worked with that. Made my experience very enjoyable.
The staff were very helpful and friendly.

reviews.name: Sam Diamond
reviews.text:
I love this gym!
I am not a fighter but at this gym it didn’t matter, they still provided me with quality training and helped me build on my techniques.
Clean gym, great people in the classes and trainers are dedicated and care about your progression regardless of your level and skills.
I will be continuing training here for my time in Bangkok.

reviews.name: JODiE
reviews.text:
Me and a buddy did a joint session together and it was great. Both trainers were outstanding. They pushed enough so that we were able to get as much from the session as possible even though we were cooking in the Bangkok heat. Really appreciate the tips on form and technique.

If you're looking for a great workout, from great trainers and you're around Rama 4, I highly recommend you visit this gym.

reviews.name: jmll
reviews.text: Nice gym with very good vibes, the coachs are very pedagogical and patient. As a beginner I felt welcomed and learned and progressed a lot in a few days. I definitely recommend to anyone in Ekkamai district to come and get at least one Muay Thai class here

reviews.name: CKE DRAPADINHO
reviews.text:
I decided to try a Nuru massage for the first time during my stay in Bangkok. I found this place through their website and noticed several very attractive profiles listed as working that day, so since it was close to my hotel I decided to walk in instead of making an appointment through Line.

The welcome was friendly. The mamasan spoke very good English and clearly explained the services and price list. I also mentioned that this would be my first Nuru massage experience.

However, when I saw the lineup, the situation was a bit different from what I expected. There were fewer than ten women present, and they didn’t resemble the profiles shown on the website for that day at all. Communication was also a bit difficult since most of them didn’t speak English. I eventually chose one therapist who seemed friendly and had a genuine looking smile.

To her credit, she tried hard to make me feel comfortable and welcome throughout the session. Unfortunately, the language barrier made it difficult to communicate preferences, and the Nuru part of the massage felt a bit rushed and awkward for me personally. This might simply be a matter of expectations versus reality, or maybe this style of massage just isn’t really my thing.

The jacuzzi and soap massage afterwards were actually more relaxing, and she made a genuine effort to create a pleasant atmosphere. She seemed kind and professional, and I appreciated that she was trying her best despite the communication issues.

In the end, the experience didn’t quite match the fantasy I had imagined beforehand. That’s partly my own expectations, and mostly the difference between the website presentation and the actual lineup available at the time. This seems to be a returning issue now I have read other reviews of the many Nuru Massage Parlours here in Bangkok.

Overall, it wasn’t a terrible experience, just not quite what I had hoped for. If you’re considering trying a Nuru massage for the first time, I would recommend communicating your expectations clearly in advance and perhaps booking ahead rather than walking in.

Unfortunately, at the end of the day, no happy ending for me.

혹시 이 동네에 오신다면 꼭 한번쯤 들러보시길 추천드립니다.

방콕 시내에서 관광객 상대로 하는 곳 보다 100배는 더 좋습니다.

리뷰이벤트 이런거 없이, 개인적으로 정말 너무 좋아서 후기남깁니다. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
reviews.textTranslated:
I came here after being recommended by a Thai friend.
I was able to receive high-quality skincare.
It was the most comfortable and excellent skincare I've received anywhere in Bangkok.
I received a shoulder, neck, and facial massage, along with a skincare routine, which took about 90 minutes.
It was incredibly relaxing and not at all irritating.
If you're ever in the area, I highly recommend stopping by.

It's 100 times better than the tourist-oriented places in downtown Bangkok.

There were no review events, but I personally loved it so much that I'm leaving a review. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind review. 🌻

reviews.name: Jane C
reviews.text:
คุณสา เจ้าของนวดเอง service เป็นกันเองและ professional มาก นวดหน้าเพิ่มความชุ่มชื้น รู้สึกผิวหน้ากระชับหลังทำเสร็จ 90 นาที ตอนทำสบายมากค่ะ ผลิตภัณฑ์บำรุงหน้าเค้าเลือกมาอย่างดีแล้ว (ปรกติผิวเราจะคันง่าย ของทีนี่ถือว่าผ่าน)
จอดรถหน้าร้านหรือบริเวณด้านใน สะดวกมาก ต้องจองล่วงหน้าก่อนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Khun Sa, the owner, provides the massage herself. The service is very friendly and professional. The facial massage added moisture, and I felt my skin tighten after the 90-minute session. It was very relaxing during the treatment. The skincare products they use are of very good quality (my skin usually gets itchy, but the products here are excellent).
Parking is available in front of the shop or inside the premises, which is very convenient. Reservations are required in advance.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากค่ะคุณเจน ยิยดีที่ได้ดูแลนะคะ 🙏❤️

reviews.name: Siriporn Saebe
reviews.text: เข้าไปใช้บริการร้านหนวดหน้าสปาแบบมือเป็นครั้งแรก เซิร์ชหาร้านเจอใน Google อ่านรีวิวว่าบริการดีเลยลองเข้าไปเป็นไปตามที่รีวิวจริง เจ้าของร้านบริการดี พูดจาเพราะ แนะนำคอสการหนวดหน้าให้ตรงกับความต้องการของใบหน้า ช่วงที่หนวดหน้าแต่ละทุกขั้นตอนอธิบายผลิตภัณฑ์และคุณประโยชน์ของแต่ละตัวนั้นๆได้ดี บริการทุกขั้นตอนด้วยความใสใจประทับใจมาก ขอแนะนำร้านนี้เลยค่ะ แล้วจะไปใช้บริการอีกค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time using a professional facial spa. I found the shop through a Google search and read good reviews, so I decided to try it. It lived up to the reviews! The owner was very friendly and polite, recommending a facial grooming course tailored to my needs. During the grooming process, they explained the products and their benefits thoroughly. The service was attentive and impressive. I highly recommend this shop and will definitely be back!

title: BrassWok Thai Cooking Class & Private Chef
ownerDescription:
BrassWok Thai Cooking Class in Phuket offers intimate, hands-on classes for just 2–6 guests, and private cooking class. Chef Pui, professionally trained at Le Cordon Bleu Dusit, opens her own home to guests for a relaxed and personal Thai cooking experience in an air-conditioned kitchen. Explore her organic Thai herb garden and learn to create authentic Thai flavours using fresh local ingredients and practical techniques you can recreate at home.

Chef Pui also offers private Thai cooking sessions and private chef experiences at villas throughout Phuket. BrassWok received TripAdvisor Certificates of Excellence in 2018, 2019, 2024 and 2025.
Advance booking required.
address: BrassWok Thai Cooking Class, Srisoonthorn Rd, Tambon Si Sunthon, Thalang District, Phuket 83110, Thailand
street: BrassWok Thai Cooking Class, Srisoonthorn Rd
plusCode: X9H3+GJ Si Sunthon, Thalang District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Baffelly Woo
reviews.text:
We had a private dining experience at Brassawok Chef Pui’s home and it was most memorable. The Thai food was amazing, bursting with fresh local flavors, with some ingredients straight from her garden.
Chef also explained the background and stories behind the dishes and the ingredients and not hesitate to share her “secret” in creating the dishes.
You can feel her passion and kindness in an authentic and welcoming setting.
Tips - ask for a tour of her garden and you won’t be disappointed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much, Baff, for sharing such a wonderful review! 🙏 It was a pleasure welcoming you both to our home for a private Thai dining experience - Supper Club at BrassWok.

I’m delighted that you enjoyed the authentic Thai flavors, fresh local ingredients, and the stories behind each dish. For me, Thai cooking is not only about the food, but also about sharing our culture, traditions, and the little secrets that make each dish special. 🌿🇹🇭

I’m especially happy you enjoyed the garden tour! Many of the herbs we use in our cooking come straight from the garden, which makes the experience even more personal and authentic.

For others reading until here, If you’re visiting Phuket and looking for an authentic Thai cooking class in Phuket, a private Thai dining experience, or a private chef for your villa in Phuket, I would be delighted to share more of Thai food, culture, and hospitality with you.

Warmly,
Chef Pui

reviews.name: Aesthetic Nurse Suzie
reviews.text: If you’re wanting to learn how to cook real authentic Thai recipes, look no further than the magnificent BrassWok Thai Cooking Studio, run by master instructor Pui. What an experience!! Her friendly demeanour right from the start was welcoming, friendly and oozed enthusiasm! We went on the Market Tour with her to learn about the different produce and then only a short drive to her kitchen which was professionally set up, lovely and clean and ready to commence our Thai cooking experience. We cooked 4 incredible dishes and what we didn’t eat we were able to take with us. We thoroughly recommend this to anyone - groups, couples, individuals who are wanting to learn the real deal when it comes to exquisite Thai cooking.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Suzie for the magnificent review! So happy to have shared with you the real Thai flavours at our BrassWok Thai Cooking Class Phuket. The market tour was something really local I'm proud to show you. It's the everyday life of people in this area.

Thanks again for recommending us, and we hope to cook with you again next time you're in Phuket!

Find out more about the BrassWok Market Tour + Thai Cooking Class in Phuket and our premium Private Chef Experience for villas at BrassWok.com

reviews.name: Rachel Adams
reviews.text:
My husband and I were fortunate enough to have a great class with Chef Pui! It ended up being just the two of us and we cooked through four amazing dishes including Larb, Steamed Fish, Pad Kea Mao and a fresh red curry. She also brewed us some beautiful and refreshing Butterfly Pea tea with flowers directly from her garden.

We are pretty frequent home cooks and found her instructions easy to follow, fun and interesting. We learned new flavors and new skills that we’ll take home and apply in our kitchen. Chef Pui herself is a delightful person to spend time with; she is easy to talk to, has a good sense of humor and clearly knows what she’s doing in the kitchen. I would absolutely recommend this class to anyone traveling in Phuket!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Rachel, Thank you so much for this great review and sharing your photos. Hope you have already made Thai food that you learn with us many times now. Hope you found pickle garlic in your supermarket too. Let me know if you have any question when you cook at home.
Regards,
Pui
P.S. We now also provide BrassWok Private Chef Service for homes and villas in Phuket so next time you come here please look us up.

reviews.name: Rue Laidler-Handy
reviews.text: We had the BEST time with chef pui today. She’s so thorough, responsive and we really felt like pui was so passionate about her livelihood. The trip to the market was fascinating and interactive. All the food we made was so delicious and we’ll definitely try to recreate this at home. Well worth the pricing and we had such a genuine and informative experience. Thanks pui- you’re an angel!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Wow what an amazing review. Thank you soooo much, Rue, taking the time and share your experience here. I'm so thankful for your second booking as well. I must've done something right. :-D 
If you get stuck or have any questions about cooking Thai food at home please do let me know.
Also, just wanna spread the words, we also offer private chef experience, for villas and homes in Phuket. If you plan your next vacation here. Please feel free to reach out.

reviews.name: Tricia Bannister
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience with the wonderful Khun Pui and staff.  I highly recommend the market experience where you’ll learn how to shop for your ingredients and also discover new produce, meats, seafood and snacks.  Khun Pui shared so much with us including a tour of her small garden as well as her kitchen tools and favorite places to try Thai delicacies in Phuket.  Our package included the group class (only 2 of us) with transportation pick up, market visit, historical explanation of the 4 dishes we got to choose and in the end were well packed for take away for dinner.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Tricia, what an amazing review, thank you so much for sharing your experience for our Market Tour and Thai Cooking Class in Phuket. It was a fun class with you and Chef Tito. Really appreciate your booking. 
Just wanna let you know we also offer private chef experience at your villas in Phuket. For a special occasion or when you have visitors, please feel free to reach out. 
Warm regards,
Pui

reviews.name: Jacob “Kobi” Bentolila
reviews.text:
We had an unforgettable experience at BrassWok with Pui. We were a family of three (parents and our 15-year-old son), and everyone enjoyed it immensely. Pui is incredibly knowledgeable and you can really feel her joy in sharing her passion for Thai food.
One of us is sensitive to gluten, and Pui was fully aware of the situation and accommodated it perfectly, so we felt completely safe.
Beyond just cooking, we learned so much about the local culture, preparation methods, and the spices—many of which she actually grows in her own garden. The result? The dishes we prepared were honestly the tastiest food we have eaten in our entire trip to Thailand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
OMG Jacob, THANK YOU SO MUCH for this excellent review! I'm so humbled to hear you say that the food you make with us  were "honestly the tastiest food we have eaten in our entire trip to Thailand." We love what we do and hearing this is so rewarding. If any of you have any questions about cooking Thai food please message me. And next time you're in Phuket please look us up as we also provide BrassWok Private Chef Service for homes and villas in Phuket.
Regards,
Pui

I truly enjoyed every moment of the class and learned so much about Thai flavors and techniques. Highly recommended. Thank you so much 🙏🏻

Reagrds,
Pui

reviews.name: ortalby
reviews.text: We had such a great family time on the cooking class. Chef Pui and her team were so nice and made us feel so welcome. The dishes were suitable to each and everyone and especially the kids loved it (they are pretty picky in food). Everything was looking good and we ate a lot and also took food home. We can’t wait to come again
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Ortal and everyone, Thank you so much again for celebrating (or working hard!LOL) the big boy's birthday at BrassWok Thai cooking class :-D 
It was such a pleasure having your family with us, and your children were so talented and confident in the kitchen—it was a joy to watch them cooking! I’m delighted everyone enjoyed the dishes and had fun, and we can’t wait to welcome you all back for another Thai cooking experience soon.

reviews.name: Ginny Chin
reviews.text: My partner n I had a good time learning how to cook staple Thai dishes from Pui, who is not only a good cook but also a wonderful host. Her recipes are easy and delicious (I’ve replicated a couple of recipes after I returned home). “Thai cooking - demystified” she jokingly touted, but it could not be more true. We signed up for the private class and my partner and I each had to cook, with Pui teaching us on the spot, giving us tips while plying us with her homemade butterfly pea tea! We also had the chance to visit her lustrous herb/ vegetable garden. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks so much for the awesome review! We are so glad you had a blast at our private Thai cooking class in Phuket. "Thai cooking - demystified" is exactly what we go for! Chef Pui loves making things easy, and hearing that you’ve already recreated the dishes at home is the best compliment ever. It was great sharing our homemade butterfly pea tea and showing you around the herb garden! For your next trip—or if you just want to sit back and relax next time—we also offer a premium private chef experience in Phuket where Chef Pui cooks directly at your villa. Hope to see you guys again the next time you want to learn to cook authentic Thai food! 
Cheers, 
BrassWok Thai Cooking Class Phuket

reviews.name: Kolin Friske
reviews.text:
★★★★ Unforgettable Thai Cooking Experience with Chef Pui!

As residents of Phuket for six years, we've had our fair share of amazing food and experiences. However, our private cooking class with Chef Pui at Brass Wok Thai Cooking Class truly stands out as some of the best we've had yet!

Our family of 4, including my wife, her mom, and auntie from Canada, had an incredible time learning from Chef Pui. This experience was not only a highlight of our visitors' 3-week stay but also a standout moment for us long-term residents.

Chef Pui's expertise and warm personality made the class both educational and fun. We created five delicious dishes: Pad Thai, Penang Curry, Tom Kha soup, Yum Woon Sen, and the classic Mango Sticky Rice for dessert. The instructions were clear and easy to follow, and the ingredients were fresh and of high quality.

What stood out was the personal attention Chef Pui gave to each of us, ensuring we understood every step of the cooking process. The kitchen was well-equipped, and the atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable.

Not only did we learn how to cook these amazing dishes, but we also gained insights into Thai culinary culture and techniques that we'll treasure forever. The best part? We got to enjoy our creations afterward!

If you're looking for an authentic, hands-on Thai cooking experience in Phuket, look no further than Brass Wok Thai Cooking Class. It's perfect for families, couples, or anyone interested in Thai cuisine. Even as long-term residents, we were impressed by the quality of this experience. Thank you, Chef Pui, for this unforgettable day – it was definitely a highlight for both our family and our visitors!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Kolin and Jen!
Thank you so much for this wonderful review! It was a true pleasure welcoming your family, and I’m delighted to hear the class became a highlight of your visitors’ trip—and even for you as long-term Phuket residents. I loved cooking with all of you and sharing Thai flavors together. Hope to see you again soon for more delicious dishes! 
— Pui, BrassWok Thai Cooking Class

reviews.name: Natasha M
reviews.text: Joined Pui in her home for an exceptional cooking class, it really was Thai food demystified! I loved the way Pui walked us through the ingredients and some of the history of Thailand through food. I really enjoyed the class and we made some exceptional dishes, plenty of take away and have for a second meal! Highly recommend this class to all Thai food beginners. Thank you Pui!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Natasha thank you so much for your feedback here. We really appreciate this.

reviews.name: Lori Irvine
reviews.text: This is an ABSOLUTE MUST if you travel to Phuket!! You can’t travel half way around the world and eat Thai food - with all its rich cultural heritage- and not try to learn how to cook it at home and enjoy this food with family and friends. It will continually bring your Thai experience to life for years to come. Pui was amazing and her knowledge and skill set was incredible!!  We learned so much while enjoying 5 traditional Thai dishes. Do NOT EAT before going!!!  Pui ensures you leave happy, educated, smiling, and full. Worth every penny!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Pui

reviews.name: Anne Wong
reviews.text:
We had a great morning with Pui in her home/studio learning how to cook some of our favourite Thai dishes. Pui certainly demystified Thai cooking for us - seems simple now once you know the key ingredients! We did not eat breakfast prior to coming which seemed like the right thing to do as you get to eat the creations along the way.
Highly recommend. Pui is great and seems very knowledgeable and passionate about cooking!

reviews.name: Joe Mool
reviews.text: We love cooking so we did some research to try to find a real hands-on cookery class while on our holiday in Phuket. We stayed in Dusit Laguna but decided to rather have a class outside the hotel. We found BrassWok Thai Cooking through google map, then went on to find all excellent reviews on TripAdvisor, then went on to see their web site and were so impressed. Very lucky that it's only 5 minutes away from our hotel and we didn't have to go all the way to Phuket town. The 3 hour class was very educational, hands on, fun, lots of food and we wish we could take another class but it was full and we had to leave the next day...

reviews.name: Christopher Smith
reviews.text:
The class takes place inside a house in a nice gated neighborhood in Phuket.

I've taken several cooking classes in the United States, and they almost always felt formal. Partially due to the location inside an actual home, this class felt more like cooking and eating with a friend.

Pui speaks great English. Her natural curiousity makes it easy to talk with her, as she displays a genuine interest in the people taking her class. She also did an excellent job of communicating ahead of time in terms of details.

We had a few scheduling quirks to work through and she showed flexibility, grace and patience, which we appreciated.

In terms of the food, Pui picked out some super fresh ingredients from the market. She made it easy and simple for us. But we got to actually cook a good bit. I'm often diasppointed at the lack of actual cooking at American cooking classes, but the amount of cooking for this class was perfect.

Each dish was authentic, not overly complex and delicious. My wife, who never eats fish, even loved the fish. The food was better than we ate in all of Thailand.

Pui gave us a great mix of education, cooking technique and general friendly conversation.

This may be the best thing we did the entire time we spent in Thailand. If you have the opportunity to book this class, do it and don't give it a second thought.

Great class run by a great person.

reviews.name: Paulyn Woodburn
reviews.text:
Pui is not just any ordinary cooking instructor or chef, she was born into a multi-generational cooking foodie family, and she’s not only knowledgeable but also passionate about cooking!
We started with a market tour which helped us learn about local (Phuket) and Thai fruit, vegetables and seafood. We then learned to cook 4 dishes. Everything was delicious and not too complicated to cook at our own homes. Highly recommended for any visitor to Phuket!

reviews.name: Verena Troller
reviews.text: Great cooking class in a family atmosphere with the warm-hearted Pui. We prepared four delicious dishes using fresh ingredients from her garden.  Pui is a gifted hostess and we can highly recommend the class.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Verena, thank you so much for your kind review. I'm so glad I got to show you the herb garden and pick some for our class. Thank you for recommending us to others. I really appreciate it. If you have any questions when you cook Thai food at home, please do not hesitate to ask me. 
Next time you come to Phuket please look us up again, as we are now also offering Private Chef Experience in villas.

reviews.name: kit
reviews.text:
Great class, picked up a number of tips.  We cooked Massaman curry, Jungle curry, Pad See Eiw, Rudy ruby.   Chef Pui's instructions were clear and engaging.  Nice location surrounded by traditional villas.

Bonus:. We had the leftover Massaman the next day and the flavours were more intense!

reviews.name: William M Scott
reviews.text:
Found this place when we did a google search. Booked online directly.
Great course. We picked what we wanted to cook. Chef Pui is very knowledgeable and helpful.
Really enjoyed the course.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi William, Thank you for joining our Thai cooking class at BrassWok in Phuket! I’m glad you enjoyed picking your own dishes and had fun learning hands-on cooking techniques. It was a pleasure cooking with you, and we’d love to welcome you back to create more delicious Thai dishes!

title: Raya Massage Pattaya
ownerDescription: Raya Thai Massage With over 10 years of experience, we continue our mission to provide the ultimate authentic Thai massage experience to all our clients. We are committed to improving further, which we believe will bring our clients to the highest level of relaxation.
address: WV58+R6J, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

reviews.name: Carrie Z
reviews.text:
Professional, clean, and my husband and I both got excellent massages three years ago here so we came back and today found it’s even better.  Not all massage places have a male worker -but they do. It can be overwhelming how much
Massage places there are , too many
Options! just relax and  choose this one :)

reviews.name: Lawrence Danz
reviews.text:
Clean airy place.  Everybody super nice and polite.
Foot massage was 250. I asked if the therapist was strong and was told I should do a “heavy” foot massage for 350.  Sure, why not.
Did not work out so well. I had to tell the therapist to use more pressure.  Which was still far from ‘heavy”. And I didn’t time it, but I would say 70% of the time was rubbing my shins. The actual foot massage was barely there.  He was just sort of poking his elbow into the side of my shin where it meets my calf.  He would do that for five minutes straight.  I thought it might be how they do it there, but I glanced next to me and there was another therapist performing what looked like an actual foot massage on the guy next to me.
Did not really feel good and was actually bored.  Was not worth 250 forget 350. 1 star for massage. Added an extra for the facility/people.

reviews.name: A R
reviews.text:
I was in Pattaya for 45 days and got a massage at Raya nearly everyday. The massages were very consistent and the people at the shop were always welcoming and friendly.
Tip your masseuse well, they are working hard 😎

reviews.name: Pol Gym
reviews.text:
Absolutely incredible!
This was simply perfect — technically, professionally, and energetically. I had a foot and head massage done by a male therapist named Oi (if I got the name right), and honestly, it was one of the best massages I’ve ever had.

I’ve been living in Thailand for 6 years, and I’ve tried countless massage places, especially around Pratumnak — but this one stands out by far. The technique, the pressure, the attention — everything was on another level. The pain I had from sitting at a desk all day was gone immediately after the session. I felt light, relaxed, and realigned.

From now on, whenever I’m on Pratumnak, this is the only place I’ll go to. Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.name: mnc Corner
reviews.text:
Relaxing atmosphere, RayaMassage is another option that you shouldn't miss.

It is conveniently located, easy to get to, and has convenient parking. The shop is decorated in a warm, comfortable style with soft music that helps you feel relaxed as soon as you walk into the shop.

The service here is very good. The masseuses are skilled and pay attention to every detail.

reviews.name: MAGIC S
reviews.text: Very good massage service and environment .. quite relaxing

reviews.name: Star M
reviews.text: The staff take great care to make sure the experience here is quiet and relaxing.

Came back on time, was told 5 more minutes, then 5 more and then 10 more and then was told I could keep waiting inside. No concept of time management and honestly this is Thailand, why would I wait an hour for a massage I made an appointment for and was on time for? Nobody seemed sorry to see me go.

และระบบประสาท

address: Soi Charan Sanitwong, Bang O, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand
plusCode: RG26+XV Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Mr.Savory
reviews.text: I’ve had office syndrome for a while, and usually I manage it with weight training—but when I don’t have time to exercise, the pain always comes back. I decided to try this clinic, and it was a great decision. The physical therapist didn’t just treat the pain—they actually taught me how to use my muscles the right way in everyday life. Now I understand how to manage my symptoms better and combine smart movement with my workouts. Super helpful and worth it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณค่ะ 🫡

reviews.name: LinPing Ping
reviews.text:
มารับการรักษาที่นี่ครั้งแรกค่ะ ได้รับคำแนะนำจากนักกายภาพดีมากเลยค่ะ ละเอียดมากๆ แบบไพรเวท 1:1 มีอาการปวดกล้ามเนื้อสะโพกและก้นมานาน วันนี้ได้รับการรักษาแบบอัลตราซาวน์ โดนจุดมากๆเลยค่ะะ และได้รับคำแนะนำในการฝึกกายบริหารให้ถูกต้อง หลังทำรู้สึกกล้ามเนื้อคลายตัวมากขึ้นค่ะ 👍

สถานที่ดี อุปกรณ์ครบครัน มีที่จอดรถด้วยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time receiving treatment here. The physiotherapist gave excellent and very detailed advice, especially in a private 1:1 setting. I've had hip and gluteal muscle pain for a long time. Today, I received ultrasound treatment, which was very effective at targeting the specific areas. I also received guidance on proper exercise techniques. After the treatment, my muscles feel much more relaxed. 👍

The facility is nice, well-equipped, and has parking.

reviews.name: Soon Nerd
reviews.text: ไปกายภาพ มาประมาณ 3 ที่ ส่วนใหญ่จะโดนแก้ปัญหาที่ปลายเหตุ การรักษาคล้ายๆกันคือ ultrasound ตรงที่ปวด แต่ที่นี่คือ ใช้วิธีการรักษาที่ยั่งยืนมากๆ เน้นให้คนไข้ exercise เป็นหลัก รวมถึงมีอุปกรณ์ ประกอบการ exercise ค่อนข้างเยอะ คุณบิวตั้งใจวิเคราะห์ร่างกายคนไข้แบบละเอียดทุกจุด ไม่ใช่แค่รักษาไปตามวิธีการขั้นพื้นฐานแบบที่เคยเจอ แต่เน้นตามสภาพร่างกายและกล้ามเนื้อของคนไข้แต่ละบุคคล การรักษาอาจจะต้องใช้เวลาและความสม่ำเสมอ แต่จะต้องดีขึ้นแน่นอนค่า
reviews.textTranslated: I've been to about 3 different physical therapy centers. Most of them only addressed the symptoms, not the root cause. The treatments were similar, mostly involving ultrasound on the painful area. But here, they use a very sustainable approach. They focus heavily on exercise for the patient, and they have a lot of exercise equipment. Khun Bew meticulously analyzes each patient's body, not just treating them with basic methods like I've encountered before. She focuses on each individual's physical condition and muscle structure. Treatment requires time and consistency, but improvement is definitely guaranteed.

reviews.name: palin sangchart
reviews.text: ประทับใจมากครับ เจ็บจี๊ดที่หน้าอกมาหลายเดือน  มาเรียนรู้ท่าบริหารที่ถูกวิธีเห็นผลตั้งแต่ครั้งแรก นักกายภาพให้คำแนะนำดีครับ
reviews.textTranslated: I'm very impressed. I'd had sharp chest pain for several months, but after learning the correct exercises, I saw results from the very first session. The physiotherapist gave great advice.

reviews.name: วรวรรณ แซ่เงี้ยม
reviews.text: เพิ่งเคยกายภาพครั้งแรก และที่นี่เป็นที่แรกค่ะ เพราะใกล้บ้าน มีที่จอดรถสะดวกมากๆ มีรถไฟฟ้าด้วยค่ะ ลงสถานีบางอ้อได้เลย เรามาด้วยอาการปวดไหล่ ปวดต้นแขนมากๆๆจนชานิ้วมือ เจ็บหน้าอก หายใจก็เจ็บหน้าอกไปหมด ปวดสะบักมากๆ ลงคอสไป12ครั้ง ตอนนี้จะครบคอสแล้ว อาการนิ้วชาดีขึ้น ปวดต้นแขนน้อยลง โดยไม่ต้องกินยาแก้ปวด และยังคงทำกายภาพต่อค่ะ หมอบิวใจเย็นมาก พูดคุยดี แนะนำดี สถานที่ไม่วุ่นวายดีค่ะ สะอาด
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time doing physical therapy, and this is the first place I've chosen because it's close to home, has convenient parking, and is easily accessible by BTS Skytrain (Bangkok O station). I came with severe shoulder and upper arm pain that caused numbness in my fingers, chest pain, and chest pain when breathing. I also had severe scapular pain. I've completed a 12-session course and am almost finished. My finger numbness has improved, and my upper arm pain has lessened without needing painkillers. I will continue with the physical therapy. Dr. Bew is very patient, kind, and gives good advice. The place is not crowded and is clean.

reviews.name: Arin Phettongkam
reviews.text:
นักกายภาพบำบัดให้คำปรึกษาและแนะนำเป็นอย่างดี มีการตรวจร่างกายอย่างละเอียด  ได้รับรู้ร่างกายในส่วนที่ไม่เคยทราบว่ามีปัญหา  ค่อยๆอธิบายอย่างใจเย็น   ชอบและดีมากค่ะ  สถานที่สะอาด
มีบรรยากาศที่ผ่อนคลาย
reviews.textTranslated: The physiotherapist provided excellent consultation and advice. A thorough physical examination was conducted, revealing areas of my body I wasn't aware of having problems with. They explained everything patiently and calmly. I really liked it; it was a great experience. The place was clean and had a relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.name: tinudda moosaw
reviews.text: ประทับใจตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกที่มารักษาแก้อาการ นักกายภาพเก่งมาก ตรวจวิเคราะห์ ให้ข้อมูลอย่างละเอียด รักษาตรงจุด ใจเย็น ไม่รีบร้อน รวมถึงสอนให้คนไข้ดูแลตัวเองเป็นในระหว่างรักษาและจบคอร์สไปแล้ว สถานที่สะอาดมาก เหมือนมาคาเฟ่ มีความสบายตาสบายใจ ที่นี่มีทั้งกายภาพบำบัด และพิลาทิส ครบเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I was impressed from my first visit for treatment. The physiotherapist is excellent; they analyze symptoms thoroughly, provide detailed information, treat the problem directly, and are patient and unhurried. They also teach patients how to take care of themselves during and after treatment. The place is very clean, like a cafe, very comfortable and relaxing. They offer both physiotherapy and Pilates here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณนะคะ ขอให้สุขภาพแข็งแรงค่า

reviews.name: kmnsm 17
reviews.text:
First time for Pilates and consult with physical therapist about my body 🤎

เป็นครั้งแรกที่ค่อนข้างประทับใจตั้งแต่เริ่มปรึกษา คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมาก ส่วนตัวออกกำลังกายอยู่เป็นประจำเข้าฟิตเนส โยคะ และอยากลองเปิดใจให้พิลาทิส พอได้มาลองเล่นพิลาทิสกับนักกายภาพบำบัด
มีการตรวจสรีระอย่างละเอียดก่อนเล่น
ทำให้เราได้รู้ตั้งแต่วันแรกว่า สะโพกและลำตัว บิดหมุนไปคนละทาง และเป็นการเริ่มต้นเล่นพิลาทิสที่ช่วยฟื้นฟูตำแหน่งของร่างกายที่ผิดเพี้ยนไป เหมือนจะง่ายแต่อยากเอาเรื่องแต่สุดท้ายได้เหงื่อก็แฮ้ปปี้ดีค่ะ  ใครมองหาพิลาทิสเพื่อการปรับสรีระแก้อาการปวด ปรับความสมดุลกล้ามเนื้อ แนะนำเลยยยยย The first time was impressive 🫶
- คลินิคน่ารักจนคิดว่าเป็นร้านคาเฟ่ นักกายภาพให้ความรู้ดีจากที่เราไม่เข้าใจเค้าสามารถอธิบายจนเห็นภาพ
- มีรอบถัดไปแน่ๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
My first time trying Pilates and consulting with a physical therapist about my body 🤎

I was quite impressed from the very beginning, starting with the consultation. The therapist gave excellent advice. I already exercise regularly, going to the gym and doing yoga, and I wanted to try Pilates. I had the opportunity to try Pilates with a physical therapist.
A detailed body examination was conducted before the session.
This allowed me to discover from the first day that my hips and torso were rotating in different directions. It was a great start to Pilates to correct this misaligned body position. It seemed easy, but it was challenging! However, I was happy to sweat it out. If you're looking for Pilates to correct posture, relieve pain, and improve muscle balance, I highly recommend it!
- The clinic was so cute, it felt like a cafe. The physical therapist was very knowledgeable; they explained things clearly so I could visualize what I didn't understand.
- I'll definitely be back for more sessions!

reviews.name: Thankamol Inchansuk
reviews.text: วันนี้เราไปเจอนักกายภาพมา ก่อนไปรักษาเรารู้สึก หายใจไม่อิ่ม แน่นๆจุกๆเวลาทำงาน หรือออกกำลังกายหนักๆ  และมีตึงๆหลังและรู้สึกหลังแอ่นมากเวลาทำท่า squat และสะโพกเปิดไม่สุด แล้วก็รู้สึกออกแรงที่ก้นไม่เท่ากัน  เลยอยากไปเช็คร่างกาย คุณหมอกายภาพตรวจร่างกาย วิเคราะห์posture และค่อยๆอธิบายละเอียดมากคะ หลังจากนั้นตอนรักษาคุณหมอจะเน้นการออกกำลังร่วมกับการฝึกหายใจ เนื่องจาก เราหายใจไม่ถูก หลังและกะบังลมตึงมากกกก รังทั่วร่างกาย หลังรักษารู้สึกโล่งสบายมาก หลังที่ตึงมานานหรือรู้สึกแน่นเวลาพยายามหายใจ หายใจลงท้องได้มากขึ้น ไหล่หลังที่โก่ง ก็ตรงขึ้น ระดับสะโพกก็บิดน้อยลง ขอบคุณสำหรับความใส่ใจของคุณหมอ จะเอาท่ายืด ท่าออกกำลัง ไปฝึกต่อคะ
reviews.textTranslated: Today I went to see a physical therapist. Before treatment, I felt shortness of breath, tightness, and pressure when working or exercising intensely. I also had back stiffness and felt my back arched too much when doing squats, and my hips didn't open fully. I also felt uneven tension in my glutes. So I wanted to get a checkup. The physical therapist examined me, analyzed my posture, and explained everything in detail. After treatment, the doctor focused on exercises combined with breathing exercises because I wasn't breathing correctly, and my back and diaphragm were very tense, causing discomfort throughout my body. After treatment, I feel much better. The back stiffness and tightness I felt when trying to breathe are gone. I can now breathe into my abdomen more easily. My shoulders, which were hunched over, are straighter, and my hips are less twisted. Thank you for the doctor's care and attention. I will continue practicing the stretches and exercises.

reviews.name: Phob phob
reviews.text: เหมือนจะไม่ดี ไม่มีอะไรแต่ลองเปิดใจมาทำติดใจครับแก้ปัญหาเฉพาะบุคคลได้ตรงจุดรวมๆคือดีมากครับ  นักกายภาพใจดีครับ  ให้คำปรึกษาหรือแก้ปัญหาในสิ่งที่คนไข้เป็นอยู่ได้ตรงจุดครับ เน้นให้คนไข้ได้ออกกำลังกายควบคู่กับการรักษา สนุกครับ ไม่เบื่อดี  ที่คลินิกสะอาดมากครับ
reviews.textTranslated: It might seem like nothing special, but I decided to give it a try and I'm hooked! They address individual needs directly, and overall, it's excellent. The physiotherapists are kind and provide targeted advice and solutions for patients' specific problems. They emphasize exercise alongside treatment, which is fun and not boring. The clinic is also very clean.

reviews.name: Achiraya Yangsap
reviews.text: นักกายภาพบำบัดตรวจร่างกายละเอียดมาก อธิบายดี สอนจนเข้าใจสรีระโครงสร้างที่เอียง บิดหมุนจากท่ายืนปกติ ชอบที่คุณบิวออกแบบท่าออกกำลังกายเฉพาะให้หลังค่อมน้อยลง ขาหลังตึงน้อยลง มีส่งคลิปออกกำลังกายให้ทำที่บ้านเป็นการบ้านด้วย คลินิกสะอาด โฮมมี่ มีที่จอดรถหาง่าย
reviews.textTranslated: The physiotherapist did a very thorough physical examination, explained things well, and taught me until I understood the anatomical structure that was tilting and twisting from a normal standing position. I liked that Khun Bew designed specific exercises to reduce hunching and stiffness in the hamstrings. She also sent exercise videos to do at home as homework. The clinic was clean, homey, and had easy-to-find parking.

reviews.name: Ratana Chongveruwon
reviews.text: ผู้สูงอายุ 90 ปี ยังเคลื่อนไหวได้ อยากให้มีกิจกรรมออกจากบ้าน  ไปออกกำลังกาย เลยพามาที่นี่ เขามีความสุขมาก กิจกรรมสนุก เอากลับไปทำที่บ้านได้  คุณวิวดูแลอบอุ่นมาก
reviews.textTranslated: This 90-year-old senior is still active and wanted to participate in activities outside the house, like exercising, so we brought him here. He was very happy; the activities were fun and he can do them at home. Ms. View provided very warm and caring service.

reviews.name: Punyanut Sooksong
reviews.text: ประทับใจสุด บรรยากาศดีและมีพื้นที่จอดรถสะดวก อยู่ในคอมมูนิตี้มอลสะดวกและปลอดภัย เริ่มเข้ามาปรึกษานักกายภาพ เนื่องจากมีอาการกระดูกสันหลังคด และออกกำลังกายไม่เป็น ไม่รู้ว่าต้องออกกำลังกายกล้ามเนื้อตรงไหน นักกายภาพเป็นมืออาชีพ และเป็นกันเองมากก ลดความกังวลของคนไม่เคยเข้าคลินิคกายภาพไปได้เยอะ พอได้มาแล้วสนุกสุด เป็นการทำกายภาพบำบัดร่วมกับการเรียนพิลาทิส เรียนพิลาทิสที่นี่ดีมากๆค่ะ นักกายภาพมีความรู้ เน้นการแก้ไขร่างกายโดยเฉพาะเลย ปรับท่าทางให้postureดูดี หลังไม่ค่อม และค่อยๆลดองศาการคดลง ในช่วงเวลาเดือนเดียว อาการตึงตามจุดต่างๆลดลง และรู้สึกแข็งแรงมากขึ้น ใครกำลังมองหาคลินิคกายภาพ แนะนำเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I was extremely impressed. The atmosphere is great, and there's convenient parking. It's located in a community mall, which is convenient and safe. I started consulting with a physiotherapist because I had scoliosis and didn't know how to exercise or which muscles to target. The physiotherapist was very professional and friendly, which greatly reduced my anxiety as someone who had never been to a physiotherapy clinic before. Once I got there, it was so much fun! It's a combination of physiotherapy and Pilates classes. The Pilates classes here are excellent. The physiotherapists are knowledgeable and focus on correcting body issues, improving posture, preventing hunching, and gradually reducing the degree of scoliosis. In just one month, the stiffness in various areas has decreased, and I feel stronger. If you're looking for a physiotherapy clinic, I highly recommend this one!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณนะคะ ลุยกันต่อค่า

reviews.name: pim pink
reviews.text:
นักกายภาพบำบัดให้คำปรึกษาและแนะนำเป็นดี มีการตรวจร่างกาย มีประสบการณ์แนะนำท่าออกกำลังกายที่เหมาะแต่ละกับบุคคลเพื่อแก้ปัญหาที่คนไข้เป็นอยู่ อธิบายอย่างใจเย็น และแนะนำท่าไปออกกำลังกายที่บ้าน ชอบและดีมากค่ะ สถานที่สะอาด
บรรยากาศที่ผ่อนคลาย ด้านหลังมอลล์มีที่จอดรถสะดวก
reviews.textTranslated: The physical therapists provided excellent consultation and advice. They performed physical examinations and were experienced in recommending exercises tailored to each patient's specific needs. They explained things calmly and recommended exercises for home use. I really enjoyed it. The place was clean and had a relaxing atmosphere. Parking is convenient at the back of the mall.

reviews.name: eakachat joneurairatana
reviews.text:
การจัดระเบียบสรีระร่างกายเพื่อแก้ปัญหาการปวดเมื่อยที่บริเวณคอ บ่า ไหล่ ที่เรื้อรังมานานกว่า 10 ปี เป็นการแก้ปัญหาที่ตรงจุดที่สุด หลังจากได้ตระเวนการทำกายบำบัด นวด ฝังเข็ม ทำเลเซอร์ อุลตร้าซาวด์ และกินยาระงับปวด ที่เป็นการระงับได้เพียงชั่วคราว

Bslife สอนให้รู้จักการฝึกวางตำแหน่งร่างกายที่ถูกต้องและกายบริหารในท่าที่เหมาะสม อาการปวดเมื่อยต่างๆ ก็เริ่มดีขึ้นมากและเริ่มเข้าสู่สภาวะปกติ อย่างไรก็ตามจำเป็นต้องมีวินัยในการฝึกออกท่ากายบริหารอย่างสมำ่เสมออย่างต่อเนื่อง ครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
Correcting body alignment to address chronic neck, shoulder, and upper back pain that had persisted for over 10 years was the most direct solution. After trying various treatments including physical therapy, massage, acupuncture, laser therapy, ultrasound, and pain medication—all of which only provided temporary relief—

Bslife taught me proper body positioning and appropriate exercises. My pain significantly improved and I began to return to normal. However, consistent and disciplined practice of these exercises is essential.

reviews.name: Hathaikarn Smattavet
reviews.text:
มีอาการหมอนรองกระดูกคอเสื่อม หลังพบว่าเป็นโรคนี้ ไม่ได้ออกกำลังกายเลย ทำให้เหมือนร่างกายเริ่มแย่ ลามไปทุกส่วน และอยากออกกำลังกาย ที่มีนักกายภาพดูแล

พอมาปรึกษา ได้ความว่า ต้องปรับ posture ทั้งตัว เพื่อให้มีกล้ามเนื้อ ผยุงคอ และปรับไหล่ห่อ คอยื่น สบักที่มีปัญหา และพบว่าหลังแอ่น  ท้องแยก มีอาการเจ็บก้นกบด้วย เลยต้องปรับกล้ามเนื้อ ท้อง ก้น สะโพกขา (สรุปปรับทุกส่วน) >> การทำกายภาพ ฝั่งเข็ม คือการลดอาการปวด แต่การปรับ posture สร้างกล้ามเนื้อ เป็นการปรับที่ต้นทาง น่าจะดีในระยะยาว

แนะนำที่นึ่ เพราะ นักกายภาพมีความรู้ด้านกายภาพดี และมีความรู้พิลาทิสด้วย และมีความใส่ใจคนไข้ ตั้งใจในการทำงานมาก ราคาไม่แพง ตอนนี้ทำไป 4 ครั้งรู้สึก ดีขึ้น ยังคงต้องทำต่อไป
reviews.textTranslated:
I have cervical disc degeneration. Since being diagnosed, I haven't exercised at all, causing my body to deteriorate and affecting various parts of my body. I wanted to start exercising with the help of a physical therapist.

After consulting with a therapist, I learned that I need to adjust my posture throughout my body to strengthen the neck muscles and correct rounded shoulders, forward head posture, and problematic scapulae. They also found I have an arched back, abdominal separation, and tailbone pain, so I need to adjust my abdominal, gluteal, hip, and leg muscles (basically, adjusting every part of my body). >> Physical therapy and acupuncture can reduce pain, but adjusting posture and building muscle addresses the root cause, which should be better in the long run.

I recommend this place because the physical therapist is highly knowledgeable in physical therapy and Pilates. They are very attentive to patients and dedicated to their work. The price is reasonable. I've had 4 sessions and feel much better, and I will continue treatment.

reviews.name: sutthiwan sutthisong
reviews.text:
มาด้วยอาการ ปวดหลัง ชาร้าวลงขา
และกระดูกสันหลังคด น้องนักกายภาพตรวจร่างกายอย่างละเอียด เลยทราบว่าเวลายืน เดิน นั่งไม่สมดุล ตัวเอียงไปด้านข้าง และ ด้านหน้า กล้ามเนื้อหลังเกร็งตลอด น้องเค้าช่วยจัดสรีระ การยืน เดิน นั่งใหม่หมด รวมทั้งให้ออกกำลังช่วยเพิ่มความแข็งแรงของกล้ามเนื้อหน้าท้อง ก้น อุ้งเชิงกราน และแกนกลางลำตัว หลังจากมาฝึกได้ประมาณ 5 ครั้ง อาการปวดลดลงไปมาก ไม่ต้องทานยาเลย น้องเค้ามีถ่ายคลิปให้กลับมาฝึกบริหารเองที่บ้านด้วย ถูกใจมากค่ะ สถานที่ก็สะอาดสะอ้าน น้องก็ใจเย็น ไม่เร่งรีบ ค่อยๆให้เราฝึกค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
I came in with back pain, numbness radiating down my legs, and scoliosis.
The physiotherapist did a thorough examination and discovered that I had an imbalance when standing, walking, and sitting, leaning to the side and forward, and that my back muscles were constantly tense. She helped me adjust my posture for standing, walking, and sitting, and also prescribed exercises to strengthen my abdominal muscles, glutes, pelvis, and core. After about 5 sessions, my pain has significantly decreased, and I no longer need medication. She even filmed exercise videos for me to practice at home, which I really appreciated. The place was clean, and the physiotherapist was patient and didn't rush me, allowing me to exercise gradually.

reviews.text: คนไข้ Stroke สมองขาดเลือดทำให้มีปัญหาร่างกายซีกซ้ายไม่มีแรง ออกจากโรงพยาบาลวันแรกจะก้าวขึ้นรถลงรถต้องใช้มือขวาช่วยดึงขา เวลาเดินแทบต้องเดินลากขา โชคดีที่ได้เจอน้องบิว เจ้าของคลินิกรับเป็นเคสดูแลประจำ ตอนแรกก็หวังผลแค่ให้ซีกซ้ายได้ฟื้นบ้าง ขับรถได้ ช่วยเหลือตัวเองได้ แต่สิ่งที่ได้รับจากน้องบิวเกินกว่าที่คาดหวังไว้มาก ไม่เพียงแค่ได้รับคำแนะนำด้านการฝึกกายภาพ แต่ได้ความรู้เกี่ยวกับกลไกการทำงานของสมองและระบบประสาทมากขึ้น  การกายภาพไม่ใช่แค่เพียงการฟื้นฟูสภาพร่างกาย แต่เป็นฟื้นฟูสมอง และฟื้นฟูบุคลิกภาพให้ปกติที่สุดด้วย ขอแนะนำ แนะนำ และแนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ ไม่ผิดหวัง แต่มีข้อแม้ว่าผู้รับบริการต้อวมีวินัย อดทน และใจเย็นด้วยนะคะ ตอนนี้แฟนฟื้ฟูกลับมาได้ 90% ในเวลา 6 เดือน
reviews.textTranslated: A stroke patient experienced weakness on the left side of their body after a cerebral ischemia. On their first day out of the hospital, they needed their right hand to pull their leg up and down when getting in and out of a car, and could barely walk without dragging their leg. Fortunately, they met Nong Bew, the owner of the clinic, who took them under her care. Initially, the goal was simply for the left side to recover, allowing them to drive and be more independent. However, what they received from Nong Bew exceeded expectations. Not only did they receive guidance on physical therapy, but they also gained a deeper understanding of the brain and nervous system. Physical therapy isn't just about physical rehabilitation; it's about restoring the brain and personality to its fullest potential. I highly recommend this clinic! You won't be disappointed. However, it's important for patients to be disciplined, patient, and calm. My partner has now recovered by 90% in 6 months.

When I was leaving, it suddenly started raining heavily, and the staff actually tried to find an umbrella for me — it was such a sweet gesture! I especially want to thank Taew for giving me such a wonderful experience.

Overall, I had a lovely time here and would definitely come back!

Ajarn Petch is awesome!

There were a few consecutive 2-3min padwork + 1 min water break rounds, which was helpful for someone like me who had been having lots of food and drinks in BKK 😅😂

Will come back again because he gave very helpful feedback for improvement - focusing on improving my technique rather than just hitting the pads just for the sake of it.

reviews.name: Repeater Odious
reviews.text:
When first arriving at the gym after finding it on Google Maps and seeing some of the pictures and reviews, it's hard not to get a little disappointed. Although the photos here don't show it, the training takes place inside a separate room to the side; not in the airy and spacious area with the boxing ring. I don't want to accuse anyone of false advertising, but don't expect any ring time at this school.

The coaches have lots of knowledge and are nice people, but this isn't the place to go if you want to be given the red carpet treatment you might get elsewhere. After paying a eye-watering 1500 baht, I expected coach Petch to offer his undivided attention for the length of the session. Instead, he seemed more interested in making friends with my Thai girlfriend. It wasn't a bad session, just one that felt routine and formulaic, like he'd done it a hundred times before and couldn't be bothered to put as much into it as he once had. That said, I did decide to come the next day for a group session.

The group session was advertised on the website to be at 5pm. It wasn't. It was at 6. What's worse, I'd been told verbally by the coach to arrive at 5 the day before. Another couple of people showed up at 5, having booked private sessions earlier that morning. The coach, luckily, did arrive and did proceed with the private sessions (at 2x 1500 baht, who wouldn't), while I was allowed to wait for an hour and shadow box or kick the bag or something. Once the group class actually started it was fine, but I felt like the only reason I'd been invited was for their teenage fighter to have someone to spar with.

After a couple more group sessions I changed to another gym. For all the talent the coaches have, it didn't feel like there was a lot of heart going into things. Others, clearly, got more out of it than me.

reviews.text:
Amazing Muay Thai gym. If you’re a beginner or a seasoned fighter this is a great gym. Especially if you’re looking to get better technically. I learned so much in just one class here.

Kru Petch and his team are phenomenal trainers they’re funny, kind, chill and good at what they do. Kru Petch has also trained some of the top fighters in Thailand.

It’s not an intimidating place where you feel like you have to be really good or keep up with professionals.

I’m so glad I found this place in Bangkok because there are so many commercial Muay Thai gyms where you don’t feel like you’re learning much or training that hard.

The class sizes are also not too big so you get a lot of one on one time with the trainers.

It’s on the third floor in the Ambassador hotel. Go into the lobby and take the elevator then enter the pool area and go upstairs.

Very conveniently located in the Ambassador hotel Soi 11.
3-4 coaches always there to handle big groups even morning sessions are often not so crowded so hurry. Just make sure to make it there and coaches will take care of your good shape.

reviews.name: TravelingObsidianFoodie
reviews.text:
What an incredible experience at BAAN Massage! I just had a 90-minute aromatic oil massage here, and it was pure bliss from start to finish.
The masseuse was absolutely amazing – she had such strong arms and hands, and clearly knows exactly what she's doing. She applied the perfect pressure, working out all my knots and tension with smooth, flowing strokes. The aromatic oil smelled divine and added that extra layer of relaxation. The stretching at the end was spot-on too – I felt so flexible and rejuvenated afterward.
I actually fell asleep halfway through because it was so soothing and therapeutic – that's how good it was!
The place itself is a calming oasis, beautifully designed and super peaceful even though it's in a busy area of Chiang Mai. Everything felt clean, professional, and welcoming.
Great timing as well – I caught a promotion and got this luxurious 1.5-hour session at an unbeatable price.
I highly recommend BAAN Massage to anyone looking for a top-quality aromatic massage. It's easily one of the best I've had in Thailand. I'll definitely be back next time I'm in town! Thank you for such a wonderful, relaxing experience 🙏✨❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful and detailed review! We’re truly delighted to hear that your massage was such a blissful and relaxing experience. It means a lot to us. We truly appreciate your high recommendation. Thank you for choosing BAAN Massage—we’ll be more than happy to welcome you back on your next visit to Chiang Mai!

Warm regards,
BAAN Massage Team

reviews.text: I had two great massage experiences at BAAN - a  90 minute Thai Massage and Relive Massage. Both sit at the top of my massage experiences. The foot and hand massages on the relive massages worked out more of the whole limbs rather than feet and hand, but to me, this was much more enjoyable and relaxing. Thai massage was very firm in all the areas it needed and worked out so many of my knots. They also were very accomodating as I double booked myself into two massages at the same time using Klook and they let me reschedule the second massage to the next day. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.text:
Very quiet and well appointed space. Clean, modern, and the staff speak good English. There’s ample availability throughout the day so you could walk in, but they also have a good online booking system.

You can either pay cash or credit card (additional 3% fee if by credit card). They start with a foot soap and wash followed by the massage. I did the head and shoulders massage + a 20 minute hand massage, which was very relaxing.

The total was about 640 for the 60 minute package, which is very reasonable given the quality of the establishment (it’s slightly higher priced than a small street massage but far more economical than larger chains like Let’s Relax or Oasis, but offering a similar service as the larger chain spas).

Overall, one of the top massage and spa establishments in Chiangmai that isn’t a big chain or a small hole in the wall. It’s modern, clean, and staff are friendly and good with communication with an easy to use online booking system. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Family_in_right_relation
reviews.text:
Maliha Yoga – A Hidden Sanctuary in Pai

Under the shade of Pai’s magnificent lychee trees sits something truly special. In the same little market where you’ll find Tribal Coffee — arguably the best coffee in the world — you’ll also discover what may well be the best yoga in Thailand.

Yes… the best coffee and the best yoga, side by side, under the same canopy of ancient trees.

But don’t take our word for it — come and experience it for yourself.

When you walk into Maliha Yoga, you immediately feel that this place is different. The studio itself is a beautiful mud-brick house, built by hand, full of warmth, soul, and intention.

A powerful mural of the stag — the king of the forest — watches over the space. The stag represents a gentle masculine strength: powerful, grounded, yet peaceful. A reminder that true strength protects life rather than harming it.

Within the walls you’ll also notice something deeply symbolic — a carved yoni, honoring the sacred portal through which every human being has entered this world. It is a quiet acknowledgment of the feminine source of life, of Mother Earth — Pachamama — the giver of all creation.

And of course, in yoga we greet the other great force that sustains us: the Father Sun, honored through the sun salutations. Beautiful stained glass in the studio reflects this light, filling the room with a gentle sacred atmosphere.

But what truly makes Maliha Yoga special is Pixie, the heart behind it all.

Pixie has practiced yoga for over 20 years. For many years she practiced quietly, not even wanting to become a teacher because she saw how easily people could become “certified teachers.” For her, yoga was never about the title — it was about devotion to the practice.

Only after 17 years of deep personal practice did she complete her teacher training, and when she finally began sharing her knowledge, it became clear that teaching was her true gift.

Today, Pixie offers that gift to everyone who comes through Pai.

Running a small independent studio is not easy, especially when louder marketing fills social media feeds. But Maliha Yoga stands strong through something much more powerful than advertising:

heart, authenticity, and decades of real practice.

If you are in Pai, this is not just another yoga class.

It is a true yoga experience.

Come for the coffee.
Stay for the yoga.
Leave with something deeper.

With gratitude,
Jason Whitehawk & family

May all beings have peace in their hearts, joy in their being, and love in, through, and around us all.

Aho.

reviews.name: benn
reviews.text:
Great place is made by great people. It is run by a Great Master. I do highly recommend the gym. You can stay in and train. Accomodation is available. A place where one can learn to be respectful, humble, passionate about the beautiful art of Muay Thai.
A place that grows in you and you become part of it.
With humility, love and respect for all at Master Toddy's Gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Benn,
Thank you for your thoughtful review. It's truly the people who make our gym a special place. We're glad you appreciate the full experience, from training to accommodation, and the values of respect, humility, and passion for Muay Thai we embody. It's wonderful to hear how the gym has become a meaningful part of your journey. Your sentiments of humility, love, and respect are deeply shared by all of us here.

reviews.name: Dre
reviews.text:
5* out of 5 * ....
You want Muay Thai Training, legit and in a great environment with great people?
Well this is the place you want to be. Friendly, helpful, open minded, legit...you name it.
Sawadee kràp 🙏🇹🇭🙏👊
Edit - now I am here a 2nd time and is even better than before

reviews.name: Mile
reviews.text: It was okay for the first couple days but I quickly came to realize that this isn’t a real Thai gym. Instead it’s a highly priced social media trap. The instructors aren’t Thai and the gym only attracts foreigners. The gym is unsanitary and the training is extremely basic. After a few days of being here I began to realize the owner of the gym is more of a businessman than an actual teacher and clearly only cares about being paid. I did meet some decent people during my stay but other people including the staff were unwelcoming. For the price I paid I expected a lot better. I’ll be going elsewhere next time.

reviews.name: C Patrick
reviews.text:
Send my wife there for training, she is having a great moment and she really love to train there. I've also been able to see the training there. What i can say is that Master Toddy is awesome, very kind and lovely person. He gives very good advice and very good technique.

Thank you very much Master Toddy and thanks a lot Master O very kind and good person.

Thanks for being there for all the fighters Around the world .. you are such a nice and good person. Be blessed. Every time am in Thailand i will come visit you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
C Patrick,
It's wonderful to hear about your wife's positive training experience and your own observations of the training environment. We're glad that Master Toddy and Master O's kindness, expertise, and valuable advice made such a memorable impact.

Thank you for your heartfelt appreciation. We're here for all fighters around the world, and your recognition means a lot to us. Looking forward to your visits whenever you're in Thailand.

reviews.name: buyushay
reviews.text: I have trained with Master Toddy for many years form his time in Las Vegas. I just made the trip to Bangkok to train with him and his team again. Excellent!! All of the trainers are experienced and professional. Everyone has a blast training there while learning the intricacies of Muay Thai. Master Toddy's office staff is awesome as well.  So helpful and a pleasure to hang out with.

reviews.name: SAINT
reviews.text:
The staff was welcoming and very helpful. You're provided with plenty of meal tickets for food to use at specific restaurants. I only wish there were more restaurants to use them but the food at the current restaurants are on point fr! The training is on point! The coaches are on point! Errrrthang on point!
They will push you at both locations!
I'll definitely be back!
I had an amazing experience and I would highly recommend this gym to others for some PROPER Muay Thai Training definitely check out Master Toddy's gym you won't regret it!

reviews.name: Joe Boland
reviews.text: Some decent genuinely good people to meet and some great trainers. However that’s only half of it. Management is beyond a joke and Master Toddy at first impression is great until you see what he is really all about. A man with little to no ethics. All the respect to what he accomplished as a fighter but the best way to sum it up is he is the “Hulk Hogan of Muay Thai”. I would highly recommend staying elsewhere.

reviews.name: Repeater Odious
reviews.text: I stayed for a week at Master Toddy's. The worst part of the experience was the initial impression. It was almost as if my arrival caught them by surprise and I wasn't really "introduced" to the training regimen and arrangements in the best way. Once everything was sorted out, however, I had a great week of training - mostly alongside other foreigners, which seems to be the norm in Thailand for some reason. I'm looking forward to coming again in the future. Maybe it'll be even better the second time around.

title: Manop Gym
ownerDescription: Muay Thai gym in Chiang Mai
