reviews.name: Tracey C
reviews.text:
Great place for all fighters and levels LGBTQ friendly.

Truely my favourite gym in Thailand - incredibly skilled and high level fighters and coaches whilst still being a really welcoming friendly and hospital place. I was made to feel super quickly at home here and felt taken very seriously in my training and fighting goals. We also did some lovely social activities together like watching fights and going rafting at a local river.

I really feel blessed to have found this training space and to have had the opportunity to train with all these wonderful people. Big shout-out also to gi gi in the office/shop who really helped me to find accomodation locally and to order material for my gym at home.

I also got several opportunities to fight whilst here which I'm very greatful for - nice matches in a local stadium with opportunities in Bangkok also available if you put in the time and work! What I especially loved is the focus on skill improvements and the mix between very light highly technical training in the mornings and heavier pad and bag work in the afternoon as well as minimum 30 minutes a day clinching which for my style is essential.

Will certainly be coming back as soon as possible.

reviews.name: אריה רסקין
reviews.text: This is a real, authentic Muay Thai gym! I looked at a lot of gyms before finding something like this. This is the top gym in all of Thailand, and I’ve been to many! It has a family atmosphere where everyone is really nice and there is no ego. The gym is full of professional title-belt fighters, yet everyone is so kind and professional. Highly recommended! I will definitely be back!

reviews.name: Haru Thang Zhe Wei
reviews.text:
Having a great experience here.
The coach is all friendly and explain well.
The most i like about this gym is everytime finish training they will teach Wai Kru.
If you want to have a pro fight experience u can talk with kru Manop. 👍👍👍

Will come back again. 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Dan Kaetsu
reviews.text:
I travel to Thailand every year to train, and have since made it a point to go to Chiang Mai to train at Manop Gym. I have been training in Muay Thai for over 20 years, and I can truly say that Manop Gym is one of the best gyms I have ever been to.

Kru Manop delivers a masterclass of technical Muay Thai knowledge and IQ (I would expect no less from the trainer of Saenchai).  I highly recommend this gym for its friendly atmosphere, authentic Muay Thai experience (not like the overpopulated camps for tourists), and of course the high level of instruction and techniques.

reviews.name: Alfie Awuye-North
reviews.text: I went to Manop Gym with zero Muay thai experience and trained for around a month. I am extremely grateful to this gym, the coaches and fighters. You can go at your own pace and if you want to be pushed it’s the perfect place to work extremely hard. I recommend this gym whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced fighter. I honestly couldn’t recommend it enough. Thank you again ❤️❤️

reviews.name: Rasmus Risager
reviews.text:
An absolute gem of Chiang Mai. Very technically sound and with a fantastic "family" vibe to it!
The fact that it's a little bit outside town means there's more longterm stays and higher level to spar with, rather than the tourist heavy gyms closer to the city.

reviews.name: Zsombor Németh
reviews.text:
As a seasoned Muay Thai practitioner who has been training at Manop Gym in Chiang Mai, Thailand for more than five years, I can confidently say that this gym is one of the best Muay Thai gyms in the region.

The head trainer, Kru Manop, is a highly skilled and experienced fighter, and his guidance has allowed me to fight in some of the biggest stadiums in Thailand, including Lumpinee, Rajadamnern, and Rangsit Boxing Stadium. Kru Manop is passionate about Muay Thai, and his dedication to the art is evident in the quality of training he provides.

What sets Manop Gym apart from other gyms is its ability to cater to students of all levels. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced fighter, you will find the training at this gym to be challenging yet manageable. The trainers speak English and provide great care and attention to their students, teaching techniques and correcting mistakes in a constructive and helpful manner.

What I appreciate most about Manop Gym is that it is a pure Muay Thai gym. There are no distractions or mixed martial arts training here, only the traditional and authentic teachings of Muay Thai. This focus on the art form allows students to truly hone their skills and become better fighters.

Overall, I highly recommend Manop Gym to anyone looking to train Muay That in Chiang Mai. With its experienced trainers, supportive community, and commitment to the art of Muay Thai, this gym is an excellent choice for anyone looking to improve their skills and become a better fighter.

reviews.name: Quang Thang Tran
reviews.text:
I booked only one week because of my tight holiday schedule and I regretted it already. It is a great experience to train muay thai here. Kru Manop is a really great muay thai coach, he pays a lot attention to details in each technique and corrects you until your technique is perfect (or beautiful as the Thai says). In addition he is very nice and generous he helps you with everything not only in the training, also to drive you to get lunch or dinner or if you need help with something else. It doesn't matter if you're a beginner or a more experienced fighter there is always room for improvement and Kru Manop will show it to you.
The other coach Kru Phonsak is also a very experienced coach, he's very funny and always jokes around.

The gym is really nice, it's located a little bit outside the city of Chiang Mai but you still can get to the city in 15 or 20 minutes with a bike or car. There are also rooms you can book to sleep in the Gym, the rooms are simple and clean. I would recommend to book the big room if it is available. So if you're into training muay thai and you're in Chiang Mai you got to visit Manop Gym.

I've met really nice people in only one week here and will remember them

reviews.name: Christian N.
reviews.text: By far the best gym I've ever been to, and I've trained in many, from Asia to Europe. Kru Manop's style of teaching is unlike anywhere else, combining freedom for you as a student to progress at your pace, while paying close attention to the beauty of your technique. At each step of my journey here, new techniques are introduced, old techniques are refined with subtle improvements. There's a wealth of experience here that is unmatched anywhere else, but what I like the most is the spirit of Manop Gym, the happy energy that surrounds everyone and the generosity that all the trainers have in sharing their knowledge. We all train together, there isn't a section for the pros and another for the beginners, we all share the art and learn from one another. Hope this helps.

reviews.name: Rob
reviews.text: Had a great experience, did a drop in class. The coaches were very good, I recommend checking this out of you are in the area!

reviews.name: Luke Hope
reviews.text: Lived and trained here for an amazing 11 weeks Manop gym has high level coaching that focuses on refining your technique as well as high level pad holders and sparring hep Kru Manop, Migkey, Moo, Sarah and Krish.

reviews.name: Jordan Nogareda
reviews.text:
I spent a month at this gym as a traveler from USA. My coach at my home gym said I should come here and I'm super happy that I did. The conditioning here is not extreme, but the attention to detail on technique is. I learned so much in such a short time and had no issue retaining it, because of the teaching ability of the Krus here. The fighters who stay here eventually become champions. I will do my best to return to this gym every year.

As far as living here, we were welcomed and treated like family. Manop helped us with any issues with the rooms and looks after the team like a father would. Family environment all the way, down to earth. He brought me to the hospital for an environmental reaction I had and sat with me the whole time..no complaining or hesitation.

Whoever you are, what ever level of training you may be at (0-hero), whatever language you speak, whenever you come here, you will be taken care of and improve your abilities.

reviews.name: mike wei
reviews.text:
I have trained 5 different gyms in Chiangmai, 4 in Phuket in one year period, Manop and the other one are the top two gyms I have trained.
Manop pays the closest attention to detail, and took the time to correct me helps me develops more efficient strike and positioning.

Manop team is always so welcoming, never felt distance training in there.

reviews.name: cillian
reviews.text: amazing gym very welcoming and technical. Was a pleasure to train here will be back!

reviews.name: Sebastian Hild
reviews.text: Very great gym. The Trainers really made a fighter out of me. The owner is a very kind and helpful person. I spend a long time there and it was very worth it.

reviews.name: Gabriel Matoso
reviews.text: The best option to train Muaythai in Chiang Mai. Good structure to have classes and to have a room. Kru Manop has large experience with high level fighters and he can teach you also if you are student or professional.

reviews.name: Youssef Kilani
reviews.text: One of the best Muay Thai gyms not only in the north but in whole Thailand. The vibe was really good, everyone is nice and welcoming and the trainers are so professional. Definitely going back there my next time in Thailand

reviews.text: I trained here last year and honestly had an amazing time.  The trainers and community who train here are fantastic.  I felt like no matter what your goal is as long as you want to learn muay thai you will get attention and learn

The gym is located in a quiet residential area of Chiang Mai but easily accessible. Highly recommend manop gym.

reviews.name: Mi
reviews.text:
* they accept card payment for 3% card fee.
(Good to know since we were out of cash the last day here)

I had a very enjoyable massage. I had 120 min for 700 THB which was very affordable.
Typical Thai mattresses that you lay on. Just be aware that you’ll have your head on a pilllow or directly on the mattress and not the normal whole I’m the bench. Can feel a bit stiff in the neck after a while but I got used to it.
My masseus was really good! I’m a masseus myself so I could tell she was in the moment and really kneaded every inch of my body.
I was really happy with the massage but my boyfriend had a more inconsistent experience where she was too soft and suddenly too hard and didn’t understand English. He had some requests that she didn’t understand unfortunately.

A couple minuses. No music during the two hour long session. I asked for the air conditioner to be warmer but she couldn’t change it due to other guest in there she said. I was a bit cold.
Masseus could’ve had some better understanding at English so we could easier communicate.

I still recommend a visit! I had a great time!

As a female, this place felt super safe and lovely. Hopefully one day I can return here!

reviews.name: Daniel Avital
reviews.text:
This is the very best traditional Thai massage place in the center in my honest opinion.
I recommend a two hour Thai massage and would recommend preparing for some serious work, this is not a relaxing oil massage (which they also offer) or an easy foot massage (also offer a really good one), this is where you come to solve problems with a serious and pretty hard Thai massage.
Pricing is very reasonable (280 THB/h last time I was there) and the staff is of the highest professional standard.
The place itself is not fancy, but very clean.

reviews.name: Khushboo Gupta
reviews.text:
Terrible experience! I’m in so much pain as I write this. Went for a 2 hour Traditional Thai massage here on 26th afternoon. I should have paid more heed to the reviews before this that mentioned an old lady who is absolutely the worst masseuse you can get! It started out all fine, but slowly started to get very painful with a lot of poking with elbows etc. Despite telling her that the pressure was too strong for my liking she just carried on and laughed it off. Honestly after a point I was just waiting to be done with this ordeal. What annoyed me even further was that the guy doing the massage for my partner, and this old lady doing my massage, would just not stop talking! They were loud and super annoying! Constantly yapping loudly.
Very unpleasant for a customer who has come for a 2 hour massage to relax, unwind and some shut eye. Anyway, finally it ended.

The pain started to set in around my upper back and shoulders only the next day and it started become pretty bad! We were staying close to this place, so the following day I went back to tell them that I was in pain and if there’s anything they can do to help it.
Their reaction was appalling to say the least, the lady at the reception first refused to say anything and just brushed me off saying we can’t do anything. When I insisted that they at least and put some balm/ do some stretches so that the pain reduces, she said we can’t do anything - go eat some medicine. After this, she just walked away disappeared and don’t come back! Came back home and met an orthopaedic first thing after landing because by the pain was quite bad. The doctor told me that the masseuse had bruised my muscles by applying wayyyy too much pressure. There can be internal bleeding too! I’m now popping pain killers and hoping to recover in a few weeks. What was supposed to be a fun and relaxing massage outing with my husband turned out to be an absolute nightmare! I think this place should be reported. Disgusted, scarred and horrified at their callousness and absurd behaviour. DO NOT GET A MASSAGE HERE. EVER!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We already know this mistake was happened that means it was a sadly experience when you visit in my country.
      We have to say apologize and of course we’ll  fix it and improve this mistake to make it better. 
      Thank so much for your comment and thank you for giving us that opportunity to serve you.

reviews.name: Shiho Ottomo
reviews.text:
I went here today, completely exhausted from the business trip and feeling unwell.
The massage therapist lady, Su, gave me a 90 min wonderful full body oil massage. She was so considerate, lovely, and caring. Initially she selected a bed, and not the mattress on the floor but it was directly under the aircon and she thought that it would be too cold for me, she took me to the matress a bit away from the aircon (while she was covered in sweat)🙏🏻😭❤️✨️. The oil massage was a based on traditional Thai massage, a bit more gentle and relaxing than dry massage. Su's Thai massage was the best one I had in my life (in Japan, Australia, and Thailand combined) 😭❤️✨️!!

The price was affordable - usually, in this area, they charge a lot more as it's a  touristy area with a bunch of hotels. My local friend told me Thai massage should be around 350 ish, no more than 400. This place was worth the money and provided amazing service. I told Su that I'm coming back to see her for the remainder of the trip. I cannot thank her enough🥰🙏🏻🙇🏻‍♀️✨️. I can highly recommend❤️. Khob khun ka, arigato🍀✨️.

reviews.text:
I genuinely had no idea what to expect going into Femme Flow, but it was a 5 star experience for sure.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Bella!
Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear about your experience and would like to clarify a few things 🙌 

You asked for 4 extra classes as a gift, although our standard bonus for a 20-class package is either unlimited self-training or a locker. Despite that, we went beyond our usual policy and gave you 2 extra classes as a sign of goodwill.

Later, you asked to share your package with a friend, which goes against our studio policy. Each student must have their own package to keep things fair for everyone — this rule is clearly communicated.
When you said you couldn’t finish your classes, we offered a 1-week freeze. At the same time, you told us you can only attend twice a week, which made your earlier request for 4 extra classes quite confusing🙁

You asked for a refund after using part of your package. According to our clear and public policy, refunds are only possible within 14 days and before activation. Your package was active, and we had regularly reminded you about it.
We’ve always acted with transparency and respect and did our best to meet you halfway. All our rules are clearly stated both online and in the studio.

You’re always welcome back — but only with mutual respect🙏
– Femme Flow Team

I would definitely come back the next time I’m in the area. Thank you very much!

reviews.name: Theresa Kotthoff
reviews.text:
Following the great reviews I came to the massage shop for a 1,5 hour foot / neck / shoulder massage. Unfortunately, I can’t recommend the place. It was actually the worst massage I ever got and I contemplated leaving during massage to avoid wasting my time. The masseuse was not skilled at all. Probably there are better therapists at the shop, but mine definitely needs training, she was also very young. Please train staff before you let them take care of customers.
I was also cold throughout the massage. So, not happy at all. 🥶

reviews.name: swapna iyer
reviews.text: Happiness in soi 21 is one of my fav massage spots. All the masseuse are very good. Today I did a 2 hour aroma + hot herbal ball as I was jetlagged and very tired. Kh Toi was just excellent. Great price, very clean, talented staff...highly recommend them

reviews.name: Mika Salmela
reviews.text: Fantastic oil massage by Pat. Even though she looked small she had a lot of power and good technique. Both calm and relaxing but at times also deep tissue massage. Next time I will go for 90 minutes.

reviews.name: Thomas
reviews.text:
I received a 60-minute Thai massage for two people.
After the massage, we were seated and served tea. I checked the receipt, which clearly stated 700 THB. I handed that receipt along with my credit card to a female staff member. After she processed the payment, I reviewed the final transaction slip and found that 721 THB had been charged.
When I asked for a breakdown of the additional charge, I was told it was a credit card processing fee. However, there had been absolutely no prior notice of this fee. Only after I questioned the difference did the staff member show a fee notice that had been placed out of customers’ sight. Presenting such information only after the payment has been completed is highly inappropriate.
In Thailand, credit card merchants are generally prohibited under card network regulations from passing processing fees on to customers. From that perspective as well, I do not believe this handling was appropriate.
This is not about the small amount of money. It is about pricing transparency and fair billing practices.
I will not return. There are other Thai massage shops of similar quality next door and across the street, and I would recommend those instead.

reviews.name: yupaporn hannarong
reviews.text: Had a great massage with one of the therapists, it was very relaxing and firm at the same time. Staff were very friendly at the front and place was clean. Recommended

was not strong enough .after I told her,she changed the powder to be harder .thanks a lot !

reviews.name: Shufang Tay
reviews.text:
Not one to write reviews usually but really wanted to give credit to this great place! Walked in by chance since the spa outlet we wanted to go to was fully booked. Had our best massage in Bangkok ever here!
We went for the 2 hours full body Thai massage + back and neck. The masseur gave us such a good stretch and sore points she kept massaging were so accurate! For both my friend & my masseur so we can really attest to the skills here. The place is clean enough. Not private room but you get your own bed with curtains drawn.
Really great value! I would come back here and pay a great value price as compared to the bigger spa establishments we visited in the past.

reviews.text: Beyond amazing!! had the 1.5 hour aroma massage and Nam was very thorough and found knots I didn't know I had 🥰

reviews.text:
This is a massage shop I highly recommend to anyone visiting Bangkok. I come here every time I’m in the city, and the massages are consistently excellent.

The place is clean, the staff are skilled, and they pay great attention to detail. I had a session with Am today—she was amazing—but honestly, every therapist I’ve had here has been great.

What touched me the most was how kindly they looked after my 10-month-old son during our visit. I know it’s not part of their service, but they went out of their way to help, and he had a great time while we had our massage. I’m truly grateful—thank you so much! 💕🥰

reviews.name: alfred zhao
reviews.text: Most of the massage therapists at this store have nothing to say about technology. I have basically experienced it all. The massage is effortless and basically goes through the motions. It is completely unlike authentic Thai massage. It is a store that attracts customers by offering low prices. This is my real experience!

reviews.name: David Jakob
reviews.text:
I recently visited Happiness Massage 21, and it was an absolute delight! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles and a calming atmosphere that instantly made me feel relaxed. The staff were incredibly professional and attentive, ensuring I was comfortable throughout my entire visit.

The massage itself was exceptional. The therapist was highly skilled and tailored the session to my needs, melting away all my stress and tension. The combination of soothing music, aromatic oils, and expert techniques made for a truly blissful experience. By the end of the session, I felt completely rejuvenated and at peace.

What I appreciated most was the attention to detail – the clean, tranquil environment and the genuine care shown by everyone at Happiness Massage 21. It’s clear they prioritize their customers’ wellbeing and satisfaction.

I highly recommend Happiness Massage 21 to anyone looking for an outstanding massage in Bangkok. I will definitely be coming back

reviews.name: Hippie Vibes
reviews.text:
I read some positive reviews and headed here, but the Thai massage was just about average.
The lady doing my massage was just disinterested & low on energy, despite me telling her to increase the pressure level. She was doing random movements - like first the legs, then the hands, then she again forgot something & went back to the legs. Also the left & right side massage movements were not coordinated

reviews.text: I've been to many massage shops in Bangkok. Here I had the best foot massage (1 hour) + back and shoulder seated in chair (30 minutes) so far! The right pressure and relaxing! I'll come back for sure! Thank you!

reviews.name: adrian motiung
reviews.text:
My first visit here in June of 26. Previously I went to their branch in Thong Lo.
What impresses me was the aesthetically pleasing and clean gym. Easily the most beautiful and cleanest BJJ Gym I have trained.

The owner, Professor P made me feel right at home. His vision to create a clean, safe  BJJ training environment with awesome vibes all around surely resonates with every BJJ enthusiast be it competitor or hobbyist.
Rules such as no jumping submission, no jumping guard and no kani basami is clearly written.

Definitely won't be my last time coming here. Whenever I'm in Bangkok, Arete will always be my first choice no doubt!

P/S I am still high from endorphins after 2 days post training.

reviews.name: Beau Barrett
reviews.text:
I spent 8 months training at arete chatuchak while living in Thailand with my wife and infant son. I had done some BJJ before back in Canada previously. My hope was to better myself in the sport but instead I ended up finding a community of friends that felt like a second family, learnt foundational and advanced techniques, entered tournaments and attended them as a team, found many new uncles and aunts for my little boy.
It has been one of the best experiences of my life and completely changed our time in Thailand for the better with the community it provided.
The coaches are great at teaching and very comfortable to talk with as they speak English fantastically.
My family and I moved out of BKK 2 days ago and the hardest part for myself and my wife was saying goodbye to everyone at this gym.
We plan to visit a few times a year so we can visit the friends that we've made for life.
If you haven't done BJJ before or know any Thai, don't worry, I would say you couldn't pick a better gym to start at than Arete Chatuchak.

reviews.name: Tazio Lai
reviews.text:
3rd visit since they’ve opened and Coach PK and his purple belt instructors are very welcoming, committed and give detailed instructions when teaching.

The gym itself is super bright and airy, air conditioned and spotlessly clean!

There’s massive shower and bathrooms for both men and women, so none of that awkward rush or lining up for the shower when it’s time to go.

Changing rooms are also bright and spacious.

The mats themselves are fantastic and feel just right for standup and take downs.

With all that, and the MRT and parking lot on site, it’s definitely worth a visit!

reviews.name: Adil
reviews.text:
The first thing you will notice when you walk into the gym is the cleanliness. This gym is probably one of the cleanest BJJ gym you could find in Bangkok. This place is very well maintained and it really does make you feel like home.

Coach PK and Coach Beam are two very professional coaches and do not push you to be perfect with your techniques the first time, and guide you step by step through every technique in detail. They will teach you many different variations and they make it in a way that makes it enjoyable for beginners.

If you are looking for a place to roll or train, I highly recommend this place. The atmosphere is great, the people are great, but most importantly, the coaches are top-notch. Whether you are there to roll, or to make connections, this is the place.

reviews.name: Paul Sricharoen
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Arete Chatujak for some time now, and it has been an incredible experience. As a complete beginner, I was a bit nervous starting out, but the coaches here are very good. Their attention to detail is next level—they don't just show a move; they make sure you understand the mechanics behind it so you actually get it right.

On top of the technical instruction, the community here is GREAT. Everyone is super welcoming, and there’s a real vibe of helping each other improve. Highly recommend to anyone in the area looking to start their BJJ journey krub.

reviews.name: Christopher Bader
reviews.text:
Come for the Jiu-Jitsu, stay for the community.

Arete Chatuchak is a great new gym with clean facilities and spacious mats. The instructors are very detail-oriented and follow a structured approach to teaching, which makes the classes easy to follow and effective.

They also have drinks, protein bars, showers, a small gym area, and merch available.

Highly recommend for anyone in Bangkok looking for a welcoming place to train. Will definitely be back! 🥋🙏

reviews.name: masahiro suda
reviews.text:
This gym is a great place for everyone. The coaches provide very detailed instruction and explain not only the techniques but also the principles behind them in a clear and easy-to-understand way.

The community here is also amazing. Regardless of gender, nationality, or skill level, everyone helps each other learn and improve.
My Thai and English are not very good, but everyone is very kind and supportive, which makes me feel comfortable training here.

It is also very beginner-friendly, so I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to start Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. In addition, the gym is always very clean and safe, making it a great environment to train in.

I’m very grateful to have found such a welcoming and supportive gym.

reviews.name: Monet
reviews.text:
As someone who was changing BJJ gyms, both coach PK and coach Beam were so kind and welcoming, making the transition absolutely seamless. The atmosphere here is very positive, supportive and focused on growth whether you're a beginner or more advance.
The instructions and drills are top-notch, with attention to detail that really helps improve your technique. The team culture fosters both hard work and camaraderie. I’m grateful to have found this gym and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to train!

reviews.name: Jacob Fang
reviews.text:
This is an excellent new BJJ school in Chatuchak, Bangkok! The atmosphere is very welcoming, and the environment is incredibly clean—easily one of the cleanest gyms in the area. There is a weightlifting rack too if you want to lift.

The instructors are fantastic—one black belt and one purple belt—both very passionate about BJJ. They take the time to break down techniques and ensure everyone understands the fundamentals. This is a great time to join since they are focusing on building a strong foundation, making it perfect for beginners.

After every class, there’s an open mat where you can roll with the instructors and continue learning. Overall, a great place to train for anyone looking to start or improve their BJJ skills!

reviews.name: michael reinsch
reviews.text: I’ve been training with Coach PK at Arete BJJ Chatuchak for over a year, and it’s been a fantastic experience. He’s an amazing coach—patient, encouraging, and incredibly knowledgeable. No matter your skill level, he takes the time to help you improve. Highly recommend Arete to anyone interested in BJJ. 👊🥋

reviews.name: Raymark Cabildo
reviews.text: I wanted to do some rolls while in the city for vacation and quickly found this place near my hotel. What a pleasant surprise! First of all, the people are friendly and knowledgeable of jiu-jitsu. Prof Pk emphasizes on practical techniques and the people that train there practice what they preach. Also the facilities, although a bit confusing to find because of construction, was very very clean and well worth the effort to drop in. Will def come back!

reviews.name: 鹿毛光芳
reviews.text: Very nice gym. People are friendly, has good facility, hot water shower room too. Worth to visit.

reviews.name: Alexander Kozlov
reviews.text: Arete Chatuchak is an amazing new school with a very strong roots from the famous Arete BJJ.  When you look for a place to train you usually want the academy be clean, friendly, easily accessible by public transport and have good knowledgeable instructors and tough but safe people to roll with. Arete Chatuchak has all of them. The head instructor PK is a very skilled and open minded black belt, and very accomplished competitor, he knows how to push his students to bring best out of them but do it in a safe and gradual manner. Classes are taught in both English and Thai, so it’s absolutely ok if you don’t speak Thai. They provide a lot of attention to every student to make sure that they learn in the way which suits them the best. This studio is so clean and so friendly but also can give you very tough rolls if it’s what you are looking for!  Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Frederic S
reviews.text:
Easily the best spot for Jiujitsu in the area.
The location is super convenient—just a short walk from MRT Kamphaeng Phet and near Chatuchak Market, so getting there is hassle-free.

The gym itself is spacious and well-kept, with clean facilities and a solid training environment. The coaches are not just skilled but also really welcoming, which makes a big difference, especially if you’re new. They have classes for all levels, including complete beginners, kids, and they’re about to start women’s self-defense classes soon.

Overall, it’s a great place to train—good people, good atmosphere, and no ego. If you’re in the area and looking for quality BJJ training, definitely worth checking out.

Pim the manager arranged everything and it was beautiful and our group had an amazing time. The spa is beautiful and and the staff is so kind. Special thanks to Pim and Wanrudee for all of your arranging. The Bridal party was a perfect way to treat the bride and celebrate with the ladies.

reviews.text: I used to come here so often, today i was coming back after a very long time. reviews.name: Kochapan T
reviews.text:
I used to be a frequent visitor and always enjoyed the Thai massage and steam room at your place. However, on my recent visits (the last 2 times), I noticed a significant decline in the Thai massage quality.

Although I clearly mentioned that I preferred a medium pressure massage because I hadn’t had Thai massage for a while, the therapist continued to apply very strong pressure that was painful. When I gave feedback during the session, the response I received  such as “Now you know what Thai massage feels like”  made me feel uncomfortable.

I’ve experienced Thai massage at other reputable places where it helped relieve back pain and left me relaxed. This time, however, I felt more pain afterwards and still haven’t recovered even after two days.

I’m sharing this feedback in the hope that your team can review and maintain the quality and standards that I used to appreciate so much.

Thank you.

reviews.name: Moohammad Binrosol
reviews.text:
I am Thai and visited this massage establishment with my Taiwanese friend. On my first visit, he paid 600 baht for a 2-hour Thai massage. However, when my friend went alone the next day, he was charged 1,400 baht for the same 2-hour Thai massage.
I would like to express my concern regarding the apparent discrepancy in pricing between locals and foreigners. This practice seems unfair and may deter tourists from returning.
I recommend that future visitors come with a Thai friend to avoid such discrepancies.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.

reviews.name: Elizabeth Cheong
reviews.text: Remember to book in advance! The place was very accommodating as my group of 8 managed to walk in at 11am and grab an evening slot for everyone at 6pm since we didn't know how to make a booking. The therapists were very professional and didn't massage too hard, which was good since Thai massages are quite intense and sometimes can cause injuries. My bf had an ankle sprain and they took particular care when massaging that area and might have made it better. There was also good service from serving tea before the massages, a free foot wash with scrubbing salts, hot and cold towels, as well as a post-massage pastry. Loved that the  place also had adopted cats that were really friendly and loved humans too!

title: Muay Thai Yoga and Fitness

reviews.name: Sandra Estrada
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible place! Cannot recommend this enough if you are visiting Koh Yao Noi. My husband and I came to visit on our honeymoon and it was the absolute highlight of our entire trip. Super beginner friendly and enjoyable for all. Nic and Htaw were awesome. Please make sure to visit as your visit helps fund local kids Muay Thai classes and materials.

reviews.name: Aden Navarro
reviews.text: This is what I came to Thailand for! Getting away from the hectic city and training Muay Thai in the most beautiful and peaceful surroundings. Nic is a 100% salt of the earth gent, friendly and patient with so much wisdom and warmth. Got memories that I’ll hold close to my heart forever. Thank you Kru 🙏

reviews.name: Daniil Kalve
reviews.text:
The first time I came here was about a year ago. Back then, the gym wasn’t even on Google Maps, I just happened to drive by and discovered it by pure chance. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by its unique tropical, old-school vibe. I took my first lesson and immediately fell in love with the atmosphere. Everyone made me feel genuinely welcome.

A year later, I decided to come back, this time to train seriously. I joined for a one-month intensive camp, and it turned out to be one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. Starting from zero, I was able to significantly improve my Muay Thai skills thanks to the incredible coaches and the supportive environment.

What made the experience even more special was the opportunity to have my first fight. The team at Thammashart Gym organized everything for me. They prepared me, pushed me, and made sure I was in the best possible shape. Everything went smoothly, I stayed injury-free and had one of the most unforgettable experiences of my life.

I’m truly grateful to the gym, the coaches, and especially Nick, Biw and Monhtaw, who welcomed me like a member of the family. I have so much respect for this place, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for authentic training and an amazing community.

reviews.name: Shaina Richardson
reviews.text: Fantastic little gym on the quiet east side of the island. We took several classes here as a family during our week stay on the island. Our kids do martial arts back home, but my husband and I were total newbies. There were rarely more than a couple other people training at the same time as we did, although you always have the option to book private sessions. Definitely a “local” gym: some expats along with short- and long-term travelers, but also had locals and even local kids. Great vibes. Nick and Bue were great: seamlessly rotating between working with everyone one-on-one, while directing good solo exercises, resting, and rehydrating in between. After a two hour class, we were always exhausted, but felt great. Would highly recommend this gym if on the island!

reviews.name: Archie Wright
reviews.text:
Such an amazing find on this island, me and my partner have never done Muay Thai and this was the perfect place to start learning. Nick and his crew are lovely people and were fantastic at teaching us the basics and introducing us to such a great sport. I had such a good morning that I went again the next day.
Also be prepared for a chilly end to the session!!
Thank you so much, Archie and Georgia :)

reviews.name: Justyna Puchała
reviews.text:
I honestly can’t put into words how grateful and happy I am that I found this little local gym on Koh Yao Noi. From the very first moment, there was something truly special about it. The energy, the passion, and the incredible people behind it made me come back every single day during my two-week stay.
It became so much more than just a place to work out — it felt like a family, like a safe space, like a second home. Leaving it behind was so much harder than I expected. I already miss it deeply and I truly can’t wait to come back and stay longer 🙏🏽🩷

reviews.name: Adrian
reviews.text: My wife and I just trained with Nick and Beau for 4 weeks every morning at 9am we were greeted by both with encouragement and one to one training focusing on learning the best technique and respecting the art of Muay Thai. We are both beginners but improved steadily over the weeks. We both feel we have made friends for life and really feel that our mental and physical health has improved. I urge everyone to give this a go. Strangely I have less aches and pains than before we started. Nick and beau are patient and very knowledgeable and go out of their way to encourage any efforts made. Give it a go whatever your age (I’m 62) you won’t regret it. Thanks to you both 🙏

reviews.name: Lara Stadler
reviews.text: Our experience in the studio was just amazing. It was my first time doing Muay Thai and I have learned so much about the sport and the philosophy behind it. A truly amazing journey! thank you to Nick and his wonderful team.

reviews.name: Cameron Taylor
reviews.text:
Found this gem of a muay thai gym during my stay in yao noi and wish I found it earlier, had a couple of sessions with nick and have my final session is tomorrow.
Nick is a fantastically patient and enthusiastic Instructor, who will push you hard in the session, technique is everything here as nick explained, no point in speeding up if the technique is not right.
Having done over 35 years in martial arts it was awesome to be a student again and empty my cup and fill it with new ideas and concepts.
Thank you nick for your inspiration and motivation.
I hope we cross paths again.

reviews.name: Owen Foreman
reviews.text: I’m so glad I stumbled across this awesome locally run, authentic Muay Thai gym on KYN. The owner Nick was a fantastic guy. Very enthusiastic about the sport, the community, and amazing to train with! I thoroughly enjoyed my time here, I recommend coming to this gym asap!

reviews.name: Louis Micheels
reviews.text: Great experience in this Muay Thai gym. The trainer was really friendly and giving good explanations for me and my friend. Can recommend this place for a two hours of training and a surprise will be waiting for you at the end of the 2 hours. 🥶

reviews.name: Gabrielė Lapeikaitė
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time at this gym. The owners truly love Muay Thai and you can feel it just by training there. They were oriented to details, explained everything step by step and cherished when we were able to perform combinations correctly. We will definitely come back one day.

reviews.name: Marvin Eddo
reviews.text:
I visited this Muay Thai gym on Koh Yao Noi with my 7-year-old daughter in December 2024, and it was an unforgettable experience. From the very first moment, we were welcomed like family. The atmosphere is real, warm, and full of heart — truly authentic Thai spirit.

The training is traditional yet very accessible, whether you’re a complete beginner or already experienced. My daughter absolutely loved it; she felt safe, motivated, and part of the group from day one.

Nick is an amazing man who gives so much back to the island community, especially to the local kids. What he’s doing here goes far beyond Muay Thai — it’s about connection, respect, and genuine care.

We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to experience real Muay Thai in the most authentic and welcoming way possible.

Love!

Marvin and Liv🫶🏻

reviews.name: Karol Czuprynski
reviews.text:
Fantastic Muay Thai gym with an amazing atmosphere and truly top-level coaching.
It’s a family-run place with huge experience — both trainers are extremely knowledgeable and professional. One of the coaches speaks perfect English (British), and his wife, who is local, also speaks very good English, so communication is effortless.

Everyone is incredibly friendly, open and welcoming, which creates a great vibe from the first minute. But most importantly — the training itself is outstanding. It’s intense, very well structured, and incredibly effective.
We honestly learned more during a single session here than during five or six trainings back home.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants real progress, great energy and high-quality Muay Thai coaching.

reviews.name: Sami Carre
reviews.text:
I went there for training because I was staying nearby.
Out of the 10 training camps I’ve done in Thailand, this was by far the best.
Nick corrects your technique down to perfection, and his wife Bui absolutely destroys your cardio.
I’ll definitely come back for two weeks to become a monster.
Cherry on the cake: they offer free lessons to the local children.

Huge thanks to Nick and Bui for the amazing experience
if you’re hesitating, don’t. Just go !

reviews.name: Ben Bendfeldt
reviews.text: I recently attended a Muay Thai class with Coach Nick, and it was an amazing experience. Nick was incredibly friendly, supportive, and patient throughout the entire session. He created a welcoming atmosphere that made it easy to learn and enjoy the process. I especially appreciated getting real insight into classic Muay Thai techniques — he explained everything clearly and encouraged us at every step. The class was both fun and motivating, and I left feeling energized and inspired. Highly recommend training with Nick! 🥊🔥

reviews.name: Katarzyna Czuprynska
reviews.text:
Amazing Muay Thai gym with a very friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
Highly experienced, family-run coaching team. Both trainers are excellent, with clear instruction and great energy. Perfect English spoken, which makes training easy and enjoyable.
Intense, well-structured sessions — we learned more in one class here than in several trainings back home.
Highly recommended!

reviews.name: L N
reviews.text:
We trained at this Muay Thai gym several times and absolutely loved it. The atmosphere is super welcoming and has a real family feel, so you feel comfortable from the very first session.
Nick and his team are fantastic instructors — thanks to them we improved our technique really quickly and ended up getting totally hooked on Muay Thai.
Thank you so much for such an amazing experience!
Warm greetings from Austria 🇦🇹

reviews.name: Anise Wirth
reviews.text: Do yourself a favor and stop in. Beginner or advanced, Nic has you covered. He’s friendly and attentive and the way he cares about the community on Koh Yao is touching. You get hands on time learning great technique through a clear teaching style that really expresses the dance of Muay Thai.

reviews.name: Katerina Giannoglou
reviews.text: Amazing Class with Nick. Thank you! Plus.. Best part of finishing the Class with an Ice Bath feels great. Come visit 💪😍

reviews.name: Lucy Smith
reviews.text: Mai has a really beautiful set-up nestled in nature where a friend and I attended two private yoga sessions, kayaking around mangroves tour and a delicious farm to table lunch which was so so so good. This was a unique local experience which I'd happily recommend to anyone.

reviews.name: Margo Christensen
reviews.text: I had an amazing time at Soma Yoga! I didn't know what to expect but I felt comfortable right away and had a good, intensive session. Mai is an wonderful teacher and she speaks great English, which made the class much easier for me. I gained a bit more knowledge about yoga and it was a lovely way to spend an evening.

reviews.name: Lena Katzek
reviews.text: I had a great time in Mai's yoga class. Unfortunately I only had time to join her once on my trip to Krabi. Mai is a really good teacher and she and the others welcomed me to the class. Thank you for the experience!

The class itself was intense and enjoyable, Mai was very helpful in correcting my positions

reviews.name: Xinying T
reviews.text: (Did a drop in session on Wednesday morning) Teacher Mai emits extremely positive and loving energy which left me feeling uplifted for the rest of the day! She was very patient and knowledgeable, and was able to help me make the appropriate adjustments. Highly recommend her classes for anyone who is looking to do Yoga in Krabi!

reviews.name: KaM M
reviews.text: Thanks Mai for the wonderful yoga class! The pace was just right, allowing me to get a great workout without feeling rushed. Mai is skilled and attentive, creating a calm and welcoming environment that made it easy to follow along and stay present. Plus, the location is easy to find - highly recommend for anyone looking for a well-guided, balanced yoga session!

reviews.name: Caroline H.
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience! Mai is such a kind soul, very welcoming and patient. The class was done in Thai and in English, which we really appreciated. We left the yoga session feeling better than when we arrived, completely reenergised. Thank you! :)

reviews.text: Great teacher and really good class in a lovely clean studio in central Krabi Town. Highly recommended. Namaste.

reviews.name: Kiyanna Rama
reviews.text: The best yoga class!! Mai gives you such a personal experience when you go to this class it is so lovely. The classes are fun and relaxing, she teaches in both Thai and English so very easy to understand. The classes are also very affordable and you definitely get the moneys worth. So if you are in Krabi town I recommend joining a class 😄
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much ka

reviews.name: A Mims
reviews.text:
Me and my friend did a 6pm functional yoga class for 300 baht. The studio was on the 3rd floor and very tidy.
The instructor was very personable and informative. Overall, the class was great and I would recommend to anyone who loves or wants to try yoga.

reviews.name: James Brooks
reviews.text: I've been meaning to try yoga for a couple of decades now, and a slip and fall prompted me to get started. Mai at Soma Yoga has the skill and experience to demonstrate how it should be done, and also has the patience to work with an older person like me that should have started earlier. J

reviews.name: Marie-Philippe Pelletier
reviews.text: Best yoga in town! Mai is very friendly, she listens to your need. She offers 2 class per day (morning and evening), always a lot of fun going to Soma yoga. If you are in town I recommend you to go!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the kind words and happy i could help 🙏😁😊

reviews.name: Char Lee
reviews.text:
I stay at Travelodge Phuket Town, and WhatsApp Sa to book an appointment after reading the reviews on Google.

Her place is 15 min away (500m) if I walked from Travelodge Phuket Town hotel.

Sa is a very nice lady, her massage technique and strength is good.

My body needed longer sessions due to Muay Thai and Wake Boarding 😆 so I came here for 1 hour initially and arranged again for a 2nd session which was 2 hour.

I’ve had 5-6 different massage sessions during my 1 week trip to Phuket, and I enjoyed Sa’s massage the most.

She’s very careful with the position you are in, and she carefully arranges your arms and legs with the help of 4 small pillows, which is very thoughtful. 🥰 I haven’t seen anyone pay so much attention to that. 😊

The pillows support your body in a way where you enjoy the massage better too. ❤️

She has limited slots daily, and is by appointment only, so head over to her Facebook page, you will see her WhatsApp number there. 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Ow wow thank you for the extended review 😊🙏
Thank you for visiting and have a safe flight. Hope to see you again if you ever come back to Thailand.

reviews.name: Kirill Buksov
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this place, it's truly a hidden gem! Suphansa is very pleasant person, and most importantly a professional in her work.
I was at two sessions (1h and 2h) and my girlfriend was at one. I can say that all times we were impressed with the effect of the massage. This is a really good healthy massage.
It's a shame that we were too lazy to make an appointment all 2 months, while we were in Thailand, but I can say that Suphansa is very busy lady and keep in mind that the next appointment will most likely be in 2 weeks. You can sign up via whatsup. She speaks english well, so there will be no problems to communicate with her.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🙏☺️ happy to hear my massage helped you and hopefully see you back in Thailand someday

reviews.name: Jiyeon Kim
reviews.text: I'm writing a review after a month. Remember me? This is Kim, who took my mom and four friends back and forth several times. ^^ suphansa is the best massage I've ever had. It feels like I've been treated, not a massage. My shoulders hurt a lot, but they became really light, and I would like to express my sincere gratitude, especially for my mom, for her more attentive feeling. I remember suphansa's cheerful laughter and energy. This was my best experience at Phuket. If I go to Phuket, I'll be the first to look for it. Always stay healthy and happy. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Kim, yes ofc i remember thank you very much for your kind review happy that i was able to help 😁 always welcome whenever you visit phuket again 🙏😁😁 greeting to mom and friends too

reviews.name: Zoe Cheng
reviews.text:
Probably not the best location with fancy interior that you would find in elsewhere, but a humble massage therapist with her solid skills and warm smile.
Had very tensed shoulder and neck from the exams, and sore glutes from training. She relieved all the tension around my neck and loosen up the tight glutes, felt absolutely amazing the next few days. Came back with my boyfriend before we end the trip, and will definitely visit her again when I m in Phuket!
Highly recommended, very skilful. Not the type of massage that are just for relaxing, but she does treat your complaints. Love it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you and happy to hear you recover by my work. Hope to see you again 🙏😊

reviews.name: Pawel Baliga
reviews.text: I recently had a therapeutic massage, and it was an incredible experience. The therapist was highly skilled and attentive, creating a calming atmosphere from the start. Thank you! :)

title: Pearl Massage (Chalong)

reviews.name: doidoi1256
reviews.text: Went for the Thai and Oil massage today,  the staff were friendly and warm. My masseuse June is very professional, she kept the aircon temperature just right throughout my 2 hour session and her pressure was so on point and made me feel completely relaxed. This is a newer outlet, very clean and zen. Highly recommend this place :)

reviews.name: Mengzhe Wei
reviews.text: I would say the best massage experience I’ve had in Thailand. The environment was classy and clean; the background music was pleasant; the service was above and beyond! The message therapist used the right pressure and hit all the spots. Very detail-oriented. The cookies and tea after the message were very nice too! If anyone asks me for recommendations in Phuket this will be on the top of my list.

reviews.name: REGINA GIGA
reviews.text: Very good and beautiful place. Music was calm and helped me to relax. I chose oil massage 1 hour. Master is very polite and professional. Recommended. Especially for people who like beauty, calmness and relaxation 💯

reviews.name: Bianca Perez Ryan
reviews.text:
My favourite massage place in Phuket by far. Clean, tidy, neat, smells good, quiet. The masseuses are incredibly good and kind.
I've come here almost every week and it's been so supportive for my body. Can't recommend more.

reviews.name: Marcin Andrzejewski
reviews.text: Great service, very pleasant massage. Masseuses very professional. Nicely decorated, new, clean and quiet place. Pleasant atmosphere, air conditioning, relaxing music from speakers. Affordable prices, I definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Resa
reviews.text: One of the cleanest massage places I’ve visited in Phuket. However, the experience feels quite rigid—they strictly follow whatever you select from the menu, with little sensitivity to areas where clients may need extra care. It comes across as somewhat robotic, and the lack of flexibility can be off-putting in a service-oriented setting.

reviews.name: Aeakrin Suntarak
reviews.text: The massage therapist was excellent very gentle and soft with a really soothing touch. It was genuinely relaxing. This is definitely a place worth coming back to. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Julia Bo
reviews.text: Nice foot massage. The place has recently opened, everything is very clean, stylish and tasteful. There is a promotion for any massage for 250 baht. It's very cheap for such a good massage. There is a large parking lot behind the building. Thank you✨🙏🏼

reviews.name: Ira Vays
reviews.text: The best Thai massage in Chalong. Atmosphere is  also amazing. Everything is so new and clean inside, in a modern style. Just come and enjoy!

reviews.name: 15YZ06
reviews.text:
Absolutely the Best Massage I’ve Ever Had!

I can confidently say this was the best massage experience of my life! From the moment I walked in, I felt relaxed and welcomed. On my first day, I had the aromatherapy massage — it was incredibly soothing, and exactly what I needed. The space itself is beautiful, calm, and thoughtfully designed to help you unwind.

The experience was so amazing, I came back the very next day for the full package: a body scrub followed by a massage. I even brought my friend along because I didn’t want to keep this gem to myself! Both of us were beyond impressed.

The masseuses are absolute professionals — kind, respectful, and truly skilled. They made us feel comfortable and cared for from start to finish. Every detail, from the scents used in the aromatherapy to the gentle music and spotless surroundings, contributed to an unforgettable experience.

Highly, highly recommend — I wish I could give more than 5 stars!

reviews.name: Olena Tarnavska
reviews.text: Amazing massage - super relaxing, clean place, friendly staff.

reviews.name: Kirill Rudenko
reviews.text: The receptionist is extremely unfriendly. The other staff members also speak rudely to each other about customers in Thai, not even realizing that the guests understand Thai. Disgusting behavior.

reviews.name: LERA Лера
reviews.text: Excellent service, great massage, very clean and  welcoming space. I enjoyed everything!

reviews.name: Adil Bouzelif
reviews.text: Best massage place in the whole Phuket region. The staff is friendly and they truly care about their customers. The variety of possible different massages is a huge plus point. When I visit Phuket this place is a must visit.

reviews.name: May Mars
reviews.text: The massage was very good. Reasonable price and the place is very cute. Friendly staffs

reviews.name: Pearl Wee
reviews.text: Best massage I’ve had in Chalong! Service was so good and it felt like every hand motion was intentional, she even tied my hair so gently! Price is normal at 350 for 1hr foot/body massage. Lots of rooms, and super clean(:

reviews.name: Jeremy Fokler
reviews.text:
The most clean, comfortable massage ever in Thailand.

Very good service.

100% recommend it.

reviews.name: K LTL
reviews.text: I had high hopes for this place as it looks so nice but it was a 4/10  foot massage. Even after I specifically asking her to do it strong she still didn’t. My 500 baht foot massage machine of Lazada at home is better. Maybe she didn’t want to put much effort in because I only paid 250 baht for the promo. Other than the below average massage, the place smells delicious and is very clean and welcoming and beautifully designed. The beds for the full body aren’t comfortable to lie on because there’s no hole for the face.

reviews.name: Olya Todos
reviews.text:
It was the best massage in my whole entire life! And I can talk about myself as a quite experienced person in this area, all the southeast Asian massages have been tested and that was the best!! Thai massage made me feel like a newborn baby! Thanks a lot to you!! Kapunkaaaa ❤️❤️❤️

And thanks to my sister, who booked for us this experience! Unbelievable! ❤️

P.S. sorry I have a photo of me after totally relaxes and blessed!

reviews.name: Maraheb stan
reviews.text: One of the best massage places in phuket .... clean... even luxury ... with standard normal prices

reviews.name: Lucy West
reviews.text: A must visit pilates and yoga studio while in Khao Lak! Bennita designed a fun and dynamic partner session for my husband and I, alternating between the cadillac and mat. Organising a session was super easy via WhatsApp! We were very impressed with the high quality instruction and repertoire. I was also fortunate to join a yoga class with Ple that same week. A lovely studio offering excellent pilates and yoga classes for those visiting Khao Lak. Highly recommend booking in a private session or joining a group class. Thanks for having us and hope to return in the future. 5 stars all round!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for visiting us Lucy and Dan 💕

We’re glad to hear you enjoy practicing with us. It’s our pleasure to be recommended by you. Hope to welcome you again in Khaolak ✨🤍

reviews.name: Kah Yan
reviews.text:
I feel so warm welcome by Bennita & Apple.

I book private Pilate and 2 hours classes was really amazing and I understand my body so well. Bennita is really patience & the teaching style based on my current flexibility & the video and photos capture is really amazing.

As for Apple private yoga was fun. I get to know how to do 2 poses wanted but unable to. Apple had really a good yoga guidance teacher.

Both of them are great. To those as tourist they do have taxi contact that can be contacted & also you can book to and from the hotel taxi.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: You’re very amazing, we love to see your movements and poses. We’re glad to hear you had good time with us. Thank you so much for visiting and hope to welcome you agin soon 💕✨

reviews.name: Sara-Letizia Geiger
reviews.text:
Best Pilates & Yoga spot in Khao Lak!

I attended a Pilates Sculpt class with Bennita and had such a lovely experience. Bennita is a very warm and welcoming person and creates a really nice atmosphere from the moment you arrive.

I found her studio Surf’n Soul on Google Maps, contacted her via the WhatsApp number listed, and she sent the class schedule right away. Reserving a spot was super easy.

The class was very well designed, challenging but still approachable. Bennita adjusts the intensity so everyone can get the most out of the workout and she’s very attentive to individual needs. I also really appreciated that she corrected my form during the exercises.

Great music, great energy, and overall just a lot of fun. I left feeling energized and would definitely love to come back.

If you’re in Khao Lak and want to stay active during your holiday, I can really recommend checking out Surf’n Soul with Bennita.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this wonderful review!  It means a lot to hear that the class felt both challenging and welcoming, and that the atmosphere made you feel comfortable. 🥰

It was a pleasure having you in class, and we’d absolutely love to welcome you back the next time you’re in Khao Lak. ✨

reviews.name: Njoki
reviews.text: Ple was my instructor and she was such a delight!  She gives really thoughtful cues and adjustments that deepened my practice, and helped me understand how proper alignment felt in my body.  The space is beautiful, with large windows and plants that make the environment feel very cozy!  The studio is clearly designed with a lot of care and love.  I felt calm and at peace after the class, and it was a great change of pace for my body between surf days.  Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words! 💛 We're so happy you enjoyed Ple's class and our studio space. It means a lot to know you left feeling calm, refreshed, and more connected to your practice. We hope to see you again next time you're in Khao Lak! 🌿✨

reviews.text: We loved our private aerial yoga lesson! It was an amazing experience, one of the highlights of our visit to Khao Lak. The yoga teacher explained everything very clearly and offered support when needed. The space for the lessons is beautiful. We hope to come back

title: Muay Thai Academy M.T.A
ownerDescription:
We are Bangkok’s premiere martial arts gym offering world-class training in Muay Thai, boxing and kickboxing for all levels.

Fighters at MTA get regular access to compete on the international circuit and high-profile promotions. For athletes looking for maximum exposure, world-class training, and a close-knitted community of fighters, Muay Thai Academy is your number one choice.

ownerUpdates.text:
Training at a Muay Thai gym offers more than just learning how to fight—it builds a complete foundation for physical fitness, mental strength, and discipline.

Full-Body Conditioning
Muay Thai is one of the most effective full-body workouts. Every session engages your arms, legs, core, and cardio system through pad work, bag drills, clinching, and conditioning. It improves endurance, strength, flexibility, and coordination all at once.

Fat Loss & Lean Muscle
High-intensity training helps burn a significant amount of calories while building lean muscle. Over time, this leads to better body composition, increased metabolism, and improved overall fitness.

Real Self-Defense Skills
Known as the “Art of Eight Limbs,” Muay Thai teaches practical striking using fists, elbows, knees, and kicks. Training regularly helps you develop timing, balance, and awareness—valuable for real-world self-defense.

Mental Strength & Discipline
Muay Thai pushes you mentally as much as physically. It builds resilience, focus, and consistency. Showing up, pushing through fatigue, and improving technique over time develops strong discipline that carries into daily life.

Stress Relief
Hitting pads and bags is one of the most effective ways to release stress. Training sessions help clear your mind, boost mood, and improve mental well-being.

Will definitely take more classes next time I’m in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Mario Boehm
reviews.text:
Nothing to say... they are good trainers. Okay, they cannot speak English, but you can still understand them because they know how to train you (on my side, I can speak and understand Thai). We have been training there since November 2022, and my son is enjoying it as well.

There are three activities during your 1.5 hours of training: 30 minutes of warm-up, 30 minutes of Muay Thai, and 30 minutes of weight training.

So yeah, see you there if you want to join! 😁"
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your review.

reviews.name: B K
reviews.text:
I was travelling in Bangkok for three weeks, and after a week, I wanted to start working out, so I registered for a one-month trial membership. At first, I thought it was a waste of money since I could only use it for two weeks after signing up for a month, but in the end, it was totally and absolutely worth it. I wish I could take FitFac with me wherever I go. 80% of the joy I had during my time in Bangkok came from here. I’m grateful to all the teachers and members for being so friendly and kind, and I want to give a special shoutout to teacher Kao for Muay Thai and teacher Arm for weight training. As a foreigner, it was difficult for me to understand Thai, but they helped me using body language and a translator until I could understand. It was so fun and comfortable to work out with them.

Bangkok is one of the most visited cities in the world, right? I hope FitFac offers more short-term membership options so that more foreigners can experience Muay Thai, Thailand’s representative sport. It would be amazing if more places where I live or visit offered Muay Thai training. I already miss everyone. Thank you all!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for all your kind word and support. We will definitely tell trainer Arm and trainer Kao about your compliment.  Thank you again and hope to see at Fitfac again once you are back in Thailand.

reviews.text: I just had the most amazing massage. From start to finish I felt very attended to and cared for. My therapist PP made the most of the 2 hours. I asked for a lot of pressure and he delivered. The services were exactly what I needed.

reviews.name: Pete Klimek
reviews.text:
1678 Massage Spa in Chiang Mai is, without exaggeration, the most professional and enjoyable massage experience I have ever had — not only in Thailand or Southeast Asia, but anywhere on planet Earth.

From the moment the treatment began, it was clear that this was a place operating at an entirely different level. My masseur, Ben, is an absolute master of his craft. From start to finish, his skilled hands applied exactly the right balance of firm pressure and gentle precision, intuitively responding to the body and releasing tension I didn’t even know I was holding. Every movement was confident, purposeful, and deeply therapeutic.

This was not just a massage — it was a complete, perfectly executed experience that left me feeling restored, relaxed, and genuinely impressed. The professionalism, technique, and care are unmatched.

1678 Massage Spa comes with the highest recommendation I could possibly give. If you are in Chiang Mai and value true expertise, this is not just a place to visit — it is the place.

reviews.text: 1678 Massage offers such a peaceful and private atmosphere, perfect for true relaxation. The staff are incredibly sincere, warm, and welcoming. reviews.name: Kevin Riley
reviews.text: I have visited 1678 2 times over the past 3 days, with another massage now booked for tomorrow as well. Upon arriving the welcome was lovely and the relaxation began. A cool facecloth and small glasses of drink. One water, the other watermelon juice I think. We are then presented with a choice of aromatic oil samples to select from for our massage. Lavender works for me! Staff are very courteous and deliver a very high standard of service. My first massage was with Boom, who gave me a wonderful 2 hour oil massage. He was excellent and I left wanting to return. I booked again and today’s massage was with Japan. Again, a lovely 2 hour oil massage. I prefer a gentle and relaxing massage and Japan really did a fantastic job. Both therapists have great technique and soothing hands. Looking forward to tomorrow with AungPao, which will be the last opportunity to visit 1678 before leaving Chiang Mai. After the massage there is a fresh coconut waiting. I’ll be returning to 1678 next year for sure!

reviews.name: Finn SHEN
reviews.text:
Bad experience！

⸻

I walked in without an appointment. The reception did not ask about my preferred therapist — I was assigned one directly without any consultation. The shop advertises and promotes health massage, which initially gave a sense of professionalism and trust.

However, the experience changed completely at the end of the session. The therapist asked me to pay 500 baht extra for a “happy ending tip.” I firmly declined, expecting that my boundaries would be respected. Instead, the remainder of the massage became extremely rushed, inattentive, and perfunctory, losing any therapeutic value. It felt like the quality of service was dependent on accepting an inappropriate request, which is unacceptable for a business promoting wellness and health.

A place that labels itself as a health massage provider should uphold ethical standards, professionalism, and genuine care regardless of tips. Sadly, this was not the case. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves staff training on proper conduct and service quality.

reviews.name: John Novak
reviews.text:
I visited Chiang Mai twice in November, and both times I made a beeline straight back to 1678 Massage Studio — and honestly, I’ll keep doing that every time I return. This place is the real deal.

The therapists here are not only incredibly talented and professional, but genuinely kind human beings. On my first trip, I had Palm, who set the bar sky-high with one of the best massages I’ve ever had in Thailand. On my second visit, I booked with Joey, and he was equally outstanding — attentive, skilled, and intuitive in all the ways that make a massage memorable.

The studio itself is peaceful, spotless, and run with so much care. Every moment feels intentional, and you can tell the team truly takes pride in what they do.

If you’re traveling to Chiang Mai and want a massage experience that actually stands out, do yourself a favor and book a session here. 1678 Massage Studio has become my go-to spot, and I’ll be returning every time I’m in town. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Bob Valentine
reviews.text:
I stumbled upon 1678 Massage Studio during my stay in Chiang Mai, and wow — what a pleasant surprise. From the moment I walked in, the little touches made all the difference. They welcomed me with a refreshing drink, followed by a relaxing foot scrub that set the tone for the whole experience.

The massage itself was honestly one of the best I’ve had anywhere. The therapist was skilled, attentive, and completely tuned in to what I needed. The facilities are spotless and thoughtfully designed, and I really appreciated having a shower inside the treatment room to rinse off the massage oils afterward — such a simple thing, but incredibly convenient.

I’ll definitely be returning on my next trip to Chiang Mai. This place is a gem.

title: The Yoga Shala Rawai
ownerDescription:
The Yoga Shala is a yoga studio in Rawai, Phuket, offering traditional & dynamic yoga classes for students of all levels. With over 25 years of teaching experience, our approach combines the discipline & precision of Ashtanga Yoga with the movement & adaptability of Vinyasa, creating a practice that develops strength, flexibility, balance, focus, & resilience.

Whether you are completely new to yoga or an experienced practitioner looking to deepen your practice, classes are taught with personal attention & an emphasis on understanding the fundamentals, refining technique, & developing a consistent practice.

At The Yoga Shala, yoga is more than exercise. It is a practice of learning to stay—steady, focused, & present through challenge.

With his kind, encouraging smile, Jason creates an atmosphere where you truly start to believe in yourself and your abilities. He has a unique way of guiding you beyond your limits while still making you feel safe and supported.

Every time we visit this beautiful island, we make it a priority to attend as many of his classes as possible. Each session feels inspiring, grounding, and deeply transformative.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Natalya. It is great to have you in class and I look forward to seeing next time you are visiting Phuket!

reviews.name: Ignacio González González
reviews.text:
Fantastic yoga studio with cute and charming cafe.
This is basically what you want from a Yoga Studio in paradise:
- serious instructor that actually cares about yoga and is a pro: Jason will keep you on your toes and will apply corrections timely. He is a proper yogie. Mat and blocks provided free of charge
- beautiful exterior studio: all made with bamboo and with tons of plants, makes you feel you are in a special place
- constant breath of air (well placed fans) and waterfall sound (multiple fountains in the property), protected from rain
-lovely cafe: did not try food, but my #7 smoothy (peanut butter, banana, strawberry and spinach) was GREAT. Same for my coffee
Went two times and I wish I could have made it another time.
Jason, you have a special place, keep it up!

Pro tip: don’t forget to apply mosquito repellent before starting a class! (Really applies to any outdoors activity in Phucket)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Ignacio for your kind words. I really enjoyed having you in class and helping you with your Yoga practice, as well as chatting with you over coffee. And thank you for noticing and appreciating the garden and all of the wonderful plants! We have worked really hard to take care of them and make the garden beautiful. See you next time! ~ Jason

reviews.name: Aleksandra Koposova
reviews.text:
Absolute yes to everything.

Jason is a great Ashtanga teacher (this is the class I took) he is attentive, strict and loving in Ashtanga way.
I saw some people commenting about not showing postures, exactly that shows the maturity and experience of the teacher when they are able to guide you into your inner listening (and outer for that matter - of the teacher in the space).

Practice is strong and might scare beginners off, yet in my own journey (when I was a beginner too) I wouldn’t have chosen anything else because of its repetition, preciseness and dedication - it will get you there, be patient! After these type of classes like Jason’s I can go into any other ones and be sure I’m not hurting myself.

+++ green, bamboo style paradise just of the business of the road, staff is super amazing and friendly & smoothies are top notch, prices are very good!

I am so bummed I am the yoga tourist who is leaving tomorrow and can’t plan more classes in this amazing space!

100% recommend 💎
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Aleksandra! I very much enjoyed helping you with your Ashtanga practice as well as chatting with you afterward.  Your ability to laugh at yourself and also be serious and diligent at the same time is much appreciated. I look forward to your return.
