reviews.name: Bryony Davies
reviews.text: I visited Rawai for a couple of weeks April-May and was quite early on in my yoga journey. I found the classes I had - Vinyasa Flow - incredibly useful, Jason is clearly a dedicated practitioner who takes care and offers guidance through each posture, teaching correct alignment and cultivating a space to learn and grow. When I came back to yoga in the UK I already felt I'd gained so much from the care taken in these classes. The atmosphere also really is wonderfully peaceful, it is pure, natural and you can see the effort taken to design a spot that is hidden but also inviting, it took me back a little seeing it at first! A precious reminder to take the time to relax and connect to ourselves, others and our surroundings. I'll remember these classes fondly, thank you for helping me on my yoga journey!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Bryony 🙏😊🙏

reviews.name: Terka Boháčová
reviews.text: Overall the yoga was good and enjoyable, but it was nothing special. I have definitely felt more welcomed in other places. But every day is different, so try it for yourself and see. :) I would not come back though. (This is just my opinion, I am not trying to be rude.) Oh and the cafe was closed, not sure why.

reviews.name: Katya Baukova
reviews.text:
The place is amazing. I sadly managed to make it only to 2 lessons which is my greatest regret from this trip.
Jason is very friendly, knowledgeable and inspiringly strong. He asks about your goal and gives clear recommendations on how to progress towards it - both in terms of specific asanas and movements / transitions, but also in terms of general approach (where to look or not to look, how to breath, what idea lies behind various rules and how you can benefit from skills acquired during yoga in daily life).
I am rather a beginner but I have attended lessons with various yoga teachers and Jason is definitely one of the best ones I have met.
I am pretty sure he can offer equally a lot to more
Proficient students.
I highly recommend attending not just regular lesson, but his workshops dedicated to different topics. I did sun salutation one and it was a blast! I wish more teachers would do such workshops to work on specific things and let you polish them before you progress to the next level.
Did I mention the cafe? Jason told me the chef was amazing but after I brought a tuna wrap back to the hotel after the lesson, the next time my husband and daughter were expecting a course for everyone 🙈 everything we tried was very well cooked and tasty.
Looking forward to being back to Rawai and yoga lessons with Jason!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you! I very much enjoyed your playful spirit as well as your diligence and commitment to learning and improving. I look forward to your return.

reviews.name: Sergey Lavrenko
reviews.text:
We would like to express our deep gratitude to Coach Jason and the whole yoga café team!

What we really appreciate is Jason’s systematic approach to every session. The location is easy to find on the map, registration on the website is smooth and user-friendly, and all the information is clear and helpful — everything is thoughtfully designed to make the decision to join easy and joyful.

Coach Jason always introduces something new in each class, helping us feel our progress — our bodies are becoming more flexible, our minds more open with every practice. We truly feel the positive shift.

And maybe the most meaningful part — through yoga, we feel a deeper connection between the people of Russia and the United States. Growth and awareness have no borders.

See you on the mat!

reviews.name: George
reviews.text:
I stay in the area whenever I visit Bangkok, and I’ve visited this place at least 10 times over the last few years. Unfortunately, the most recent visit would be my last. It appears that the place knows it’s frequented by tourists who won’t be able to do anything once cash payment is accepted, and there’s no lack of new tourist customers who don’t know anything.

When every other massage parlour I frequent is fully booked at night, I’ll come here as it’s the only one with availability (there’s a good reason why). I know the standards here aren’t the best, but I really don’t have high expectations for a 1H foot massage where I scroll on my phone to relax after dinner time. To be fair, there are some good masseurs here, and previously even the not-so-great ones are passable when I turn a blind eye.

For the last visit, however, I booked a 2H foot massage, which turned out to be an utter waste of both time and money. The first masseur was caressing the skin of my leg without any skills, just going through the motions with the lightest touch. It was so unpleasant it was getting frustrating. I tried to tell the masseur 3 times that I’ll prefer a bit more strength, but the masseur simply nodded without improvements. After 15 minutes, I had to request for a change of masseur, which was the first time I had ever been forced to do so. During this process, there was no apology or even any sign that anyone felt bad about this. The receptionist, which disappeared once she took my payment, simply popped up to indicate a change of masseur in the records.

The second masseur, though not a fantastic experience, did a passable massage for the first hour. Just when I thought I’d be able to somewhat relax and salvage this experience, the second hour went downhill. Caressing my leg with the lightest touch for 10 minutes with occasions of unexplained pauses while she stares into space, followed by maybe 30 seconds of proper massage, before lapsing into the lightest touch again. It was very, very obvious that after accepting payment, the masseurs were just trying to pass time. When this happened, I tried to tell the masseur that I’d prefer a bit more strength. Then the second masseur loudly exclaimed “No, no more!”, and said she was tired already! Then she started speaking loudly in Thai to the masseur beside her for the next 5 minutes. What happened to quietness and relaxation? I’d like to stress I wasn’t hoping for any deep tissue, but it’s simply insulting when she’s only brushing my skin with feather touches accompanied with unexplained pauses.

The whole experience was downright negative and unwelcoming, and it left a bad taste in my mouth. The fact that the masseur could loudly exclaimed that she’s tired and she doesn’t wanna put any more strength in the main hall says a lot of about the quality control of this place. If masseurs are tired, the receptionist shouldn’t have accepted my reservation and money. At the end of the session, my shoes was also dropped to the ground with a loud clack instead of being placed properly on the ground. While I went at night, my session ended 40 minutes before their closing time, so it’s not like I made anyone stay behind.

This is coming from someone who visited this place multiple times knowing the tier and style of such 300+ baht parlours. I regretted coming, and I wished I had just gone back to my hotel. Wasted 600 baht and 2 hours just to feel frustrated and oily. If you’re stuck with no other options just like me, I’d say take a taxi to somewhere else or get a massage delivery.

reviews.name: Kevin Yee
reviews.text:
I’m sure the BJJ here is solid—this review isn’t about the quality of instruction. It’s about the lack of transparency around payment.

I showed up for a drop-in session after being referred by someone I met at Arete BJJ in Bangkok. I’ll admit, I arrived about 15 minutes late because I got lost trying to find the place. But when I got there, I was told I couldn’t train unless I paid upfront—in cash only. No card, no PayPal. Super frustrating.

What really threw me off is that nowhere on the website, Instagram, or Google listing does it say “cash only.” As a result, I couldn’t train, wasted a Grab ride, and left disappointed by the lack of flexibility.

I respect the policy—it’s their business. But as someone who also runs a business, I believe in making it easy for people to pay you. This whole situation could’ve been avoided with just one line on the website or IG.

To be fair, I’m a guest in this country and I might not be used to how things work here in Thailand. Going forward, I’ve started DMing gyms ahead of time to check about drop-in fees and payment options.

If you’re planning to visit: bring cash.

To the owner—if you’re reading this, I’ll be honest: I felt kind of weird and reluctant posting this. I saw all the raving reviews and love supporting the BJJ community, especially businesses. No beef here — I just wish I didn’t have to learn this the hard way. Happy to update or remove this review if the info gets updated.

reviews.text: It was the best massage we ever had in our life so far. I have a chronic legs and right arm pain. Auntie Aun solved it out. It was amazingly good! reviews.name: Aleksandra Paunovic
reviews.text:
I was recommended this massage studio by a friend who studied and practiced there, and I can honestly say she did not exaggerate about how exceptional this place is.

I booked a two-hour session with Mr. One, and before the treatment even started, he carefully asked about my pain and physical issues. I have been struggling with shoulder pain for the past nine years and have visited many physiotherapists and massage therapists over the years. No one has ever worked on my shoulder with the same level of knowledge, precision, and understanding as Mr. One did.

As a professional Muay Thai fighter, my body goes through intense physical stress, so finding someone who truly understands muscle function, recovery, and therapeutic treatment is extremely important to me. This was not just a relaxing massage, it was real therapeutic work performed by someone with genuine expertise.

I am honestly amazed by the results. For the first time in years, I feel like someone is actually helping me with my pain. I was so impressed that I immediately booked my second appointment, and I will definitely continue coming here regularly.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a professional therapeutic massage with real knowledge behind it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so so much for your kindness, I really appreciate it ❤️❤️🙏🏻

Than you very much!

reviews.name: Travelling Darryl
reviews.text:
Had massages from 3 different massage therapists here: 1. Referred to Kai by two fellow massage therapist friends from 🇨🇦.

Excellent technique, stretching and pressure on my tired body.

2.  Had an excellent massage with Po, if I am spelling it right.  Wonderful technique.

3.  Lastly, I took 3 x 2 hour sessions over 3 days with Mr. Suwat, owner, for some chronic body issues from overuse in tennis & biking.

Not sure how to explain - wow 🤯 does not cover it.

🌞pain in the massage could be unbearable in my problem areas and I knew I needed to breathe through it.

🥳 then it dissipated and disappeared.

😊 some unconscious tension I was carrying inside my body / muscles was lifted.

🥰 my body started to feel soft again because a layer of ‘protection’ I carried for years was lifted.

🏃‍♂️energy became higher and more balanced as well as being more calm / relaxed mindset.

Would have done 2-3more days in a row with him.  Layer after layer of old injuries started to be released.

Our health is most important.

Highly recommend this service and their therapists.

reviews.text:
Just one word...wow!!!
If you want to have a good time with friends, if you want to know nothing about yourself and your body awareness, if you want to feel good for 1 or 2 hours and resume your old habits of a stressed Westerner, this place will not be there. But ideal... If you want to understand through sensation what is blocked inside you and your body is begging you to finally free itself, then this is the right address! I am a professional in massage and I have already experienced medical and therapeutic Thai massage which impressed me a lot in France but I must say that it was well above the level. I finally understood what working with the body means, no offense to certain incompetent physiotherapists or osteopaths, who are unfortunately too numerous. Thank you for what you do, you are a great team!!!

reviews.text: If you need a proper therapeutic massage, that is definitely the place to go, they use a very special techniques and also recommend exercises to continue unblocking your body when you travel away. Within 2 hours they unblocked my neck and shoulders, pressing to the points on my cheeks; and also fixed my hip that was bothering me for many years. The most effective massage I ever experienced.

reviews.name: Jacob Chen
reviews.text: Real medicinal Thai Massage here. It’s a massage academy and they do their training here. I’ve been looking for a proper massage place in the month I’ve been in Thailand and I’ve finally found it. A good therapist finds your ailments for you and my two sessions with Tuk had been the best therapeutic massages I’ve had in Thailand. She never asked whether I wanted harder or softer (my muscles are tight so she goes pretty hard) and I just let her do her thing. If you want to actually improve your ailments and not just a relaxing experience, then this is the best place for it.

As someone who gets deep tissue and Thai massages on a regular basis in the States, I can 100% recommend this as the highest quality Thai massage I've experienced.

Recommend minimum 2 hour to get long term benefit.

reviews.name: Kane Ong
reviews.text:
Wow I'm very impressed! This is not your usual Thai massage by the street; specifically treatment deep tissue massage.
Feels like getting into a Jujitsu match, but all the stretching and pin point on acupoints were therapeutic. Extremely professional staffs, they definitely know their work👍🏼 Kudos to therapist Miss Tok: she could press on deep muscle tissue with her toes, felt like she had 4 hands!
I've been troubled by herniated spinal disc for years, they could easily identify the Cervical/Thoracic/Lumbar discs according to accurate spinal column alignment.
My advice to those with physiological injuries; don't waste your money anywhere else, just bring your X-ray films here 👍🏼

I have needed physical therapy for more than 10 years, and then I have to do yoga and stretching exercises every day so that I can feel relieved. But whenever I'm suddenly stressed or overworked at work. Sometimes my pain can't even be dealt with by doing exercises and getting a massage? I have seen countless chiropractors or physical therapists in over 10 years. So what if you have some pain?
If you travel to Chiang Mai, you might as well experience it! Call to inquire about making an appointment.😊🙏🌻✨✨✨👍

reviews.name: Livia antonini
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this massage center. I booked an aromatherapy full body massage along with a head, neck, and shoulder massage, and what I received was nowhere close to what was advertised.

The “full body” massage was absolutely not a full body massage. The therapist barely touched me. He essentially just spread oil on my skin without applying any real technique, pressure, or professional skill. He only worked briefly on my back and calves. He completely skipped my thighs, stomach, hands, and feet. It felt careless and unprofessional, as if he had no proper training at all.

I was uncomfortable speaking up during the session, but when it came to the head massage, it became impossible to ignore how bad it was. He barely touched my head. There was no technique, no structure, no sense of what a head massage should be. It felt rushed, superficial, and honestly pointless. On top of that, he somehow managed to make my back hurt during the process.

I do want to add that the staff at the front desk were very kind and welcoming, and the place itself is clean and well-maintained. I also went there with two friends, and they both had female therapists and seemed to receive proper, professional massages.

To be fair, the owner did refund the head massage after I explained my dissatisfaction, which I appreciate. I admit that I did not speak up during the full body massage, and that is partly on me. However, there is clearly a serious inconsistency in the quality of service. For the same price, I received something that felt careless and unprofessional, while others received what they had actually booked.

Overall, this experience felt like a waste of money and very disappointing.

reviews.text: I had the best experience here! I’ve been dealing with chronic SI joint and sacrum pain, along with sciatica that often keeps me from doing the things I want to do. After this massage, I experienced better results than I’ve had with acupuncture, cupping, and physical therapy combined. I honestly wish this place was open 24/7. To top it off, they finished my session with a perfectly ripe coconut and sweet cantaloupe the perfect touch to an amazing treatment.

reviews.name: Mark Jones
reviews.text: The guys here were really welcoming and made me feel relaxed. The spa is comfortable and the garden is so cute. The guys that did my body scrub and massage were fantastic.

reviews.name: Hot Latte
reviews.text: The standard of this spa surpasses every one that I have been to in Bangkok, in the sense that the ambience, amenities snd cleanliness totally befit a resort spa in a charming city like Chiang Mai. A lovely garden is the first welcome you will encounter. Attended by a manager who is proficient in English in a warm and authentic Thai-styled reception area, I already sensed a calming vibe. The massage room is very clean and elegantly simple in its decor. The attached shower is also very clean and assuring that I was going to have a restful and hygienic experience. The next most impressive touch is the high quality massage top snd pants that were both stylish and comfortable, reflecting the attention to details by the spa owner. The Thai massage itself may not be the best, and that is no fault of the spa since I declined the manager’s recommendation to go for a more experienced masseur, I still left the session quite happy. Other Thai spas should look up to this place for authentic Thai spa vibe.

reviews.name: Ernst Wiens
reviews.text: While visiting Chiang Mai, I loved going for morning walks around the old city Square. On two occasions, the owner or manager of the spa was working on the plants near the entrance of the property. And on both occasions, we had a conversation. He sounded like such a nice gentleman that I decided I would go to that spa for my final massage before flying back to Canada. What a wonderful experience. Mr. Touie,the masseur , was exceptional. After the massage was finished, there is an attached shower room for the client to have a wonderful shower. They even arranged for a tuktuk to come pick me up and take me to the airport for my flight. The entire experience was flawless. I wish to thank the staff and to let them know that when I return to Chiang Mai, I will see you again.

reviews.name: Capri Me (RD)
reviews.text:
Came as walk in early in the morning.
Fast frontline service, informative, cash only. Free bottle of a Singha water

Product & price are clear, my therapist deliver medium but on point massage, very relaxing and not missing a single spot

Truly a full body experience msg.
Completing the service, they provide a coconut, chiangmai crackers, and watermelon. At this price and service attitude, it was marverlous!

reviews.name: Kent Chung
reviews.text: Retro environment, good service,located beside the road ,the price is more expensive than other massage centers. Everyone likes to have different tastes and end up with coconut juice and fruit entertaining.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your useful advice

reviews.name: Don Lewis
reviews.text: I had a two hour combined Thai and hot oil massage here yesterday. The price was very reasonable (1200 baht, but it was a special promotion) and the massage was very good. I received the full time and was offered a shower at the end. I will definitely go back.

reviews.name: Faye Hung
reviews.text: Great service.  Reasonable price. The coconut and fruit at the end of service is an excellent touch.  It would be more comfortable if the massage table can have the hole for the head to rest in.  It's uncomfortable with my head twisted to one side as the masseuse worked on my back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank for your kindness and very useful content in our service

reviews.name: cody shen
reviews.text: Best salon de massage in Chiangmai. I stayed in this city for 4 days and I came to have the massage every day. After the massage, the fruit and coconut were generously offered.

reviews.name: Andy Sun
reviews.text: Mostly male clientele for this spa, masseurs generally decent and clean. The massage skills fluctuate from one to the next. Be careful about one or two of them possibly asking for a tip which I find unprofessional, but very rare actually.

reviews.name: World Fark
reviews.text: Win gave me a good massage.the shop was quiet and secret.my final night at chiangmai was perfect🌈

reviews.name: Dany Boy
reviews.text: I visited the place on 13th February in the early evening and ordered 90 min Aroma massage. I don't know the therapist name, but this was by far the best male massage I had in Thailand for the last 5 years. I visit Thailand often but not Chang Mai and after this massage I will visit here instead of Bangkok. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Taro2022 G
reviews.text: Went to this Sanctuary Spa Chiang Mai today. The scenic was such a beauty. The manager was very attentive and was immediately gave us a welcome bottle of water. There my partner and I both selected the masseur. The room was clean and today and it comes with soothing massage music and the melody almost make me sleep throughout. Masseur was attentive and the strength is just right and he did ask me whether I am here for holiday and that’s all and throughout just concentrate the massage on me. At the end of the session I tip the masseur and thank him for his wonderful massage. At the counter we were amazed by the spa who gave us a compliment fruit mango and and coconut drink for our patronage . We thank the manager greatly, this is the spa we are talking about - 5 stars for the service. We will definitely be back and recommended to our friends.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing 
Your experiences

reviews.name: Jim Hayward
reviews.text: While visiting Chiang Mai I discovered the Sanctuary Spa. I specifically enjoy a strong Thai massage. More often than not, I find massages to be not strong enough. That was not the case at Sanctuary Spa. My masseuse Pik was extremely well trained and provided one of the best traditional Thai massages I’ve ever had. I was so impressed I went back again and got an oil massage, which was very different, but totally relaxing. I highly recommend Sanctuary Spa for men who want to be massaged by men. 👍

reviews.name: Zach Flaherty
reviews.text: I very much enjoyed my body scrub + 90 minute aromatherapy massage.  Boon, the owner was very kind. He even offered  me use of the sauna,  which wasn't included in the package. Noam, the masseuse gave a very good massage. I highly recommend. Another nice perk is the coconut 🥥 and mango after your massage. I'll be back when I'm in Chiang Mai in the future.

reviews.name: Z William
reviews.text:
Nice atmosphere and clean room. My massage therapist was exactly what I needed in terms of pressure/strength of massage. Professional, courteous and competent. I didn't rate it a 5🌟 simply due to the price. I find it substantially higher than others for the same treatment (45% higher). But that does not mean I will not be back, in fact I am already planning a return visit.
Go and check it out!

Update: I have been back 3 times now since my initial visit and I confirm my previous review for service and have updated it to a 5 star!!

Update #2: I continue to visit when I need a massage and it has become "home". I am always greeted with a smile by name. The service is always perfect and professional.  I have nothing negative to say about Sanctuary Spa. I've stopped looking for another place for massages, this is it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: J
reviews.text: Expensive and really terrible. I had booked a package with 30 min body scrub and 90 min massage and the therapist spent much longer doing my scrub and my massage seemed to last 50 min max. The massage was awful, it had no rhythm whatsoever and was like she was randomly gently stroking me. I asked for more pressure and then it was way too much and painful, she was going over my spine and bones. It was such a frustrating experience, the worst massage I've had in Thailand in 3 months. There was no hole in bed to put your face and so my neck is super painful now, The sauna didn't work and the steam room was too powerful to sit inside. I would avoid and go elsewhere. Waste of money

reviews.name: Baby Toes
reviews.text: Had two good massages at this place during my short Chiangmai visit. I think the general standard of the masseuse here is quite high. Came with 3 other friends and all of us had very good massages with different therapists. My masseuse gave a strong massage but it was never painful. Staff was very polite and attentive. Making an appointment was easy as they respond pretty fast on Facebook. It was also nice that there was a shower room in my massage room for me to wash off after my body scrub. And they serve you fruits and coconut juice at the end which I think is quite generous. If you prefer male masseuse then I think this is a good place for you as they have mostly male therapists. Thumbs up 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: Sevo Flurane
reviews.text:
I had two bad massages in Chiang Mai. My partner recommended Sanctuary spa and it didn’t disappoint. Did 1.5 hours with Khun Jo. He is very attentive. Asked about the massage and the temperature in the room. The owners were really nice. The room is very clean with private shower. At the end of massage, Khub Jo offered fresh coconut and sweet mango. I am impressed. We are now a fan and will be back!

Update. May 2023. Just had another great massage with Mister Ton. Very strong pressure. Great technique. The owner is very attentive. Highly recommend. If you want a truly skilled masseuse, you must try Mister Rom. Rom skills were impeccable.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for you’re here

reviews.name: Johan
reviews.text: Enjoyed good Thai Massage. The massage was performed directly on a mattress which gave a bit of variety in stretches and positions vs shops that are using tables.

reviews.name: The Global
reviews.text: This was my first experience of temple massage, there are two massage shops in the temple courtyard, the charge for 1 hour of Thai massage is Rs 150, the prices for all types of massages are very reasonable, most of the staff here are elderly people, the staff here is very experienced, we got massage done here for 2 hours, the experience here was very different and good.

reviews.name: ALeen
reviews.text:
This was the worst massage experience I’ve ever had. I was very unlucky to get a therapist who was unprofessional. She used her elbows almost the entire session, sat on my legs and lower back, and kept talking and gossiping about other customers.

The massage was supposed to be 1 hour, but she only used her hands for about 5 minutes, and the rest was just painful elbow pressure. It was not relaxing at all — it was uncomfortable and very painful.

Honestly, if you really want to get a massage here, just go for a simple foot massage — that’s more than enough.

I truly regret spending my time and money here. If anyone is planning to come, I recommend choosing a place with proper air-conditioned rooms and better service.

reviews.name: M “Alana” T
reviews.text:
Foot massage 120THB/60min. 100THB/30min
Thai Massage 120min/60min
No reservations.

I wanted Chi Nei Tsang but I didn't have time. I guess you have to make a call for a reservation in advance.

I went there at the end of the day, so only one person was on the waiting seat. I waited like 15min. The beds were available but some massage ladies have already finished work.

No A/C, nothing luxury, but very good price in a temple!

I'm not sure if my massager was good....she was kinda so so, but anyway I tipped her 100THB.

It's said that they may raise the price soon!

reviews.name: Niyas Haris
reviews.text:
Had a really good and authentic Thai massage experience at Rompho Temple Thai Massage. The massage felt professional and traditional, and the pricing is very budget-friendly.

If you’re looking for a genuine Thai massage without spending too much, this place is definitely worth checking out.
Highly recommended 👍

reviews.name: Kai Chung
reviews.text: Wonderful.  I did the one hour foot massage with my wife.  We were offered a private room.  The music is relaxing.  The decor was nice.  We were offered water to begin, a rice cracker and tea to finish.  The skill was good.  We shall return.

reviews.name: worrawat13
reviews.text: Now the price increases to 150 according to inflation, however, that 150 is the normal price local local people here get. Anyway, if you come with group, due to the limitation of space/bed and management, you have a high chance to get separated. Try another place if you wanna line-up with group or even two persons.

reviews.name: Miłosz Wawrzyniec Romaniuk
reviews.text: Massage salon situated in a temple courtyard. Rather modest and simple but you can find  really professional service here. A row of comfortable seats under a roof and a row of mattresses inside makes a cosy place where you can relax and have a great thai massage. They charge 120 THB for an hour of massage which is a money well spent for a service that makes you wanting to leave a tip. Definitely worth visiting!

reviews.name: Aiva. M.
reviews.text: Just don't go. Better spend more and go to a proper massage parlor. During foot massage I did not feel any relaxation what so ever... Left 3 star just because I still respect people's work and effort:)

reviews.name: Louise Rowan
reviews.text: There are two massage places inside the temple grounds. We went to the one that’s on the left as you enter, along the temple wall. It was fabulous. Thoroughly recommend. I’m sure the place on the other side is good too 😉

reviews.name: Kuan Sun
reviews.text: 120Baht per hour, they are doing philanthropy for sure, massage very nice, would be great if u come before noon so u dont need to wait a long queue

reviews.name: Alex Pepe
reviews.text: Situated in the temple court. Great staff, experienced ladies. This is an open space “massage factory” so popular and busy. The most attractive prices are applied at 120THB one hour one Thai massage instead of 250THB any where else. I am a Massage therapist in Geneva and I fairly recommend this place to get treated. 😌

reviews.name: Arturo Garcia - Yoga
reviews.text:
An amazing place for massage, very professional and hard to beat prices. Experienced masseuses in a very simple setting.
Highly recommended.

reviews.name: 吉田祥子
reviews.text:
I had a one hour foot massage. I've had massages in many places in Thailand, but this was the first time I'd experienced such quality at this price.
Highly recommended💯

reviews.name: Amina
reviews.text: 1 star just because 0 star doesn't exist. The worst foot massage I ever had in my whole life. Total waste of time and even if it's cheap but paying cheap for nothing is expensive ! The lady was talking the whole hour with her colleagues and was just touching me. I told her many times where it hurts and where she should focus on. I was telling her what to do the whole time and she didn't do anything right. Don't come here.

reviews.name: Kia Orion
reviews.text: love this spot! it's no frills, so don't expect any fancy water bottles or treats afterward. but that's the beauty, is that the massages are fantastic, the ladies are super sweet, and the price is right. i get a massage here once a week and the ladies are pros.  5 stars. do yourself a favor, stop reading google reviews and get over there!

reviews.name: Rathana
reviews.text: I was weirdly greeted by a "No white people here" with my friend after waiting for a while in front of the door for a foot massage, without specific reasons. Surprising, especially considering they are within a pagoda area and the abundant signs in front of the pagoda pointing at this spot. There is a good massage spot right next door showing RDN Massage doing wonders.

reviews.name: Gaz Efc
reviews.text: Excellent foot massage. Care taken but so good value

reviews.name: David Holt
reviews.text:
As always we have a 2 hour thai massage.
My operator today was new to me...but an excellent technician.
We try to go weekly ...and have for 2 years...as it is so affordable and consequently we always tip each technician at least 100 baht.

reviews.name: Vancouvergirl
reviews.text:
Worst service!👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼
The male masseuse was so rude! He kicked me out just because I asked for a woman masseuse instead of him.
He said “Get out of my place!! I don’t want a picky customer!!”

Just because I don’t want a stranger male touch my body..Is that my fault? This place have tons of women masseuse why can’t just give me one😅

You get what you pay for 👎🏼

reviews.name: Jania Hsu
reviews.text: The massage there was great and cheapest in Chiang Mai!!! Chilled place with nice and experienced staffs. I also tip them for the quality service!!!! Highly recommend.

title: GAOYOD Thai Boxing Gym (เก้ายอดมวยไทยยิม)
ownerDescription:
Gaoyod Muay Thai Gym
Discover authentic Muay Thai training in the heart of Bangkok, just 5 minutes from ICONSIAM. Gaoyod Muay Thai Gym offers personalized Muay Thai classes for all ages and skill levels, led by retired professional Muay Thai fighters. Whether you’re a complete beginner, fitness enthusiast, or preparing for competition, our welcoming gym is the perfect place to learn real Muay Thai technique and improve your health. Private and group classes are available daily in a safe, friendly environment with air conditioning, showers, and parking.
address: ชั้น 3, 591 Charoen Nakhon 14 (3rd, 591 floor, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
street: ชั้น 3, 591 Charoen Nakhon 14 (3rd, 591 floor

reviews.name: Anna Lusta
reviews.text:
I really liked my first Muay Thai class with Kru Banana! He explained all the moves clearly, was reasonably strict and patient with me, correcting all mistakes and paying special attention to my technique.
Gym is easy to find and very close to BTS
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We really appreciate the feedback! Correcting mistakes early is the best way to build a strong foundation, and Kru Banana is one of the best at it. Glad you found us easily from the BTS 🥊

reviews.name: A
reviews.text: It is my first time learning Thai kick boxing. It s fun and good for my body. It may help me in a difficult situation. The place is clean with changing and shower room. It s on the 3 rd floor of badminton courts. Kru Kluay the trainer is very nice patient and skillful. Fee is reasonable only 500 Baht per 1.5 hrs
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We really appreciate the detailed review! It’s great to hear that our clean facilities and reasonable rates made your first session even better. Kru Kluay is indeed very patient and skilled at teaching the practical side of Muay Thai. :)

reviews.name: C B
reviews.text:
Kru Banana is an amazing coach. He is the only coach I found who is focused on teaching proper technique, strategy and defense. He corrects every mistake and makes sure you improve, even if you’re a complete beginner. If you are interested in Muay Thai as a combat sport, you should try this gym!

Before joining this gym, I did trial classes at several other gyms where Muay Thai was just treated like a weight-loss workout: people just hit pads with no technique and mistakes were never corrected. I saw that at many gyms, including gyms that claim to train fighters, which left me very disappointed. That’s why Gaoyod feels like a hidden gem: unlike other gyms, it teaches you real Muay Thai and proper technique. The atmosphere is great too so it’s a perfect place to train and make progress!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for this incredibly detailed review! We are thrilled that you’ve found a home at Gaoyod. Kru Banana is passionate about preserving the art of Muay Thai, and he truly believes that technique and defense are the foundation of a real fighter. We're glad our 'hidden gem' lived up to your expectations.

reviews.name: Dagmar Marshall
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience training with Kru Banana! His coaching style is clear, technical, and very motivating. He pays close attention to detail and makes sure you improve your technique while still keeping the sessions fun and engaging.
Whether you’re a beginner or more advanced, he adapts the training perfectly to your level. I learned a lot in a short time and really enjoyed every session.
Will definitely come back again next time I’m in Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for such a wonderful review.  We will pass your kind words to Kru Banana.  Bangkok and our gym are looking forward to have you back again soon 😊

reviews.name: Benjaporn Theeraruk
reviews.text:
I follow Kru (coach) Banana from another gym. He is a real teacher for Thai Boxing. Place is clean, shower rooms are provided. Reasonable fee.
No doubt about his technics cause I used to learn with him for straight 2 yrs.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We truly appreciate the support! There’s no better compliment than a student following their teacher to a new gym. We’re glad you’re enjoying the new facilities and the same high-quality technique Kru Banana is known for.

reviews.name: Phabion Moran
reviews.text:
I had an amazing Muay Thai training session from 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The coach, Banana was incredibly experienced and placed a strong emphasis on technique, ensuring every movement was executed correctly. Despite the language barrier, communication was excellent—his demonstrations were clear and easy to follow, making it a highly effective session. The training was both challenging and rewarding, and I left feeling more confident in my skills. I highly recommend this session to anyone looking to improve their Muay Thai, whether you're a beginner or more advanced!

Looking forward to the next session 😁
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your positive experience with us.

reviews.name: Rachel Newbill
reviews.text: My son started here a few months ago. He has grown so much and loves it! The instructors are fantastic and even though we don't speak Thai, they are wonderful! He looks forward to the weekly class! He has learned a lot. Great prices. Highly recommend!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the lovely review! We're so happy your son is enjoying the classes and making great progress. It’s wonderful to hear that he looks forward to coming each week. We appreciate your recommendation!

reviews.name: Sjard Fitter
reviews.text:
Kru Banana 🍌✊
As absolute Beginner, it was a very good first session. Nevertheless i don’t speak any Thai I had a good time and learnt the basics. Thank you very much!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We are so glad you had a great first session with Kru Banana 🍌.

reviews.name: Hamed
reviews.text: Popped in today and wasn’t expecting much, but I was honestly surprised by how good the session was. Coach really drilled into how important footwork is — not just for moving, but for defending and creating openings. He showed me different ways to counter and how to defend attacks properly. Biggest takeaway: when you defend or use footwork, you should always be ready to either counter straight away or respond back with something. Great session overall. So thank you and if anyone sees this I really do recommend as someone who has done Muay Thai I have definitely learnt plenty, only issue was language barrier but good old translator did the trick. 👍🏽
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the kind words! It’s great to hear that the footwork and countering drills clicked for you. We believe there’s always something new to learn, no matter your experience level. See you next time!

reviews.name: arma santiningrum
reviews.text:
I was in Wongwiang Yai area and have a limited time stay there. But i want to try to do muay thai during my stay in Bangkok. So i randomly try this place and it was great 😍

You will have a chill place to do muaythai (with aircon/fan), and its not crowded. The best part is..they have 2 trainer !! That time was only 3 of us and both of them teach us. Thanks to Mr Banana teach me how to have stable leg in this sport
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review!

We're delighted that our team met your expectations and made your experience memorable. At GAOYOD Thai Boxing Gym (เก้ายอดมวยไทยยิม), customer satisfaction is our top priority, and your positive feedback reassures us that we're on the right track.

Best regards,
GAOYOD Thai Boxing Gym (เก้ายอดมวยไทยยิม)

reviews.name: Dev Kanakan
reviews.text:
Excellent trainer and a perfect gym for beginners and enthusiasts.
Loved the sessions. As a tourist , it was such a great pleasure to have got this training experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Dav. 😊

reviews.name: Marcel Gerlinger
reviews.text:
I trained at GAOYOD Thai Boxing Gym over the past few weeks while on a business trip in Bangkok, and I couldn’t have asked for a better place.

The gym is well-equipped, nicely air-conditioned, and has a relaxed but focused atmosphere. Training sessions are structured and adaptable — whether you're a beginner or experienced, they tailor the intensity to your level. If you want to push your pace, they'll match it. If you need more technical focus, they take the time to correct your form.

Even though I was only in town temporarily, I felt welcomed and looked forward to every session. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Bangkok who wants authentic Muay Thai training.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks for the awesome review! We're thrilled you enjoyed your training at GAOYOD Thai Boxing Gym during your Bangkok trip.
It's great to hear you felt welcome and found our sessions adaptable. We appreciate your high recommendation and hope to see you again soon!

reviews.name: Richard Thomas
reviews.text: I’ve visited Coach Banana recently and really enjoy his teaching style. I’ve trained in martial arts and he pushes my skill set every class.  Thumbs up!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the 'thumbs up'! We’re glad to hear that someone with your martial arts background is finding value in Coach Banana’s sessions. He loves pushing students to refine their skills and level up.

reviews.name: Ellen Cooney
reviews.text: Did a muay Thai class today, teacher was great and really showed me the muay Thai technique. Amazing class highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Glad you had an amazing session! It’s all about the technique, and we're happy you enjoyed the experience.

reviews.name: Mark Lee
reviews.text: First time trying Muay Thai and instructor Kru Banana made it a great experience. Provided a lot of corrections and feedback to help me learn the fundamentals step by step. Highly recommend for a more personalized training experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Mark, for sharing your first Muay Thai experience with us! We’re delighted to hear that Kru Banana’s guidance made your training enjoyable and helpful in learning the fundamentals step by step. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for more personalized training soon

reviews.name: Amy Vong
reviews.text: Place is located upstairs Tito Court. Fun and challenging! You definitely get a work out. Instructor attentive and help perfected the moves. Learned so much in first session.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Amy.  😊

reviews.name: Hans-Gert Dahmen
reviews.text: I have tried several other gyms in the area, but this is the best. They really take the time it needs to correct your technique and teach you how to move properly. In other gyms the focus was on making you exhausted, but not here. I can definitively recommend it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We really appreciate the feedback! Quality technique is our top priority, so it’s great to hear you enjoyed the focused coaching here. Looking forward to your next session!

reviews.name: Mr Clifford Wong
reviews.text: We attended Gaoyod as walk-ins to the group class in June 2025. Kru Banana took us and he was superb. Good communication,  great knowledge and superb tips for improving. Counter strike instruction was invaluable. Highly recommend this small gym. Hidden gem with no frills, all skills.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for joining us and for the great review! We’re glad you enjoyed training with Kru Banana—he’ll be happy to hear your feedback. Hope to see you again soon! 🥊🙏🏼

reviews.name: Elijah Shel
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Kru Kluay is the first and only Muay Thai instructor I’ve met who does not just focus on hitting the bag, he takes the time to explain techniques in detail and refine your fighting skills. This level of technical instruction is quite rare among Muay Thai coaches in Thailand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Elijah. We're delighted to hear you had an amazing experience with Kru Kluay. We believe in detailed, technical instruction to help every student truly grow. Your feedback means a lot to us - hope to welcome you back for more training soon.

reviews.name: Caiden King
reviews.text: Kru banana is a really good trainer who teaches through the language barrier
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! We’re lucky to have Kru Banana—he proves that Muay Thai is a universal language. So glad you enjoyed the training despite the language barrier.

reviews.text: I had a massage by Lola this morning, it was one of the best massages I have received! She worked carefully on my tight shoulders which are now feeling amazing! The overall experience was exceptional.i will definitely come back. Thank you Lola!

reviews.name: Elena Molina
reviews.text: I love this massage place ! The kindest and professional staff . They have a really good massage . Will miss them

reviews.name: Lily Fletcher
reviews.text: I had a back and shoulder deep tissue massage with Ao. Honestly, the best massage I’ve ever had. I cannot recommend her enough. I will be back.

reviews.name: Brandon Lucas

reviews.name: Hollie Geraghty
reviews.text:
My introduction to Muay Thai with coach Ben was everything I could have hoped for. His classes are structured, challenging, thorough, and the perfect blend of fitness meets skill. The equipment is clean and organised, the aircon keeps the studio a comfortable temperature and the music is always on point. The one-on-one pad work you get during his classes ensures you learn so much so quickly, and he knows just the right moment to scale things up and push you harder.

Ben is also super skilled at accommodating for Thai and English-speakers, left and right handed people, beginners and experienced fighters all at the same time. Everyone I met here was wonderful too, and Ben really cultivates a space where there is always smiles and laughter. I was also able to purchase tickets from him for a big fight night at Rajadamnern Stadium. Very grateful for all I learned across three months here! 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Orange Elephant
reviews.text:
Just a 5 mins walk down the main road from Wutthakat BTS Station, this was the perfect place for myself, with a number of a years of Muay Thai experience, and my father who was a complete beginner. Also, it's air conditioned, which is most welcome for anyone not used to the heat. We did a group class and smoothly booked a session via Line (most updated schedule and pricing available there) the day before. All equipment can be borrowed there. Just come in comfortable sports attire.

Ben speaks English fluently and was an awesome instructor to both of us. My father learnt the basics, worked up a sweat, enjoyed himself, while I got technical pointers on my boxing and weight shifting during combinations. Ben told us he's expanding his gym to build a ring, punching bags, sauna, and even an ice bath - I look forward to plunging into the ice bath the next time I'm back in Bangkok! Highly recommended to novices and anyone with experience. Thanks Kru Ben for having us!

Ps. Lots of delicious food along the street opposite the gym 😋

reviews.name: Pati
reviews.text: I have been attending personal training sessions with Ben, and I highly recommend it. The classes are adjusted to my level, and Ben really focuses on technique, so I feel like I’m learning a lot. We also include stretching and strength training in the sessions. Ben is a really great guy and an excellent trainer. I recommend everyone to give his classes a try, both beginners and advanced participants!

reviews.name: 刘宇晨
reviews.text: If you want to learn real boxing and Muay Thai, come here. Unlike other gyms where the teaching is rough, Coach Ben's movements are truly standard. He'll meticulously correct every detail for you. After practicing for a while, you'll realize how much Coach Ben's teaching can help you. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced fighter, you'll leave with a wealth of knowledge. It's suitable for beginners and experienced fighters who are hitting a plateau. No matter how many gyms I've been to, Coach Ben's gym remains my original choice. Furthermore, the new boxing gym will be completed around March. The space appears to be ample, and all the teaching equipment is brand name, clean, and brand new, making it very comfortable to use for target practice. The venue is also very clean.

reviews.name: William Borg
reviews.text:
I was there today and had an amazing experience with Ben. He was very friendly and helpful. He adjusted from the experience and conditioning you have. A very big thing and what makes Ben special about his training is that you see that he loves what he’s doing. Extremely passionate. Every question that was asked, he answered with fine details. His English is fluent and there is no type of language barrier.

I strongly recommend for everyone!

reviews.name: DG
reviews.text: I trained with Ben as a beginner for one month, five days a week. I dropped a significant amount of weight and quickly picked up the basics, every session a new detail learned. That's testament to his eye for detail on your form and knowledge as a fighter. He's calm, relaxed, with a good sense of humour. I look forward to seeing the completed expansion work on the new gym area. And training with Ben in the future whenever I'm in Bangkok. Fully recommend.

reviews.name: Prince K
reviews.text: Ben’s Muay Thai is next level, yaar! Ben is not just a trainer, he’s a proper guru and super chill but knows how to push you to your limits. Every class builds your speed, strength, and mindset. We learn something new every single day and haha from fresh Muay Thai moves to even a new Thai word! The vibes are always positive, the energy is solid, and you walk out feeling stronger inside and out. Best decision made and highly recommend! 🙌🥊

reviews.text: Amazing hidden Muay Thai gym. Ben is an amazing person and coach. Super insightful private class, and very well priced. Would definitely go again. 500 baht for a private.

reviews.text:

It’s worth all the money you’re going to pay, and you get a bargain if you take a monthly plan.

Even more fun if you train with friends.

Talking about amenities, his gym has everything, weight training machine, multiple ACs, it’s always clean and you get all the equipments.

Bonus: Everyday I learn a new Thai word from Ben 😂 Today’s word is “Kapaotang Hai” which means wallet lost xD

Don’t think just go for it! He’s the best!

reviews.name: Quinten Verdegem
reviews.text:
Ben is an outstanding Muay Thai trainer who consistently delivers high-quality coaching. Training sessions are well structured, challenging, and always tailored to individual skill levels.

What really sets Ben apart is his professionalism and genuine commitment to his students’ progress. He pays close attention to detail, corrects form effectively, and motivates you to push past your limits while maintaining a safe and supportive environment. Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced fighter, Ben knows how to help you improve.

Highly recommended for anyone serious about learning Muay Thai and developing both skill and confidence.

reviews.text:
We had the best massage here. We showed up late at night around 10pm and there was only 1 woman there. By the time we went to the bathroom, changed and laid down, there was a second lady already waiting for us which was literally no more than 5 minutes. The first lady who welcomed us was a little older but she had the brightest personality with a smile and a giggle with every interaction. I was blessed to get her as my masseuse. I had the best foot massage in all of the 10 days we've been here. Her pressure was perfect and she knew all the spots. And bonus points, she did a little foot reflexology too! She kept me in a trance right between falling asleep and fully aware. I was so relaxed the entire time. Being so impressed by her, i had to write a review immediately. I wish we found this place sooner because i would have jumped to go back to them.
My fiancé got a thai massage and he was very happy with his massage as well. Its hard to find two good masseuse at the same time, especially at night but this one was *chef's kiss." Highly recommend!

The place is super peaceful and quiet — exactly what you need. The vitality pool is so amazing, smells amazing, and the lemongrass tea they serve is really good too. Such a nice touch.

If you need a break from everything, this is the place. Already looking forward to my next visit.

reviews.name: Katherine
reviews.text:
My magnesium oil massage is amazing, Namoy she is lovely and very professional. The strength of massage is so on point and very consistent. Will definitely recommend if you have trouble sleeping or had a long flight.

Thank you, Namoy, and Sam for the great experience <3

reviews.name: Ema Kacar
reviews.text:
I had a 3-hour spa session at Auriga Spa, and it was honestly one of the most beautiful experiences I’ve ever had.
My therapist, Nui, was incredible. From the moment we started, she truly listened to my body and adapted the New Moon treatment specifically for me. Every touch felt intentional, intuitive, and deeply caring. It wasn’t just a massage – it felt like a personalised healing ritual. I walked out lighter, calmer, and completely reset.
What made it unforgettable was that it was my birthday. At the end of the treatment, they surprised me with a cake and sang Happy Birthday to me. I actually teared up 🥹 It was such a thoughtful, genuine gesture and made me feel so special and looked after.
The space itself is serene, elegant, and deeply peaceful – but it’s the people that make Auriga exceptional. Nui didn’t just “do a treatment”, she truly spoiled me and tuned into what my body needed.
If you want a spa experience that feels soulful, personal, and luxurious in the best possible way, this is it. I’ll remember this birthday forever. 💛✨

reviews.name: Sameer Ismail
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Auriga Spa, located in the beautiful Capella Bangkok. The service was excellent from start to finish – very professional, attentive, and welcoming. The massage itself was very good, relaxing, and done with great care and skill. Overall, a high-quality spa experience in a calm and luxurious setting. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Ivan Chung
reviews.text:
Great service and hospitality with professional therapist.

Environment is zen which makes you relax and calm, and therapist is professional and can tailor make the treatment depends on your body and energy level.

Thank you the receptionist (Army) and therapist (Nui) for the experience.

Only recommendation is hardware can further improve to provide a more seamless experience

reviews.name: Thawan Gunawan
reviews.text: Masseuse Khun Nui took care of me today. Highly recommended for anyone looking for not only a physical relaxation experience but also a spiritual one. Exceptional experience today. Did the 90-mins Full Moon Massage + 45-min Sound Healing Therapy, Masseuse Nui was extremely professional & knowledgeable with her massage & sound healing techniques. Definitely, a must-do experience. Thank you Khun Nui for guiding me  & letting me understand how ‘to turn my the switch off’ through sound healing & breathwork, allowing my mind to fully reset properly after this session. Will carry her suggestions in my daily-life!

reviews.name: Alex Mar
reviews.text: Truly Asia’s greatest spa. Fully lives up to the reputation (and often fully booked so book ahead). I was greeted by Som and her staff who did everything to secure me an appointment and went through the treatments. It’s a stunning space and if you’re a guest you can also freely access the vitality tropical shower and plunge pools. Everything is Aesop or Biologique Recherche. Just incredible. The spa is gorgeous, so relaxing and thoughtfully designed. My therapist Win had decades of experience and gave the best traditional treatment and even took the time to teach me stretches and recommend new skincare which I love. Everyone here truly cares, is passionate about skincare and health and the place is beautiful. They give you a great wind down post-treatment care ritual with tea and a heated neck pillow as well. don’t know if I can find a better spa in the world, I still think about relaxing there and how incredible and warm the staff are. Really the next level and future of what spas should be and therapists should be. Like most things at this Capella, it’s hard to beat and I can’t wait to come back.

reviews.name: Suranya Phoneprasert
reviews.text: I enjoyed a 90‑minute Cartier oil massage with therapist Nancy, and it was absolutely wonderful. The treatment was deeply relaxing, and Nancy’s skill and attentiveness made the experience exceptional. I highly recommend trying this service.

reviews.name: Yudi Lesmana
reviews.text: Amazing spa by the riverside, had body scrub and aroma therapy massage which was probably one of the best in town. Nancy was very skillful and attentive ensuring excellent experience. The vitality area is one-of-a-kind too.

reviews.name: YiYin Wang
reviews.text:
Heavenly experience and just at the time I thought I have tried all the best luxury spa in bkk, I came to Auriga as the last stop — and holy moly it even surpasses all the rest!

Especially thanks to my therapist G ( or Ji, sorry I didn’t catch the spelling but she mentioned it’s pronounced as G ), she’s crazy good, I prefer reasonably strong pressure and suffer from spinal stiffness, and G hit each points 200% precise in the deepest yet gentlest way, I asked how come she’s this strong and she said only because she knows the spots — and yes it’s true.

I was lucky enough to enjoy the facilities for 1 hour in advance and had it almost all for myself, adore the Asthetic and how they work with the serene vibe with, to me, a touch of futuristic / spiritual style, that’s how it reminds me. Pure bliss!

reviews.name: Janusz Daga
reviews.text: Auriga Spa in Bangkok, nestled close to the serene riverbanks, offers a truly luxurious experience. The ambiance is stunning, with a blend of modern elegance and traditional Thai aesthetics. The Essence Massage is a highlight, delivering a deeply relaxing and rejuvenating experience. The skilled therapists and attention to detail make it a top choice for those seeking indulgence and tranquility in the heart of Bangkok.

reviews.name: Sumol
reviews.text: Experience pure bliss at the spa and wellness at Capella Bangkok. Relax in the soothing hot pool, rejuvenate with a hydra water shower, and unwind with a variety of expertly crafted massages. The serene atmosphere and professional staff will leave you feeling refreshed and revitalized.

reviews.name: Jia Jin Low
reviews.text:
I’ve been here twice, and IMO it’s the best spa in all of Bangkok. In my mind, there’s 3 tiers of nice spas here: Panpuri & Thann < most luxury hotels in Bangkok < Capella. Wish I tried the Opium Spa while staying at the Siam Hotel, but never did, so can’t compare.

I have to say, even when staying in FS, I made the journey to Capella just for its spa. The masseuses are better trained, and the facilities just a tiny step up (looks at the unnecessary but cool “shower experience” 👀). They also lack the FS’s ridiculous weekend surcharge, so it was actually cheaper, for a better experience.

Would return here again and again. Even if I was staying halfway across town. Or hundreds of miles away in Singapore.

reviews.name: Sharna Park
reviews.text: The Auriga Spa, located within the Capella Hotel in Bangkok, features excellent facilities and massage therapists with gentle yet exceptional techniques. After feeling tired from outdoor activities, the 90-minute massage session provided a deeply satisfying experience.

reviews.name: Saranya Paiboonnukulkij
reviews.text: Highly recommended. My best spa (in hotel) experienced. Mind and body relaxation in 2.5 hrs. This place is serene, well design and also accessible. The service is just perfect not too much formality and not too casual. Didn't take a lot of photo because enjoyed my time so much 😊.

reviews.name: Navin Khanijow
reviews.text:
A very luxurious spa with a modern marble luxury decor equipped with the latest spa bed and jacuzzi

Probably the best spa in Thailand at the moment!

In the locker room, they have all type of amenities available to pamper yourself or get dressed up later after the spa session. Big nice shower room.

They also have what other spa don't have is the vitality pool and the bath shower experience and this is exactly the competitive edge which makes the best spa in Thailand. The vitality pool in which you can use before and after the treatment is very relaxing, warm water and have a bubble options for muscle relaxation. The shower experience is something which you must really really try, because while showering, you feel like you in a rain forest under the storm or the rain. Have to experience yourself.

I took the magnesium oil massage treatment for 90 minutes. The therapist name Jane is an absolute professional. Her steps of service to attention of details is simply amazing. Nice massage, professional and very relaxing in a modern luxury massage room.

The reason I cut 1 star is because as I already informed before hand many times that I will be using the vitality pool experience after the massage, they should make me have shower in my private massage room which already consist of a shower room. Instead, they asked me to have a shower outside in the public area and then wait to be taken to the room later. They should already know that I will be having a massage so in the private room, they should have offered me to have a massage there. Hope they can understand and improve from here.

However, very amazing, very relaxing and will definitely repeat.
Love the after massage tea which is very relaxing and the thai cold dessert which makes you very refreshed.

reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this Thai massage. The therapist was extremely rough and seemed completely absent during the session. From the beginning, I felt treated like just another tourist rather than a client deserving care and attention.

There was no gentleness, softness, or sense of presence in her touch—it felt mechanical and careless, almost like poking rather than massage. I asked her several times to be more gentle and soft, and even tried to show it by softly placing my hand on hers, but my requests were ignored.

Instead of feeling relaxed or respected, I felt uncomfortable and tense. At one point, I even considered ending the massage early, but felt too awkward to stand up and leave. That alone says a lot about how unpleasant the experience was.

To make it worse, at the end of the massage she handled my hair very roughly, aggressively messing it up, which felt disrespectful and unnecessary.

Massage is not only about technique, it’s about presence, sensitivity, loving touch and respect. Unfortunately, none of that was present here. I will not be returning and cannot recommend this place.

Her kindness and attentiveness made the experience stand out, and her professional demeanor was a true highlight. I found it hard to keep my eyes off her attractiveness, but it was her expertise and sweet nature that truly made the visit worthwhile. I highly recommend Aya Massage Parlor and will definitely be returning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your wonderful experience! We’re delighted to hear that Mira provided such a memorable and exceptional session, combining her skill, professionalism, and warm personality. Your kind words mean so much to us, and we’re thrilled to know you plan to return. We look forward to welcoming you back to Aya Massage Bangkok soon!

reviews.name: Emily White
reviews.text: I got my nails done here and they were awful. One completely broke off the day after. I went back and asked for them to be removed and a refund. They took them off and asked me for more money. They would not listen to me or give me a refund. I feel they are not even trained in doing nails. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND TO ANYONE. Terrible service. The photo below is how they left my nails after burning my skin with some sort of acid trying to take them off

reviews.name: Mia
reviews.text:
I’ve never left a bad review before, but this experience was so bad that I feel as though I need to.

I got the Thai Massage - 60 minutes. And will preface this by saying my friend got the same thing at the same time and her experience was completely fine.

It was as though my lady had never given a massage before, she was entirely unsure the whole time giggling at every moment. We were always one step behind my friend leading me to believe she was attempting to copy the movements. But everything was just so wrong, there was no pressure and the she kept dropping me out of positions, or putting me into ones that I’ve never had before and just felt awkward.

I was actually very close to walking out as I felt I was more likely to get injured than benefit, and I just felt very awkward.

Moral of the story, I think the masseuses are actually okay, I maybe just didn’t get one, so be wary when walking in.

reviews.name: Itim Itimmm
reviews.text: I had such a great experience here! The staff were super friendly and really knew what they were doing. The massage was amazing I felt so relaxed and refreshed after. The place was clean and had a really chill vibe. Definitely coming back again, highly recommend! 💖

reviews.name: marla neu
reviews.text:
I had the worst experience here. I wanted a french manicure but they didn’t have the colour i wanted. Instead of telling me she just used a different, way darker colour. Once I realized i asked thats when she told me. I was verry confused as to why she didnt just tell me upfront so i could choose something else. But i gave it a chance cause maybe it would turn out great (and i was overwhelmed with the situation because of the language barrier) but when she drew the white french on my feet it looked so bad. The white was all over my nail and it really did look like a child drew it so i asked if she just could remove all the polish. Didn’t get any money back and thats probably why you have to pay upfront.
I really stayed nice during the whole process and the women aswell so that was ok but i clearly paid for something i didnt want and didnt get…

reviews.name: Tessa van Westerop
reviews.text:
Giving two stars cuz i ready good things about the massages, but personally didnt have a good experience. I got a french pedicure, and it literally looks like a child did it. The communication was bad, and i had to pay up front (i get that bit now).
She didnt clean my feet first, just went into the cutticle clipping straight away. Didnt wait for the paint to dry inbetween layers, its uneven and gloopy.

When she was done, i asked if it was dry, she said yes, i put on my sandals and the nail immediatly smudged when i hit a strap. Clearly not dry. They acted like i did something stupid, but she did redo the nail. I looked a lot worse than her first attempt. Half an hour later its already chipping. Might be a good place for a massage but definitely not a pedicure.

I feel like i should have asked for a refund/discount but their english was not good enough for me want to start that
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Tessa ,I apologize for the unsatisfactory service you experienced. If you are still here, please return for a free replacement. I am truly sorry and have instructed my staff to improve. I am sorry to have caused you dissatisfaction. I apologize again.
แปลบทสนทนา

reviews.text:
I did manicure and my husband went for foot massage - both very disappointing.

This is not to be rude but first part of someone doing your manicure is for their own hands to be clean. This was not the case for the person doing my manicure. Their staff need proper training, this was the worst manicure I have ever had.

They need to work on cleanliness of this place and take it seriously.

reviews.name: J Stl
reviews.text:
Lovely woman, terrible manicure / pedicure.

The “gel” cost me 700baht even though they didn’t have the colours they advertised in the windows and they were using clearly old varnish that was gloopy and applied unevenly.

When I asked her to tidy them up, she
a) filled out gaps with more chunks of nail varnish,
b) used her own nails with no gloves to carve under my nail beds, and
c) didn’t even clean off the nail varnish she’d smudged over my hand and thumb.
She blew my nails dry with her mouth and used her finger to pat them to test if they were dry.

She confirmed they were ready and just putting my shoes on wiped the varnish right off (so gloopy) so I asked for a them to remove it and a partial refund. I was happy to pay for the filing (even though it was the wrong shape and she left bits of skin and nail left so I’ve had to file them myself) but they only gave me 250baht back. The guy who may have been a manager even interrupted me when I was speaking.
The woman was apologetic but SUCH waste of money and time on my last day.

reviews.name: Woravat Fungtragool
reviews.text:
Highly recommended.
Best Thai massage I've ever had.

I only went in for a one-hour session, but the relief I got for my lower back pain was incredible. The therapist is exceptionally skilled. You honestly won't find this level of expertise just anywhere. She knew exactly what she was doing and seamlessly incorporated deep stretching into the massage, which really helped ease the pain.

She also used a traditional wooden hammer tapping technique that felt remarkably similar to the shockwave therapy you'd receive at a modern physiotherapy clinic.

If this clinic were closer to my home, I would be here every single week.

After the massage, they offer complimentary herbal tea and snacks.

reviews.name: Nunnapus Priyanapusskul Esteba
reviews.text: อบสมุนไพรตอนหน้าหนาว (ที่อบอยู่ outdoor) คือดีมาก เหงื่อออกดี หายใจโล่งขึ้น ออกมาพักโดนกับอากาศเย็นๆ ทำให้สดชื่นมาก หลังอบเสร็จ มานวดตัว ผ่อนคลายมาก เคลิ้มหลับกันเลย อบสมุนไพรแนะนำให้จองล่วงหน้า เพราะทางร้านจะเตรียมเป็นสมุนไพรสดๆให้ ข้าวตังทานคู่กับชาดอกไม้ อร่อยมาก ขนมอาลัวคือที่สุด 🥰
reviews.textTranslated: The herbal steam bath in winter (the outdoor one) is amazing. You sweat a lot, breathe easier, and getting out into the cool air is so refreshing. After the steam bath, a body massage is incredibly relaxing; you might even fall asleep! I recommend booking the herbal steam bath in advance because the shop prepares fresh herbs. The rice crackers with flower tea are delicious, and the alua (Thai sweet) is the best! 🥰

reviews.textTranslated:
Today I had the opportunity to try their herbal steam tent treatment combined with a massage to relieve aches and pains.
For 800 baht, 120 minutes, it was well worth it.

The atmosphere inside the shop was clean and tidy, with a relaxing fragrance. Although it's not a luxury spa, it's definitely a premium-level health massage shop.

The shop is located in the alley next to Lakeland. This road leads to the airport, and there are many good restaurants and cafes nearby.

reviews.text:

다시는 이용하지 않을 것이다.
관광객들 호갱되지않게 조심하세요.

reviews.text:
We visited this salon as a couple and clearly chose regular massage services only (Thai massage + oil massage). During the massage, my husband was asked twice if he wanted a “happy ending.”
This is completely unacceptable, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially when customers explicitly choose a non-sexual massage and come together as a couple.
When I confronted the staff calmly about this, they pretended not to understand and avoided taking responsibility.
If this is a place that offers sexual services, it should be clearly stated. If not, staff should never make such offers.
I would strongly warn other couples and travelers looking for a legitimate massage to be cautious! Really not okay!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hello

We sincerely apologize if anything said by our staff made you feel uncomfortable.
Our staff member speaks very limited English, and the words “happy happy” were meant only as a light-hearted joke to make a relaxed atmosphere. 
There was absolutely no inappropriate intention.

Our shop provides professional massage services. If this caused any misunderstanding, we are truly sorry.

We hope we can clear up this misunderstanding peacefully, and we kindly ask you to remove this review, as it has an impact on staff who did not intend to cause any discomfort.

Thank you very much for your understanding.

reviews.textTranslated:
I stopped by because it was close to my accommodation, and it was truly the best massage I’ve ever received.

I got a 1-hour foot massage and a 1-hour Thai massage. It was incredibly refreshing, and they knew exactly where the sore spots were to properly loosen them up.

I plan to get my massages here without fail whenever I come to Bangkok :)

Also, perhaps because it hasn't been open for long, the facilities are super clean, and the owner and staff are incredibly friendly!!!

I rarely leave reviews, but I had such a great time that I had to leave one!!!

Teacher 'Bang' is truly the best...❤️

I’m leaving with a happy massage on the last day of my Bangkok trip!!!

reviews.name: Dr Nond
reviews.text: เข้ามานวด คอ บ่า ไหล่ เป็นลูกค้าตั้งแต่สาขาหนึ่งตอนนั้นเพื่อนแนะนำมา ผมไปต่างประเทศมา2 ปี กลับมาได้เจอหมอเป้งชายอีกครั้งที่สาขานี้ ดีใจมากๆ เป้งบริการดีเหมือนเดิม นวดตรงจุด มีความรู้เรื่องกายภาพ จุดกดตามๆ กดรีดและคลายกล้ามเนื้อได้ดีมาก แบบถ้ามาเจอหมอเป้งคือจบ เคยไปนวดที่อื่นมาหลายที่ เหมือนเสี่ยงดวงและนวดไม่ค่อยโดนกล้ามเนื้อ และคลายจุดกดเจ็บพวก trigger point ไม่ได้ดีขนาดนี้ อันนีบอกว่าเจ็บตรงนี้ ตึงตรงนี้ หมอเป้ง จัดให้หมด ช่วงแรกๆ ที่มาลูกค้าไม่เยอะมาก แต่ตอนนี้ลูกค้าประจำเริ่มเยอะบางวัน ต้อง  book ก่อนล่วงหน้า เพื่อให้ได้คิวชัวร์ อันนี้ชื่นชมจากใจเลยครับ คนอื่นที่ร้านก็นวดดีนะครับเพราะเค้าคัดพนักงานฝีมือดีระดับหนึ่งละแต่ถ้าเอาชัวร์แนะนำคนนี้ครับ นวดจริงจังใส่ใจลูกค้ามากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: I came here for a neck, shoulder, and back massage. I've been a customer since their first branch, recommended by a friend. I was abroad for two years, and I was so happy to see Dr. Peng (male masseur) again at this branch. He's just as good as before. He's very knowledgeable about physiotherapy, hitting the right pressure points and releasing tension effectively. If you come to Dr. Peng, you're guaranteed a great result. I've been to many other places before, and it felt like a gamble; they didn't hit the right muscles or release trigger points as well as he does. I tell him where I'm in pain and where I'm tense, and Dr. Peng fixes it all. Initially, there weren't many customers, but now they have a lot of regulars, and sometimes you have to book in advance to secure a slot. I really appreciate that. The other masseurs at the shop are also good, because they've selected highly skilled staff, but if you want guaranteed results, I highly recommend Dr. Peng. He's very serious and attentive to his clients.

reviews.text: The Massage I had got here was OK. I visit a lot of different massage parlors in Thailand and not for a happy ending, but I enjoy a massage after walking around when I have sore feet. I also have a back issue so I like an oil massage with a lot of pressure. The staff was friendly, but they did act a little confused when me and my girlfriend came in and wanted to get massages. They said they weren’t able to do it at first and then I was fine with that and I was gonna get a foot massage but then they said they’d make a phone call and get somebody else to come in to perform this type of massage that we could just wait. I said I was fine with a foot massage, but they insisted on the oil massage anyway so we waited about five minutes and another lady came in. My girlfriend got a time massage and she thought it was OK. I had got the oil massage and I believe it was the first time this lady I’ve ever given an oil massage in her life because she did not do what 90% of the other people do when you get an oil massage. Although the massage was OK it really wasn’t what I was looking for. I don’t like leaving less than four star reviews, but I feel that I need to be fair so other people will know what their expectations is. I’ll probably never be back in this town again, so I won’t be visiting this shop again. The price was fair, but I don’t believe I got what I had paid for.

Dear Customer
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience with us. 🙏
I’m truly sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations — and more importantly, that we let you down in terms of professionalism and care during your session.

Cleanliness and a peaceful environment are very important to us, and while we’re glad that you appreciated our studio’s aesthetic, we sincerely apologize for the distractions and lack of attentiveness you experienced from your therapist. This is absolutely not the level of service we aim to provide.

We take your feedback seriously and will be addressing this with our team immediately to ensure better focus, respect, and attention to every guest. Your comfort and trust mean a lot to us, and I would love the opportunity to make this right for you in the future.

Please feel free to contact us directly if you're open to giving us another chance. We’d be grateful for the opportunity to provide the calm, focused, and healing experience that every guest deserves. 💛

Warm regards,
Arokah Massage (Rama 4)
