reviews.name: Shawn Ng
reviews.text:
Lemongrass Thai Heritage Massage is hands down one of the best massage experiences I’ve had in Bangkok.
I purchased the THB 10,000 package, which came with a free THB 2,500 credit, giving a total value of THB 12,500 — excellent value for money, especially considering the quality of service and treatment.
The massage was very good, consistently professional and effective. I always go for the 90-minute session, which is perfect — thorough, relaxing, and really helps release tension. The therapists are skilled and know exactly how to adjust pressure properly.
The environment is clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, creating a calm and relaxing atmosphere from start to finish. I appreciated the thoughtful details: a cold towel to freshen up, a warm cup of tea before the massage, and another tea after the session, which made the experience feel complete and well taken care of.
Excellent service, great value, and a consistently high standard. I’d definitely return again and highly recommend this place to anyone staying around Huai Khwang or Din Daeng.

reviews.name: Yif Lim
reviews.text:
I was impressed at how u could do a spa booking via the tablet in the room in the hotel for a session the next day at 11am. As I was excited to do the massage earlier as I have a flight to catch and needed to leave the hotel by 1pm, so I decided to head early to the spa the next day morning to see if I can get an earlier slot since the spa opens at 10.30am.

However, when I reached the spa at 10.20am, it was closed, I decided to wait outside. Just then, a walk-in customer came just right before me and I followed suit, but he booked the 10.30am slot instead. And the lady at the front desk said that all bookings are full now and there is no availability till 12.30pm. She said booking can only be confirmed via the phone. I’m like huh? I’m here now isn’t it? Also, there was no indication that I needed to call to confirm the booking. Anyway the time was 10.20am and the spa official opens at 10.30am, so how could I call? And anyway I’m physically here, they should have given me priority instead of the walk-in customer.

What’s funny is the male customer who just booked before me, is only doing his service for an hour so shouldn’t the next available slot be at 1130? But nope, it’s only available at 1230pm. So I seriously don’t know what’s going on, but this is a warning to all guests who use the tablet to book the spa service that all timings are available but does not mean that they are available.

Really horrible experience and it’s a shame as wwe have stayed at the Lancaster twice and the service, cleanliness and facilities are great, except this spa. U can check the attached photo from the tablet that it doesn’t say that u have to call to confirm the slot. Any guest would assume that the slot is confirmed as there’s a cancellation policy. Absolutely appalling.

reviews.name: Frederique De Sousa
reviews.text:
Very good Muay Thai gym located in Chinatown. The place is in a small narrow alley in a middle of a market. If you don’t find it, don’t hesitate to ask any stall vendor, they are very kind and will indicate you exactly where is the Muay they place.

The owner and the coachs are great, speak good English to train you. Price are good, 600THB for 1h20min

You can go without hesitation

Thank Han and Noi
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much my friend you're welcome see you next time 😀😀

reviews.name: Rados Paunovic
reviews.text:
Don’t let the interior of the gym throw you off - this is one of the best places to train in Bangkok. The coach is excellent and experienced as well as polite and friendly!

This was my wife’s first ever Muay Thai class and she really enjoyed it. Now she’s asking me to buy some equipment for our home gym.

If you’re not sure how to find it just ask some of the locals hanging around the stalls and they’ll point you to it, everyone knows the place.

Definitely will train again here.

reviews.name: Liam doyle
reviews.text:
As a beginner, I really enjoyed this class. Very good value, 500 baht for a private class.
The instructor did not speak much English but he can demonstrate easily what to do and how to adjust, and as a beginner you’re really working on the basics of each movement anyway so he doesn’t need to explain the moves in huge detail.
Good workout and learnt a lot, and enjoyable as instructor was very relaxed, often finding my lack of coordination quite funny, which made me feel relaxed.
I called ahead to book a time but don’t know if this was needed.

reviews.name: Raveena Poon
reviews.text:
This place is perfect for anyone looking to try or start Muay Thai training. It’s a truly local gym run by experienced, retired Muay Thai fighters who know their craft inside out. The training sessions are 1.5 hours long—much longer than the usual 1-hour classes elsewhere—and the price is also more affordable than most other options in Bangkok.

The trainers are incredibly friendly, funny, and welcoming, which makes the experience even more enjoyable. I appreciated how easy it was to book—just a quick phone call, and they were super flexible with timings. They give you their full attention throughout the class, ensure you warm up properly, and guide you through stretching and cooldown too.

It can be a bit tricky to find, tucked away in a quiet little lane. Honestly, the lane might make you feel like you won’t come out alive—but don’t worry, it’s completely safe! Just ask someone nearby if you’re unsure, and they’ll help you out.

I took two sessions here and will definitely come back for more whenever I’m in the city again. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:

Would recommend for anyone staying in Bangkok.

reviews.text: I loved this gym! İ was only going to be in Bangkok for a few days, but still wanted to train. I walked in and they were able to work with me right away. The session lasted 90 minutes and I received great feedback. They were very friendly. I will definitely go back the next time I’m in Bangkok. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Jose Amerigo Didal
reviews.text: I just pulled-up with no reservation and then former muay thai champion, Jompichit, gave me one-on-one session. Very friendly staff and good environment. I’m relatively a beginner and they can adjust in my pace. 500baht only for a champion coach is a good deal!

reviews.name: Miłosz Wawrzyniec Romaniuk
reviews.text: Hospitable trainers, friendly trainees, nice atmosphere and demanding trainings make this gym a good place for everyone who is looking for a well spent time. The training starts at 3 PM, lasts 2 hours and costs 500 THB. You can also have a personal training for 1000 THB, or even have accommodation here and train. Rather for advanced Muay Thai adepts, than for rookies.

reviews.text: Great private class. 600 thb and 1 hour 20 min long. Free bottled water. Kind instructors, and they let me take small breaks when needed. Did skipping warmup, shadowboxing and technique, 5 rounds pad work, bag work, some callisthenics and stretching at end.

Overall, great experience and I would recommend this gym to anyone who is looking for this type of vibe. 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We tried walking into a few places on a Sunday, but they were all fully booked. Luckily, we managed to get a spot here for a massage without much wait. The staff were very friendly, and the massage itself was relaxing. The only downside was that another client fell asleep and was snoring quite loudly, which disrupted the atmosphere a bit. Still, I’d recommend this spot if you’re looking to rest your feet after a long day of walking.

reviews.name: Mina Hofer
reviews.text:
I always make it a point to visit this massage boutique whenever my husband and I are in Bangkok. This time, we tried their newly expanded location on the 5th floor, and it was just as impressive as the OG spot on the 2nd floor. The service is exceptional, and the masseuses are highly skilled—they really know how to work out tension and knots.

We especially loved the Swedish and foot massages—they were exactly what we needed to reset our bodies after a long flight.

The 5th floor branch is in a quieter area, and the décor of the new boutique is elegant and calming, making it the perfect place to unwind. If you’re looking to relieve tension or work out deep muscle aches, I can’t recommend their Thai or Swedish massages enough. They’re intense in the best way, and you’ll leave feeling lighter, looser, like you are walking on cloud!

Worst massage I've had in Thailand. Paid for a 90 minute oil massage and left deeply disappointed. The therapist had essentially two techniques for the entire session, flat hand oil rubs and hooking fingers with no pressure, and never once checked in about pressure or comfort. For the price and duration, it felt like a very expensive skin moisturising session.

The finish was the cherry on top. Towel removal using a bowl of water and a towel that wasn't wrung out properly, resulting in water being dripped all over me repeatedly.

CentralWorld has so many great massage options. Save your money and try any of the neighbouring stores instead. You'll be much better off.

reviews.name: Kimberly Anne
reviews.text: Treat yourself to an escape from Bangkok’s heat and bustle, and enjoy a couple of hours in this cool, tranquil space. You will not find kinder, more personal service. I have tried other spas around Bangkok and overall, was disappointed by the disconnection during treatment -the energetic exchange was cold and impersonal (staring off into space, mentally elsewhere, or chatting in Thai through the service). THEN, enter KStory…all of the therapists from which I have had the pleasure of receiving massage (Thai, body, foot, 1 hour and 2 hour versions) here, have been attentive, warm, and engaged in the process. The owner is fluent in English and a good conversationalist, if you wish to do so. Otherwise, she and her team will work silently -diligently kneading, rubbing, stretching, and effectively melting your tension away. I enjoy deep therapy and the pressure has been on POINT. How their soft hands can maintain consistent pressure for 2 hours is both impressive and greatly appreciated. The experience is completed with a tray of soothing tea and mints. And the price…2 hours for less than the normal tip at my spa in the US. I almost feel guilty. But that’s their going rate, so give gratitude and tip generously (which is easy, given the USD to BHT conversion). This is now our go-to home spa in Bangkok. Happy to support this small business and hardworking therapists. The 5 star reviews are well-earned and it’s my sincere pleasure to promote them with my own.

reviews.name: Bryan
reviews.text:
A Five-Star Experience at Holi Icon Thailand (曼谷二店) – Exceptional Traditional Massage & Wellness Services

Nestled in the heart of Bangkok, Holi Icon Thailand’s second location offers a haven of relaxation and rejuvenation, specializing in authentic traditional therapies, including their renowned Dragon Tendon Massage (抓龙筋) and Phoenix Tendon Massage (抓凤筋), alongside expert prostate care massage (전립선 마사지). From the moment I stepped through their doors, I was greeted by a serene ambiance—warm, earthy tones, soft Thai music, and the gentle scent of herbal oils—setting the stage for a transformative experience.

My session began with a consultation to address my specific needs, ensuring the therapist tailored the treatment to my comfort and goals. The Dragon Tendon Massage, a traditional practice focusing on male reproductive and urinary health, was both invigorating and precise. The therapist’s skillful technique combined deep tissue work with gentle stretches, targeting tension and promoting circulation. I appreciated the professionalism and respect shown throughout, making even the more intimate aspects of the massage feel entirely comfortable and therapeutic.

For those seeking a holistic wellness approach, the Phoenix Tendon Massage (catering to female clients) is equally praised for its focus on pelvic health and vitality, using rhythmic strokes and herbal compresses to restore balance. The prostate massage service, while specialized, was administered with utmost care—educational, discreet, and designed to enhance overall well-being, not just physical relaxation.

What truly stands out is Holi Icon’s commitment to authenticity. Their therapists are trained in ancient Thai healing techniques, blending tradition with modern understanding of anatomy and physiology. The space itself is immaculate, with private rooms that exude tranquility, and amenities like herbal teas and warm towels that elevate the post-massage glow.

Whether you’re a local seeking relief from daily stress or a traveler looking to indulge in Thailand’s renowned wellness culture, Holi Icon Bangkok二店 delivers an exceptional experience. The combination of skilled practitioners, serene surroundings, and a menu of services that honor traditional healing makes this spot a must-visit. I left feeling balanced, revitalized, and deeply impressed by the level of care—this is wellness at its finest.

If you’re ready to treat your body and mind to a service that goes beyond relaxation, Holi Icon Thailand is where tradition meets transformation. Highly recommended for anyone seeking effective, professional, and culturally rich massage therapies in Bangkok.

Kudos to Ben, I hope to see her again when I return in a few weeks.

reviews.textTranslated: My first visit with my boyfriend was great; I had a neck, shoulder, and back massage while he had a Thai massage from an older masseuse (I didn't ask her name). They also have membership discounts, and I will probably be using this shop regularly. Highly recommend it if you want a high quality massage! 💯

I had an amazing experience at this place! The atmosphere was so relaxing and clean. I tried the sports massage, and it was incredible, my muscles felt so much better after my gym session! The masseuse was very skilled and attentive.

reviews.text: I went here twice while in Chiang Mai, and both massages were EXCEPTIONAL! The receptionist was incredibly kind and the massage therapists were well trained. Recommend this place 100%

reviews.name: Elaine Stavnitzky
reviews.text: This was recommended to me by local expats. I got a Thai massage. The masseuse had very strong hands. Ambiance is beautiful and hospitality was lovely. Staff are kind and polite. I was disappointed to learn that if I paid by credit card, I was charged in English pounds at a rate that was not so great, but as I didn't have the cash, I didn't have the option. The store is on a busy road so you can hear it over the gentle music. I would recommend bringing your ear buds.

reviews.text: I had an awesome experince at Royal Thai Massage. The premises are clean and the owner/reception staff very nice. She used many massage styles (thai, sports massage, deep tissue) according the needs of various body areas. She also carefully avoided area where there was an old injury in my back. I strongly suggest booking here via Fresha app they use as you may chose the masseuse and get fixed price for the treatment. As all was so good I left a generous tip also.

reviews.name: Shirley
reviews.text: My parents and I had the most amazing Thai massages after a long day after New Year’s. I’ve been coming to Thailand for massages for over 15 years now. Wat Pho/Chetawan centers are still the most reliable - The massage hit all the right meridian points, everything loosened up after. Wimolsiri Per, Penchan, and Asthawut did an amazing job. Wonderful full body massage. Very well-trained practitioners who understand anatomy (and not “fake” traditional massages that are just uneducated pain) - thank you!

reviews.name: Koong 8142
reviews.text: The therapist really knew what they were doing — they checked in on my pain points and figured out the problem before getting started. The pressure was perfect, and I felt so much better afterward. The staff were super kind and welcoming too. Definitely recommend if you're looking for a proper, relaxing, and healing massage experience!

reviews.name: Dejan Vidaković
reviews.text:
Don't make a mistake of coming here! 6 years I've been having Thai massages all over Bangkok. This is the worst one I've ever had and also the most expensive.

They have dual pricing for foreigners so you'll get ripped off and pay double what you would for the worst massage you'll ever get.

I didnt mind paying extra because I believed i would get massaged by professionals. Instead it was total amateurs who didn't know bone from muscle. Just so you don't think it's a one-off case, my girlfriend had it with me at the same time and hers was horrible as well.

Avoid. Avoid. Avoid

reviews.name: John Napoli
reviews.text: Amazing place. Not bougie, don't expect lux trappings (change in bathroom, common room for massages). Prices accordingly. Had the Thai massage with balm. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Mike Rattana
reviews.text: One of the best Traditional Thai Massage in Thailand. Please wear polite clothing and shower in advance prior to visiting. Highly recommended if you want an authentic Thai massage experience done by well trained specialists.

reviews.name: Y S
reviews.text:
Never recommend this massage shop for foreigners. They have double standard. For example Thai massage 60 mins for Thai people 380 bath, for foreigners 520 bath.
I have not seen massage shops offering double standard.

reviews.name: Roopa Balan
reviews.text: Calm authentic soothing place, did a traditional Thai massage with phlai oil. Full body massage with the right pressure points and stretching, fully clothed. Felt so relaxed.. don't miss it if you are in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jonathan Dunn
reviews.text: I wanted to experience the real Thai massage so I decided to come here, which supposely is the origin of traditional Thai Massage.  I quality of massage is good.  What I am puzzled by is one still needs to pay the entrance fee for the whole complex even if he/she only wants to get the massage.  The complex is big and I had issues finding the massage place.

reviews.name: Srdjan Beronja
reviews.text:
My partner and I both had great Thai massages here! Good pressure and technique - we both felt really good afterwards.
The staff is very professional, the place is clean and air conditioned, and the overall experience was quite pleasant. We'd love to come back next time we're in Bangkok!

reviews.name: Evgeniia Berger
reviews.text: My first Thai Massage experience was great. We didn’t have to wait, the masseurs were very experienced (over 20 years!) and attentive. First, you change to a traditional Thai fishermen pants and a blouse, the massage itself is performed in a hall with other people. So if you’re looking for a privacy, it is all quite open here. I loved this massage place a lot. Would come back here again.

reviews.name: Ancelikh
reviews.text:
Ive been coming to this place for ages after long flights and its really hard for me to try to understand these negative reviews that people post here.
I never never had a bad massage here, never.
I even brought all my friends here and recommended this place to all others, nobody had a bad experience.
The masseuse are professional, they know what they doing and you really get your body worked on... You feel the positive effect for days.... What else do you want ?
Highly recommended for superb massage in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Phr Tht
reviews.text:
I'd love to give 5 stars bc last time i was there i was super impressed. The staffs are good. The price is more than other places but you know you're in the good hands.
Just this time, there're Indian customers who brought kid and they talked very loud. I think you shouldn't let kids in if they (or their parents) can behave well. It kills the relaxing vibe of the other guests.

reviews.name: Mirelle Patterson
reviews.text: BEST Thai massage!! Professional, experienced staff as well lovely front of house. Was so amazing I’ve been back 2 days in row. Highly recommend for anyone travelling in Bangkok :)

reviews.text:

reviews.name: Min Lee
reviews.text: Great shop for massage, the extra baht for the service is definitely worth it

reviews.name: dino bellino
reviews.text: Best massage in Thailand, they had real technique and didn’t just follow a routine. The massage centre was nice and peaceful. Firm pressure if desired and they were inquisitive about the body rather than most massage shops who treat everybody as the same.

reviews.name: sompong vongpunsawad
reviews.text: No-nonsense legitimate traditional Thai massage for health.  Staff were trained by the Wat Pho school of therapeutic massage and so they are knowledgeable in muscle therapy.  For the uninitiated, try their 30 minute program first.  Dry massage recommended to avoid lingering herbal scent on your body.  Cash payment preferred and please remember to politely tip 10-20%.  Nowhere else in The Kingdom of Thailand will you get a more legitimate Thai-style massage.

reviews.name: Honest Review
reviews.text:
EXTREMELY RUDE AND UNPROFESSIONAL — AVOID!!!

We went in for a 1 hour foot massage. I was paired with a judgemental masseuse who was looking me up and down whilst I was brought upstairs for the massage. Little did I know she was going to be the one massaging me!

Ignoring what I thought to be irrational thoughts, I proceeded with the massage with her as my masseuse. My god it was TERRIBLE. When I requested for her to focus on my calves, she rolled her eyes at me. When I asked her to increase the pressure she took this wooden guasha stick and pressed it full force into the back of my calves and proceeded to make remarks in Thai to the other masseuses in the room and they ALL started laughing making me feel more than uncomfortable and still had the face to wait around for tips — HOW RUDE AND UNMANNERED!

TLDR: Save your money and go elsewhere, this place is definitely NOT it.

reviews.text:
Definitely going for that upmarket feel, it's a really nice, spacious, modern building.

Couple issues. First, rather hidden about their prices. Not online, and didn't tell me when I messaged them. It is a pricey place. Cheapest massages are 500 to 600 baht, many much more. Explaining things online would help with timing, as we only had an hour but many of their services are 90 minutes.

There also needs to be a better explanation on the English menu about which ones are using oil, as we didn't know we werr getting an oil massage. But that's fine, we're silly farangs.

What wasn't cool was them rushing us. They kept bugging us to start even though we werent completely changed. Even worse, at the end, it was ten minutes to closing, and they turned off the music and kinda pressured us to leave before we finished our tea. Quite unprofessional.

The actual massages were pretty good. Mine was kinda light for what I like, but my partners was good.

All in all, it's a nice if pricey place that could use a couple improvements that are probably somewhat specific to foreign clients, which are probably somewhat rare for them anyways. Perhaps for a local it would be a quite great experience.

reviews.name: Quinton Lee
reviews.text:
I rarely ever leave lowstar reviews, but my fiancé and I were really disappointed with our experience here.

We came to this massage shop after seeing many good reviews and reasonable prices, so we decided to try the cannabis oil massage. We had read that it was supposed to be a next level relaxation experience, perfect after weeks of traveling and feeling sore.

Unfortunately, it did not live up to the hype. The room atmosphere was not very comfortable, and my bed was tucked into a corner, making it hard for the masseuse to properly reach one side of my body. The massage itself felt unstructured and inconsistent, mostly light gliding with little technique. She would do a certain motion or technique on one side of my body, then completely neglect it on the other, almost rushing or half-heartedly finishing it. When she did apply stronger pressure, it was directly on my bones instead of my muscles, which was more painful than relaxing. Even after I asked for more consistent pressure, it did not improve.

The cannabis oil also did not seem to have any noticeable relaxing effect. It felt like they barely used any, leaving my skin dry and uncomfortable for most of the massage. By the end, my skin actually started feeling itchy and irritated from the friction.

We were genuinely looking forward to this, but unfortunately, it ended up being a very disappointing experience overall.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to provide such detailed feedback, Quinton. We are deeply disappointed and sincerely apologize that your experience, particularly with the premium Cannabis Oil Massage, was so far below the high standard we promise at Na Kalare Massage.

We rely on reviews like yours to correct issues immediately. We are extremely concerned by your comments regarding the inconsistent technique, direct bone pressure, poor room comfort, and the insufficient application of the oil. This experience is completely unacceptable and does not reflect the expertise of our Thai massage therapists.

We have immediately addressed the issues with the specific staff members and reviewed our protocol for the Cannabis Oil application to ensure this never happens again.

We value your patronage and would like to personally address this disappointing visit. Please contact us directly at 081-6396256 so we can offer a resolution. We genuinely hope to restore your faith in our commitment to professional wellness in Chiang Mai.

The therapists kept giggling and chatting, the chairs were uncomfortable, and the massage was so bad I needed another one afterward to recover. Washroom lighting was poor too. I don’t understand the 5-star ratings—I do not recommend this place.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Indu,

reviews.text:
センターポイントシーロムホテル周辺にはマッサージ店が多いですが、ちょっと高めです。
徒歩7-8分で1番安価なマッサージ店がここです。タイマッサージ、フットマッサージは1時間250B(1000円程度)、オイルマッサージが400Bでした。
店構えは今ひとつですが、セラピストは免許を有しているプロなので、他店と同じマッサージが2割ほど安く受けられます。
私の場合は、1回目はかなり強い施術で寝れませんでしたが、2回目はソフトマッサージを依頼したところ寝落ちしました。

追記:すぐ近くに工場直販のバッグ屋さんがあり、女性のお土産に良いかもです。
reviews.textTranslated:
There are many massage parlors around Centre Point Silom Hotel, but they are a bit pricey.
The cheapest one is here, a 7-8 minute walk away. A one-hour Thai massage or foot massage is 250 baht (about 1,000 yen), and an oil massage is 400 baht.
The store's appearance is a bit disappointing, but the therapists are licensed professionals, so you can get the same massage as other stores for about 20% cheaper.
In my case, the first time I got a massage, it was quite strong and I couldn't sleep, but the second time I asked for a softer massage and fell asleep.

PS: There's a factory-direct bag store nearby that might be a good place to buy souvenirs for women.

Siam Kempinski is one of two Kempinski hotel in Bangkok.
I mixed them up in a previous review of the Kempinskis. This hotel is very close to Siam Paragon, a huge shopping mall near Centara building.

This Siam Kempinski differs from Sindhorn Kempinski in that way that the poolarea is between the buildings at groundfloor, when I went up to Centara rooftop I spotted an additional pool on the roof to the left. Must be some kind of presidential suite private pool.

Both of Kempinskis hotel in Bangkok are of very high class. Cant wait to win on my fotball lottery to have a chance to stay at Kempinskis.
Photos speak for itselfs.
While Siam is more central,Sindhorn is more close to Lumpini.

reviews.name: berry
reviews.text:
we initially booked bangkok for 6 days but ended up extending our stay for another week, and honestly the spa became a huge part of our routine while we were there.

i have chronic back pain and a spine condition, so during the trip i ended up getting massages almost every day. a month later, my back pain still hasn’t come back, which honestly still surprises me.

over our stay i tried several treatments including the bespoke massage, traditional thai massage, aromatherapy and foot massages after long shopping days around bangkok. every therapist we had was excellent, and you can really feel the level of training and care in the way they work.

a huge thank you to bo and mew at reception, who were always so warm and kind every single time we came in. after a few visits they already remembered us and always made the whole experience feel calm and comfortable.

and a very special thank you to khun pew. she understood my back pain almost immediately and somehow always knew exactly where the tension was without me needing to explain much. i genuinely came home feeling better than i had in a very long time.

the spa itself is beautiful and peaceful, but what really stayed with me was the people there. we’ll definitely return next time we’re in bangkok. 🤍

reviews.text:
I bought 2 spa voucher for an hour each during my stay at Siam Kempinski. Booking was a bit difficult as they were so busy and the admin gave me wrong number so I couldn't reach them at first. My plan was changed, appointment was rescheduled but luckily they still had time for my rebooking.

First session - arrived early as i totally forgot that i changed the booking but the receptionist was very nice and helpful so i didn't have to wait long. The waiting room was called relaxation room and the atmosphere was just that. My treatment was in a room called Angelica. Room was a bit noisy due to AC but they put on music that help you relax, so all was well. The lavender oil was nice and time passed quicky when you enjoyed it.

Second session - my appreciation for the spa director who offered complimentary 30 minutes on top of my 60, made the experience totally memorable. The masseur was very nice, calm voice, and attentive to my every need. My skin was so soft and I felt very relax and calm.  Hot tea was served before and after.

Once again, I felt bad for not buying more vouchers. If you have a chance, do jot hesitate to try out the spa here.

ps. 8 hours later and I can still smell the lavender oil on my skin.

At no time did Hana leave me to think that this was a just a professional engagement for her and I could enjoy the moment and fantasy to the fullest.
I was shocked to read her profile that her age is on the 30’ies, I expected she would be in her late 20’ies.
I hope to be able to visit Kiss Bangkok Massage again soon.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the great review ;o)

reviews.name: Pawel K
reviews.text: Very good service, I got a girl named Anna, her services were very good, brilliant masseuse, very relaxing and soothing. She gave me a brilliant soapy massage and then a body to body one as well. Very nice and polite, very easy to speak to, a good person to talk to. Very open and inviting, very nice experience. I definitely recommend her services, the whole experience was very satisfying. 10 out of 10.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the 5 stars

reviews.name: Greg Wilbur

I spent two hours with Bella. She was wonderful, very sweet, physical and fabulously beautiful. She was much more beautiful as a person and physically (unclothed) than her pictures on the website.
Whenever I am back in Bangkok, I will seek her out at Kiss Bangkok for more.
Respect these wonderful women, ask if you can take a picture, ask what they like and respect them when they say no to any request you have.
Please tip these beautiful women, they are doing this to support themselves and their families.

reviews.name: Michael S.
reviews.text:
Whenever I am in Bangkok I always make sure to go to Kiss Massage.
I have had several 2 hour massages with Maxi and Okie, and every time has been an entirely amazing experience!
They are both beautiful, extremely energetic, responsive, and caring of my needs.
They are focused entirely on the experience, and making sure I am completely taken care of.
Thanks so much Maxi and Okie, and Kiss Massage!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: You are welcome ;0)

reviews.name: Arjun srinivas
reviews.text: I had booked a 4 hands full service massage and had a nice time with Olive and Okie (I am not sure if it's their real name as I don't see those names in the website). These 2 girls made me feel like a king. I felt like I was in heaven. Really awesome service. Hope to visit again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks a lot!

reviews.name: Jay Cee

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the 5 stars ;0)

reviews.name: Shilpa Suresh
reviews.text: My husband and I booked a couple’s massage with Jeab and Julie. I must say, their services are fantastic, even for women. Finding massage services that cater to women is quite difficult, but these girls treated us so well. I would recommend this place to any couple looking to try new things and spice it up.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much very this great review!

reviews.name: Oleksandr Puhachov (AlexWicked)
reviews.text: Great place if you want to relax. Had Jane in my room, she were so nice what I decide to come for jacuzzi and 2 girls. Jane and Friend were amazing and they make me extra happy. Definitely worth visit.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the review!

reviews.name: Willow Zhang
reviews.text: just had my best body scrub & aroma massage in a long time!! its a good experience here, unfortunately I'm flying off the next day and won't be able to revisit again

reviews.name: Chan KIN WONG
reviews.text: Had one of the best shoulder/back massage with Pin. Very detailed massage into all the muscle groups of the shoulder & back. The only thing that can be improved if they have a bed that can support the head when faced down.

reviews.name: Gergely Nagy
reviews.text: The ladies are real professionals, i had good massages and I get the kindest service there in whole Bangkok. The place is a very good example for a clean, tidy and quiet parlor. This is the place what i will definitely go, when i get back in Bangkok! Recommend with 5 star!

reviews.name: Emily Wilson
reviews.text: I came back here after finding this massage place by accident the first time. I asked for the Thai massage from Pen and she does a fantastic job. She provides a lot of stretching and digging into the tension spots. It makes for both a really therapeutic and relaxing experience. I really appreciate her work and am glad they are so close to the red train line so I can get a massage after flying!

reviews.name: R H
reviews.text: Unassuming place, but gave one of the best massages I received throughout my 4 day stay in Bangkok. I asked for a 30 minute back, shoulder and head massage and they DELIVERED! The head massage was sooo good !! Please visit if ur in the area!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your amazing experience! We're thrilled to have provided you with one of the best massages during your stay in Bangkok. Your satisfaction means the world to us, and we're delighted that our 30-minute back, shoulder, and head massage exceeded your expectations. We look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating experience soon!

reviews.name: JR JR
reviews.text:
good to stay around here, and advanced booking is needed.

cons:  staff may be busy and need to answer calls during the massage treatment
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review and for highlighting both the pros and cons. We will work on improving this to ensure a more relaxing and uninterrupted experience in the future. We look forward to welcoming you again!

reviews.name: Khaliesah N
reviews.text: enjoyed our time here so much, would have definitely booked a longer time if we had the time. very clean, with the loveliest therapists. highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the fantastic review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed your time with us and found our place clean and our therapists lovely. reviews.name: Frank Natoli
reviews.text: Came here on my last day in Bangkok but wish I came here on my first day! Hands down the best massage I received it Thailand. Got a Thai massage for a reasonable price and still feeling great days later! Will come back on my next trip to Bangkok!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Frank! We're absolutely delighted to hear that your experience with our Thai massage was the best you received in Thailand. reviews.name: Emily “지선” Yang
reviews.text: Made a reservation through LINE messenger. It's a very clean and cute massage shop and the massage chairs are super comfortable. My mom and I got foot massage and they were so good. I felt so relaxed afterwards and loved the little snack that they gave me at the end. Highly recommend!

Your recommendation means the world to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another serene and relaxing visit soon. Thank you for choosing us for your foot massage needs.

reviews.name: Nakyung Oh
reviews.text: I had a great massage from very skilled masseuses. Probably one of the best Thai massage place in this area.

reviews.text: Mac and his family are doing something incredible here. The positive and simple way of teaching Thai massage over a month long program is really incredible. Highly recommend spending a month learning here. Everyone became family. I already miss it. ✨

reviews.name: Audrey Lambert
reviews.text:
Thanks to Mac for his generosity. I have spent 4weeks here, falling during Songkran Festival in  April. Mac is always so keen to share about his beliefs and culture.
The school is a very simple, humble and rich place that brings like-minded people together.
As a massage therapist, I chose to learn Thai Massage to enhance my practice. Little did I know that I would be learning much more than that and connect with beautiful souls.
Highly recommend!

Ps: Mac’s cooking is so wholesome!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏❤️🌟Thank you very much for honoring us by coming to learn Thai massage. We will never stop improving our Thai Massage teaching techniques. Thank you again Chumphoopong family 🙏❤️😊

reviews.name: Maya Samaha
reviews.text: This school is one of the best experiences you will have as a student. Mac is a true legend and teaches ancient ways of Thai massage that have been practiced for generations. You can feel the wisdom he knows and shares is passed on with so much love and appreciation. A very special style of teaching where joy and humor is present. Not to mention he cooks delicious and healthy meals each day which are to die for!!!! Life changing experience, I can't say enough good things or express my gratitude for the 4 weeks spent at his school. A beautiful and spiritual experience that will stay with me forever.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Us Chumphoopong family thank you for coming to our massage school, we’re grateful you’ve given us other memorable moments together. We’ll try our best to keep improving and make this place better for future generations. Thank you so much again and I hope we can see each other again in the future🙏❤️

reviews.name: Danielle D
reviews.text:
I came here between April-May 2025 for a 4 weeks stay to learn about Thai massage and of course I can recommand this place.

Beside the learning process I loved the localisation in the village (only 10 minutes by walk from the main street if you walk quickly and even quicker if you rent a scooter) but not far from the city of Chiang Mai which was really accessible with the apps Grab or InDrive. And the main advantage in my view was the fact of living in the school place, not needing to run everyday for some transports and also having the possibility to practice after our courses with the students who wanted to continue and even the weekend when it wasn't the cleaning time of the school. And the school offer different type of accommodation which make it affordable for many type of budgets and type of persons.

About the learning process, as I'm a person who didn't have any professional massage skills or experiences, I don't have anything to compare with but what I can say is that I've learned a lot! I think the courses were well structured week by week about the density of contents, it seems a lot for the first weeks. Then the last one feels lighter and is refreshing as we discover different techniques day by day and by the last week, we sure are tired (maybe the hot weather enhanced the state of fatigue). Mac is a great teacher and always made the time to repeat if we needed and always was ready to answer to any questions even after the courses when he was busy.
I would say that as english isn't my mother tongue, sometimes I got lost in taking notes but luckily I was with a great bunch of students really helpful so don't hesitate if you neither is not fluent as you thought in english ahaha (but if you don't speak at all english, I would not recommand it for you).

And to finish, Mac is a great host !!!!!! Funny, easy-going, giving us great recommations and advices, and we went in nice places and restaurants when we were off and free.

Thanks a lot for those great memories Mac and wish you the best for you, your family and your school. Take care!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏Thank you very much for honoring us by coming to learn Thai Massage with our Chumphoopong family. We will continue to improve our teaching and techniques, and we will never stop developing Thai Massage. Thank again from Chumphoopong family 🙏❤️🌟😊

reviews.name: Nathan Bender
reviews.text: Thank you Mac for building such an amazing school that makes us all feel like a family. Your warm and friendly approach to teaching is awesome, and your relatable stories and humor makes us all feel relaxed and excited to learn. The course books with illustrations were extremely helpful after graduation, because they are easy to rely on when you feel stuck in your practice. In addition, the allowance to take pictures and video while in our guided practice, was undoubtedly priceless. It’s easy to pull up the pictures and video and understand the positions, where you offered corrections on the spot and documented in the pics and video. Looking forward to inviting you to our retreat center in the U.S. for workshops!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
🙏❤️Thank you so much for coming to study with us and honor our school. I’ll make sure to improve our teaching techniques and build a place where you can learn with others and enjoy your time here. I’m looking forward to come and work with you in the U.S. Thank you so much again

Chumphoopong family

reviews.name: Marc Correll
reviews.text:
On the outskirts of Chiang Mai is this treasure of a school!  Laid back, fun, friendly, Mac the teacher is a Master indeed!  I took the 4 weeks course, after already being a Thai massage therapist and learned so much and elevated my personal practice in many ways!
Mac cooks lunch for everyone M-F, vegetarian and always super tasty!  The facilities are great, shared kitchen and bathrooms!  I had the tiny house, A/C and private Bathroom.
The location is a bit away from things, but once you pick up on some short cuts, shops and food are only 10-15 minute walk away, and bikes are also available!  Night time sleeping is top notch!  Quiet and filled with the sounds of the Thai countryside!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We thank you for coming and enjoying the time spent all together not just as a class but as a community. We’ll make sure to improve our school and teachings to give the best experience to the next students.

We hope we can see each other again in the future and remember to keep practicing 🙏❤️

Deepest thanks from the Chumphoopong family

reviews.name: Marcus
reviews.text: I loved this school, being able to stay on the land under the stars and hearing the temple in the mornings were very special to me. Waking up getting a cup of coffee every morning to watch the sunrise, fantastic lunches from Mac himself. A masterful vegetarian chef who knew :D. I also loved his way of teaching, enjoy your life and your time there. The night market is a nice walk away, and chang mai isnt a long scooter ride. Mac also has group events if people there all want to go, it’s such a fun experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏🌟Thank you very much for the honor of coming to study Thai massage with our Chumphoopong family.❤️😊

reviews.name: Plantpowered.susannah
reviews.text:
I’m very happy with the decision of staying for 2 months with MAC after completing the whole course and did a border run to Laos just to come back for more!

The school is situated in a relaxing and lay back environment, 30 mins away from the centre of Chiang Mai. A wide range of accommodation options are available on the premise, with homemade vegetarian lunches provided on every school day by MAC, making the whole learning experience more enjoyable and immersive.

MAC has a great sense of humor, easy going, full of passion and patience in his teaching. He has developed his own system of teaching and in the back of his mind he wants to keep improving his teaching in anyways possible :)

Thank you so much for the teaching, MAC. Now I can have my own Thai massage practice with absolute confidence 💚
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the honor of coming to learn Thai massage with our family.

reviews.name: Donny McFarlane
reviews.text:
An amazing experience! I'm so glad I chose Mac's cosy home out in the countryside to learn Thai massage, and didn't go to the big, busy schools. I was training with a maximum of 5 other students and we had plenty of time to practice. I feel blessed to have done it this way.

I stayed at the school in the room in the house, I would suggest also staying at the school as Chiang Mai is about 20-30m drive away, but everything was great and I'll never forget the skills I learned. I will definitely go back to reinforce my learning, and catch up with Mac.

Thank you Mac and Valentino, you guys are amazing!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the honor of coming to learn Thai massage with our family.

reviews.name: Marion Roullin
reviews.text:
A friend recommended this school and it did not disappoint!

MAC is a knowledgeable and experienced teacher, as well as a generous, friendly and fun character.

Half of our time was spent watching and taking notes (we received one book per week) and then we had time to practice under his supervision.

I had no previous experience in massage (only teaching Yoga and offering energy healing), and I found week 1 and 2 quite intense on my body, "keep practicing!"

Week 3 and 4 were so much fun and really consolidated the first couple of weeks.

MAC is also a great cook and provided tasty local vegetarian food.

We also have the visit of the ice cream lady a couple of times a week :)

I had a great time with my group too and I'm very grateful for this time together. On our last day MAC and his family took us to the temple for a yearly celebration and it was a beautiful way to get blessings and close this chapter.

Thanks again MAC💛
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏🌟❤️Thank you very much for the honor of coming to study Thai massage with our Chumphoopong family.❤️💫😇

reviews.name: Henning Dammeier
reviews.text: Macs school is a true original traditional gem. From his heart he did not just create a massage school he created a community where everyone becomes part of his family. He lives the buddhistic values and is always there for support. Can’t recommend it enough this is nowadays very hard to find!! Thank you Mac and Minerva ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for coming and attending the course with us. We’ll make sure to improve more and more, trying to give the best experience to the upcoming students who wish to join us in the future.
We thank you again and hope to see you again in the next years  and remember to keep practicing! 🙏❤️

❤️Chumphoopong family❤️

reviews.name: Christian Gold
reviews.text: If you’re looking for more than just learning techniques, this school is the perfect choice. The teacher is warm, open, and creates an atmosphere where everyone can simply be themselves. It feels like a family, not a business and that makes all the difference. The daily homemade lunch is outstanding, and the people I met there became more than acquaintances, they became friends. In a world where everything often feels commercial, this place manages to keep genuine humanity at its core. If you’re serious about building a strong foundation in Thai Massage, I highly recommend starting here. The environment gives you everything you need. The rest, as always, comes down to how much you practice yourself.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
🙏 Thank you very much. That is exactly the type of experience that I’d like my students to have. I’m always very happy if, together with massage, they also get a taste of what Thai lifestyle and culture are about. I’m very grateful when people appreciate all this. 
Thank you once again for choosing my place ❤️

reviews.name: Flow Roots
reviews.text:
Best place to learn Thai massage ! Small groups of 2-12 people maximum.
Mac is a really good teacher and he cooks fantastic !
You can learn 1lvl (1week), lvl 2 (sd week), then 1 all week of practice and then the 3lvl.
In 3 weeks you are able to learn good thai massage session of 1h or 1h30 or 2h.
All the rest is your practice and time ;)

The home stay is perfect , Mac is a really good host and you can find a typical cheap local market for your food at 10 minutes bike ride.

I've stayed 1 month last year and 7 weeks this time.... such a good and healthy place!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the honor of coming to learn Thai massage with our family.

reviews.name: Zita Varga
reviews.text:
Too hard to tell in a few sentences how magical is this place!! Very authentic and informative thats for sure but is much more! Real communities can develop and Mac is absolutely holding the space,  sharing his knowledge, his home, cooking with his heart. I spent a month there and we learned a lot... the classes were always a looooot of fun but a lot to learn as well, there was always space to ask. Personally experienced a deep understanding and respect towards thai massage. Mac also drive us around to discover the local places.
I met incredible caring people what im forever greatful and i totally believe the place and energies there is calling people from all around the world who need to be there.
Thank you for everything 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏❤️🌟Thank you very much for honoring us by coming to learn Thai massage with the Chumphoopong family. We will continue to develop Thai massage techniques to be better and better forever thank again 🙏❤️🌟😊

reviews.name: N. P.
reviews.text:

reviews.name: Ggg Ggg
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with my experience at this place.

First of all, when I walked in, it felt quite dirty. Even the massage clothes had someone’s long hair on them, which immediately created a bad impression.

But that was just the beginning.

The massage room, about 10 square meters, was freezing cold. The air conditioner was set to 20°C at full power, and there was also an additional fan running. It was so cold that my hair literally stood on end — it was impossible to relax.

On top of that, there was constant loud noise coming from the corridor, which completely ruined the atmosphere.

I booked a two-hour session but could only stay for an hour and a half. I eventually got up and left because it was simply unbearable.

And the worst part happened when I shared my feedback with the administrator (who is Korean). When I explained everything, she laughed. I asked her, “Is there something funny here?” because I paid money and didn’t receive the service I expected. Instead of acknowledging the issue, she twisted my words and replied, “Why are you telling me not to smile?” — something I never said.

This reaction alone shows a complete lack of professionalism from the manager.

I do not recommend this place.

reviews.name: Софья Таранюк
reviews.text: It was the worst massage of my life. I have been living in Phuket for 6 years and have known this place since the Covid days. I haven't visited it for the last few years, but when my friend arrived, I wanted to show her a real Thai massage and booked a 3-hour package. When we entered the room, everything was covered in oil. You literally slide across the floor. Then the massage began, and we understood why. The masseuse simply pours oil on you, spreads it over one area of your body, and moves on to the next. It's hard to call it a massage. You just lie there covered in oil and don't get any pleasant sensations. The girls simply DON'T KNOW how to give a massage. It was so bad that we just wanted to get up and leave, even though we paid 1,900 baht for two for this procedure. It was evening and the administrator was no longer there. The next day, I wrote to the administrator personally on WhatsApp, she thanked me for the information and that was it. She said it was very nice of me not to bother her in the evening. I said that it would be very nice of her to offer me a solution, give me a discount on a massage with a good specialist, and refund part of the money. After that, she stopped responding. I do not recommend anyone visit this place. They will make you feel uncomfortable for your money, and you will not receive any service here either.

reviews.name: Sarinya Lee
reviews.text: Love it!!!!! Owner super nice. Very good polite masseuse. Clean spa room with bathroom, extremely able price. We enjoyed our treatments very much. A place where you can relax and enjoy pampering yourself.

reviews.text: The center is around 20 minutes drive from Patong.  It looks ordinary outside but comfortable, clean and spacious inside.  The staff are providing excellent service customers.  We are in a group of 7 people having scrub and massage and oil for 3 hours, Thai massage for 2 hours, Thai massage and oil for two hours.  We are all happy to their service with reasonable good price as compared with other massage centers in the town center.  We go back again to enjoy one more time massage before we leave this country.

reviews.text:
Don't go unless your part of a Chinese Tourbus group.
The owner made the manager rush me off to a corner somewhere to pay because she didn't want the Chinese to see it for whatever reason.  I am a normal and presentable person so it wasn't me.  It seems she doesn't care about walk ins only tour bus.  Absolutely horrible massage.  Went in for a 1 hour oil massage. She only rubbed oil on me no massage no pressure. Never going back there again and you shouldn't bother either.  Absolutely not recommended.  Negative 5 stars.

reviews.text: It was the best service and massage I've ever experienced.  But it's crowded, so I recommend making a reservation.

reviews.name: Memorable .1
reviews.text: I've visited this spa more than four times, but the last experience I had was terrible, and I'm not sure if the person I interacted with was the owner. The incident occurred before we began the massage. We paid a Spa service by the member price because I am a member, however I did not bring my membership card. I understand if they needed me to pay an additional charge. However, the manner in which she addressed my friend and me was unacceptable. She began with an upset look, presenting a bizarre scenario that was unnecessary to mention. My friend simply asked if there was any record of our past visits, looking for a solution, but her response, "This is only a spa," felt unnecessarily dismissive and emotional. I realize there may have been past issues with customers, but we did not intend to cause trouble. The 2-hour massage session last time was far from relaxing, not due to the therapists, who were excellent, but because of her demeanor towards us. Her explanations were not rude in words, but her facial expressions, reactions, and tone were unpleasant. Please do not assume that all guests are trying to take advantage of your services. I urge you to maintain a service-oriented mindset. We are paying for your services and do not expect any freebies.

reviews.name: Debbie Teo
reviews.text: DO NOT GO! terrible experience! after quoting us the price the manager/boss (korean) who was rude and unfriendly told us not to mention the price in English when a bus of Korean tourists arrived. The Thai staff however were very nice and patient but kept whispering when communicating to us which left us very puzzled. While waiting to be ushered in we were chatting and laughing at the outdoor/smoking area which was nowhere near the massage area the 'manager/boss(korean)' came over to ask us to keep quiet. We immediately walked off as it is such an unpleasant experience.

reviews.name: Tiffany Loh
reviews.text: Unpleasant experience - was greeted by a Korean (who seemed to be the manager); wasn’t interested to accept us. When a tour group of Koreans arrived, she asked us not to mentioned the price in English, and later rebuked us for being too noisy (when we were at the outdoor reception area, not even near to the massage area yet).

reviews.name: JcKnf
reviews.text: Being fairly new to massage, my wife and I didn't know what to expect when we visited Galaxy. So, like most people we went with highest rated place and we were not dissapointed. In fact, we were highly satisfied. The welcoming staff were very cordial and professional. The facility was large yet the rooms were clean, private and tranquil. And the massages were excellent. We had several different massage therapists and they all were top notch. We also came to meet and know the owner. She was very kind, down to earth, and seemed to put a lot of thought and effort in improving the quality of their massage. Overall, we ended up going back there several times more during our stay in Phuket. We would highly recommend Galaxy to all of our friends and family, and we would certainly come back for ourselves when we return to Phuket.

reviews.name: Sabrina Delphine
reviews.text: Galaxy Spa is absolutely amazing!!! It’s hidden away in Chalong area so it’s nice and quiet, and the staff are wonderfully attentive and very kind.  I had a 60 min massage and I felt brand new afterwards. There is also a new restaurant as well, so you can enjoy a full spa day! 👍

reviews.name: Linda Lewis
reviews.text: A friend recommended Khun Weaw and Pikul Thai Massage to me when I moved to Chiang Mai at the first of April. She recommended the 1 hour - gentle - aroma oil body massage since I am 78 and am under a lot of stress. I had the first massage and was so grateful for the care and expertise Khun Weaw showed. She is a master at finding the sore spots, kinks, knots, and stiff places and fixes them. I am totally relaxed when she finishes her treatment of me. She knows just how much pressure to use to improve how I feel without hurting me. I can trust her. I have since arranged a permanent session each week with Khun Weaw. I consider this part of my new health regimen of eating right, losing weight, exercising daily, becoming healthier with more stamina, better balance, more energy. I highly recommend Pikul Thai Massage. It is very clean and they make it so you can completely relax, knowing you are in wonderful hands. 5 stars are not enough!

reviews.text: This place is the 💣 💣 💣 💣 got 90 minutes Thai massage that is top notch! You may get afraid of going in there BUT do not worry! It's not a shady place lol. Wish I lived in Chiang Mai. Definitely have gone there every week before dinner in nimman!!

reviews.name: Teckharn Kuan
reviews.text:
During my 5 days trip in chiangmai, I went to Pikul Massage 4 times. The only one day that I didn’t go was that I went for a whole day trip outside chiangmai.

I came across Pikul Massage while I was wandering around Nimman on Day 2. I was lucky to have met Mr.Buncha. He’s such a humble man that he’s fully understand what he’s doing, knowing how a body functions. For someone who goes for massage very often like me, Mr.Buncha is all you can ask for. He’s humble, meticulous and so skillful. When he does his work, he will lightly press on each point to make sure he got the pressing points correct.

The place is simple but clean, and the price is very reasonable. Highly recommended!!!! ❤️❤️❤️

P/s: don’t forget to tip the masseurs, I hope they can make a decent living for being such skillful professionals! 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻

reviews.name: Bo Kazah
reviews.text: Neck pain for a month after this.(and its recurrant and comes and goes ever since then)  The old unskilled obese (zero English) lady has no idea what she's doing.  People have died during Thai massage and the best surgeon in chiang mai does not reccomend thai massage because of so many "fake massage" scam artists out there(which makes it dangerous) She kept trying to do something insane with my neck and I naturally resisted but she kept tapping me "Jai yen yen, Jai yen yen (relax)" over and over again and, one of the worst decisions of my life, I finally gave in, she bent my head down towards my chest and then did a full twist of my neck, literally the most insane thing anyone has ever done in the history of time.  Beware of this place, they have NO IDEA what a massage is, they just watched someone else give one and tried to copy, obviously.  Its 1% my fault though, for letting her near my (previously healthy and strong) neck.

reviews.name: Jason Liew
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Wanjai Thai Massage! The 300 baht fee is incredibly value for money, especially when compared to other places in Thailand. I appreciate that therapists are assigned based on gender preference, offering a comfortable experience for everyone. Opting for a smaller outlet over the larger complex proved to be a great decision for my family and me. The air-conditioned environment and ample privacy made our visit even more enjoyable. Looking forward to returning with my family soon!

Thirdly, they didn't close the curtains, so there was no privacy. While I was getting a massage, an old man looked at me and sat next to me, waiting his turn... I regret that I put up with it and didn't stop.

ownerDescription:
เราสอนมวยไทยและมวยสากล เพื่อออกกำลังกายเป็นหลักครับ เน้นกิจกรรมการล่อเป้าแบบตัวต่อตัวเพื่อเป็นการ cardio จำนวน 5-6 ยก และสลับกับการเวทครับ ลูกค้าที่ไม่มีเบสิคมาก่อนเราก็ดูแลให้ตั้งแต่เบสิคเลยครับ และเราเป็นยิมปลอด pm2.5 ด้วยครับ

ทางยิมจะรับลูกค้าจำนวนจำกัด ไม่เกิน 11 คนต่อคลาส เพื่อควบคุมคุณภาพการสอน ลูกค้าจึงต้องเช็คคิวว่างและนัดหมายล่วงหน้าทุกครั้ง ยินดีต้อนรับทุกคน และรับเด็กอายุไม่ต่ำกว่า 8 ขวบครับ

We train Muaythai and Western Boxing just for fitness. Padwork one on one with coaches like a personal training for cardio and some weight training. Accepting everyone / every level , even without the basics. And accept children no less than 8 years old. We are a PM2.5 free gym.

Please check available time and make an advance reservation.
address: 51 ซอยเมตตา Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200, Thailand
plusCode: QXM4+FV Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: SHARIF Alan
reviews.text: “This gym is truly a hidden gem. It’s air-filtered and air-conditioned. The coaches are very skilled and kind—they always try to improve your technique, correct your mistakes, and push your limits. The gym is also suitable for all levels

reviews.name: Sasi
reviews.text: Such a great Muay Thai gym experience. I’ve been training here for a few months, and it’s been consistently amazing. The instructors are incredibly supportive, fun, and know how to keep you motivated at any level. The space is air-conditioned with a PM 2.5 filter, which makes training much more comfortable. Prices are very reasonable for the quality you get, and the equipment is top-notch and well maintained. Everything is clean and organized too. Honestly, one of the best gyms in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Scott Netterwald
reviews.text:
I have been coming here for 3 months now and I am very happy with my choice of gym. The coaches are very friendly and welcoming as well as offering solid technique and training. I have also enjoyed my fellow training partners especially my sparring partners.

The gym is clean and air conditioned with plenty of air purifiers for when the seasonal burnings affect the air quality which is particularly helpful for those easily affected by air pollution.

They offer 6 rounds of padwork every session with extra rounds of sparring for those who are experienced enough and desire to do so, with guidance from coaches.

Prices are also very reasonable for the Chiang Mai area.

reviews.name: Chayanin Per
reviews.text: It’s been almost 3 months since I started, and I’ve lost 5 kilograms. The trainers are great; kind, lovely, and very skilled. They teach well and share real boxing techniques. I do 6 rounds a day, and it’s a true workout that uses both strength and skill. Majority is the music is amazing!

reviews.name: XIN Sarith Wuku
reviews.text:
I'm on a gym tour through Chiang Mai, and this was the first stop. Loved it! BIG emphasis on pad work so you get a lot of one on one time with the coaches. It's not a fight gym, but it's definitely a fun one. If yur down for a great workout and not to get your face bruised up, come to Heavy Hit!
-@thealmostlegendaryxin

reviews.name: Tanvi Rahman
reviews.text:
Easily my favorite gym in Thailand.

- Being indoors with AC and proper cooling makes training 10x better
- The trainers are fantastic. Warm, friendly, and they all speak English
- This gym cater to all skill levels
- The facilities are CLEAN. This is the only Muay Thai gym I’ve found in Thailand that actually has an accessible handwashing station.
- Phenomenal pricing
- Coaches all make time to work with you directly

reviews.name: KXTN
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and a very welcoming gym The trainers are knowledgeable, patient,and pay close attention to each student, whether you’re a beginner or already have experience The equipment is well-maintained, and every training session is both enjoyable and challenging I’ve improved my technique and fitness significantly Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Daniel Graves
reviews.text: Every time I visit Chiang Mai, I always come to Heavy Hit 3x a week. Ive been coming for about 9 months now. The teachers really care about you understanding the technique and getting great exercise. Also, it’s just fun! Highly recommend to everyone.

reviews.name: Molly Baker
reviews.text: Great Muay Thai boxing gym. I have been going inconsistently for about a year and the trainers are the best. I love this gym because it’s truly all levels. During training sessions there will be very beginner and advanced boxers. Great environment and the coaches are very accommodating with English. Clean and A/C, couldn’t recommend this gym more.

reviews.name: Rob Penhale
reviews.text: This is an excellent gym. Great atmosphere. Skilled trainers who work you through many rounds on the pads, and the owner who is one of the coaches has expert knowledge and really takes the time to improve and push you. Would highly recommend this gym.

reviews.name: Mikei Supachai Sitthiyai
reviews.text: Great experience. Im a bit nervous for the first time Thai Boxing, but all of the team are very welcome and ensure we are comfortable with the training. The session is running for 1 hr - 1.5 hrs with small group and variety of training.

reviews.name: Chee
reviews.text: Heavy Hit Boxing Gym is phenomenal! The pad work here is exceptional—truly some of the best I’ve experienced. The coaches are amazing, always bringing high energy and expertise to every session. Whether you're a beginner or more advanced, they tailor the workouts perfectly to suit your level, making sure you’re challenged but never overwhelmed. The supportive atmosphere is unmatched, and you’ll leave every class feeling stronger and more confident. If you’re looking to up your boxing game, this is the place to be!

reviews.name: Almira Khalikova
reviews.text: It's a place I've loved since my first visit. Coaches explain the sequence of exercises to the newbies. I especially like one-on-one sessions! Maybe l want a cleaner room, but not everyone cares.) After the gym, I come out in calm and peace😂

reviews.name: minnikar k
reviews.text: the best boxing gym ever! great for beginners, fun and energetic coaches, and they help you with each and every step. ❤️ love this HH fam!

reviews.name: Gerhard Pappert
reviews.text: Highly recommended, great gym. The coaches I trained with, Tuck, Frame, Bas, are all highly skilled, fun and energetic. They make you feel very welcome, care about your progress and push you. I learned a lot from training at Heavy Hit Boxing and I have great memories of my winter in Chiang Mai.  🙏🏼

reviews.name: wirinya srisawat
reviews.text: This boxing gym is amazing. I have been boxing here for over a year, and I can say that you will get more rounds with a coach than at other places in Chiang Mai. Most places I went to usually make you exercise with a punching bag, then spar with a coach for only 2-3 rounds. This place is worth my money.

reviews.name: Winnie Chung
reviews.text: Had 1 hour private class today.  5 rounds of pad work and sparring. Good experience👍

reviews.name: Eglė
reviews.text: Really nice place! It was my first time doing muay thai and people who work there were really friendly and had patience to explain the elbow move for me

reviews.name: Pete O'Callaghan
reviews.text:
I love this place.

Fun atmosphere, friendly trainers and an incredible workout.

They cater to all levels, from people who are training for the first time, to those who have been training for years.

They're all great pad-holders, with Tuck (the head trainer) in particular being one of the best I've ever trained with (and I've trained at big gyms in Bangkok and Phuket, including Sitsongpeenong and Tiger).

Nop and Frame are also great!

If you're looking to get fit and have fun training Muay Thai, this is the best place in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Gus Hardart
reviews.text: A great workout for people of any age.  Tuk and his coaches give great instruction, are fun and work you as hard as you let them.  The best HIIT workout I have ever had! Also helps develop functional core strength, flexibility and balance.  And you are learning a martial art at the same time!
